_note: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili ya maudhui ya kozi. IMETAFSIRIWA KWA MASHINE — inasubiri uhakiki wa mzungumzaji mzaliwa kabla ya kuchapishwa, kwa mujibu wa course/CLAUDE.md na Forex_Course_Style_Guide.md sehemu ya 5.
_conventions: Terminology follows course/Forex_Course_Glossary.md and Stock_Market_Terms_Glossary.md. Where those record that East African trading usage keeps the English term, it is kept — see keepAsIs below, which records the reason for every such decision so a reviewer can disagree with it.

Clock times stay in international format (10:00 asubuhi), NOT Swahili traditional time (saa nne). A trader compares these against ForexFactory or Investing.com, which show international time; converting would actively mislead. This was caught by the number-integrity gate rather than by judgement.
Percentages keep the % symbol and the numeral (40%, not 'asilimia arobaini'), so figures stay scannable in a lesson full of arithmetic and the gate can verify none were lost.
Currency amounts, price levels, ratios and dates are never re-expressed. $10,000 stays $10,000; 1.0800 stays 1.0800; 50:1 stays 50:1.
Citations — author names, journal titles, paper titles and years — stay in English. They are how a reader finds the source.

Diagram descriptions (alt text and captions) ARE translated, but the labels inside the SVG diagrams themselves are still English: they sit at fixed coordinates and Swahili runs longer, so translating them without re-running the generators would overflow the boxes.

0030b6183594.en: Risking too much per trade. Betting 10%, 20%, or an unmeasured amount on a single idea, so one bad run ends the account. Fixed by the fixed-fractional 1 to 2% rule and the position-sizing formula (Chapter 3, Lesson 1), and by keeping effective leverage low (Chapter 3, Lesson 2).
0030b6183594.sw: Kuhatarisha kupita kiasi kwa kila biashara. Kubashiri 10%, 20%, au kiasi kisichopimwa kwenye wazo moja, ili mfululizo mmoja mbaya umalize akaunti. Hurekebishwa na kanuni ya sehemu thabiti ya 1 hadi 2% na fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1), na kwa kuweka leverage halisi chini (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2).

00316ea28e9d.en: A record of every trade and whether you followed your plan, used to measure real expectancy and catch repeated mistakes.
00316ea28e9d.sw: Rekodi ya kila biashara na kama ulifuata mpango wako, inayotumika kupima matarajio halisi na kukamata makosa yanayorudiwa.

0055242b0945.en: No plan, trading on emotion. Entering because a chart looks ready rather than because a written rule was met. Fixed by the trading plan in Lesson 2 and the pre-committed exits in Lesson 1.
0055242b0945.sw: Hakuna mpango, kufanya biashara kwa hisia. Kuingia kwa sababu chati inaonekana tayari badala ya kwa sababu kanuni iliyoandikwa ilikidhiwa. Hurekebishwa na mpango wa biashara katika Somo la 2 na kutoka kulikojitolewa mapema katika Somo la 1.

0086c55723d9.en: A process where independent experts evaluate a study's methodology and findings before publication, specifically to catch errors or unsupported conclusions.
0086c55723d9.sw: Mchakato ambapo wataalamu huru hutathmini mbinu na matokeo ya utafiti kabla ya kuchapishwa, mahususi ili kubaini makosa au hitimisho lisilo na ushahidi.

00aa3270ed3b.en: The gap between the forecast and the actual result — what actually moves price.
00aa3270ed3b.sw: Pengo kati ya utabiri na tokeo halisi — ndicho kinachosogeza bei hasa.

00e1e0a68304.en: Not quite. The spread describes the gap between the best bid and best ask; it says nothing about how many shares are available at those prices. Thin volume means a large order works through worse and worse levels.
00e1e0a68304.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Spread hueleza pengo kati ya bid bora na ask bora; haisemi chochote kuhusu hisa ngapi zinapatikana kwa bei hizo. Kiasi chembamba kinamaanisha agizo kubwa hufanya kazi kupitia viwango vibaya zaidi na zaidi.

00e28cf9724e.en: An asset that specifically holds zero or negative correlation during periods of market stress — even if it behaves completely differently the rest of the time.
00e28cf9724e.sw: Mali inayoshikilia mahususi uwiano wa sifuri au hasi wakati wa vipindi vya shinikizo la soko — hata kama inatenda tofauti kabisa wakati mwingine wote.

00f1c60dd7c6.en: That definition contains the most important honest sentence in this entire chapter: an indicator can only ever highlight something that is already visible in price itself. Since every indicator is computed from the prices on your screen, it cannot know anything the chart doesn't already contain. The reason traders use them anyway is practical, not magical — a good indicator makes a pattern easier to see and act on consistently.
00f1c60dd7c6.sw: Maana hiyo ina sentensi muhimu zaidi ya uaminifu katika sura hii nzima: kiashiria kinaweza tu kuangazia kitu ambacho tayari kinaonekana katika bei yenyewe. Kwa kuwa kila kiashiria hukokotolewa kutoka bei zilizo kwenye skrini yako, hakiwezi kujua chochote ambacho chati haina tayari. Sababu wafanyabiashara huvitumia hata hivyo ni ya kivitendo, si ya kimuujiza — kiashiria kizuri hurahisisha kuona mtindo na kuchukua hatua kwa uthabiti.

0124ce9643be.en: Without a shared medium of exchange, both sides need to want exactly what the other has, at the same time.
0124ce9643be.sw: Bila njia ya pamoja ya kubadilishana, pande zote mbili zinahitaji kutaka hasa kile ambacho mwenzake anacho, kwa wakati mmoja.

024ee2918092.en: The specific price, or condition, at which your thesis is proven wrong and the reason for the trade no longer holds. It is where your stop-loss belongs — not at an arbitrary distance, but where being wrong becomes a fact.
024ee2918092.sw: Bei mahususi, au hali, ambapo nadharia yako inathibitishwa kuwa batili na sababu ya biashara haishikilii tena. Ndipo stop-loss yako inapostahili kuwa — si kwa umbali wa bahati nasibu, bali pale kukosea kunapokuwa ukweli.

0251b34f14b6.en: The reasoning is simple enough to hold in your head: to break even, total winnings must equal total losses, so (win rate times reward) must equal (loss rate times risk). Solve that and the winning fraction is 1 / (1 + R). You do not need to memorise the algebra — you need to remember that a better reward-to-risk ratio lowers the win rate you need, and a worse one raises it, fast.
0251b34f14b6.sw: Hoja ni rahisi vya kutosha kuishikilia kichwani: ili kulingana, jumla ya ushindi lazima ilingane na jumla ya hasara, hivyo (kiwango cha ushindi mara tuzo) lazima kilingane na (kiwango cha hasara mara hatari). Tatua hilo na sehemu ya ushindi ni 1 / (1 + R). Huhitaji kukariri aljebra — unahitaji kukumbuka kwamba uwiano bora wa tuzo-kwa-hatari hushusha kiwango cha ushindi unachohitaji, na mbaya huupandisha, kwa kasi.

0279f048eff5.en: The same 40.00, rearranged. The arrangement is what feels different.
0279f048eff5.sw: Ile ile 40.00, ikipangwa upya. Mpangilio ndio unaohisi tofauti.

02d76127f279.en: Correct — discipline means following a plan committed to in advance, so the important decisions are not made live at all. It is a system that removes in-the-moment choices, not a feeling you summon.
02d76127f279.sw: Sahihi — nidhamu inamaanisha kufuata mpango uliojitolewa mapema, ili maamuzi muhimu yasifanywe hai kabisa. Ni mfumo unaoondoa chaguo za papo hapo, si hisia unayoiita.

02db2a5f0d72.en: Here is the technique that separates a careful trader from a merely confident one. Before entering, you deliberately assume the trade has already failed, and work backwards to why.
02db2a5f0d72.sw: Hii hapa mbinu inayotenganisha mfanyabiashara makini na anayejiamini tu. Kabla ya kuingia, unadhania kwa makusudi kwamba biashara tayari imeshindwa, na unafanya kazi kurudi nyuma hadi sababu.

02e981aac3dd.en: When the Swiss National Bank abandoned its EUR/CHF floor in 2015, stops and stop-outs failed in the liquidity vacuum — and the traders who survived were not the ones who predicted it, but the ones sized small enough to be wrong.
02e981aac3dd.sw: Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilipoacha sakafu yake ya EUR/CHF mwaka 2015, stop na stop-out zilishindwa katika ombwe la ukwasi — na wafanyabiashara walionusurika hawakuwa wale walioitabiri, bali wale waliopimwa wadogo vya kutosha kukosea.

030362c6552f.en: The rule capping a shareholder's loss at what they paid for the shares.
030362c6552f.sw: Kanuni inayoweka kikomo cha hasara ya mwanahisa kwa kile alicholipia hisa.

0346c57f95f4.en: Your broker's platform usually shows a pip-value or position-size calculator, and you should use it — it does this arithmetic for you at live rates. Understanding the mechanism is still worth it for one reason: it lets you sanity-check the tool. The most common calculator error is having it set to the wrong account currency, which produces exactly the kind of silent mis-sizing above. A number you can check is safer than a number you have to trust.
0346c57f95f4.sw: Jukwaa la broker wako kwa kawaida huonyesha kikokotoo cha thamani ya pip au ukubwa wa nafasi, na unapaswa kukitumia — hufanya hesabu hii kwa niaba yako kwa viwango vya moja kwa moja. Kuelewa utaratibu bado kunastahili kwa sababu moja: kunakuruhusu kukagua uzima wa zana. Kosa la kawaida zaidi la kikokotoo ni kuwa limewekwa kwa sarafu isiyo sahihi ya akaunti, ambako huzalisha hasa aina ya upimaji mbaya wa kimyakimya hapo juu. Namba unayoweza kuikagua ni salama zaidi kuliko namba unayolazimika kuiamini.

0418ca506f20.en: A result that flips with the exit rule chosen is fragile — the same data-snooping caution from Lesson 5
0418ca506f20.sw: Tokeo linalobadilika kutegemea kanuni ya kutoka iliyochaguliwa ni dhaifu — tahadhari ile ile ya kupekua data kutoka Somo la 5

04379d1cb346.en: Total profit rises from 100 million to 110 million, a 10% improvement. Over the same period the share count rises from 50 million to 60 million to fund an acquisition. Earnings per share fall from 2.00 to about 1.83. The company grew and each owner's slice shrank.
04379d1cb346.sw: Faida ya jumla hupanda kutoka milioni 100 hadi milioni 110, uboreshaji wa 10%. Katika kipindi kile kile idadi ya hisa hupanda kutoka milioni 50 hadi milioni 60 kufadhili ununuzi. Mapato kwa kila hisa hushuka kutoka 2.00 hadi takriban 1.83. Kampuni ilikua na kipande cha kila mmiliki kilipungua.

043bf5e76bb2.sw: RSI juu ya 70 / chini ya 30 — ununuzi au uuzaji wa hivi karibuni wa upande mmoja.

04a24b550eb8.sw: Kukubali hatari lakini kuweka kikomo cha kiasi inachoweza kukugharimu.

04cd0ccdc5a9.en: With no fee at all, 10,000 becomes about 76,123. At an expense ratio of 0.05%, typical of a broad index ETF, it becomes about 75,063. At 0.75% it becomes about 61,641. At 1.50%, a level not unusual for an actively managed fund plus an adviser, it becomes about 49,840.
04cd0ccdc5a9.sw: Bila ada kabisa, 10,000 hukuwa takriban 76,123. Kwa uwiano wa gharama wa 0.05%, wa kawaida kwa ETF pana ya index, hukuwa takriban 75,063. Kwa 0.75% hukuwa takriban 61,641. Kwa 1.50%, kiwango kisicho cha kawaida kwa fund inayosimamiwa kwa bidii pamoja na mshauri, hukuwa takriban 49,840.

04d61f25c6ee.en: This is one of those claims that gets repeated everywhere in trading education. Unusually, it's also been rigorously tested — and it holds up.
04d61f25c6ee.sw: Hili ni mojawapo ya madai yanayorudiwa kila mahali katika elimu ya biashara. Isivyo kawaida, pia limejaribiwa kwa ukali — na linashikilia.

04e53d28db3b.en: A 20-period MA with bands ±2 standard deviations, widening with volatility.
04e53d28db3b.sw: MA ya vipindi 20 yenye kanda za ±2 za mkengeuko sanifu, zinazopanuka kulingana na mtikisiko.

05bed71ba96a.en: An instruction to buy or sell only at a specified price or better. Guarantees price. Does not guarantee execution — it may never fill if the market doesn't reach your level.
05bed71ba96a.sw: Maelekezo ya kununua au kuuza kwa bei iliyobainishwa au bora zaidi tu. Huhakikisha bei. Haihakikishi utekelezaji — inaweza isitimizwe kamwe kama soko halitafikia kiwango chako.

0621e04e3143.en: Executes only at a specified price or better.
0621e04e3143.sw: Hutekelezwa kwa bei iliyobainishwa au bora zaidi tu.

06388de79eab.en: Premiums and discounts widen exactly when you would least want them to. If the underlying market is closed, illiquid or falling fast, an authorised participant cannot price or trade the basket reliably, and the arbitrage that normally closes the gap weakens. ETFs holding hard-to-trade assets — small foreign markets, corporate bonds — show this most. The mechanism is strongest in the calm conditions where you need it least.
06388de79eab.sw: Malipo ya ziada na punguzo hupanuka hasa wakati ambao ungependa yasipanuke. Kama soko la msingi limefungwa, halina ukwasi au linashuka kwa kasi, mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa hawezi kuweka bei au kufanyia biashara kikapu kwa kutegemewa, na arbitrage inayofunga pengo kwa kawaida hudhoofika. ETF zinazoshikilia mali ngumu kufanyiwa biashara — masoko madogo ya kigeni, hatifungani za kampuni — huonyesha hili zaidi. Utaratibu una nguvu zaidi katika hali tulivu ambapo unauhitaji kidogo zaidi.

0652c5c72b57.en: A company earns 100 in revenue. Suppliers take 40, staff take 35, interest on debt takes 10, and tax takes 5. The residual is 10, and it belongs to the shareholders — either paid out or reinvested on their behalf. If revenue had been 90 instead, the first four claims would still take 90, and the residual would be zero.
0652c5c72b57.sw: Kampuni hupata 100 ya mapato. Wasambazaji huchukua 40, wafanyakazi huchukua 35, riba ya deni huchukua 10, na kodi huchukua 5. Mabaki ni 10, na ni ya wanahisa — yakilipwa au kuwekezwa upya kwa niaba yao. Kama mapato yangekuwa 90 badala yake, madai manne ya kwanza bado yangechukua 90, na mabaki yangekuwa sifuri.

066332ca2f88.en: A yield that rises sharply without the dividend changing is a price signal, not an income opportunity. It usually means the market expects the payment to be cut. Screening for the highest yields, without asking why they are high, systematically selects for exactly the companies about to reduce them.
066332ca2f88.sw: Mavuno yanayopanda kwa kasi bila gawio kubadilika ni ishara ya bei, si fursa ya mapato. Kwa kawaida humaanisha soko linatarajia malipo yatapunguzwa. Kuchuja kwa mavuno makubwa zaidi, bila kuuliza kwa nini yako makubwa, huchagua kwa utaratibu hasa kampuni zinazokaribia kuyapunguza.

069ae24c73d3.en: Your balance is settled cash — it only changes when a trade is closed. Equity is balance plus the floating profit or loss of trades still open. The moment you open a position, the two can diverge, and every risk measure that matters is built on equity, not balance.
069ae24c73d3.sw: Salio lako ni fedha zilizotatuliwa — hubadilika tu biashara inapofungwa. Usawa ni salio pamoja na faida au hasara inayoelea ya biashara bado zilizo wazi. Wakati unapofungua nafasi, hizo mbili zinaweza kutofautiana, na kila kipimo cha hatari kinachohusika kimejengwa juu ya usawa, si salio.

06a1e205d117.en: The break-even win rate for each ratio, and three traders whose win rates hide who actually makes money.
06a1e205d117.sw: Kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana kwa kila uwiano, na wafanyabiashara watatu ambao viwango vyao vya ushindi huficha ni nani anayepata pesa hasa.

06c0b2dca788.en: Neither, because tracking difference is unrelated to investor returns
06c0b2dca788.sw: Hakuna, kwa sababu tofauti ya kufuatilia haihusiani na faida za wawekezaji

06d1900f2d54.en: A flash crash is not really about the news that started it. It is about a market so thin that a modest imbalance meets no resistance, and automated stop and hedging orders feed on each other. The same sell order that barely moves price during the busy London afternoon can crater it at one in the morning. Liquidity, not headlines, decided how far this move went.
06d1900f2d54.sw: Anguko la ghafla kwa kweli halihusu habari zilizolianzisha. Linahusu soko jembamba mno kiasi kwamba kutolingana kwa kiasi hukutana na upinzani wowote, na maagizo ya kiotomatiki ya stop na ya kulinda hujilisha wenyewe kwa wenyewe. Agizo lile lile la kuuza ambalo halisogezi bei sana wakati wa mchana wenye shughuli wa London linaweza kuliporomosha saa saba usiku. Ukwasi, si vichwa vya habari, ndio uliamua msogeo huu ulikwenda mbali kiasi gani.

06d57e1c8d80.en: Correct — a journal's main value is measuring your real expectancy and revealing the mistakes you repeat. It is how you tell a losing system from a winning one in a drawdown, and how you actually improve.
06d57e1c8d80.sw: Sahihi — thamani kuu ya kumbukumbu ni kupima matarajio yako halisi na kufichua makosa unayoyarudia. Ndivyo unavyotofautisha mfumo unaopoteza na unaoshinda katika kushuka, na ndivyo unavyoboreka hasa.

0709e16d7ccc.en: No single pillar is a trade. A cheap currency can stay cheap for years without a catalyst; strong momentum with terrible valuation is how bubbles end. The point of six pillars is that any one can be wrong — conviction comes from independent agreement, the same logic as not trusting a single indicator in Chapter 2, Lesson 1.
0709e16d7ccc.sw: Hakuna nguzo moja ni biashara. Sarafu rahisi inaweza kubaki rahisi kwa miaka bila kichocheo; kasi kali yenye uthaminishaji mbaya ndivyo mapovu yanavyoisha. Kusudi la nguzo sita ni kwamba yoyote inaweza kuwa batili — uhakika hutoka kwenye makubaliano huru, mantiki ile ile ya kutoamini kiashiria kimoja katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 1.

076459059650.en: There is a strong pull to do the opposite — to grab small profits quickly and give losing trades room to recover. That instinct feels like winning because it raises your win rate, but it is Trader C above, and it is a losing pattern with a comforting face. The psychology behind it, and how to build a plan that resists it, is Chapter 4.
076459059650.sw: Kuna mvuto mkali wa kufanya kinyume — kunyakua faida ndogo kwa haraka na kuzipa biashara za hasara nafasi ya kupona. Silika hiyo huhisi kama kushinda kwa sababu hupandisha kiwango chako cha ushindi, lakini ni Mfanyabiashara C hapo juu, na ni mtindo wa hasara wenye uso wa kufariji. Saikolojia iliyo nyuma yake, na jinsi ya kujenga mpango unaoupinga, ni Sura ya 4.

08496018b086.en: Stake 1 unit on one number. You win 35 units with probability 1 in 37, and lose 1 unit with probability 36 in 37. The average outcome is (35 divided by 37) minus (36 divided by 37), which is about minus 0.027. Repeat it a thousand times and the average result is a loss of about 27 units, regardless of any streak along the way.
08496018b086.sw: Weka kipimo 1 juu ya namba moja. Unashinda vipimo 35 kwa uwezekano wa 1 kati ya 37, na kupoteza kipimo 1 kwa uwezekano wa 36 kati ya 37. Tokeo la wastani ni (35 kugawanywa kwa 37) toa (36 kugawanywa kwa 37), ambayo ni takriban toa 0.027. Rudia mara elfu na tokeo la wastani ni hasara ya takriban vipimo 27, bila kujali mfululizo wowote njiani.

086c57f5744d.en: That ability turns any gap between the ETF price and its NAV into a profit opportunity, and pursuing the profit closes the gap.
086c57f5744d.sw: Uwezo huo hugeuza pengo lolote kati ya bei ya ETF na NAV yake kuwa fursa ya faida, na kufukuza faida hufunga pengo.

08a8469b3f97.en: This is a satisfying result because it is not circular. The levels are not self-fulfilling magic; they work because of a concrete, measurable feature of how orders (Chapter 1, Lesson 7) are actually placed. Support and resistance earn their place on the naked chart.
08a8469b3f97.sw: Hili ni tokeo la kuridhisha kwa sababu si la mzunguko. Viwango si uchawi unaojitimiza; hufanya kazi kwa sababu ya kipengele halisi kinachopimika cha jinsi maagizo (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7) yanavyowekwa hasa. Msaada na upinzani hujipatia nafasi yao kwenye chati tupu.

08afccdf7d64.en: There is a structural argument here too, and it is unusually clean. William Sharpe set it out in 1991 in the Financial Analysts Journal (volume 47, issue 1, pages 7 to 9), in a paper called The Arithmetic of Active Management.
08afccdf7d64.sw: Kuna hoja ya kimuundo hapa pia, na ni safi isivyo kawaida. William Sharpe aliieleza mwaka 1991 katika Financial Analysts Journal (juzuu 47, toleo 1, kurasa 7 hadi 9), katika karatasi iliyoitwa The Arithmetic of Active Management.

08cee491361c.en: The price at which you open a position.

099cb718e0e9.en: The fraction of the account risked per trade
099cb718e0e9.sw: Sehemu ya akaunti inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara

0a56de2a3725.en: EUR/USD shows a bid of 1.08500 and an ask of 1.08510. The spread is 0.00010 — one pip. On a standard lot (100,000 units), one pip is worth roughly $10, so this trade costs about $10 the moment you open it, before the market has moved at all in either direction.
0a56de2a3725.sw: EUR/USD inaonyesha bid ya 1.08500 na ask ya 1.08510. Spread ni 0.00010 — pip moja. Kwenye lot sanifu (vipimo 100,000), pip moja ina thamani ya takriban $10, hivyo biashara hii inagharimu takriban $10 wakati unapoifungua tu, kabla soko halijasogea kabisa upande wowote.

0aa591719d9a.en: The logic follows everything the course has taught. A central bank changes rates or signals a change (Chapter 2, Lesson 3). That reprices currencies and government bonds first, because they are closest to interest rates. Changing borrowing costs then feed into credit and company earnings, moving equities. Growth and rate expectations move commodities. And the most risk-sensitive assets — including cryptocurrencies — swing the most, because they sit at the far, high-beta end of the risk spectrum.
0aa591719d9a.sw: Mantiki hufuata kila kitu kozi imefundisha. Benki kuu hubadilisha viwango au huashiria mabadiliko (Sura ya 2, Somo la 3). Hilo hupanga upya bei za sarafu na hatifungani za serikali kwanza, kwa sababu ziko karibu zaidi na viwango vya riba. Gharama za kukopa zinazobadilika kisha hupenya hadi mikopo na mapato ya kampuni, zikisogeza hisa. Matarajio ya ukuaji na viwango husogeza bidhaa. Na mali nyeti zaidi kwa hatari — ikiwemo sarafu za crypto — huyumba zaidi, kwa sababu zinakaa mwisho wa mbali, wa beta kubwa wa wigo wa hatari.

The ratio is 130%, the shortfall is being funded from somewhere else, and the yield on the screen is describing a payment rather than a promise.
0aff70813b61.sw: Kampuni hupata 3.00 kwa hisa na hulipa 1.20. Uwiano wa malipo ni 40%, na mapato yangeweza kushuka kwa zaidi ya nusu kabla gawio halijafunikwa. Nyingine hupata 1.00 na hulipa 1.30. Uwiano ni 130%, upungufu unafadhiliwa kutoka mahali pengine, na mavuno kwenye skrini yanaeleza malipo badala ya ahadi.

0b00121dcd8f.en: Correct. Tracking a rule means following it, including when it changes membership. Many funds trading the same names at the same moment is an expensive way to trade, and the cost comes out of fund assets — one of the reasons a fund never matches its index exactly.
0b00121dcd8f.sw: Sahihi. Kufuatilia kanuni kunamaanisha kuifuata, ikiwemo inapobadilisha uanachama. Fund nyingi zikifanya biashara ya majina yale yale wakati mmoja ni njia ghali ya kufanya biashara, na gharama hutoka kwenye mali za fund — mojawapo ya sababu fund haifanani na index yake hasa.

0c9ad6159424.sw: Msemo "iliyobaki" ndio unafanya kazi katika sentensi hiyo. Kampuni hulipa wasambazaji wake, wafanyakazi wake, wakopeshaji wake na bili yake ya kodi kwanza. Wanahisa ni wa mwisho kwenye foleni. Kinachowafikia ni mabaki.

0ccb53ffd1ac.sw: Kiwango cha ubadilishaji kinachoamuliwa na ugavi na mahitaji ya soko huria, badala ya kuwekwa thabiti au kufungwa kwa makubaliano ya serikali.

0ccf2b04b3f8.en: Not quite. Market orders take whatever is available, so you buy at the ask (41.10) and sell at the bid (40.90). That is a loss of 0.20 per share even though the quoted price never moved. Only a resting limit order can avoid paying the spread — at the risk of not trading at all.
0ccf2b04b3f8.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Maagizo ya soko huchukua chochote kinachopatikana, hivyo unanunua kwa ask (41.10) na kuuza kwa bid (40.90). Hiyo ni hasara ya 0.20 kwa kila hisa ingawa bei iliyonukuliwa haikusogea kamwe. Agizo la kikomo linalopumzika tu ndilo linaloweza kuepuka kulipa spread — kwa hatari ya kutofanya biashara kabisa.

0cd0870529fb.sw: Forex na hisa ni masoko yanayofanana kabisa
