0ce8bd816121.sw: Msimamizi wa fund huweka upya bei ya ETF kwa mkono hadi 50.00

0cf4a19210a7.en: A fund with a slightly higher fee but tighter tracking can leave you better off than a cheaper one that lags. The advertised fee is the headline; the tracking difference is the result. Both are worth checking, and the next lesson explains why even small differences matter so much over time.
0cf4a19210a7.sw: Fund yenye ada kubwa kidogo lakini kufuatilia kwa ukaribu zaidi inaweza kukuacha bora zaidi kuliko ile ya bei nafuu inayokawia. Ada iliyotangazwa ni kichwa cha habari; tofauti ya kufuatilia ni tokeo. Vyote viwili vinastahili kukaguliwa, na somo lijalo linaeleza kwa nini hata tofauti ndogo zinahusika sana.

0cfc3c50f91e.en: Step back and the six chapters form one process. The mechanics (Chapter 1) let you place a trade. Reading the market (Chapter 2) and the case studies (Chapter 5) tell you what is happening and how it can go wrong. Risk management (Chapter 3) keeps you alive. Psychology and the plan (Chapter 4) make you follow your own rules. And this chapter assembles them into how a professional actually works: build a six-pillar thesis, define its invalidation and pre-mortem it, place it only in a suitable regime, size it against the risk of ruin, weight toward your best ideas, and review the decision afterwards. That loop, run honestly and repeatedly, is the whole craft.
0cfc3c50f91e.sw: Rudi nyuma na sura sita huunda mchakato mmoja. Utaratibu (Sura ya 1) hukuruhusu kuweka biashara. Kusoma soko (Sura ya 2) na uchunguzi wa matukio (Sura ya 5) hukuambia kinachotokea na jinsi kinavyoweza kwenda vibaya. Usimamizi wa hatari (Sura ya 3) hukuweka hai. Saikolojia na mpango (Sura ya 4) hukufanya ufuate kanuni zako mwenyewe. Na sura hii huviunganisha kuwa jinsi mtaalamu anavyofanya kazi hasa: jenga nadharia ya nguzo sita, fafanua kuvunjika kwake na uifanyie pre-mortem, iweke tu katika hali inayoifaa, ipime dhidi ya hatari ya kufilisika, elekeza uzito kwenye mawazo yako bora, na upitie uamuzi baadaye. Mzunguko huo, ukiendeshwa kwa uaminifu na kurudiwa, ndio ufundi wote.

0d2dae1ef11c.en: Not quite — effective leverage is position divided by equity, so the 2,000 dollar account runs 25:1 versus 5:1 and is called after a far smaller move.
0d2dae1ef11c.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — leverage halisi ni nafasi kugawanywa kwa usawa, hivyo akaunti ya dola 2,000 huendesha 25:1 dhidi ya 5:1 na huitwa baada ya msogeo mdogo mno.

0d3d099288b2.en: The same effect on a contribution schedule: 200 a month for 30 years at 7% gross is 72,000 of your own money paid in. At 0.05% it grows to about 241,601. At 1.50% it grows to about 182,722. The 58,879 difference is close to what you contributed over the first twenty-four years.
0d3d099288b2.sw: Athari ile ile juu ya ratiba ya michango: 200 kwa mwezi kwa miaka 30 kwa 7% ghafi ni 72,000 za pesa zako mwenyewe ulizoingiza. Kwa 0.05% hukua hadi takriban 241,601. Kwa 1.50% hukua hadi takriban 182,722. Tofauti ya 58,879 iko karibu na kile ulichochangia katika miaka ishirini na minne ya kwanza.

0d99e8c125f9.en: On January 15, 2015, the Swiss National Bank unexpectedly removed a floor it had defended for over three years, promising to hold EUR/CHF at 1.20 "with the utmost determination." Without warning, they abandoned it — and cut interest rates further into negative territory in the same announcement. EUR/CHF collapsed from 1.20 to as low as 0.85 within minutes. Every stop-loss order set anywhere near 1.20 triggered correctly and converted to a market order exactly as designed — but there was no buyer waiting nearby to fill them. Orders that should have closed near 1.19 or 1.15 instead filled at 0.90 or worse, if they filled at all. Alpari UK declared insolvency that same day. FXCM absorbed $225 million in client losses and needed an emergency bailout to survive. Many individual traders discovered they owed their broker more than their entire account balance, from a single trade.
0d99e8c125f9.sw: Tarehe 15 Januari 2015, Benki Kuu ya Uswisi iliondoa bila kutarajiwa sakafu iliyokuwa ikiitetea kwa zaidi ya miaka mitatu, ikiahidi kushikilia EUR/CHF kwa 1.20 "kwa uamuzi wa hali ya juu." Bila onyo, waliiacha — na kupunguza viwango vya riba zaidi hadi eneo hasi katika tangazo lile lile. EUR/CHF ilianguka kutoka 1.20 hadi chini kama 0.85 ndani ya dakika chache. Kila agizo la stop-loss lililowekwa popote karibu na 1.20 lilianzishwa kwa usahihi na kugeuka kuwa agizo la soko hasa kama lilivyoundwa — lakini hakukuwa na mnunuzi aliyesubiri karibu kulitimiza. Maagizo yaliyopaswa kufunga karibu na 1.19 au 1.15 badala yake yalitimizwa kwa 0.90 au vibaya zaidi, kama yalitimizwa kabisa. Alpari UK ilitangaza kufilisika siku hiyo hiyo. FXCM ilifyonza hasara za wateja za $225 milioni na ikahitaji uokoaji wa dharura ili kuendelea kuishi. Wafanyabiashara wengi binafsi waligundua walikuwa wanadaiwa na broker wao zaidi ya salio lote la akaunti yao, kutokana na biashara moja.

0dbc6cb78124.en: To celebrate a trade that worked

0dc4e36270d0.en: Every trade you place has two distances built into it: how far price can go against you before your stop-loss closes it, and how far it can go in your favour before you take profit. The relationship between those two distances is the most important number in a trading plan that Foundations Chapter 2 kept pointing toward without naming.
0dc4e36270d0.sw: Kila biashara unayoiweka ina umbali miwili iliyojengwa ndani yake: umbali ambao bei inaweza kwenda dhidi yako kabla stop-loss yako haijaifunga, na umbali ambao inaweza kwenda kwa manufaa yako kabla hujachukua faida. Uhusiano kati ya umbali hizo mbili ndio namba muhimu kuliko zote katika mpango wa biashara ambao Sura ya 2 ya Msingi iliendelea kuuelekeza bila kuutaja.

0def72a6ac5f.en: A live percentage measure of account equity relative to margin currently in use, calculated as (Equity ÷ Used Margin) × 100.
0def72a6ac5f.sw: Kipimo hai cha asilimia cha usawa wa akaunti ikilinganishwa na margin inayotumika sasa, kinachokokotolewa kama (Usawa ÷ Margin Iliyotumika) × 100.

0df07daaee51.en: Nothing enforces the link between an ETF price and what it holds. An incentive does, and it weakens under stress.
0df07daaee51.sw: Hakuna kinacholazimisha uhusiano kati ya bei ya ETF na kile inachoshikilia. Motisha ndiyo hufanya hivyo, na hudhoofika chini ya shinikizo.

0e59fa1db1cb.en: Chasing news. Jumping into a high-impact event with no evidence for how that release behaves. Fixed by checking the economic calendar and sitting out events you have not personally studied (Chapter 2, Lesson 4).
0e59fa1db1cb.sw: Kufukuza habari. Kuruka ndani ya tukio lenye athari kubwa bila ushahidi wa jinsi toleo hilo linavyotenda. Hurekebishwa kwa kukagua kalenda ya kiuchumi na kukaa nje ya matukio ambayo hujayasoma binafsi (Sura ya 2, Somo la 4).

0edd2cf33fe6.en: Pull up any major pair on a free charting tool, add a 20 and a 50 SMA, and scroll back through six months of history. Count the crossover signals. How many would have been profitable trades, and how many were whipsaws? Notice where the whipsaws cluster — trending stretches or sideways stretches?
0edd2cf33fe6.sw: Fungua jozi lolote kuu kwenye zana ya bure ya kuchora chati, ongeza SMA ya 20 na 50, na tembeza nyuma katika miezi sita ya historia. Hesabu ishara za mikatizo. Ni ngapi zingekuwa biashara zenye faida, na ngapi zilikuwa whipsaw? Tambua whipsaw zinapojikusanya — vipindi vya mwelekeo au vipindi vya kando?

0ee94db5bf05.en: A general decline in prices across an economy over time.
0ee94db5bf05.sw: Kushuka kwa jumla kwa bei katika uchumi kwa muda.

0f1778f89320.en: A price chart carrying no indicators at all: just the candles, and often a few hand-drawn support and resistance lines. The name signals what has been removed.
0f1778f89320.sw: Chati ya bei isiyobeba viashiria kabisa: mishumaa tu, na mara nyingi mistari michache ya msaada na upinzani iliyochorwa kwa mkono. Jina linaashiria kilichoondolewa.

0f295de672ac.en: Correct — their finding is that managers' best-analysed ideas outperform, where the case is strongest, not where the feeling is strongest. It is an argument for rigour, not confidence.
0f295de672ac.sw: Sahihi — tokeo lao ni kwamba mawazo yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi ya wasimamizi hufanya vizuri zaidi, pale hoja ilipo imara zaidi, si pale hisia ilipo kali zaidi. Ni hoja ya ukamilifu, si ya kujiamini.

0f2ac93410c8.en: A calendar shows: 10:00am, CAD, HIGH impact, "Overnight Rate," Forecast 1.75%, Previous 1.75%. That tells you a lot before anything happens. The forecast matches the previous rate, so no change is expected — if the actual lands at 1.75%, the reaction is likely muted, because it's already priced in. But if the Bank of Canada surprises and hikes, every CAD pair can move sharply within seconds. Same event, wildly different outcomes, decided entirely by the gap between actual and forecast.
0f2ac93410c8.sw: Kalenda inaonyesha: 10:00 asubuhi, CAD, athari KUBWA, "Kiwango cha Usiku," Utabiri 1.75%, Iliyopita 1.75%. Hiyo inakuambia mengi kabla ya chochote kutokea. Utabiri unalingana na kiwango kilichopita, hivyo hakuna mabadiliko yanayotarajiwa — kama halisi itatua kwa 1.75%, mwitikio unawezekana kuwa mdogo, kwa sababu tayari umewekewa bei. Lakini kama Benki ya Kanada itashangaza na kupandisha, kila jozi la CAD linaweza kusogea kwa kasi ndani ya sekunde chache. Tukio lile lile, matokeo tofauti kabisa, yakiamuliwa kabisa na pengo kati ya halisi na utabiri.

0f31b892e4ac.en: Correct — Osler (2003) found orders bunch at round numbers used as support and resistance: take-profit orders reverse price at the level, stop-loss orders accelerate it once broken. The levels have a concrete order-flow cause, not a mystical one.
0f31b892e4ac.sw: Sahihi — Osler (2003) aligundua maagizo hujikusanya kwenye namba za mviringo zinazotumiwa kama msaada na upinzani: maagizo ya take-profit hugeuza bei kwenye kiwango, maagizo ya stop-loss huiharakisha mara inapovunjika. Viwango vina sababu halisi ya mtiririko wa maagizo, si ya kifumbo.

0f63bd340fd5.en: The gap between profit and cash usually has a specific location, and it is normally worth finding.
0f63bd340fd5.sw: Pengo kati ya faida na fedha kwa kawaida lina mahali mahususi, na kwa kawaida linastahili kupatikana.

0f6a983a2e01.en: The standard unit for measuring a price move — the 4th decimal place for most pairs, 2nd for yen pairs.
0f6a983a2e01.sw: Kipimo sanifu cha kupima msogeo wa bei — nafasi ya 4 ya desimali kwa jozi nyingi, ya 2 kwa jozi za yen.

0f813d708dc8.en: A licensed firm that gives traders access to the currency market and executes their buy/sell orders — in this context, without any physical exchange of cash.
0f813d708dc8.sw: Kampuni yenye leseni inayowapa wafanyabiashara ufikiaji wa soko la sarafu na kutekeleza maagizo yao ya kununua/kuuza — katika muktadha huu, bila ubadilishanaji wowote wa kimwili wa fedha taslimu.

0f83d4aedda0.en: Expectancy in R is then simply (win rate times the average R won) minus (loss rate times the average R lost). If you always risk 1R and honour your stops, your average loss is 1R, and the formula gets clean.
0f83d4aedda0.sw: Matarajio kwa R basi ni (kiwango cha ushindi mara R ya wastani iliyoshindwa) toa (kiwango cha hasara mara R ya wastani iliyopotea) tu. Kama daima unahatarisha 1R na kuheshimu stop zako, hasara yako ya wastani ni 1R, na fomula inakuwa safi.

0fa95d052d49.en: That is real, measured evidence that a core price-action tool carries information. But evidence that something works is more trustworthy when there is also a reason why it works. Osler supplied that too.
0fa95d052d49.sw: Huo ni ushahidi halisi uliopimwa kwamba zana kuu ya shughuli ya bei hubeba taarifa. Lakini ushahidi kwamba kitu kinafanya kazi unaaminika zaidi pale kunapokuwa pia na sababu ya kwa nini kinafanya kazi. Osler alitoa hiyo pia.

0fb25817ce74.en: Synthetic replication adds counterparty risk: a risk that is not about the index at all, but about whether the bank on the other side of the swap can pay. Foundations Chapter 2 made the general point that risks you have not named are the ones that hurt. This is a concrete instance — the fund can track the index perfectly and still fail for a reason that has nothing to do with the index.
0fb25817ce74.sw: Kuiga kwa bandia huongeza hatari ya mshirika: hatari isiyohusu index kabisa, bali kama benki iliyo upande mwingine wa swap inaweza kulipa. Sura ya 2 ya Msingi ilitoa pointi ya jumla kwamba hatari usizozitaja ndizo zinazoumiza. Huu ni mfano halisi — fund inaweza kufuatilia index kikamilifu na bado ikashindwa kwa sababu isiyohusiana na index.

0ffe064c82cc.en: "Discipline" gets used as if it means staying calm, or having nerves of steel. That is the wrong definition, and chasing it sets you up to fail — because you will not always feel calm.
0ffe064c82cc.sw: "Nidhamu" hutumiwa kana kwamba inamaanisha kubaki mtulivu, au kuwa na mishipa ya chuma. Hiyo ni maana isiyo sahihi, na kuifukuza kunakuandaa kushindwa — kwa sababu hutajisikia mtulivu daima.

102903ec54a5.en: Take a 10,000 dollar account, risking 1% (100 dollars), with a 50-pip stop-loss. On USD/JPY, true pip value is 6.67 dollars, so the correct size is 100 / (50 x 6.67) = 0.30 standard lots. If you had used the 10-dollar shortcut, you would have traded 0.20 lots — and actually risked only 0.20 x 50 x 6.67 = 66.70 dollars. You under-sized: your real risk was two-thirds of what you intended, quietly leaving return on the table. On EUR/GBP, true pip value is 12.70 dollars, so the correct size is 100 / (50 x 12.70) = 0.157 standard lots. Using the 10-dollar shortcut would have given 0.20 lots — and a real risk of 0.20 x 50 x 12.70 = 127 dollars. You over-sized: you risked 27% more than the 1% you decided on.
102903ec54a5.sw: Chukua akaunti ya dola 10,000, ukihatarisha 1% (dola 100), yenye stop-loss ya pip 50. Kwenye USD/JPY, thamani halisi ya pip ni dola 6.67, hivyo ukubwa sahihi ni 100 / (50 x 6.67) = lot 0.30 sanifu. Kama ungetumia njia ya mkato ya dola 10, ungefanya biashara ya lot 0.20 — na kwa kweli ungehatarisha dola 0.20 x 50 x 6.67 = 66.70 tu. Ulipima chini: hatari yako halisi ilikuwa theluthi mbili ya uliyokusudia, ukiacha faida mezani kimyakimya. Kwenye EUR/GBP, thamani halisi ya pip ni dola 12.70, hivyo ukubwa sahihi ni 100 / (50 x 12.70) = lot 0.157 sanifu. Kutumia njia ya mkato ya dola 10 kungetoa lot 0.20 — na hatari halisi ya 0.20 x 50 x 12.70 = dola 127. Ulipima juu: ulihatarisha 27% zaidi ya 1% uliyoiamua.

1067f3663ccf.en: Before trusting any stated success rate: Is this from a peer-reviewed journal, or a personal website/book? Can you find the original source, or only secondhand mentions? Does it specify the market, time period, and conditions tested? Does the number stay consistent across sources, or does it quietly shift?
1067f3663ccf.sw: Kabla ya kuamini kiwango chochote cha mafanikio kilichotajwa: Je, hii inatoka kwenye jarida lililokaguliwa na wenzake, au tovuti binafsi/kitabu? Je, unaweza kupata chanzo asilia, au ni matajo ya mkono wa pili tu? Je, inabainisha soko, kipindi cha muda, na hali zilizojaribiwa? Je, namba inabaki thabiti katika vyanzo mbalimbali, au inabadilika kimyakimya?

10dfe29ca4b0.en: Here's the demystifying truth: MACD is measuring how two moving averages converge and diverge — which is exactly what you just learned to see directly on the chart with the 20/50 pair. When people talk about MACD crossovers, they're talking about the same underlying event as a moving-average crossover, expressed as an oscillating line below the chart instead of two lines on it. If you understand the crossover section, you already understand MACD. Some traders prefer its presentation (the histogram makes momentum shifts visually loud); others just read the averages directly. There is no extra information in it that the moving averages don't contain.
10dfe29ca4b0.sw: Huu hapa ukweli unaoondoa fumbo: MACD inapima jinsi wastani wawili unaosogea wanavyoungana na kutengana — ambacho ndicho hasa umejifunza kuona moja kwa moja kwenye chati kwa jozi la 20/50. Watu wanapozungumzia mikatizo ya MACD, wanazungumzia tukio lile lile la msingi kama mkatizo wa wastani unaosogea, likielezwa kama mstari unaoyumba chini ya chati badala ya mistari miwili juu yake. Kama unaelewa sehemu ya mkatizo, tayari unaelewa MACD. Baadhi ya wafanyabiashara hupendelea uwasilishaji wake (histogram hufanya mabadiliko ya kasi yaonekane wazi); wengine husoma tu wastani moja kwa moja. Hakuna taarifa ya ziada ndani yake ambayo wastani unaosogea hauna.

10f45afc4f78.en: The equal-weighted index rises more, because it holds more small companies
10f45afc4f78.sw: Index yenye uzito sawa hupanda zaidi, kwa sababu inashikilia kampuni ndogo zaidi

1167f82a1d87.en: They have equal influence, because indices treat members equally
1167f82a1d87.sw: Zina ushawishi sawa, kwa sababu index huwatendea wanachama sawasawa

118bbbbf6178.en: It is roughly unchanged — you hold a share worth 58.00 plus 2.00 in cash
118bbbbf6178.sw: Haujabadilika kwa kiasi kikubwa — unashikilia hisa yenye thamani ya 58.00 pamoja na 2.00 ya fedha taslimu

119b0bb56536.en: The gap between bid and ask — the built-in cost of a trade.
119b0bb56536.sw: Pengo kati ya bid na ask — gharama iliyojengwa ndani ya biashara.

11f0421aa18b.en: It's tempting to assume the spread is simply how a broker makes money — and that's part of the picture, but not the deepest explanation. There's a genuine, well-established body of academic research on exactly this question, going back to a landmark 1985 paper.
11f0421aa18b.sw: Ni rahisi kudhani spread ni jinsi tu broker anavyopata pesa — na hiyo ni sehemu ya picha, lakini si maelezo ya kina zaidi. Kuna mkusanyiko halisi na wenye msingi imara wa utafiti wa kitaaluma juu ya swali hili hasa, unaorudi hadi karatasi muhimu ya mwaka 1985.

11f2606112fc.en: The price the market will pay you to sell.
11f2606112fc.sw: Bei ambayo soko litakulipa ili uuze.

12147b077bd8.en: One last thing an index quietly omits. Most headline indices are price indices — they track share prices only, and ignore dividends paid along the way. Total return versions exist and are usually higher. Lesson 6 covers why that difference is larger than it sounds.
12147b077bd8.sw: Kitu kimoja cha mwisho ambacho index huacha kimyakimya. Index nyingi za vichwa vya habari ni index za bei — hufuatilia bei za hisa tu, na hupuuza gawio lililolipwa njiani. Matoleo ya faida ya jumla yapo na kwa kawaida yako juu zaidi. Somo la 6 linaeleza kwa nini tofauti hiyo ni kubwa kuliko inavyosikika.

124d2bee7f40.en: Run your process at the portfolio level: Are you weighting capital toward your best-analysed theses, or spreading it evenly and dragging your strong ideas toward average? Are you concentrating conviction while still sizing every single trade to the fixed-fractional risk rule — never concentrating risk? Does every trade you take survive a real funnel (scan, thesis, pre-mortem, reward-to-risk), or do ideas reach your account untested? And in review, are you judging the quality of the decision and the thesis, or only whether it happened to make money?
124d2bee7f40.sw: Endesha mchakato wako katika kiwango cha mkusanyiko: Je, unaelekeza mtaji zaidi kwenye nadharia zako zilizochambuliwa vizuri zaidi, au unausambaza sawasawa na kuvuta mawazo yako imara kuelekea wastani? Je, unajikita kwenye uhakika huku bado ukipima kila biashara moja kwa kanuni ya hatari ya sehemu thabiti — kamwe bila kujikita kwenye hatari? Je, kila biashara unayoichukua hunusurika faneli halisi (kuchunguza, nadharia, pre-mortem, tuzo-kwa-hatari), au mawazo hufika kwenye akaunti yako bila kujaribiwa? Na katika kupitia, je, unahukumu ubora wa uamuzi na nadharia, au tu kama ilibahatika kupata pesa?

1258e59bdf26.en: Print unlimited paper money with no risk
1258e59bdf26.sw: Kuchapisha pesa za karatasi bila kikomo bila hatari

1260f26736e8.en: This reframes "free money" everywhere it appears in trading. A strategy that pays a little, reliably, for a long time, with rare but severe blow-ups, is not beating the market — it is being paid a premium for a risk that has not shown up yet. The forward premium puzzle from Chapter 2, Lesson 3 explains why the trade works at all; this crash risk explains what you are really being paid for.
1260f26736e8.sw: Hii hupanga upya "pesa za bure" kila mahali zinapojitokeza katika biashara. Mkakati unaolipa kidogo, kwa kutegemewa, kwa muda mrefu, wenye milipuko nadra lakini mikali, hauushindi soko — unalipwa malipo ya ziada kwa hatari ambayo bado haijajitokeza. Fumbo la malipo ya mbele kutoka Sura ya 2, Somo la 3 hueleza kwa nini biashara hufanya kazi kabisa; hatari hii ya kuanguka hueleza unalipwa kwa ajili ya nini hasa.

126313ee2e36.en: A combination of factors — very thin overnight liquidity, options-hedging sell flow, stop-loss execution, and algorithms — with no single cause
126313ee2e36.sw: Mchanganyiko wa mambo — ukwasi mdogo mno wa usiku, mtiririko wa kuuza wa kulinda options, utekelezaji wa stop-loss, na algoriti — bila sababu moja

12ac93ee5f0d.en: The power of the pre-mortem is psychological. Once you have committed to a thesis, you are motivated to see it work, and that motivation quietly blinds you to its weaknesses — the overconfidence of Chapter 4, Lesson 1. Assuming failure flips the incentive: now your goal is to find problems, and you find far more than you would by asking "what could go wrong?" in the abstract.
12ac93ee5f0d.sw: Nguvu ya pre-mortem ni ya kisaikolojia. Mara ukishajitolea kwa nadharia, unahamasishwa kuiona ikifanya kazi, na motisha hiyo hukupofusha kimyakimya kwa udhaifu wake — kujiamini kupita kiasi kwa Sura ya 4, Somo la 1. Kudhania kushindwa hugeuza motisha: sasa lengo lako ni kupata matatizo, na unapata mengi zaidi kuliko ungepata kwa kuuliza "ni nini kingeweza kwenda vibaya?" kwa ujumla.

12d0f941b161.en: A cash payment made by a company to its shareholders out of the residual you met in Lesson 1.
12d0f941b161.sw: Malipo ya fedha taslimu yanayofanywa na kampuni kwa wanahisa wake kutoka mabaki uliyokutana nayo katika Somo la 1.

134353d843d4.en: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling & Schrimpf (2012), published in The Journal of Finance, showed that carry trade returns are strongly tied to global foreign-exchange volatility. The strategy earns steady profits in calm periods — then suffers sharp, correlated losses precisely when global volatility spikes (crises, panics). In other words, carry trade returns behave like compensation for taking on crash risk, not a free lunch. The interest edge is real, but you're being paid to hold a currency that can drop violently at the worst possible moment — a direct, real-world echo of the fat-tails warning from Lesson 2 and the SNB collapse from Chapter 1.
134353d843d4.sw: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling & Schrimpf (2012), waliochapisha katika The Journal of Finance, walionyesha kwamba faida za carry trade zimefungwa kwa nguvu na mtikisiko wa fedha za kigeni duniani. Mkakati hupata faida thabiti katika vipindi tulivu — kisha hupata hasara kali na zenye uwiano hasa mtikisiko wa kimataifa unapopanda ghafla (majanga, hofu). Kwa maneno mengine, faida za carry trade hutenda kama fidia kwa kuchukua hatari ya kuanguka, si chakula cha bure. Faida ya riba ni halisi, lakini unalipwa kushikilia sarafu inayoweza kushuka kwa nguvu wakati mbaya zaidi unaowezekana — mwangwi wa moja kwa moja wa dunia halisi wa onyo la mikia minene kutoka Somo la 2 na kuanguka kwa SNB kutoka Sura ya 1.

1364d3ad5082.en: You gained money because the peso strengthened
1364d3ad5082.sw: Ulipata pesa kwa sababu peso iliimarika

138f845081ef.sw: Wito wa Margin na Hatari ya Leverage

13d46aa50561.en: Diagram showing the position sizing formula worked through with a real example, and why fixed-percentage risk is preferred over theoretically optimal sizing
13d46aa50561.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi ikipitiwa kwa mfano halisi, na kwa nini hatari ya asilimia thabiti hupendelewa kuliko upimaji bora kinadharia

13f99b81d4f1.en: The deeper question is whether a company paying dividends is better for you than one that does not.
13f99b81d4f1.sw: Swali la kina zaidi ni kama kampuni inayolipa gawio ni bora kwako kuliko ile isiyolipa.

1453e7b50a54.en: Candlestick charts don't show the closing price
1453e7b50a54.sw: Chati za mishumaa hazionyeshi bei ya kufunga

1462b7984844.en: A beginner spreads money evenly across every idea they have. The evidence says that is a mistake.
1462b7984844.sw: Anayeanza husambaza pesa sawasawa katika kila wazo alilonalo. Ushahidi unasema hilo ni kosa.

14a6d74c5b5f.en: Spreading exposure so no single holding dominates the result.
14a6d74c5b5f.sw: Kueneza uwazi ili umiliki mmoja usitawale matokeo.

150f0619969f.en: The lower bound comes from a legal arrangement most people never think about, and it is not a natural feature of ownership. If you own a corner shop outright and it fails owing money, the creditors can pursue you personally. If you own shares in a company that fails owing money, they cannot.
150f0619969f.sw: Kikomo cha chini hutoka kwenye mpangilio wa kisheria ambao watu wengi hawakuwahi kuufikiria, na si sifa ya asili ya umiliki. Kama unamiliki duka la kona kabisa na likashindwa likidaiwa pesa, wadai wanaweza kukufuata binafsi. Kama unamiliki hisa katika kampuni iliyoshindwa ikidaiwa pesa, hawawezi.

1517803c69c1.en: Trader A wins 40% of trades at 1:2. Out of 10 trades, 4 wins pay 2R each (+8R) and 6 losses cost 1R each (-6R), for +2R overall — a profit, from being wrong more often than right. Trader B wins 60% at 1:1: 6 wins (+6R) and 4 losses (-4R) also make +2R. Same result from opposite-looking records. Now Trader C wins 70% of trades but takes profits half the size of the risk (1:0.5): 7 wins pay 0.5R each (+3.5R) and 3 losses cost 1R each (-3R), for just +0.5R over 10 trades. Trader C is right far more often than A or B and makes a quarter as much.
1517803c69c1.sw: Mfanyabiashara A hushinda 40% ya biashara kwa 1:2. Kati ya biashara 10, ushindi 4 hulipa 2R kila moja (+8R) na hasara 6 hugharimu 1R kila moja (-6R), kwa +2R kwa jumla — faida, kutokana na kukosea mara nyingi zaidi kuliko kuwa sahihi. Mfanyabiashara B hushinda 60% kwa 1:1: ushindi 6 (+6R) na hasara 4 (-4R) pia hufanya +2R. Tokeo lile lile kutoka rekodi zinazoonekana za kinyume. Sasa Mfanyabiashara C hushinda 70% ya biashara lakini huchukua faida za nusu ya ukubwa wa hatari (1:0.5): ushindi 7 hulipa 0.5R kila moja (+3.5R) na hasara 3 hugharimu 1R kila moja (-3R), kwa +0.5R tu katika biashara 10. Mfanyabiashara C ni sahihi mara nyingi zaidi mno kuliko A au B na hupata robo moja ya kiasi.

152c130f3d0c.en: Both can exist for the same pattern. The question is never just "does it work" — it's "how do I know, and how sure can I actually be?"
152c130f3d0c.sw: Zote mbili zinaweza kuwepo kwa mtindo ule ule. Swali si tu "je, inafanya kazi" kamwe — ni "ninajuaje, na ninaweza kuwa na uhakika kiasi gani hasa?"

153f331497ed.en: Correct — exotic pairs combine a major currency with a smaller or emerging-market currency — lower liquidity, wider spreads, more volatility.
153f331497ed.sw: Sahihi — jozi adimu huunganisha sarafu kuu na sarafu ya uchumi mdogo au unaoibukia — ukwasi mdogo, spread pana zaidi, mtikisiko zaidi.

15447beaefd0.en: Look up any share you follow and record the bid, the ask and the last price at two moments: shortly after the market opens, and in the middle of the session. Calculate the spread as a percentage of the midpoint each time. The difference between the two readings is a cost you would have paid without ever seeing it itemised.
15447beaefd0.sw: Tafuta hisa yoyote unayoifuatilia na urekodi bid, ask na bei ya mwisho katika nyakati mbili: muda mfupi baada ya soko kufunguliwa, na katikati ya kipindi. Kokotoa spread kama asilimia ya sehemu ya kati kila mara. Tofauti kati ya usomaji hizo mbili ni gharama ambayo ungeilipa bila kuiona ikiorodheshwa kamwe.

1575dfccbc6a.en: Ghanem, Harasheh, Sbaih & Ajmal (2024), published in Cogent Business & Management — genuinely recent research — tested 497 technical trading rules across 10 currencies over 22 years (2000–2022). Technical trading rules significantly predicted price movements in both developed and emerging-market currencies, with emerging markets showing even higher predictability.
1575dfccbc6a.sw: Ghanem, Harasheh, Sbaih & Ajmal (2024), waliochapisha katika Cogent Business & Management — utafiti wa hivi karibuni kweli — walijaribu kanuni 497 za biashara za kiufundi katika sarafu 10 kwa miaka 22 (2000–2022). Kanuni za biashara za kiufundi zilitabiri msogeo wa bei kwa kiasi kikubwa katika sarafu za nchi zilizoendelea na za masoko yanayoibukia, ambapo masoko yanayoibukia yalionyesha utabirikaji wa juu zaidi.

15eaeb0e4b07.en: A general decline in prices across an economy over time — the opposite of inflation — which can deepen a recession by encouraging people to delay spending.
15eaeb0e4b07.sw: Kushuka kwa jumla kwa bei katika uchumi kwa muda — kinyume cha mfumuko wa bei — ambako kunaweza kuzidisha mdororo kwa kuwahamasisha watu kuahirisha matumizi.

1601006d5fbe.en: Correct. Cap weighting tells you what the typical unit of money did; equal weighting tells you what the typical company did. When a small number of very large companies lead, those two answers diverge — and the headline always quotes the first.
1601006d5fbe.sw: Sahihi. Uzito wa mtaji hukuambia kipimo cha kawaida cha pesa kilifanya nini; uzito sawa hukuambia kampuni ya kawaida ilifanya nini. Idadi ndogo ya kampuni kubwa mno inapoongoza, majibu hayo mawili hutofautiana — na kichwa cha habari daima hunukuu la kwanza.

160858ca1d64.en: Diversification — Why "Don't Put All Your Eggs in One Basket" Is Testable
160858ca1d64.sw: Kusambaza Uwekezaji — Kwa Nini "Usiweke Mayai Yako Yote Kwenye Kikapu Kimoja" Inaweza Kupimwa

16570b6302f1.en: The price of one currency expressed in terms of another.
16570b6302f1.sw: Bei ya sarafu moja iliyoelezwa kwa sarafu nyingine.

16aba5e87987.en: These two families make opposite bets. A mean-reversion tool in a strong trend loses repeatedly ("it's stretched!" — it stretches further). A trend-following tool in a sideways market whipsaws to death. Neither tool is broken in those moments — it's being asked the wrong question. Diagnosing which kind of market you're in is the judgment that sits above every indicator, and no indicator can make it for you — which is exactly where this chapter goes next.
16aba5e87987.sw: Familia hizi mbili hufanya mabashiri ya kinyume. Zana ya kurudi kwa wastani katika mwelekeo mkali hupoteza mara kwa mara ("imenyooshwa!" — inanyooka zaidi). Zana ya kufuata mwelekeo katika soko la kando hujipiga whipsaw hadi kufa. Hakuna zana iliyoharibika katika nyakati hizo — inaulizwa swali lisilo sahihi. Kubaini ni aina gani ya soko uliomo ndiyo hukumu inayokaa juu ya kila kiashiria, na hakuna kiashiria kinachoweza kuifanya kwa niaba yako — ambako ndiko hasa sura hii inakoenda baadaye.

16cdf077ada9.en: A large move upward, because rates are high
16cdf077ada9.sw: Msogeo mkubwa kuelekea juu, kwa sababu viwango viko juu

17004f141195.en: Put the pieces together and the rule is simple and strict: the entire exit plan is written before the position exists.
17004f141195.sw: Unganisha vipande na kanuni ni rahisi na kali: mpango mzima wa kutoka umeandikwa kabla nafasi haijawepo.

177b705bbbfe.en: Correct — no surprise means the outcome was already priced in. Big moves come from the gap between actual and forecast, not from the event happening.
177b705bbbfe.sw: Sahihi — kutokuwa na mshangao kunamaanisha tokeo tayari lilikuwa limewekewa bei. Misogeo mikubwa hutoka kwenye pengo kati ya halisi na utabiri, si kutokana na tukio kutokea.

179894110be6.en: This is why the course keeps insisting that execution and risk control matter more than prediction. Two defences would have softened this: trading the pound during liquid hours rather than holding naked exposure through the thinnest part of the night, and sizing so that even a violent, illiquid spike against you is survivable. Neither requires predicting the crash — only respecting that liquidity and timing are real risks, not background details.
179894110be6.sw: Ndiyo sababu kozi inaendelea kusisitiza kwamba utekelezaji na udhibiti wa hatari vinahusika zaidi kuliko utabiri. Kinga mbili zingelilainisha hili: kufanya biashara ya pauni wakati wa saa zenye ukwasi badala ya kushikilia uwazi wazi katika sehemu nyembamba zaidi ya usiku, na kupima ili hata mwiba mkali wa soko lisilo na ukwasi dhidi yako uweze kunusurika. Hakuna kati yao kinachohitaji kutabiri anguko — kuheshimu tu kwamba ukwasi na muda ni hatari halisi, si maelezo ya nyuma.

17a7ccaeeb93.en: The market strongly expects a central bank to raise rates by 0.5%. The bank raises by only 0.25%. What's the most likely reaction in that currency?
17a7ccaeeb93.sw: Soko linatarajia kwa nguvu benki kuu ipandishe viwango kwa 0.5%. Benki inapandisha kwa 0.25% tu. Ni mwitikio upi unaowezekana zaidi katika sarafu hiyo?

17d06133d14a.en: Take any company whose shares you could buy. Find its most recent annual figures and write down four numbers: revenue, total costs, interest paid, and what remained. Then write down what a 10% fall in revenue would do to the last number if the first three were unchanged. That single calculation explains more about why the share price moves than any chart you will look at this month.
17d06133d14a.sw: Chukua kampuni yoyote ambayo ungeweza kununua hisa zake. Pata takwimu zake za hivi karibuni za mwaka na uandike namba nne: mapato, gharama za jumla, riba iliyolipwa, na kilichobaki. Kisha andika kushuka kwa 10% kwa mapato kungefanya nini kwa namba ya mwisho kama tatu za kwanza zingebaki bila kubadilika. Hesabu hiyo moja hueleza zaidi kuhusu kwa nini bei ya hisa husogea kuliko chati yoyote utakayoitazama mwezi huu.

17d0eb7147b2.en: Two linked orders where one executing cancels the other.
17d0eb7147b2.sw: Maagizo mawili yaliyounganishwa ambapo moja likitekelezwa hufuta lingine.

17d5f1a002b7.en: A large financial firm permitted to create new ETF shares or redeem existing ones by trading directly with the fund.
17d5f1a002b7.sw: Kampuni kubwa ya kifedha inayoruhusiwa kuunda hisa mpya za ETF au kukomboa zilizopo kwa kufanya biashara moja kwa moja na fund.

17fd25fcd972.en: True or False: according to Heimer and Simsek's (2019) study, capping leverage for US retail forex traders had no measurable effect on trader outcomes.
17fd25fcd972.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kwa mujibu wa utafiti wa Heimer na Simsek (2019), kuweka kikomo cha leverage kwa wafanyabiashara wa forex wa rejareja wa Marekani hakukuwa na athari yoyote inayopimika kwa matokeo ya wafanyabiashara.

17fd65d97d78.en: Giving every company in the index the same weight regardless of its size or share price, and restoring those weights periodically.
17fd65d97d78.sw: Kutoa kila kampuni katika index uzito ule ule bila kujali ukubwa wake au bei ya hisa, na kurejesha uzito huo mara kwa mara.

180d374c4f78.en: Change the weighting rule and the same three companies tell three different stories.
180d374c4f78.sw: Badilisha kanuni ya uzito na kampuni zile zile tatu husimulia simulizi tatu tofauti.

1825af246dff.en: The most common method weights each company by its market value, so bigger companies move the index more.
1825af246dff.sw: Mbinu ya kawaida zaidi hutoa uzito kwa kila kampuni kwa thamani yake ya soko, hivyo kampuni kubwa zaidi husogeza index zaidi.

1838a6116cfd.en: The pound fell about 6% in two minutes with no major news, driven by thin overnight liquidity and a stop-and-algorithm cascade — showing that execution and liquidity risk can hurt you even when your direction is right.
1838a6116cfd.sw: Pauni ilishuka takriban 6% ndani ya dakika mbili bila habari kuu, ikiendeshwa na ukwasi mdogo wa usiku na mfululizo wa stop na algoriti — ikionyesha kwamba hatari ya utekelezaji na ukwasi inaweza kukuumiza hata mwelekeo wako ukiwa sahihi.

1858b35113d2.en: Not quite. It is not evidence of fraud, and the two figures are certainly related. The point is that profit involves legitimate judgement — depreciation, when a sale counts, provisions — while cash from operations tracks money that actually arrived. A gap that persists for years is a question to investigate, not a verdict either way.
1858b35113d2.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Si ushahidi wa udanganyifu, na takwimu hizo mbili zinahusiana kwa hakika. Pointi ni kwamba faida huhusisha hukumu halali — kushusha thamani, lini mauzo huhesabika, matengo — ilhali fedha kutoka shughuli hufuatilia pesa zilizofika hasa. Pengo linalodumu kwa miaka ni swali la kuchunguza, si hukumu upande wowote.

18861b94d83c.en: Picture this: you live in the U.S. and you're heading to Mexico for a week. Right now, the exchange rate is 1 USD = 20 MXN (Mexican pesos).
18861b94d83c.sw: Fikiria hivi: unaishi Marekani na unaelekea Mexico kwa wiki moja. Sasa hivi, kiwango cha ubadilishaji ni 1 USD = 20 MXN (peso za Mexico).

188b61339ed1.en: Two academic studies looked at whether Bitcoin is a safe haven for stock portfolios. One (Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice, 2026) found Bitcoin showed statistically significant negative correlation with the S&P 500 — a real candidate for safe-haven status. Another found Bitcoin's correlation with stocks rose from roughly 0.05 in 2017 to 0.25–0.30 by 2021, and concluded crypto behaves as a diversifier, not a safe haven. Both studies used real data and careful methods. They still disagree — a sign the underlying relationship genuinely shifts over time.
188b61339ed1.sw: Tafiti mbili za kitaaluma zilichunguza kama Bitcoin ni kimbilio salama kwa mikusanyiko ya hisa. Moja (Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice, 2026) iligundua Bitcoin ilionyesha uwiano hasi wenye maana kitakwimu na S&P 500 — mgombea halisi wa hadhi ya kimbilio salama. Nyingine iligundua uwiano wa Bitcoin na hisa ulipanda kutoka takriban 0.05 mwaka 2017 hadi 0.25–0.30 kufikia 2021, na ikahitimisha kwamba crypto hutenda kama msambazaji, si kimbilio salama. Tafiti zote mbili zilitumia data halisi na mbinu makini. Bado hazikubaliani — ishara kwamba uhusiano wa msingi hubadilika kweli kwa muda.

189c3c33d524.en: Strong forex-specific evidence backs support and resistance; the evidence for candlestick patterns is contested.
189c3c33d524.sw: Ushahidi imara mahususi wa forex huunga mkono msaada na upinzani; ushahidi kwa mitindo ya mishumaa una mgogoro.

18a2da2fa9ce.en: As far away as the account can withstand

18b529de96e7.en: This is the answer to the question this whole course has been building toward: forex exists specifically because currencies are no longer fixed to gold or each other. They float, they move — and where there's constant, unpredictable movement in something valuable, a market emerges to trade it. That market is the one you're learning to navigate.
18b529de96e7.sw: Hili ndilo jibu la swali ambalo kozi hii nzima imekuwa ikilielekea: forex ipo mahususi kwa sababu sarafu hazifungwi tena kwenye dhahabu wala kwa kila mmoja. Zinaelea, zinasogea — na palipo na msogeo wa kudumu usiotabirika katika kitu chenye thamani, soko hujitokeza kukifanyia biashara. Soko hilo ndilo unalojifunza kulipitia.

18c1d9513b25.en: The risk-to-reward ratio sets the win rate you need to break even, which is why a trader who is wrong more often than right can still make money — and a high win rate can still lose.
18c1d9513b25.sw: Uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo huweka kiwango cha ushindi unachohitaji ili kulingana, ndiyo sababu mfanyabiashara anayekosea mara nyingi zaidi kuliko kuwa sahihi anaweza bado kupata pesa — na kiwango kikubwa cha ushindi kinaweza bado kupoteza.

18d7636d8999.en: Look back at Chapter 3, Lesson 3 and you will recognise this. The disposition effect is Trader C — grabbing small wins while letting losses run — turned from a diagram into a documented pattern across thousands of real people. It is the psychological engine that manufactures a bad risk-to-reward ratio, one trade at a time.
18d7636d8999.sw: Tazama nyuma Sura ya 3, Somo la 3 na utalitambua hili. Athari ya kuachana na nafasi ni Mfanyabiashara C — kunyakua ushindi mdogo huku ukiacha hasara zikimbie — ikigeuzwa kutoka mchoro kuwa mtindo ulioandikwa katika maelfu ya watu halisi. Ndio injini ya kisaikolojia inayotengeneza uwiano mbaya wa hatari-kwa-tuzo, biashara moja kwa wakati.

19236252e783.en: An app shows one number and calls it the price. That number is a summary of something more detailed, and the detail is where your costs live.
19236252e783.sw: Programu huonyesha namba moja na kuiita bei. Namba hiyo ni muhtasari wa kitu chenye undani zaidi, na undani ndipo gharama zako zinapoishi.

195ade9e0b7e.en: Overtrading and revenge trading. Trading out of boredom or confidence, or forcing trades to win back a loss. Fixed by trading only setups that meet your rules, and by a plan rule that caps trades or enforces a cool-down after a loss (Chapter 4, Lesson 1).
195ade9e0b7e.sw: Kufanya biashara kupita kiasi na biashara ya kulipiza kisasi. Kufanya biashara kwa kuchoshwa au kujiamini, au kulazimisha biashara ili kurudisha hasara. Hurekebishwa kwa kufanya biashara ya mipangilio inayokidhi kanuni zako tu, na kwa kanuni ya mpango inayoweka kikomo cha biashara au kulazimisha kipindi cha kupoa baada ya hasara (Sura ya 4, Somo la 1).

1963c77932f8.en: Expectancy in dollars and in R, a real edge versus a high win rate that still loses, and the long-run-average catch.
1963c77932f8.sw: Matarajio kwa dola na kwa R, faida halisi dhidi ya kiwango kikubwa cha ushindi kinachopoteza bado, na mtego wa wastani wa muda mrefu.

196a34d51ee2.en: Choosing not to take an action because the risk outweighs the benefit.
196a34d51ee2.sw: Kuchagua kutochukua kitendo kwa sababu hatari inazidi manufaa.

197d72c62128.en: None — the framework is purely intuitive
197d72c62128.sw: Hakuna — mfumo ni wa kueleweka tu

198ecdaa8a7f.en: The price the market will charge you to buy the base currency.
198ecdaa8a7f.sw: Bei ambayo soko litakutoza ili ununue sarafu ya msingi.

19a6e50b86a8.en: Correct — $5,000 × 2% = $100 risk. $100 ÷ 40 pips = $2.50 per pip needed. $2.50 ÷ $10 = 0.25 standard lots.
19a6e50b86a8.sw: Sahihi — $5,000 × 2% = hatari ya $100. $100 ÷ pip 40 = $2.50 kwa kila pip inayohitajika. $2.50 ÷ $10 = lot 0.25 sanifu.

19b217ffe546.en: First, whether you own shares in a company at all, or units in a fund that owns shares. These behave differently and Lesson 5 explains why. Second, if it is a single company, whether the class you hold votes. Third, where the company sits in the queue you met above: how much it owes, and to whom, because everything owed is paid before anything reaches you.
19b217ffe546.sw: Kwanza, kama unamiliki hisa katika kampuni kabisa, au vipimo katika fund inayomiliki hisa. Hivi hutenda tofauti na Somo la 5 linaeleza kwa nini. Pili, kama ni kampuni moja, kama daraja unaloshikilia hupiga kura. Tatu, mahali kampuni inapokaa katika foleni uliyokutana nayo hapo juu: inadaiwa kiasi gani, na na nani, kwa sababu kila kinachodaiwa hulipwa kabla ya chochote kukufikia.

19df03a31c84.en: Taking on a risk's full potential downside, with no limit.
19df03a31c84.sw: Kubeba hasara yote inayowezekana ya hatari, bila kikomo.

19dfb7ded818.en: Mean-reversion tools bet a stretched price will snap back to its average — powerful when the market is ranging, but built on tidy bell-curve statistics that real prices routinely break.
19dfb7ded818.sw: Zana za kurudi kwa wastani hubashiri kwamba bei iliyonyooshwa itarudi kwenye wastani wake — zenye nguvu soko linapokuwa kwenye ukanda, lakini zimejengwa juu ya takwimu safi za mkunjo wa kengele ambazo bei halisi huzivunja mara kwa mara.

1a01c2c374ce.en: Chart patterns guarantee profitable trades 70% of the time
1a01c2c374ce.sw: Mitindo ya chati huhakikisha biashara zenye faida 70% ya muda

1a169d33635a.en: Map the regime before the trade: Name it — risk-on or risk-off, calm or volatile, trending or ranging — and ask whether your thesis suits it. Follow the transmission chain from its source: a central-bank move shows up in FX and rates first, then ripples outward; where is the cleanest expression? Treat crypto as a high-beta link in that chain in risk-off waves, not an independent safe haven. And when you scan and nothing aligns, recognise the all-quiet regime and take the cash position, not a forced trade.
1a169d33635a.sw: Chora ramani ya hali kabla ya biashara: Itaje — kukubali hatari au kukwepa hatari, tulivu au yenye mtikisiko, yenye mwelekeo au ya ukanda — na uulize kama nadharia yako inaifaa. Fuata mnyororo wa usambazaji kutoka chanzo chake: msogeo wa benki kuu hujitokeza katika FX na viwango kwanza, kisha husambaa nje; usemi safi zaidi uko wapi? Chukulia crypto kama kiungo cha beta kubwa katika mnyororo huo katika mawimbi ya kukwepa hatari, si kimbilio salama huru. Na unapotazama na hakuna kinacholingana, tambua hali ya utulivu kamili na uchukue nafasi ya fedha taslimu, si biashara ya kulazimishwa.

1a238f7c5da5.en: Independent expert evaluation of a study's methodology before publication.
1a238f7c5da5.sw: Tathmini huru ya wataalamu ya mbinu ya utafiti kabla ya kuchapishwa.

1a2a630b54bc.en: The 100,000-unit standard lot isn't an arbitrary round number — it reflects the historical scale of interbank trading, where banks moved large sums to settle international trade, long before individual retail traders had any access to the market. Mini, micro, and nano lots were introduced later specifically to make the market accessible to smaller accounts.
1a2a630b54bc.sw: Lot sanifu ya vipimo 100,000 si namba ya mviringo ya bahati nasibu — inaakisi ukubwa wa kihistoria wa biashara kati ya benki, ambapo benki zilihamisha kiasi kikubwa kulipia biashara ya kimataifa, muda mrefu kabla wafanyabiashara binafsi wa rejareja hawajapata ufikiaji wowote wa soko. Lot ndogo, ndogo sana, na za nano zilianzishwa baadaye mahususi ili kufanya soko lipatikane kwa akaunti ndogo.

1a62a3dd926e.en: For most of human history — over 6,000 years — barter was how people exchanged what they had for what they needed: trading goods or services directly, with no money involved. It worked, but it had one serious flaw.
1a62a3dd926e.sw: Kwa sehemu kubwa ya historia ya binadamu — zaidi ya miaka 6,000 — kubadilishana bidhaa ndiyo ilivyokuwa njia ya watu kubadilishana walichokuwa nacho kwa walichohitaji: kubadilishana bidhaa au huduma moja kwa moja, bila pesa. Ilifanya kazi, lakini ilikuwa na kasoro moja kubwa.

1a899b3e54e3.en: Not quite — the true pip value is higher than the one you used, so each pip costs more and the same lot size risks more: about 127 dollars instead of 100.
1a899b3e54e3.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — thamani halisi ya pip iko juu kuliko ile uliyoitumia, hivyo kila pip inagharimu zaidi na ukubwa ule ule wa lot huhatarisha zaidi: takriban dola 127 badala ya 100.

1a9728ea2fcc.en: You risk more than 1% — about 27% more than intended
1a9728ea2fcc.sw: Unahatarisha zaidi ya 1% — takriban 27% zaidi ya ulivyokusudia

1aa8e63b1a0d.en: A fixed number of pips away, the same for every trade
1aa8e63b1a0d.sw: Idadi thabiti ya pip mbali, ile ile kwa kila biashara

1ab2029e1391.en: In the transmission chain, where does a change in central-bank interest rates show up first?
1ab2029e1391.sw: Katika mnyororo wa usambazaji, mabadiliko ya viwango vya riba vya benki kuu hujitokeza wapi kwanza?

1b3cc67a15df.en: You broke even — exchange rates always average out
1b3cc67a15df.sw: Ulilingana — viwango vya ubadilishaji daima hujilinganisha

1b42a4aae85c.en: Because index funds do not charge fees at all
1b42a4aae85c.sw: Kwa sababu index fund hazitozi ada kabisa

1b57e542064a.en: Not quite — a market order fills immediately at whatever price is available: guaranteed execution, but not price.
1b57e542064a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — agizo la soko hutimizwa mara moja kwa bei yoyote inayopatikana: utekelezaji wa uhakika, lakini si bei.

1b671eef52b1.en: A strategy that sometimes loses several trades in a row
1b671eef52b1.sw: Mkakati unaopoteza biashara kadhaa mfululizo wakati mwingine

1b68bf91dba0.en: A professional does not hunt for trades everywhere at once. They first ask what kind of market they are in, because the answer decides which of the six pillars will even work.
1b68bf91dba0.sw: Mtaalamu hawindi biashara kila mahali kwa wakati mmoja. Kwanza huuliza wako katika aina gani ya soko, kwa sababu jibu huamua ni ipi kati ya nguzo sita itakayofanya kazi kabisa.

1b9aecc6040c.en: A schedule of upcoming economic data releases and policy announcements, listing the time, the currency affected, the expected impact, and the market's forecast for each.
1b9aecc6040c.sw: Ratiba ya matoleo ya data ya kiuchumi na matangazo ya sera yanayokuja, ikiorodhesha muda, sarafu inayoathiriwa, athari inayotarajiwa, na utabiri wa soko kwa kila moja.

1ba8b6cb0de5.en: Account balance plus or minus the floating profit and loss of open positions.
1ba8b6cb0de5.sw: Salio la akaunti pamoja au kutoa faida na hasara inayoelea ya nafasi zilizo wazi.

1bb11d956150.en: Most strategy failures are not the strategy being broken — they are the strategy being used in the wrong regime. Before asking "is this a good trade?", ask "what regime is this, and does my thesis suit it?" A carry thesis in a rising-volatility, risk-off regime is not a good trade no matter how wide the rate gap.
1bb11d956150.sw: Kushindwa kwingi kwa mikakati si mkakati kuharibika — ni mkakati kutumika katika hali isiyo sahihi. Kabla ya kuuliza "je, hii ni biashara nzuri?", uliza "hii ni hali gani, na je, nadharia yangu inaifaa?" Nadharia ya carry katika hali ya mtikisiko unaopanda na kukwepa hatari si biashara nzuri bila kujali pengo la kiwango ni pana kiasi gani.

1c05b52c944b.en: A hawkish stance favours higher interest rates to fight inflation; a dovish stance favours lower rates to promote growth. Individual policymakers, and a central bank's overall tone, are described this way.
1c05b52c944b.sw: Msimamo wa hawkish hupendelea viwango vya juu vya riba kupambana na mfumuko wa bei; msimamo wa dovish hupendelea viwango vya chini kukuza ukuaji. Watunga sera binafsi, na sauti ya jumla ya benki kuu, huelezwa hivi.

1c7651c5d726.en: True or False: money must be a physical object made of something valuable, like gold, to function as money.
1c7651c5d726.sw: Kweli au Uongo: pesa lazima iwe kitu cha kimwili kilichotengenezwa kwa kitu chenye thamani, kama dhahabu, ili ifanye kazi kama pesa.

1c9c0fa6b9a0.en: This is where the whole course's most repeated idea becomes arithmetic instead of a slogan. Foundations Chapter 2 said being right often is not the same as trading well. Here is the proof.
1c9c0fa6b9a0.sw: Hapa ndipo wazo linalorudiwa zaidi la kozi nzima linakuwa hesabu badala ya kauli mbiu. Sura ya 2 ya Msingi ilisema kuwa sahihi mara nyingi si sawa na kufanya biashara vizuri. Huu hapa uthibitisho.

1cf557c641de.en: Correct — expectancy is a long-run average. Over eight trades luck dominates, and a positive-expectancy system can easily lose. The edge only reliably shows over a large sample, which is why small per-trade risk matters.
1cf557c641de.sw: Sahihi — matarajio ni wastani wa muda mrefu. Katika biashara nane bahati hutawala, na mfumo wenye matarajio chanya unaweza kupoteza kwa urahisi. Faida hujitokeza kwa kutegemewa tu katika sampuli kubwa, ndiyo sababu hatari ndogo kwa kila biashara inahusika.

1d11e111d8fe.en: Technical analysis asks "what is price doing?" Fundamental analysis asks "why would price move at all?" Neither replaces the other — many traders use technicals for timing and fundamentals for direction. And for currencies specifically, one fundamental force sits above all others.
1d11e111d8fe.sw: Uchambuzi wa kiufundi huuliza "bei inafanya nini?" Uchambuzi wa kimsingi huuliza "kwa nini bei ingesogea kabisa?" Hakuna unaobadilisha mwingine — wafanyabiashara wengi hutumia kiufundi kwa muda na kimsingi kwa mwelekeo. Na kwa sarafu mahususi, nguvu moja ya kimsingi hukaa juu ya nyingine zote.

1d4869183aec.en: Something is worth investigating: profit involves judgement, cash does not, and a persistent gap has a cause worth finding
1d4869183aec.sw: Kuna kitu kinachostahili kuchunguzwa: faida huhusisha hukumu, fedha haihusishi, na pengo la kudumu lina sababu inayostahili kupatikana

1d506212dd3a.en: A fourth number sits across all three statements and changes what every per-share figure means.
1d506212dd3a.sw: Namba ya nne hukaa katika taarifa zote tatu na hubadilisha maana ya kila takwimu ya kwa-hisa.

1d6f532d78ec.en: An order that sits inactive until price reaches a trigger level, at which point it becomes a market order. Once triggered, it carries a market order's guarantee: execution, not price.
1d6f532d78ec.sw: Agizo linalokaa bila kufanya kazi hadi bei ifikie kiwango cha kianzishi, wakati huo linakuwa agizo la soko. Mara linapoanzishwa, hubeba uhakika wa agizo la soko: utekelezaji, si bei.

1d7ef3cc744e.en: The bid-ask spread is a real, research-backed cost of trading — not just broker profit — and a pip is the unit you measure price moves in.
1d7ef3cc744e.sw: Spread ya bid-ask ni gharama halisi ya kufanya biashara inayoungwa mkono na utafiti — si faida ya broker tu — na pip ni kipimo unachopimia misogeo ya bei.

1d8628911d2d.en: An asset with an average positive — but imperfect — correlation to your existing holdings. Still tends to move with the rest of your portfolio, just not in lockstep.
1d8628911d2d.sw: Mali yenye uwiano chanya wa wastani — lakini usio kamili — na umiliki wako uliopo. Bado huelekea kusogea pamoja na mkusanyiko wako wote, ila si kwa hatua moja.

1daa3223e7f9.en: Price action reading rests on three things you have largely met already. This lesson assembles them into one method rather than re-teaching them.
1daa3223e7f9.sw: Usomaji wa shughuli ya bei unategemea mambo matatu ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa tayari umekutana nayo. Somo hili huyaunganisha kuwa mbinu moja badala ya kuyafundisha tena.

1dbdfda813f1.en: You lost money, but only because of broker fees
1dbdfda813f1.sw: Ulipoteza pesa, lakini kwa sababu ya ada za broker tu

1e15bde9ee09.en: The market reacts asymmetrically: bad news moves prices more than equally-sized good news. A disappointing number tends to produce a bigger move than an equally-surprising positive one. Practically, this means downside surprises deserve more respect than upside ones when you're judging how much room to give an event — and it's another quiet echo of the fat-tails theme from Lesson 2 and the SNB collapse in Chapter 1.
1e15bde9ee09.sw: Soko huitikia bila usawa: habari mbaya husogeza bei zaidi kuliko habari njema ya ukubwa sawa. Namba ya kukatisha tamaa huelekea kuzalisha msogeo mkubwa zaidi kuliko ile chanya inayoshangaza vivyo hivyo. Kivitendo, hii inamaanisha mishangao ya upande wa chini inastahili heshima zaidi kuliko ya juu unapohukumu nafasi ya kutoa kwa tukio — na ni mwangwi mwingine wa kimyakimya wa mada ya mikia minene kutoka Somo la 2 na kuanguka kwa SNB katika Sura ya 1.

1e3c66ad751a.en: The build-up that paid twice, the crowded 2008 unwind, and the evidence that carry income is crash-risk compensation.
1e3c66ad751a.sw: Mkusanyiko uliolipa mara mbili, kuvunjika kwa msongamano wa mwaka 2008, na ushahidi kwamba mapato ya carry ni fidia ya hatari ya kuanguka.

1e6040f0fd6d.en: The disciplined version: wait for the RSI to exit the extreme zone. Price falls, RSI drops below 30 (oversold) — you wait. Only when RSI crosses back above 30 — meaning the selling pressure has actually broken — do you buy. Same mirrored for shorts: wait for RSI to fall back below 70 rather than shorting the moment it becomes overbought. You sacrifice a little of the move in exchange for confirmation that the reversal has actually begun, rather than betting that it will.
1e6040f0fd6d.sw: Toleo lenye nidhamu: subiri RSI itoke kwenye kanda ya kupindukia. Bei inashuka, RSI inashuka chini ya 30 (imeuzwa kupita kiasi) — unasubiri. Ni pale tu RSI itakapokatiza tena juu ya 30 — ikimaanisha shinikizo la kuuza limevunjika hasa — ndipo ununue. Vivyo hivyo kwa kioo kwa short: subiri RSI ishuke tena chini ya 70 badala ya kufanya short wakati inapokuwa imenunuliwa kupita kiasi. Unatoa sehemu ndogo ya msogeo kwa kubadilishana na uthibitisho kwamba mgeuko umeanza hasa, badala ya kubashiri kwamba utaanza.

1e738d1b193f.en: Not quite — this is moving the stop, which destroys your planned risk-to-reward. Set it at invalidation as an order before entry and never widen it.
1e738d1b193f.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — hii ni kusogeza stop, jambo linaloharibu hatari-kwa-tuzo uliyopanga. Iweke kwenye kuvunjika kama agizo kabla ya kuingia na usiipanue kamwe.

1e8df8a1e9a9.sw: Juu ya bei yako ya kuingia

1ec9866ffeff.en: Selecting holdings in an attempt to beat an index, rather than tracking it.
1ec9866ffeff.sw: Kuchagua umiliki kwa jaribio la kushinda index, badala ya kuifuatilia.

1ed8a72b7262.en: Company A trades at 300 a share and is worth 10 billion in total. Company B trades at 50 a share and is worth 80 billion. Which has more influence on a price-weighted index like the Dow?
1ed8a72b7262.sw: Kampuni A hufanyiwa biashara kwa 300 kwa hisa na ina thamani ya bilioni 10 kwa jumla. Kampuni B hufanyiwa biashara kwa 50 kwa hisa na ina thamani ya bilioni 80. Ni ipi yenye ushawishi zaidi juu ya index yenye uzito wa bei kama Dow?

1ef6a888ca1a.en: Pressure-test your own plan: Is it actually written down, or does it live only in your head where it can quietly change? Can you state your system's expectancy — even a rough figure from past trades — in R or in dollars? Is that expectancy positive over a meaningful number of trades, not just your most recent, most memorable few? And is your risk per trade small enough that a normal losing streak cannot end you before the expectancy has time to play out?
1ef6a888ca1a.sw: Jaribu mpango wako mwenyewe kwa shinikizo: Je, umeandikwa hasa, au unaishi kichwani mwako tu ambapo unaweza kubadilika kimyakimya? Je, unaweza kutamka matarajio ya mfumo wako — hata takwimu ya jumla kutoka biashara zilizopita — kwa R au kwa dola? Je, matarajio hayo ni chanya katika idadi yenye maana ya biashara, si chache zako za hivi karibuni na zinazokumbukwa zaidi tu? Na je, hatari yako kwa kila biashara ni ndogo vya kutosha kiasi kwamba mfululizo wa kawaida wa hasara hauwezi kukumaliza kabla matarajio hayajapata muda wa kujitokeza?

1f07ec38337e.en: The second is a record of what actually happened.
1f07ec38337e.sw: Ya pili ni rekodi ya kilichotokea hasa.

1f1f77215d1f.en: A trader who is right only 40% of the time can be consistently profitable, if every loss is small and controlled while winners are allowed to run. A trader who is right 90% of the time can still go broke, if a single uncontrolled loss is large enough to erase every gain before it. Being right often is not the same as trading well.
1f1f77215d1f.sw: Mfanyabiashara ambaye ni sahihi 40% tu ya muda anaweza kupata faida kwa uthabiti, kama kila hasara ni ndogo na inadhibitiwa huku washindi wakiruhusiwa kukimbia. Mfanyabiashara ambaye ni sahihi 90% ya muda anaweza bado kufilisika, kama hasara moja isiyodhibitiwa ni kubwa vya kutosha kufuta kila faida iliyotangulia. Kuwa sahihi mara nyingi si sawa na kufanya biashara vizuri.

1f2a71f22327.en: The order is the entire technique. You move from slowest to fastest, and each timeframe has exactly one job.
1f2a71f22327.sw: Mpangilio ndio mbinu yote. Unasogea kutoka polepole zaidi hadi kasi zaidi, na kila kipindi kina kazi moja hasa.

1f4d1bba956a.en: Not quite — you concentrate conviction toward the best theses while still sizing every trade to the fixed-fractional rule. Concentrate conviction, not risk.
1f4d1bba956a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — unajikita kwenye uhakika kuelekea nadharia bora huku bado ukipima kila biashara kwa kanuni ya sehemu thabiti. Jikite kwenye uhakika, si hatari.

1f92c66f8946.en: A second thing worth checking is how the fund actually obtains its exposure.
1f92c66f8946.sw: Kitu cha pili kinachostahili kukaguliwa ni jinsi fund inavyopata uwazi wake hasa.

1faa54b95a3f.en: On 15 January 2015, without warning, the Swiss National Bank abandoned the floor. The franc did not drift — it detonated. EUR/CHF fell straight through 1.20 and collapsed by roughly 30% intraday, trading as low as around 0.85 in the chaos, before settling nearer parity. The move happened in minutes, and with so little liquidity that the exact bottom is genuinely disputed: one broker's own feed printed as low as 1.1659 within nine seconds as the banks providing its prices pulled them.
1faa54b95a3f.sw: Tarehe 15 Januari 2015, bila onyo, Benki Kuu ya Uswisi iliacha sakafu. Faranga haikusogea taratibu — ililipuka. EUR/CHF ilishuka moja kwa moja kupitia 1.20 na kuanguka kwa takriban 30% ndani ya siku, ikifanyiwa biashara chini kama karibu 0.85 katika machafuko, kabla ya kutulia karibu na usawa. Msogeo ulitokea ndani ya dakika chache, na kwa ukwasi mdogo mno kiasi kwamba sehemu kamili ya chini ina mgogoro kweli: mpasho wa broker mmoja ulionyesha chini kama 1.1659 ndani ya sekunde tisa benki zinazotoa bei zake zilipoziondoa.

1fb1bcbce1f1.en: The first day a share trades without the right to the upcoming dividend. Buy on or after this date and the seller keeps the payment.
1fb1bcbce1f1.sw: Siku ya kwanza ambayo hisa hufanyiwa biashara bila haki ya gawio linalokuja. Nunua siku hiyo au baadaye na muuzaji huweka malipo.

1fdcb1f4e656.en: The floor, the collapse, the fallout, and the survival lesson: being sized to be wrong beat being right.
1fdcb1f4e656.sw: Sakafu, anguko, matokeo, na fundisho la kunusurika: kupimwa ili ukosee kulishinda kuwa sahihi.

1fe39245c8fc.en: Currencies aren't traded in equal volume. Some are involved in a huge share of global trading; most barely register.
1fe39245c8fc.sw: Sarafu hazifanyiwi biashara kwa kiasi sawa. Baadhi zinahusika katika sehemu kubwa mno ya biashara ya kimataifa; nyingi hazionekani sana.

204340d01125.en: Most funds hold the real securities, which is called physical replication. Some instead enter a contract with a bank that agrees to pay the index return, which is called synthetic replication. The synthetic version can track more closely and reach otherwise awkward markets — but it introduces a party who has to honour the contract.
204340d01125.sw: Fund nyingi hushikilia dhamana halisi, ambako huitwa kuiga kwa kimwili. Baadhi badala yake huingia mkataba na benki inayokubali kulipa faida ya index, ambako huitwa kuiga kwa bandia. Toleo la bandia linaweza kufuatilia kwa ukaribu zaidi na kufikia masoko yasiyo rahisi vinginevyo — lakini huanzisha mtu anayelazimika kuheshimu mkataba.

2049db0eee55.en: Market structure. This is just the shape of the trend, also from Foundations Chapter 3: an uptrend is a series of higher highs and higher lows, a downtrend a series of lower highs and lower lows. Each recent high or low is a swing point — a local peak or trough. When price stops making higher highs and starts making lower lows, the structure has shifted. That shift, read from the bare chart, is the price-action trader's core signal.
2049db0eee55.sw: Muundo wa soko. Huu ni umbo la mwelekeo tu, pia kutoka Msingi Sura ya 3: mwelekeo wa kupanda ni mfululizo wa vilele vya juu zaidi na mabonde ya juu zaidi, mwelekeo wa kushuka ni mfululizo wa vilele vya chini zaidi na mabonde ya chini zaidi. Kila kilele au bonde la hivi karibuni ni sehemu ya mzunguko — kilele au bonde la eneo hilo. Bei inapoacha kufanya vilele vya juu zaidi na kuanza kufanya mabonde ya chini zaidi, muundo umebadilika. Mabadiliko hayo, yakisomwa kutoka chati tupu, ndiyo ishara kuu ya mfanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei.

2049f55ea7f7.en: What the company owns and owes at a single moment. It answers: what does the business consist of right now?

23a26e5b52fc.en: So the layering is: correct position size keeps you far from the margin call in the first place; the broker's stop-out is a second line that usually works; and negative balance protection is a legal backstop for the rare case where a gap defeats the stop-out. The first line is the one you control, and it is the one that matters most.

Safu ya kwanza ndiyo unayoidhibiti, na ndiyo inayohusika zaidi.

23ae7eb38811.en: The last three words are the ones beginners skip: in your account's currency. A pip is a movement in the quote currency of a pair. Your profit and loss, though, are counted in whatever currency your account is held in. Pip value is the bridge between those two, and the bridge is only "10 dollars" in one specific case.
23ae7eb38811.sw: Maneno matatu ya mwisho ndiyo wanaoanza huyaruka: kwa sarafu ya akaunti yako. Pip ni msogeo katika sarafu ya bei ya jozi. Faida na hasara yako, hata hivyo, huhesabiwa kwa sarafu yoyote ambayo akaunti yako imeshikiliwa kwayo. Thamani ya pip ndio daraja kati ya hizo mbili, na daraja ni "dola 10" katika kesi moja mahususi tu.

242fd6f1c221.en: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003), published in the American Economic Review, examined six years of real-time exchange rate quotes alongside the matching macroeconomic expectations and actual realizations, across the dollar versus the German mark, pound, yen, Swiss franc, and euro. Their central finding: announcement surprises — the divergence between what was expected and what arrived — produce immediate jumps in exchange rates. Not the announcements themselves. The gap between expectation and reality is what moves price, confirming with high-frequency data exactly what Lesson 3 argued.
242fd6f1c221.sw: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003), waliochapisha katika American Economic Review, walichunguza miaka sita ya nukuu za viwango vya ubadilishaji vya wakati halisi pamoja na matarajio ya kiuchumi mkuu yanayolingana na uhalisia halisi, katika dola dhidi ya alama ya Ujerumani, pauni, yen, faranga ya Uswisi, na euro. Tokeo lao kuu: mishangao ya matangazo — utofauti kati ya kile kilichotarajiwa na kile kilichofika — huzalisha miruko ya mara moja katika viwango vya ubadilishaji. Si matangazo yenyewe. Pengo kati ya matarajio na uhalisia ndicho kinachosogeza bei, kikithibitisha kwa data ya masafa ya juu hasa kile ambacho Somo la 3 lilihoji.

Kile ambacho hakuna kati yao kinachojumuisha ni gharama ya biashara ya fund yenyewe, wala spread unayolipa sokoni, wala ada yoyote ya jukwaa inayotozwa na yeyote anayeshikilia akaunti.

26022c3a9435.en: Daily chart: EUR/USD in a clear uptrend, higher highs and higher lows. Direction established — you're looking for longs only. Down to the 1-hour: price has pulled back to a support level that held twice before. That's a setup consistent with the daily trend. Down to the 15-minute: you wait for price to stop falling and turn up, then enter — with your stop just below that support level. Because the 15-minute chart let you enter close to your invalidation point, your stop distance is smaller, which by the position-sizing formula from Chapter 1, Lesson 5 means you can take a properly sized position for the same fixed dollar risk.
26022c3a9435.sw: Chati ya kila siku: EUR/USD katika mwelekeo wazi wa kupanda, vilele vya juu zaidi na mabonde ya juu zaidi. Mwelekeo umebainishwa — unatafuta long tu. Shuka hadi saa 1: bei imerudi nyuma hadi kiwango cha msaada kilichoshikilia mara mbili awali. Huo ni mpangilio unaolingana na mwelekeo wa kila siku. Shuka hadi dakika 15: unasubiri bei isimame kushuka na kugeuka juu, kisha unaingia — ukiwa na stop yako chini kidogo ya kiwango hicho cha msaada. Kwa sababu chati ya dakika 15 ilikuruhusu kuingia karibu na sehemu yako ya kuvunjika, umbali wako wa stop ni mdogo zaidi, ambao kwa fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 5 inamaanisha unaweza kuchukua nafasi iliyopimwa vizuri kwa hatari ile ile thabiti ya dola.

263fede39d67.en: A fee is one of the few things about investing you can control completely, and it is certain. The return is uncertain, the timing is uncertain, your own behaviour is uncertain. The expense ratio is a known number you can read before you buy and change by choosing a different fund. Spending effort on the certain, controllable input before the uncertain, uncontrollable one is simply the better use of attention.
263fede39d67.sw: Ada ni mojawapo ya vitu vichache kuhusu uwekezaji unavyoweza kuvidhibiti kabisa, na ni ya uhakika. Faida haina uhakika, muda hauna uhakika, tabia yako mwenyewe haina uhakika. Uwiano wa gharama ni namba inayojulikana unayoweza kuisoma kabla ya kununua na kuibadilisha kwa kuchagua fund tofauti. Kutumia juhudi juu ya pembejeo ya uhakika inayodhibitika kabla ya ile isiyo na uhakika isiyodhibitika ni matumizi bora tu ya umakini.

264ca4f14ea7.en: The probability that a series of losing trades reduces an account to the point where it can no longer recover or continue. It is the trading form of the classical "gambler's ruin" problem in probability.
264ca4f14ea7.sw: Uwezekano kwamba mfululizo wa biashara za hasara hupunguza akaunti hadi mahali isipoweza tena kupona au kuendelea. Ni umbo la biashara la tatizo la kawaida la "kufilisika kwa mchezaji wa kamari" katika uwezekano.

27178fe5679c.en: By late 2007 the Reserve Bank of Australia was paying around 6.75%, while the Bank of Japan paid about 0.5% — a gap of roughly five percentage points, earned simply for holding the position. On top of that interest, the trade itself kept rising: as more money poured in, the yen weakened and the Australian dollar strengthened, so carry traders were paid twice — the rate difference, plus the currency move. AUD/JPY climbed to an all-time high near 107.80 in October 2007.
27178fe5679c.sw: Kufikia mwishoni mwa mwaka 2007 Benki ya Akiba ya Australia ilikuwa ikilipa karibu 6.75%, ilhali Benki ya Japani ililipa takriban 0.5% — pengo la takriban pointi tano za asilimia, likipatikana kwa kushikilia nafasi tu. Juu ya riba hiyo, biashara yenyewe iliendelea kupanda: pesa nyingi zilipomiminika, yen ilidhoofika na dola ya Australia iliimarika, hivyo wafanyabiashara wa carry walilipwa mara mbili — tofauti ya kiwango, pamoja na msogeo wa sarafu. AUD/JPY lilipanda hadi kilele cha wakati wote karibu na 107.80 mwezi Oktoba 2007.

272f29b569f6.en: Not quite. The cost is a trading cost, not a fee or a tax. Trackers must all buy the new constituents and sell the departing ones around the same date, and that concentrated trading is paid for out of the fund itself.
272f29b569f6.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Gharama ni ya biashara, si ada wala kodi. Wafuatiliaji wote lazima wanunue washiriki wapya na kuuza wanaoondoka karibu tarehe ile ile, na biashara hiyo iliyojikita hulipwa kutoka kwenye fund yenyewe.

273c4fb22902.en: Anton, Cohen and Polk, in their study "Best Ideas," found that the positions in which professional managers showed the most conviction — their single best-analysed ideas — outperformed both the market and the managers' own other holdings by roughly 2.8 to 4.5% per year. The striking part is the rest: the majority of the other stocks those managers held did not beat the market at all. Their edge was concentrated in a handful of ideas, and diluted by everything else they owned.
273c4fb22902.sw: Anton, Cohen na Polk, katika utafiti wao "Best Ideas," waligundua kwamba nafasi ambazo wasimamizi wa kitaaluma walionyesha uhakika mkubwa zaidi — mawazo yao moja yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi — yalifanya vizuri zaidi kuliko soko na kuliko umiliki mwingine wa wasimamizi wenyewe kwa takriban 2.8 hadi 4.5% kwa mwaka. Sehemu ya kushangaza ni iliyobaki: hisa nyingi zilizobaki ambazo wasimamizi hao walizishikilia hazikushinda soko kabisa. Faida yao ilijikita katika mawazo machache, na ilipunguzwa na kila kitu kingine walichokimiliki.

279d6fb5fe18.en: Why did stop-loss orders fail to protect many traders during the Swiss franc shock?
279d6fb5fe18.sw: Kwa nini maagizo ya stop-loss yalishindwa kuwalinda wafanyabiashara wengi wakati wa mshtuko wa faranga ya Uswisi?

27f2104a42ca.en: Consider a trader holding a long pound position with a sensible stop, asleep during the London night. The flash crash triggers the stop deep in the plunge, filling far below its level in the thin market — and then price recovers within minutes. The trader is left with a real, oversized loss from a move that had largely reversed by the time they woke. They were not wrong about the pound. They were caught by when and how the market moved, not by which direction it ultimately went.
27f2104a42ca.sw: Fikiria mfanyabiashara anayeshikilia nafasi ya long ya pauni akiwa na stop yenye busara, amelala wakati wa usiku wa London. Anguko la ghafla huanzisha stop ndani kabisa ya kuporomoka, likitimizwa chini mno ya kiwango chake katika soko jembamba — na kisha bei hupona ndani ya dakika chache. Mfanyabiashara anaachwa na hasara halisi, kubwa kupita kiasi kutokana na msogeo ambao ulikuwa umegeuka kwa kiasi kikubwa wakati alipoamka. Hawakukosea kuhusu pauni. Walikamatwa na lini na jinsi soko lilivyosogea, si mwelekeo ulioenda hatimaye.

27faf872fbdf.en: Not quite. Fees are disclosed and reasonably stable. The point is that the fee is only part of what separates a fund from its index — the full gap is the tracking difference, and occasionally the cheaper-looking fund delivers less of the index.
27faf872fbdf.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ada hufichuliwa na ni thabiti kwa kiasi. Pointi ni kwamba ada ni sehemu tu ya kinachotenganisha fund na index yake — pengo kamili ni tofauti ya kufuatilia, na mara chache fund inayoonekana nafuu hutoa sehemu ndogo ya index.
