282ca6651ca1.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — ushahidi unaonyesha faida za carry huanguka kwa pamoja mtikisiko unapopanda ghafla, hivyo mapato thabiti ni fidia kwa hatari ya kuanguka, si chakula cha bure.

285269579e9b.en: This is the part of price action with the best academic support, and — unusually for this course — the strongest evidence is forex-specific rather than borrowed from stock markets.
285269579e9b.sw: Hii ndiyo sehemu ya shughuli ya bei yenye uungwaji mkono bora zaidi wa kitaaluma, na — isivyo kawaida kwa kozi hii — ushahidi imara zaidi ni mahususi wa forex badala ya kukopwa kutoka masoko ya hisa.

288e878c33fb.en: Fundamentals — what is the macro story? Interest-rate paths, growth, inflation, central-bank direction (Chapter 2, Lesson 3). Is the underlying economic pressure pushing the currency your way?
288e878c33fb.sw: Misingi — simulizi ya uchumi mkuu ni ipi? Njia za viwango vya riba, ukuaji, mfumuko wa bei, mwelekeo wa benki kuu (Sura ya 2, Somo la 3). Je, shinikizo la msingi la kiuchumi linasukuma sarafu upande wako?

28d3428f77ab.en: Not quite — a strategy's edge is regime-dependent; most failures are the regime changing, not the strategy breaking.
28d3428f77ab.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — faida ya mkakati hutegemea hali; kushindwa kwingi ni hali kubadilika, si mkakati kuharibika.

292e4edfdf42.en: A firm allowed to create or redeem ETF shares directly with the fund.
292e4edfdf42.sw: Kampuni inayoruhusiwa kuunda au kukomboa hisa za ETF moja kwa moja na fund.

29a225414d53.en: Not quite — a journal's main value is measuring real expectancy and revealing repeated mistakes, which is how you improve and how you read a drawdown correctly.
29a225414d53.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — thamani kuu ya kumbukumbu ni kupima matarajio halisi na kufichua makosa yanayorudiwa, ambavyo ndivyo unavyoboreka na kusoma kushuka kwa usahihi.

29b8521472a9.en: Nothing — profit and cash flow are unrelated measures
29b8521472a9.sw: Hakuna — faida na mtiririko wa fedha ni vipimo visivyohusiana

29c468650066.en: The difference in fee is 1.45 percent a year. The difference in outcome is about 25,000.
29c468650066.sw: Tofauti ya ada ni asilimia 1.45 kwa mwaka. Tofauti ya tokeo ni takriban 25,000.

29e0edb510b1.en: Once the trade matches, ownership does not change hands instantly. There is a settlement period between agreeing the trade and the shares and money actually moving.
29e0edb510b1.sw: Mara biashara inapolingana, umiliki haubadiliki mikono papo hapo. Kuna kipindi cha kutatua kati ya kukubaliana biashara na hisa na pesa kusogea hasa.

29e64cb81fb2.en: A short sequence of one to three candlesticks — such as a pin bar, an engulfing pair, or a morning star — claimed to signal a likely reversal or continuation in price.
29e64cb81fb2.sw: Mfululizo mfupi wa mshumaa mmoja hadi mitatu — kama pin bar, jozi ya engulfing, au morning star — unaodaiwa kuashiria mgeuko au mwendelezo unaowezekana wa bei.

2a6328754a66.en: True or False: when no pillar aligns and there is no catalyst, a disciplined trader lowers their standards so they always have a position on.
2a6328754a66.sw: Kweli au Uongo: hakuna nguzo inapolingana na hakuna kichocheo, mfanyabiashara mwenye nidhamu hushusha viwango vyake ili daima awe na nafasi.

2aa4fb79736b.en: Correct — real trading never guarantees a return, so a promise of guaranteed or unusually high returns is the clearest sign of a scam. Losing streaks, spreads and news moves are ordinary features of real markets.
2aa4fb79736b.sw: Sahihi — biashara halisi haihakikishi faida kamwe, hivyo ahadi ya faida ya uhakika au kubwa isivyo kawaida ndiyo ishara iliyo wazi zaidi ya ulaghai. Mifululizo ya hasara, spread na misogeo ya habari ni sifa za kawaida za masoko halisi.

2abee711822a.en: The journal is what turns expectancy (Lesson 2) from a formula into a number you actually know about yourself, and it is the only way to tell the difference between a losing system and a winning system in a normal losing streak. The checklist protects the next trade; the journal improves the next hundred.
2abee711822a.sw: Kumbukumbu ndicho kinachogeuza matarajio (Somo la 2) kutoka fomula kuwa namba unayoijua hasa kuhusu nafsi yako, na ndiyo njia pekee ya kutofautisha kati ya mfumo unaopoteza na mfumo unaoshinda katika mfululizo wa kawaida wa hasara. Orodha ya ukaguzi hulinda biashara inayofuata; kumbukumbu huboresha mia inayofuata.

2b820ceeee62.en: Buying a diversified basket of productive companies and holding it for twenty years passes the first test comfortably and makes the second largely irrelevant, because you are not trying to beat anyone. Trading in and out of single companies on the strength of a news headline fails both.
2b820ceeee62.sw: Kununua kikapu kilichosambazwa cha kampuni zenye tija na kukishikilia kwa miaka ishirini hupita jaribio la kwanza kwa raha na hufanya la pili lisihusike kwa kiasi kikubwa, kwa sababu hujaribu kumshinda mtu yeyote. Kufanya biashara ya kuingia na kutoka katika kampuni moja kwa nguvu ya kichwa cha habari hushindwa yote mawili.

2b93f7b3d6da.en: Diagram mapping each common beginner mistake to the fix and the lesson that already gives it — no plan, over-risking, moving stops, cutting winners and riding losers, overtrading, chasing news, indicator overload, and trusting unverified claims — plus the two habits that catch them: a pre-trade checklist and a trading journal
2b93f7b3d6da.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha kila kosa la kawaida la anayeanza dhidi ya suluhisho na somo linalotoa tayari — hakuna mpango, kuhatarisha kupita kiasi, kusogeza stop, kukata washindi na kupanda wapotezaji, kufanya biashara kupita kiasi, kufukuza habari, kujaza viashiria, na kuamini madai yasiyothibitishwa — pamoja na tabia mbili zinazoyakamata: orodha ya ukaguzi ya kabla ya biashara na kumbukumbu ya biashara

2bf0484ee21e.en: Not quite. The advertised fee is only part of what separates a fund from its index. Tracking difference captures the total shortfall, and here the fund with the higher fee delivered a smaller one.
2bf0484ee21e.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ada iliyotangazwa ni sehemu tu ya kinachotenganisha fund na index yake. Tofauti ya kufuatilia hunasa upungufu wa jumla, na hapa fund yenye ada kubwa zaidi ilitoa upungufu mdogo zaidi.

2c075765136f.en: The transmission chain from rates outward, how regimes pick the winning pillar, and why all-quiet means cash.
2c075765136f.sw: Mnyororo wa usambazaji kutoka viwango kwenda nje, jinsi hali zinavyochagua nguzo inayoshinda, na kwa nini utulivu kamili unamaanisha fedha taslimu.

2c578d22b975.en: Fund A charges 0.07% a year and has lagged its index by 0.19% annually. Fund B charges 0.12% and has lagged by 0.10%. Which has served its investors better, and why?
2c578d22b975.sw: Fund A hutoza 0.07% kwa mwaka na imekawia index yake kwa 0.19% kila mwaka. Fund B hutoza 0.12% na imekawia kwa 0.10%. Ni ipi imewahudumia wawekezaji wake vizuri zaidi, na kwa nini?

2c6b810e61d4.en: Correct — it is the stop-out mechanism from Chapter 3, Lesson 2 at scale: each wave of triggered stops adds selling into a thin market, driving price down and setting off the next wave.
2c6b810e61d4.sw: Sahihi — ni utaratibu wa stop-out kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 2 kwa kipimo kikubwa: kila wimbi la stop zilizoanzishwa huongeza kuuza katika soko jembamba, likisukuma bei chini na kuanzisha wimbi linalofuata.

2c7219fee72d.sw: Mitindo ya mishumaa daima hufanya kazi

2c73442a3b46.en: Identifying a risk, judging if it's worth taking, and controlling its potential cost.
2c73442a3b46.sw: Kutambua hatari, kuhukumu kama inastahili kuchukuliwa, na kudhibiti gharama yake inayowezekana.

2c8c857a467c.sw: Mkakati huacha kufanya kazi kwa bahati nasibu

2ca0fed06e89.en: Becomes a limit order (not market order) once triggered.
2ca0fed06e89.sw: Hukuwa agizo la kikomo (si agizo la soko) mara linapoanzishwa.

2cc74f176f60.en: For forex, a practical, widely-used pairing is the 20-period and 50-period SMA (stock traders often add the 200-day; that's a different market's convention). What a single SMA gives you is a cleaner read of the trend direction than raw candles — a downward-sloping 20 SMA says the last 20 periods have, on average, been falling.
2cc74f176f60.sw: Kwa forex, uwianishaji wa kivitendo unaotumika kwa upana ni SMA ya vipindi 20 na 50 (wafanyabiashara wa hisa mara nyingi huongeza ya siku 200; hiyo ni desturi ya soko tofauti). Kile ambacho SMA moja hukupa ni usomaji safi zaidi wa mwelekeo kuliko mishumaa ghafi — SMA ya 20 inayoteremka chini inasema vipindi 20 vya mwisho, kwa wastani, vimekuwa vikishuka.

2d1f4f54405d.en: Diagram showing the base/quote breakdown of a currency pair and the historical pecking order that determines which currency is listed first
2d1f4f54405d.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha mgawanyo wa msingi/bei wa jozi la sarafu na daraja la kihistoria linaloamua ni sarafu ipi inaorodheshwa kwanza

2d25342f94af.en: It is fair to ask whether this much care over a few dollars of pip value really matters. The answer comes from the mathematics of losing, not winning.
2d25342f94af.sw: Ni haki kuuliza kama uangalifu huu wote juu ya dola chache za thamani ya pip unahusika kweli. Jibu linatoka kwenye hisabati ya kupoteza, si kushinda.

2d3bdd7ddbf0.en: The conflict facing a country whose currency is the world's reserve currency: it must supply the world with enough of its currency for global trade, while keeping enough confidence in that currency to stay credible — two goals pulling in opposite directions.
2d3bdd7ddbf0.sw: Mgongano unaokabili nchi ambayo sarafu yake ndiyo sarafu ya akiba ya dunia: lazima iipe dunia sarafu yake ya kutosha kwa biashara ya kimataifa, huku ikihifadhi imani ya kutosha katika sarafu hiyo ili ibaki ya kuaminika — malengo mawili yanayovutana pande tofauti.

2d624684d501.en: Correct. Recurring charges add together, and the advertised fund fee is a floor rather than a total. Neither figure includes the fund's own trading costs or the spread you pay on the exchange, so 0.55% is the minimum rather than the answer.
2d624684d501.sw: Sahihi. Malipo ya kudumu huongezeka pamoja, na ada ya fund iliyotangazwa ni sakafu badala ya jumla. Hakuna takwimu inayojumuisha gharama za biashara za fund yenyewe wala spread unayolipa sokoni, hivyo 0.55% ni kiwango cha chini badala ya jibu.

2d7eafef476b.en: USD/JPY is trading at 150.00. Pip value = 1,000 yen / 150.00 = 6.67 US dollars per pip on a standard lot. Not 10 dollars — about a third less.
2d7eafef476b.sw: USD/JPY inafanyiwa biashara kwa 150.00. Thamani ya pip = yen 1,000 / 150.00 = dola 6.67 za Marekani kwa kila pip kwenye lot sanifu. Si dola 10 — takriban theluthi moja pungufu.

2dadae349dcd.en: A price level where rising prices have repeatedly reversed downward.
2dadae349dcd.sw: Kiwango cha bei ambapo bei zinazopanda zimegeuka kushuka mara kwa mara.

2dafe224435d.en: An indicator (developed by John Bollinger in the 1980s) consisting of a 20-period moving average with an upper and lower band drawn a set number of standard deviations above and below it — 2 by default.
2dafe224435d.sw: Kiashiria (kilichoendelezwa na John Bollinger katika miaka ya 1980) kinachojumuisha wastani unaosogea wa vipindi 20 wenye ukanda wa juu na wa chini ulioorwa idadi iliyowekwa ya mikengeuko sanifu juu na chini yake — 2 kwa chaguo-msingi.

2db51f2f8492.en: Indices also change their membership, and the change is not free.
2db51f2f8492.sw: Index pia hubadilisha uanachama wake, na mabadiliko si ya bure.

2e16a618b624.en: The two documented engines of loss and their evidence, and discipline as a structural fix rather than an act of willpower.
2e16a618b624.sw: Injini mbili zilizoandikwa za hasara na ushahidi wao, na nidhamu kama suluhisho la kimuundo badala ya tendo la nia thabiti.

2e29f8f465ba.en: Watch for these in your own trading: When you close a trade early, ask honestly — is this my plan executing, or the disposition effect offering me a sure small win? When you are still holding a position past where your stop should have been, ask the same question in reverse — plan, or hope? Count your trades over a week: are you trading because a setup genuinely met your rules, or because you were bored, confident, or chasing a loss back? And is each trade's exit placed as an order before you enter, so the decision is already made and not left to you to fumble in the moment?
2e29f8f465ba.sw: Tazama haya katika biashara yako mwenyewe: Unapofunga biashara mapema, jiulize kwa uaminifu — je, huu ni mpango wangu ukitekelezwa, au athari ya kuachana na nafasi ikinipa ushindi mdogo wa uhakika? Unapokuwa bado unashikilia nafasi zaidi ya pale stop yako ilipopaswa kuwa, jiulize swali lile lile kinyume — mpango, au matumaini? Hesabu biashara zako kwa wiki: je, unafanya biashara kwa sababu mpangilio ulikidhi kanuni zako kweli, au kwa sababu ulikuwa umechoshwa, unajiamini, au unafukuza hasara irudi? Na je, kutoka kwa kila biashara kumewekwa kama agizo kabla hujaingia, ili uamuzi uwe tayari umefanyika na usiachwe kwako kuupapasa wakati huo?

2e7ae68c2fe0.en: Because fees are not disclosed for index funds
2e7ae68c2fe0.sw: Kwa sababu ada hazifichuliwi kwa index fund

2eb1b593ab25.en: A currency fixed in value relative to another currency.
2eb1b593ab25.sw: Sarafu yenye thamani thabiti ikilinganishwa na sarafu nyingine.

2eb301ad176e.en: A written, structured argument for why a specific trade should work, built from several independent lines of evidence rather than a single opinion or feeling.
2eb301ad176e.sw: Hoja iliyoandikwa na yenye muundo ya kwa nini biashara mahususi inapaswa kufanya kazi, iliyojengwa kutoka mistari kadhaa huru ya ushahidi badala ya maoni au hisia moja.

2ee47880d5dc.en: Not quite — (0.60 times 80) minus (0.40 times 150) = minus 12 dollars per trade. A high win rate cannot save losses far larger than the wins.
2ee47880d5dc.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — (0.60 mara 80) toa (0.40 mara 150) = toa dola 12 kwa kila biashara. Kiwango kikubwa cha ushindi hakiwezi kuokoa hasara kubwa mno kuliko ushindi.

2ee5d178adcf.en: It's easy to casually call a pair like USD/MXN a "minor" pair, since it's less liquid than a major — but by standard classification, it's actually an exotic pair. A true minor (cross) pair never involves USD at all — it's two majors paired directly, like CAD/JPY. Precision matters here because exotic pairs carry meaningfully different risk (lower liquidity, wider spreads, higher volatility) than true minors.
2ee5d178adcf.sw: Ni rahisi kuliita jozi kama USD/MXN jozi "ndogo" kwa mzaha, kwa kuwa lina ukwasi mdogo kuliko jozi kuu — lakini kwa uainishaji wa kawaida, kwa kweli ni jozi adimu. Jozi la kweli ndogo (la kuvuka) halihusishi USD kabisa — ni jozi kuu mbili zilizowekwa pamoja moja kwa moja, kama CAD/JPY. Usahihi unahusika hapa kwa sababu jozi adimu hubeba hatari tofauti kwa maana halisi (ukwasi mdogo, spread pana zaidi, mtikisiko mkubwa zaidi) kuliko jozi ndogo za kweli.

2ef603f0ac0c.en: Two decisions define any index. Which companies are in it, and how the contribution of each is weighted. The second decision is the one almost nobody examines, and it changes the answer more than people expect.
2ef603f0ac0c.sw: Maamuzi mawili hufafanua index yoyote. Kampuni zipi ziko ndani yake, na mchango wa kila moja unapewa uzito gani. Uamuzi wa pili ndio karibu hakuna anayeuchunguza, na hubadilisha jibu zaidi ya watu wanavyotarajia.

2f19e2ac8f6a.en: A diversifier has an average positive (but imperfect) correlation; a safe haven specifically holds zero/negative correlation during market stress
2f19e2ac8f6a.sw: Msambazaji ana uwiano chanya wa wastani (lakini usio kamili); kimbilio salama hushikilia mahususi uwiano wa sifuri/hasi wakati wa shinikizo la soko

2f874f690765.en: In 1933, with U.S. gold reserves under severe strain, the government required citizens to exchange gold coin and bullion for currency, ending public redemption of dollars for gold domestically. In 1934, the Gold Reserve Act officially devalued the dollar from $20.67 to $35 per ounce — the U.S. left the domestic gold standard, but kept a modified, international-only version alive at that new rate.
2f874f690765.sw: Mwaka 1933, akiba za dhahabu za Marekani zikiwa chini ya shinikizo kali, serikali iliwataka raia kubadilisha sarafu na madini ya dhahabu kwa fedha, ikimaliza ukombozi wa umma wa dola kwa dhahabu ndani ya nchi. Mwaka 1934, Sheria ya Akiba ya Dhahabu ilishusha rasmi thamani ya dola kutoka $20.67 hadi $35 kwa wakia — Marekani iliacha kiwango cha dhahabu cha ndani, lakini ikaweka hai toleo lililorekebishwa, la kimataifa tu, kwa kiwango hicho kipya.

2fb344e89e0b.en: You profit in forex by holding one currency while it strengthens against another, then converting back — no travel required.
2fb344e89e0b.sw: Unapata faida katika forex kwa kushikilia sarafu moja inapoimarika dhidi ya nyingine, kisha kubadilisha tena — hakuna safari inayohitajika.

2fb6f4ba2114.en: This reframes everything the course has built. The whole point of Chapters 1 through 3 was to let you decide the things that matter — position size, stop, target, the ratio — in advance, while you are calm and thinking clearly. Discipline is simply honouring those decisions when fear and greed show up, which they will. That is why the tools are the answer, not gritted teeth: an OCO order (Chapter 1, Lesson 7) executes your exit whether or not you can bring yourself to click; a pre-set position size (Chapter 3, Lesson 1) removes the greedy "go bigger just this once." The plan is your defence against your own psychology — and building that plan properly is the subject of the next lesson.
2fb6f4ba2114.sw: Hii hupanga upya kila kitu ambacho kozi imekijenga. Kusudi lote la Sura ya 1 hadi 3 lilikuwa kukuruhusu uamue mambo yanayohusika — ukubwa wa nafasi, stop, lengo, uwiano — mapema, ukiwa mtulivu na unafikiri kwa uwazi. Nidhamu ni kuheshimu tu maamuzi hayo hofu na tamaa zinapojitokeza, ambazo zitajitokeza. Ndiyo sababu zana ndizo jibu, si meno yaliyokazwa: agizo la OCO (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7) hutekeleza kutoka kwako iwe unaweza kujilazimisha kubofya au huwezi; ukubwa wa nafasi uliowekwa mapema (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1) huondoa "nenda kubwa zaidi mara hii tu" ya tamaa. Mpango ni kinga yako dhidi ya saikolojia yako mwenyewe — na kujenga mpango huo ipasavyo ni mada ya somo lijalo.

2fbf4b2fcfc8.en: Fees are quoted as small annual percentages, which makes them sound trivial. The arithmetic of compounding them over an investing lifetime is not trivial at all, and it is the most reliably ignored number in personal investing.
2fbf4b2fcfc8.sw: Ada hunukuliwa kama asilimia ndogo za kila mwaka, jambo linalozifanya zisikike zisizo na maana. Hesabu ya kuzijikusanya katika maisha yote ya uwekezaji si isiyo na maana kabisa, na ndiyo namba inayopuuzwa kwa uhakika zaidi katika uwekezaji binafsi.

2fc3c8065b0f.en: The money gained or lost per pip, for a given position size, in your account currency.
2fc3c8065b0f.sw: Pesa zinazopatikana au kupotea kwa kila pip, kwa ukubwa fulani wa nafasi, kwa sarafu ya akaunti yako.

2fd7e9179bac.en: Not quite — rates hit currencies and bonds first (closest to rates), then ripple out to credit/equities, commodities, and crypto.
2fd7e9179bac.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — viwango hugonga sarafu na hatifungani kwanza (karibu zaidi na viwango), kisha husambaa hadi mikopo/hisa, bidhaa, na crypto.

2ff325dec436.en: As markets fell, leveraged investors rushed to close their carry positions all at once. Closing the trade meant buying back yen — millions of traders buying the same currency at the same time — so the yen did not just recover, it surged. The same crowding that had paid on the way up now punished everyone on the way down, together.
2ff325dec436.sw: Masoko yalipoanguka, wawekezaji wa leverage walikimbilia kufunga nafasi zao za carry wote kwa pamoja. Kufunga biashara kulimaanisha kununua yen tena — mamilioni ya wafanyabiashara wakinunua sarafu ile ile kwa wakati mmoja — hivyo yen haikupona tu, ilipanda ghafla. Msongamano ule ule uliokuwa umelipa njiani kwenda juu sasa uliadhibu kila mtu njiani kwenda chini, kwa pamoja.

3020c48f2bed.en: True or False: a system with positive expectancy should be profitable over your next eight trades.
3020c48f2bed.sw: Kweli au Uongo: mfumo wenye matarajio chanya unapaswa kuwa na faida katika biashara zako nane zijazo.

302bef81e9ed.en: Not every red entry is equal. The events that most reliably move currencies: central bank rate decisions (Fed FOMC, ECB, BoE, BoJ), the highest-impact events in forex; inflation data (CPI), because it shapes what the central bank does next; employment data, especially US Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), released monthly; GDP releases, the broad growth picture; and central bank speeches and minutes, often as market-moving as decisions themselves, since traders parse them for hawkish/dovish hints.
302bef81e9ed.sw: Si kila kiingilio chekundu ni sawa. Matukio yanayosogeza sarafu kwa kutegemewa zaidi: maamuzi ya viwango vya benki kuu (Fed FOMC, ECB, BoE, BoJ), matukio yenye athari kubwa zaidi katika forex; data ya mfumuko wa bei (CPI), kwa sababu hutengeneza kile benki kuu inachofanya baadaye; data ya ajira, hasa Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) za Marekani, zinazotolewa kila mwezi; matoleo ya GDP, picha pana ya ukuaji; na hotuba na kumbukumbu za benki kuu, mara nyingi zinazosogeza soko kama maamuzi yenyewe, kwa kuwa wafanyabiashara huzichambua kwa dalili za hawkish/dovish.

303161638ae9.en: A share shows a bid of 24.98 and an ask of 25.02. The quoted price is 25.00 — the midpoint, which is a number nobody is actually offering. Buy now and you pay 25.02. Sell immediately afterwards and you receive 24.98. You are down 0.04 per share, or 0.16%, without the price having moved at all.
303161638ae9.sw: Hisa huonyesha bid ya 24.98 na ask ya 25.02. Bei iliyonukuliwa ni 25.00 — sehemu ya kati, ambayo ni namba ambayo hakuna anayeitoa hasa. Nunua sasa na unalipa 25.02. Uza mara moja baadaye na unapokea 24.98. Umeshuka 0.04 kwa kila hisa, au 0.16%, bila bei kusogea kabisa.

303584cd0ae9.en: As you look at any currency quote, ask yourself: which direction is the currency moving — is it strengthening or weakening against the one you're comparing it to? What would make you expect that movement to continue, reverse, or hold steady? And what does it actually cost to convert — fees, spread, timing — versus the size of the move you're expecting?
303584cd0ae9.sw: Unapotazama nukuu yoyote ya sarafu, jiulize: sarafu inasogea mwelekeo upi — inaimarika au inadhoofika dhidi ya ile unayoilinganisha nayo? Ni nini kingekufanya utarajie msogeo huo uendelee, ugeuke, au ubaki thabiti? Na inagharimu nini hasa kubadilisha — ada, spread, muda — ikilinganishwa na ukubwa wa msogeo unaoutarajia?

305ce5953e84.en: It creates a counterparty relationship and raises questions about collateral and how much of the fee reaches investors
305ce5953e84.sw: Huzalisha uhusiano wa mshirika na huzua maswali kuhusu dhamana na kiasi gani cha ada hufika kwa wawekezaji

30756825330b.en: Operating cash flow tells you the business produced cash. Free cash flow tells you how much survived the cost of keeping the business running. A company generating strong operating cash that spends all of it replacing worn-out equipment is not producing anything for its owners, however healthy the top of the statement looks.
30756825330b.sw: Mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli hukuambia biashara ilizalisha fedha. Mtiririko huru wa fedha hukuambia kiasi gani kilinusurika gharama ya kuendesha biashara. Kampuni inayozalisha fedha imara za shughuli inayozitumia zote kubadilisha vifaa vilivyochakaa haizalishi chochote kwa wamiliki wake, hata juu ya taarifa ionekane na afya kiasi gani.

308338b4f073.en: At 1:1, break-even win rate = 1 / (1 + 1) = 50%. At 1:2, it is 1 / (1 + 2) = 33.3%. At 1:3, it is 1 / (1 + 3) = 25%. So with a 1:3 ratio, you can lose three trades out of four and still break even. Going the other way, if your reward is only half your risk (you take 15-pip profits behind a 30-pip stop), R is 0.5 and the break-even win rate climbs to 1 / 1.5 = 66.7% — you now have to win two out of every three trades just to stand still.
308338b4f073.sw: Kwa 1:1, kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana = 1 / (1 + 1) = 50%. Kwa 1:2, ni 1 / (1 + 2) = 33.3%. Kwa 1:3, ni 1 / (1 + 3) = 25%. Hivyo kwa uwiano wa 1:3, unaweza kupoteza biashara tatu kati ya nne na bado ukalingana. Kwenda upande mwingine, kama tuzo yako ni nusu tu ya hatari yako (unachukua faida za pip 15 nyuma ya stop ya pip 30), R ni 0.5 na kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana hupanda hadi 1 / 1.5 = 66.7% — sasa lazima ushinde biashara mbili kati ya kila tatu ili tu kusimama tuli.

308bf9d43005.en: An asset with an average correlation at or below zero to another asset, across all conditions — calm markets and turbulent ones alike.
308bf9d43005.sw: Mali yenye uwiano wa wastani ulio sawa na au chini ya sifuri na mali nyingine, katika hali zote — masoko tulivu na yenye msukosuko sawasawa.

308debd585d5.en: The formula: Lot Size = (Account Balance × Risk %) ÷ (Stop-Loss in Pips × Pip Value).
308debd585d5.sw: Fomula: Ukubwa wa Lot = (Salio la Akaunti × Hatari %) ÷ (Stop-Loss kwa Pip × Thamani ya Pip).

30a37365597f.en: Heimer & Simsek (2019), published in the Journal of Financial Economics, studied exactly this question using a natural experiment: when the US imposed its 50:1/20:1 leverage cap in 2010, the researchers compared American traders (now capped) against otherwise-similar European traders (still uncapped at the time) using a difference-in-differences approach. They found the leverage constraint reduced trading volume by 23%, and — the key result — improved high-leverage traders' portfolio returns by 18 percentage points per month, alleviating their losses by roughly 40%. Their conclusion: the trading the cap eliminated was disproportionately speculative rather than informed, meaning the restriction removed harmful activity rather than useful market participation.
30a37365597f.sw: Heimer & Simsek (2019), waliochapisha katika Journal of Financial Economics, walisoma swali hili hasa kwa kutumia jaribio la asili: Marekani ilipoweka kikomo chake cha leverage cha 50:1/20:1 mwaka 2010, watafiti walilinganisha wafanyabiashara wa Marekani (sasa wenye kikomo) dhidi ya wafanyabiashara wa Ulaya wanaofanana kwa mengine (bado bila kikomo wakati huo) kwa kutumia mbinu ya tofauti-ndani-ya-tofauti. Waligundua kikwazo cha leverage kilipunguza kiasi cha biashara kwa 23%, na — tokeo muhimu — kiliboresha faida za mikusanyiko ya wafanyabiashara wa leverage kubwa kwa pointi 18 za asilimia kwa mwezi, kikipunguza hasara zao kwa takriban 40%. Hitimisho lao: biashara ambayo kikomo kiliiondoa ilikuwa ya kubahatisha kwa kiwango kisicholingana badala ya kuwa yenye taarifa, ikimaanisha kikwazo kiliondoa shughuli yenye madhara badala ya ushiriki wa soko wenye manufaa.

30d4c6946201.en: The classical gold standard, from its 1879 U.S. adoption through the Great Depression.
30d4c6946201.sw: Kiwango cha kawaida cha dhahabu, kuanzia kukubaliwa kwake Marekani mwaka 1879 hadi Mdororo Mkubwa wa Uchumi.

311bc61478b1.en: It reduces the fund's return by the amount lent
311bc61478b1.sw: Hupunguza faida ya fund kwa kiasi kilichokopeshwa

31309cb0dea0.en: A one-to-three-candle shape claimed to signal a reversal or continuation.
31309cb0dea0.sw: Umbo la mshumaa mmoja hadi mitatu linalodaiwa kuashiria mgeuko au mwendelezo.

319461b63bed.en: Diagram showing how to read each column of an economic calendar entry, the impact colour coding, the research on announcement surprises, and the beginner workflow
319461b63bed.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha jinsi ya kusoma kila safu ya kiingilio cha kalenda ya kiuchumi, mfumo wa rangi wa athari, utafiti juu ya mishangao ya matangazo, na mtiririko wa kazi wa anayeanza

31b3e6887ea5.en: Your account balance plus or minus the running profit or loss of any open positions. It is the real, live value of your account at this moment.
31b3e6887ea5.sw: Salio la akaunti yako pamoja au kutoa faida au hasara inayoendelea ya nafasi zozote zilizo wazi. Ndiyo thamani halisi, hai ya akaunti yako kwa sasa.

31ca10c11517.en: Correct — a short position profits when price falls, so the stop-loss sits above the entry, since a rise is what proves a short position wrong.
31ca10c11517.sw: Sahihi — nafasi ya short hupata faida bei inaposhuka, hivyo stop-loss inakaa juu ya kiingilio, kwa kuwa kupanda ndiko kunakothibitisha nafasi ya short imekosea.

31cb0e3fe6b6.en: An order book ladder for a share quoted at 25.00, showing asks at 25.02, 25.04 and 25.06 above bids at 24.98, 24.96 and 24.94, with the 0.04 spread marked between them and a note that buying and selling immediately costs 0.16 percent.
31cb0e3fe6b6.sw: Ngazi ya kitabu cha maagizo kwa hisa iliyonukuliwa kwa 25.00, ikionyesha ask kwa 25.02, 25.04 na 25.06 juu ya bid kwa 24.98, 24.96 na 24.94, ikiwa na spread ya 0.04 ikiwekwa alama kati yao na dokezo kwamba kununua na kuuza mara moja hugharimu asilimia 0.16.

31e37d81f705.en: Setting a Stop-Loss — Where and Why
31e37d81f705.sw: Kuweka Stop-Loss — Wapi na Kwa Nini

32674418fc51.en: Money valuable because of government backing and trust, not a physical commodity.
32674418fc51.sw: Pesa yenye thamani kwa sababu ya uungwaji mkono wa serikali na imani, si bidhaa ya kimwili.

3274dfec9e6f.en: When you use the calendar: check it for both currencies in your pair, not just the one you're focused on; compare forecast against previous before the release, since that gap shows what's already priced in; give downside surprises extra respect, because the research says bad news hits harder; and keep a personal log of how specific events behave, because your own data beats generic advice.
3274dfec9e6f.sw: Unapotumia kalenda: ikague kwa sarafu zote mbili katika jozi lako, si ile tu unayoizingatia; linganisha utabiri dhidi ya iliyopita kabla ya toleo, kwa kuwa pengo hilo huonyesha kilichowekewa bei tayari; ipe mishangao ya upande wa chini heshima ya ziada, kwa sababu utafiti unasema habari mbaya hugonga kwa nguvu zaidi; na weka kumbukumbu binafsi ya jinsi matukio mahususi yanavyotenda, kwa sababu data yako mwenyewe hushinda ushauri wa jumla.

32a33fa80eb6.en: Not quite — the difference is 1.08510 − 1.08500 = 0.00010, which is exactly one pip for a standard pair.
32a33fa80eb6.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — tofauti ni 1.08510 − 1.08500 = 0.00010, ambayo ni pip moja hasa kwa jozi sanifu.

32c78f6f4b88.en: True or False: once in a trade, it is fine to widen the stop if the thesis is still intact but price is moving against you uncomfortably.
32c78f6f4b88.sw: Kweli au Uongo: mara ukiwa ndani ya biashara, ni sawa kupanua stop kama nadharia bado iko sawa lakini bei inasogea dhidi yako kwa namna isiyostarehesha.

32e8e862a5ad.en: The hardest regime to trade is the one where nothing is happening.
32e8e862a5ad.sw: Hali ngumu zaidi kufanyia biashara ni ile ambapo hakuna kinachotokea.

3328f86d7319.en: Kelly's formula is well-proven, but it has a serious practical problem for real trading: it requires you to already know your true win rate and reward-to-risk ratio — numbers a beginner (and honestly, most traders) can't estimate reliably. Worse, "full Kelly" is aggressive enough that even with a genuine edge, it can produce 50–80% drawdowns along the way. This is precisely why professional traders and quants typically use "fractional Kelly" — a half or quarter of the full formula — trading some theoretical growth for dramatically less volatility.
3328f86d7319.sw: Fomula ya Kelly ina uthibitisho mzuri, lakini ina tatizo kubwa la kivitendo kwa biashara halisi: inakuhitaji ujue tayari kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi na uwiano wa tuzo-kwa-hatari — namba ambazo anayeanza (na kwa uaminifu, wafanyabiashara wengi) hawawezi kuzikadiria kwa kutegemewa. Vibaya zaidi, "Kelly kamili" ni ya ukali wa kutosha kiasi kwamba hata ukiwa na faida halisi, inaweza kuzalisha kushuka kwa 50–80% njiani. Hii ndiyo hasa sababu wafanyabiashara wa kitaaluma na wataalamu wa hesabu kwa kawaida hutumia "Kelly ya sehemu" — nusu au robo ya fomula kamili, wakibadilisha ukuaji fulani wa kinadharia kwa mtikisiko mdogo zaidi kwa kiasi kikubwa.

33456f37b867.en: Build these into your routine: Run the pre-trade checklist every single time — a planned setup, a real stop as an order, a ratio that clears your minimum, size within your risk percentage, and no chasing. When you break a rule, write down which one and why; the pattern in your journal is your real list of mistakes. Be most suspicious of anything that removes the need to think — a signal to copy, a promise of guaranteed returns, a can't-lose setup. And remember that a losing streak inside a positive-expectancy system is not a mistake; abandoning the system because of it is.
33456f37b867.sw: Jenga haya katika utaratibu wako: Pitia orodha ya ukaguzi ya kabla ya biashara kila mara moja — mpangilio uliopangwa, stop halisi kama agizo, uwiano unaopita kiwango chako cha chini, ukubwa ndani ya asilimia yako ya hatari, na kutokufukuza. Unapovunja kanuni, andika ni ipi na kwa nini; mtindo katika kumbukumbu yako ndio orodha yako halisi ya makosa. Kuwa na shaka zaidi na chochote kinachoondoa hitaji la kufikiri — ishara ya kunakili, ahadi ya faida ya uhakika, mpangilio usioweza kupoteza. Na kumbuka kwamba mfululizo wa hasara ndani ya mfumo wenye matarajio chanya si kosa; kuacha mfumo kwa sababu yake ndiyo kosa.

334e0e4b6b85.en: While researching this lesson, a live search turned up a trading blog claiming "a study covering over 8,000 chart setups" found a "62% average success rate" — no named author, no journal, no link. Before trusting a number like this, what would you want to see before believing it?
334e0e4b6b85.sw: Wakati wa kufanya utafiti wa somo hili, utafutaji wa moja kwa moja ulipata blogu ya biashara ikidai "utafiti unaohusu mipangilio zaidi ya 8,000 ya chati" uligundua "kiwango cha wastani cha mafanikio cha 62%" — hakuna mwandishi aliyetajwa, hakuna jarida, hakuna kiungo. Kabla ya kuamini namba kama hii, ungependa kuona nini kabla ya kuiamini?

334f93d8a48e.en: Notice that you already have every component from earlier chapters — the plan just assembles them. What and when to trade comes from Chapter 2 (indicators, fundamentals, the economic calendar). The stop goes at the invalidation level from Foundations Chapter 2 and Chapter 2, Lesson 5. The target sits at a real support or resistance level, and must clear your risk-to-reward minimum from Chapter 3, Lesson 3. Position size comes from the formula in Chapter 3, Lesson 1, capped by a fixed risk percentage. The plan is not new material; it is these decisions written down in advance.
334f93d8a48e.sw: Tambua kwamba tayari una kila kipengele kutoka sura zilizotangulia — mpango huviunganisha tu. Cha kufanyia biashara na lini hutoka Sura ya 2 (viashiria, misingi, kalenda ya kiuchumi). Stop huenda kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika kutoka Sura ya 2 ya Msingi na Sura ya 2, Somo la 5. Lengo hukaa kwenye kiwango halisi cha msaada au upinzani, na lazima lipite kiwango chako cha chini cha hatari-kwa-tuzo kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 3. Ukubwa wa nafasi hutoka kwenye fomula katika Sura ya 3, Somo la 1, ukiwekewa kikomo na asilimia thabiti ya hatari. Mpango si nyenzo mpya; ni maamuzi haya yakiandikwa mapema.

3352f8e28996.en: Dollars make expectancy concrete, but they change with account size and position size, which makes it hard to compare trades or systems. The fix is to measure everything in the R unit from Chapter 3, Lesson 3.
3352f8e28996.sw: Dola hufanya matarajio kuwa halisi, lakini hubadilika kulingana na ukubwa wa akaunti na ukubwa wa nafasi, jambo linalofanya iwe vigumu kulinganisha biashara au mifumo. Suluhisho ni kupima kila kitu kwa kipimo cha R kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 3.

339313eb71b4.en: Not quite — the stop belongs at the invalidation level where the thesis is proven wrong, not at an arbitrary distance.
339313eb71b4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — stop inastahili kuwa kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika ambapo nadharia inathibitishwa kuwa batili, si kwa umbali wa bahati nasibu.

33ae0887ab43.en: Diagram showing one trade measured in R with a stop at minus 1R and target at plus 2R, a table of break-even win rates (1:1 needs 50 percent, 1:2 needs 33.3 percent, 1:3 needs 25 percent), and three traders over ten trades where a 40 percent win rate at 1:2 and a 60 percent win rate at 1:1 both make plus 2R while a 70 percent win rate at 1:0.5 makes only plus 0.5R
33ae0887ab43.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha biashara moja ikipimwa kwa R ukiwa na stop kwa toa 1R na lengo kwa jumlisha 2R, jedwali la viwango vya ushindi vya kulingana (1:1 huhitaji asilimia 50, 1:2 huhitaji asilimia 33.3, 1:3 huhitaji asilimia 25), na wafanyabiashara watatu katika biashara kumi ambapo kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 40 kwa 1:2 na kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 60 kwa 1:1 vyote hufanya jumlisha 2R ilhali kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 70 kwa 1:0.5 hufanya jumlisha 0.5R tu

33c4be231ea0.en: Not quite — re-read the three functions: medium of exchange, store of value, and unit of account.
33c4be231ea0.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — soma tena kazi tatu: njia ya kubadilishana, hifadhi ya thamani, na kipimo cha hesabu.

33ddda526035.en: That ownership is real but limited. It does not entitle you to walk into the company and take a desk. It entitles you to two things: a vote on certain decisions, and a claim on whatever value is left over after everyone else has been paid.
33ddda526035.sw: Umiliki huo ni halisi lakini una mipaka. Haukupi haki ya kuingia kampunini na kuchukua dawati. Hukupa haki ya vitu viwili: kura juu ya maamuzi fulani, na dai juu ya thamani yoyote iliyobaki baada ya kila mtu mwingine kulipwa.

33ff2be251aa.en: Two panels comparing a roulette wheel, where 37 pockets and a 35 to 1 payout give an expected return of about 0.973 units per unit staked, with owning productive businesses, where cash is generated outside the transactions between investors so every owner can gain at once.
33ff2be251aa.sw: Paneli mbili zikilinganisha gurudumu la roulette, ambapo mifuko 37 na malipo ya 35 kwa 1 hutoa faida inayotarajiwa ya takriban vipimo 0.973 kwa kila kipimo kilichowekwa, na kumiliki biashara zenye tija, ambapo fedha huzalishwa nje ya miamala kati ya wawekezaji hivyo kila mmiliki anaweza kupata faida kwa wakati mmoja.

3414513d76b1.en: A fee is charged on the whole balance every year, so it compounds against you. 1.45% a year became a third of the final pot.
3414513d76b1.sw: Ada hutozwa juu ya salio lote kila mwaka, hivyo hujikusanya dhidi yako. 1.45% kwa mwaka ilikuwa theluthi moja ya chungu cha mwisho.

3424a16419b9.en: The value of the fund's holdings per fund share.
3424a16419b9.sw: Thamani ya umiliki wa fund kwa kila hisa ya fund.

343580f2c11a.en: Price repeatedly reverses at these levels — a probability built from history, not a guaranteed wall.
343580f2c11a.sw: Bei hugeuka mara kwa mara kwenye viwango hivi — uwezekano uliojengwa kutoka historia, si ukuta wa uhakika.

343c630c2241.en: Your equity minus the margin currently used by open positions. It is the cushion available to absorb further losses and to open new trades.
343c630c2241.sw: Usawa wako kutoa margin inayotumiwa sasa na nafasi zilizo wazi. Ndio mto unaopatikana kufyonza hasara zaidi na kufungua biashara mpya.

3446a6fd80c5.en: Profit involves judgement in a way cash does not. How quickly to depreciate equipment, when a sale counts as made, how much to set aside for bad debts — each is a legitimate choice within the rules, and each moves reported profit. Cash from operations is harder to shape because it tracks money that actually arrived. This is why experienced readers start with the cash flow statement, which is the opposite of what most beginners do.
3446a6fd80c5.sw: Faida huhusisha hukumu kwa njia ambayo fedha haihusishi. Kasi ya kushusha thamani ya vifaa, lini mauzo huhesabika kuwa yamefanyika, kiasi gani cha kutenga kwa madeni mabaya — kila kimoja ni chaguo halali ndani ya kanuni, na kila kimoja husogeza faida iliyoripotiwa. Fedha kutoka shughuli ni ngumu zaidi kuiumba kwa sababu hufuatilia pesa zilizofika hasa. Ndiyo sababu wasomaji wenye uzoefu huanza na taarifa ya mtiririko wa fedha, ambako ni kinyume cha wanaoanza wengi wanavyofanya.

3449601295a1.en: What to look for when you next open a holding. Confirm three things, in this order.
3449601295a1.sw: Cha kutazama utakapofungua umiliki wako ujao. Thibitisha vitu vitatu, kwa mpangilio huu.

3456bfdbea12.en: The prevailing environment of the market: whether risk appetite is rising or falling, whether volatility is low or high, and whether prices are trending or ranging. The regime determines which strategies have an edge and which are traps.
3456bfdbea12.sw: Mazingira yaliyopo ya soko: kama hamu ya hatari inapanda au inashuka, kama mtikisiko uko chini au juu, na kama bei zina mwelekeo au ziko kwenye ukanda. Hali huamua ni mikakati ipi yenye faida na ipi ni mitego.

3485b3492b9b.en: Correct — if the reward per win is smaller than the risk per loss, even a 70% win rate can barely break even or lose. Win rate is only half the story; the risk-to-reward ratio is the other half.
3485b3492b9b.sw: Sahihi — kama tuzo kwa kila ushindi ni ndogo kuliko hatari kwa kila hasara, hata kiwango cha ushindi cha 70% kinaweza kulingana kwa shida au kupoteza. Kiwango cha ushindi ni nusu ya simulizi tu; uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo ni nusu nyingine.

34910e988b37.en: The ratio matters because it decides how often you actually have to be right just to stay level. Wins have to pay for losses, and a bigger reward per win means each win pays for more losses.
34910e988b37.sw: Uwiano unahusika kwa sababu huamua ni mara ngapi lazima uwe sahihi hasa ili tu kubaki sawa. Ushindi lazima ulipie hasara, na tuzo kubwa zaidi kwa kila ushindi inamaanisha kila ushindi hulipia hasara zaidi.

34a374ebb7cf.en: Nothing changes, because rates rose as predicted
34a374ebb7cf.sw: Hakuna kinachobadilika, kwa sababu viwango vilipanda kama ilivyotabiriwa

3537ad7a693b.en: True or False: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) found that markets respond symmetrically — good and bad news of equal size move prices by equal amounts.
3537ad7a693b.sw: Kweli au Uongo: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) waligundua kwamba masoko huitikia kwa usawa — habari njema na mbaya za ukubwa sawa husogeza bei kwa viasi sawa.

358e2944f2b0.en: An index is a rule. An exchange-traded fund is a way to own the thing the rule describes, in one purchase, on an exchange.
358e2944f2b0.sw: Index ni kanuni. Exchange-traded fund ni njia ya kumiliki kile ambacho kanuni huelezea, katika ununuzi mmoja, kwenye soko.

3595bb0b2346.en: Barber and Odean (2000), in The Journal of Finance, tracked 66,465 households at a discount broker over 1991 to 1996. Their finding is one of the most cited in behavioural finance: the households that traded the most earned 11.4% a year, while the market itself returned 17.9%. Same market, same years — the gap was activity. They concluded that overconfidence drives the excessive trading, and the excessive trading drives the underperformance. Their title puts it bluntly: trading is hazardous to your wealth.
3595bb0b2346.sw: Barber na Odean (2000), katika The Journal of Finance, walifuatilia kaya 66,465 kwenye broker wa punguzo kwa 1991 hadi 1996. Tokeo lao ni mojawapo yanayonukuliwa zaidi katika fedha za kitabia: kaya zilizofanya biashara zaidi zilipata 11.4% kwa mwaka, ilhali soko lenyewe lilirudisha 17.9%. Soko lile lile, miaka ile ile — pengo lilikuwa shughuli. Walihitimisha kwamba kujiamini kupita kiasi huendesha biashara ya kupita kiasi, na biashara ya kupita kiasi huendesha utendaji duni. Kichwa chao kinaeleza wazi: kufanya biashara ni hatari kwa utajiri wako.

35be92cc719f.en: The three-letter codes you see in every currency pair aren't arbitrary abbreviations — they follow a real, formally maintained international standard.
35be92cc719f.sw: Misimbo ya herufi tatu unayoiona katika kila jozi la sarafu si vifupisho vya bahati nasibu — inafuata kiwango halisi cha kimataifa kinachodumishwa rasmi.

35c3f851688e.en: Long-term ownership, since the same shares are involved
35c3f851688e.sw: Umiliki wa muda mrefu, kwa kuwa hisa zile zile zinahusika

35ed70eafc8f.en: One signal, three different mechanisms — and every one of them can be overridden by sentiment.
35ed70eafc8f.sw: Ishara moja, mifumo mitatu tofauti — na kila mmoja wao unaweza kuzidiwa nguvu na hisia za soko.

36001364f6e3.en: The SEC's own framing is that the market price is generally kept close to NAV because of this arbitrage function inherent in the structure. Note the word generally. It is a mechanism, not a guarantee.
36001364f6e3.sw: Uwasilishaji wa SEC wenyewe ni kwamba bei ya soko kwa ujumla huwekwa karibu na NAV kwa sababu ya kazi hii ya arbitrage iliyomo katika muundo. Tambua neno kwa ujumla. Ni utaratibu, si uhakika.

3614fd5f71b0.en: This is what turns the pillars from a feeling into an edge. When your valuation pillar and your carry pillar and your momentum pillar all point the same way, you are not stacking opinions — you are aligning several independently documented return sources on a single trade.
3614fd5f71b0.sw: Hiki ndicho kinachogeuza nguzo kutoka hisia kuwa faida. Nguzo yako ya uthaminishaji na nguzo yako ya carry na nguzo yako ya kasi zote zinapoelekea upande ule ule, hurundiki maoni — unalinganisha vyanzo kadhaa vya faida vilivyoandikwa kwa kujitegemea kwenye biashara moja.

361566a79bf8.en: Be honest about the limits here, in the spirit of the Kelly caution from Chapter 1, Lesson 5. The precise risk-of-ruin number for a real strategy depends on inputs — your true win rate, your average win and loss, how correlated your trades are — that most traders cannot pin down reliably. So do not chase a specific ruin percentage from a calculator as if it were fact. Respect the direction the mathematics points, which is not in doubt: a smaller fraction risked per trade means dramatically lower odds of ruin.
361566a79bf8.sw: Kuwa mwaminifu kuhusu mipaka hapa, kwa roho ya tahadhari ya Kelly kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 5. Namba kamili ya hatari ya kufilisika kwa mkakati halisi hutegemea pembejeo — kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi, ushindi na hasara yako ya wastani, jinsi biashara zako zilivyo na uwiano — ambazo wafanyabiashara wengi hawawezi kuzibainisha kwa kutegemewa. Hivyo usifukuze asilimia mahususi ya kufilisika kutoka kikokotoo kana kwamba ni ukweli. Heshimu mwelekeo ambao hisabati inauonyesha, ambao hauna shaka: sehemu ndogo inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara inamaanisha uwezekano mdogo mno wa kufilisika.

364912489d2c.en: Chang & Osler (1999), published in The Economic Journal, tested head-and-shoulders specifically on foreign exchange rates. It did generate statistically significant profits — but was "dominated" by simpler trading rules, meaning a plainer strategy achieved the same or better result with less complexity.
364912489d2c.sw: Chang & Osler (1999), waliochapisha katika The Economic Journal, walijaribu head-and-shoulders mahususi kwenye viwango vya ubadilishaji wa fedha za kigeni. Ulizalisha faida yenye maana kitakwimu — lakini ulikuwa "umezidiwa" na kanuni rahisi zaidi za biashara, ikimaanisha kwamba mkakati sahili zaidi ulifikia matokeo sawa au bora zaidi kwa utata mdogo.

3657fee55131.en: Both people in a trade have to want exactly what the other one has, at the same time. A farmer with vegetables who wants shoes has to find a shoemaker who happens to want vegetables — not meat, not tools. If not, the trade just doesn't happen.
3657fee55131.sw: Watu wote wawili katika biashara lazima watake hasa kile ambacho mwenzake anacho, kwa wakati mmoja. Mkulima mwenye mboga anayetaka viatu lazima ampate mshona-viatu ambaye kwa bahati anataka mboga — si nyama, si zana. Kama sivyo, biashara haifanyiki tu.

3691185ff537.en: The second currency listed in a pair. It's the currency the price is expressed in — how much of it one unit of the base currency costs.
3691185ff537.sw: Sarafu ya pili iliyoorodheshwa katika jozi. Ndiyo sarafu ambayo bei inaelezwa kwayo — kiasi chake ambacho kipimo kimoja cha sarafu ya msingi kinagharimu.

3692ba54987d.sw: Japani ilipandisha viwango vya riba kwa kasi

36dc87b95366.en: Correct — prediction accuracy alone doesn't determine success. A trader who controls losses well can be profitable even with a mediocre prediction record.
36dc87b95366.sw: Sahihi — usahihi wa utabiri peke yake hauamui mafanikio. Mfanyabiashara anayedhibiti hasara vizuri anaweza kupata faida hata akiwa na rekodi ya utabiri ya wastani.

36edb0300452.en: Correct. The instrument is the same but the source of return is not. Over a holding period of minutes, the businesses have generated nothing new, so any gain comes from whoever took the other side — before costs, which make the activity negative-sum in aggregate.
36edb0300452.sw: Sahihi. Chombo ni kile kile lakini chanzo cha faida si kile kile. Katika kipindi cha kushikilia cha dakika, biashara hazijazalisha chochote kipya, hivyo faida yoyote hutoka kwa yeyote aliyechukua upande mwingine — kabla ya gharama, ambazo hufanya shughuli iwe jumla-hasi kwa jumla.

37313f98fdcd.en: An ETF trading above or below its net asset value.
37313f98fdcd.sw: ETF inayofanyiwa biashara juu au chini ya thamani halisi ya mali yake.

374eac3419d6.en: Yes, pip value is always 10 dollars on a standard lot
374eac3419d6.sw: Ndiyo, thamani ya pip daima ni dola 10 kwenye lot sanifu

378f03b3be18.en: Write down every recurring percentage you currently pay: fund charges, platform fees, and any advice fee. Add them into a single number. Then find the cheapest equivalent broad fund available to you and write its total next to yours. The gap between those two figures is the one number in this course you can change today with certainty.
378f03b3be18.sw: Andika kila asilimia ya kudumu unayoilipa sasa: malipo ya fund, ada za jukwaa, na ada yoyote ya ushauri. Ziongeze kuwa namba moja. Kisha pata fund pana inayolingana ya bei nafuu zaidi inayopatikana kwako na uandike jumla yake kando ya yako. Pengo kati ya takwimu hizo mbili ni namba moja katika kozi hii unayoweza kuibadilisha leo kwa uhakika.

37a627fa0d4e.en: The gap between the bid and ask price. This is the built-in cost of entering and exiting a trade.
37a627fa0d4e.sw: Pengo kati ya bei ya bid na ask. Hii ndiyo gharama iliyojengwa ndani ya kuingia na kutoka katika biashara.

37a887ba03d2.sw: Aina za Maagizo na Utekelezaji wa Biashara

37b713b27e00.en: A unit of ownership in a company — a part-owner, not a lender.
37b713b27e00.sw: Kipimo cha umiliki katika kampuni — mmiliki mshirika, si mkopeshaji.

37cdd96c2742.en: Cutting winners, riding losers. Taking small profits quickly while letting losses run — the disposition effect. Fixed by setting a risk-to-reward minimum before entry (Chapter 3, Lesson 3) and letting linked OCO orders execute the exit (Chapter 4, Lesson 1).
37cdd96c2742.sw: Kukata washindi, kupanda wapotezaji. Kuchukua faida ndogo kwa haraka huku ukiacha hasara zikimbie — athari ya kuachana na nafasi. Hurekebishwa kwa kuweka kiwango cha chini cha hatari-kwa-tuzo kabla ya kuingia (Sura ya 3, Somo la 3) na kuacha maagizo ya OCO yaliyounganishwa yatekeleze kutoka (Sura ya 4, Somo la 1).

37e928fcd832.en: The bunching of stop-loss and take-profit orders at round-number levels, which makes those levels act as support and resistance.
37e928fcd832.sw: Kurundikana kwa maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit kwenye viwango vya namba za mviringo, kunakofanya viwango hivyo vitende kama msaada na upinzani.

3852db82e35e.en: Before trading, put it into practice: check the actual current spread on the pair you're using rather than a marketing headline number, which is often a best-case minimum that doesn't hold at all hours. Compare the all-in cost (spread plus any commission), not just the quoted spread — a "0.0 pip spread" account with a large commission can cost the same as, or more than, a wider-spread account with no commission. And notice when spreads widen around news events or thin trading hours, factoring that into when you enter or exit a position.
3852db82e35e.sw: Kabla ya kufanya biashara, itekeleze: kagua spread halisi ya sasa kwenye jozi unalotumia badala ya namba ya kichwa cha habari cha matangazo, ambayo mara nyingi ni kiwango cha chini cha hali bora zaidi kisichoshikilia saa zote. Linganisha gharama ya jumla (spread pamoja na kamisheni yoyote), si spread inayonukuliwa tu — akaunti ya "spread ya pip 0.0" yenye kamisheni kubwa inaweza kugharimu sawa na, au zaidi ya, akaunti yenye spread pana isiyo na kamisheni. Na tambua spread inapopanuka wakati wa matukio ya habari au saa za biashara chache, ukizingatia hilo unapoingia au kutoka katika nafasi.

38675d4e33b4.en: The most important part of this case study is that none of it was a surprise to the research. Chapter 2, Lesson 3 gave you the finding in advance.
38675d4e33b4.sw: Sehemu muhimu zaidi ya uchunguzi huu ni kwamba hakuna kati ya haya kilichoushangaza utafiti. Sura ya 2, Somo la 3 lilikupa tokeo mapema.

38d38ec876eb.en: You place a stop to sell at 45. Bad news arrives overnight and the share opens at 38. The stop triggers immediately and sells near 38, not 45. Nothing malfunctioned. The order did exactly what it says, and what it says is different from what most people assume it says.
38d38ec876eb.sw: Unaweka stop ya kuuza kwa 45. Habari mbaya hufika usiku na hisa hufunguliwa kwa 38. Stop huanzishwa mara moja na huuza karibu na 38, si 45. Hakuna kilichoharibika. Agizo lilifanya hasa linavyosema, na linavyosema ni tofauti na watu wengi wanavyodhania linasema.

38d9ed7e5e9d.en: A deliberate reduction in a currency's official value.
38d9ed7e5e9d.sw: Kupunguza kwa makusudi thamani rasmi ya sarafu.

391059aa525b.sw: Kufanya biashara kupita kiasi; rekebisha kwa kufanya biashara zaidi

3932af5ab9d6.sw: Kutathmini sarafu kwa nguvu za kiuchumi za msingi, si mitindo ya chati.

39e9770f8dc5.en: Most central banks target around 2% inflation, not 0%. Zero inflation removes a central bank's room to maneuver — it can't cut rates to fight a slowdown without risking deflation, which discourages spending and can deepen a recession. Moderate, steady inflation is the target precisely because both extremes are worse.
39e9770f8dc5.sw: Benki kuu nyingi hulenga mfumuko wa bei wa karibu 2%, si 0%. Mfumuko wa bei wa sifuri huondoa nafasi ya benki kuu ya kujimudu — haiwezi kupunguza viwango vya riba kupambana na kudorora bila kuhatarisha mporomoko wa bei, ambao hukatisha tamaa matumizi na unaweza kuzidisha mdororo. Mfumuko wa bei wa wastani na thabiti ndilo lengo hasa kwa sababu pande zote mbili za mwisho ni mbaya zaidi.

3a4b16dd60bd.en: Correct — that's exactly what fractional reserve banking is: holding only a fraction of deposits, and lending or issuing notes against the rest.
3a4b16dd60bd.sw: Sahihi — ndivyo hasa benki ya akiba ya sehemu ilivyo: kushikilia sehemu tu ya amana, na kukopesha au kutoa noti dhidi ya kilichobaki.

3aa01a2e1432.en: Note the difference from the candlestick chart you already know: the chart is the display format, while a candlestick pattern is a specific claim that a particular little shape predicts what comes next. That claim is exactly the kind this course insists on testing rather than repeating — which is Sections 3 and 4.
3aa01a2e1432.sw: Tambua tofauti na chati ya mishumaa unayoijua tayari: chati ni umbizo la kuonyesha, ilhali mtindo wa mishumaa ni dai mahususi kwamba umbo dogo fulani hutabiri kinachokuja. Dai hilo ni hasa aina ambayo kozi hii inasisitiza kujaribiwa badala ya kurudiwa — ambazo ni Sehemu ya 3 na 4.

3ab1610703cf.en: Correct — the edge was concentrated in the best-analysed ideas; the rest of what the managers held diluted it. Weight belongs on your strongest theses.
3ab1610703cf.sw: Sahihi — faida ilijikita katika mawazo yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi; kilichobaki walichoshikilia wasimamizi kilipunguza. Uzito unastahili kuwa kwenye nadharia zako imara zaidi.

3ac5a47009db.sw: Biashara ya bidii hushinda soko kwa kutegemewa

3b05ccd329fa.sw: Mtaji wa mfanyabiashara mwenyewe unaoshikiliwa kama dhamana ya nafasi ya leverage.

3b0ad15c8a31.en: Diagram of the four-step process from thesis to a survivable trade — set the stop at the invalidation level, demand a reward-to-risk of at least about 2 to 1, run a pre-mortem by assuming the trade already failed and listing why (Klein 2007), and write the full exit before entry — with the rule that you may exit if the thesis breaks but never move the stop or target because price is uncomfortable
3b0ad15c8a31.sw: Mchoro wa mchakato wa hatua nne kutoka nadharia hadi biashara inayoweza kunusurika — weka stop kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika, dai tuzo-kwa-hatari ya angalau takriban 2 kwa 1, fanya pre-mortem kwa kudhania biashara tayari imeshindwa na kuorodhesha kwa nini (Klein 2007), na andika kutoka kamili kabla ya kuingia — ukiwa na kanuni kwamba unaweza kutoka kama nadharia itavunjika lakini kamwe usisogeze stop au lengo kwa sababu bei haistarehe

3b1ce65a10b7.en: The annual fee a fund charges, as a percentage of the money you have invested with it. It is deducted from the fund's assets, so you never see a bill.
3b1ce65a10b7.sw: Ada ya kila mwaka ambayo fund hutoza, kama asilimia ya pesa ulizowekeza nayo. Hutolewa kutoka mali za fund, hivyo huoni bili kamwe.

3b5e577ff4ea.en: The fixed-percentage risk approach from Foundations Chapter 2 (risking 1–2% per trade) is, in effect, a simplified, beginner-safe cousin of the same underlying idea: risk a small, controlled fraction of your capital rather than a large, theoretically "optimal" one you can't actually calculate with confidence.
3b5e577ff4ea.sw: Mbinu ya hatari ya asilimia thabiti kutoka Sura ya 2 ya Msingi (kuhatarisha 1–2% kwa kila biashara) ni, kwa hakika, binamu rahisishwa na salama kwa anayeanza wa wazo lile lile la msingi: hatarisha sehemu ndogo inayodhibitiwa ya mtaji wako badala ya kubwa, "bora" kinadharia ambayo huwezi kuikokotoa kwa uhakika hasa.

3b8980f35633.en: Read what that claim is and is not. It does not say no active manager can beat the market — plainly some do. It says the average actively managed unit of currency must underperform the average passive one after costs, as a matter of arithmetic rather than evidence. Individual skill is a claim about the distribution around that average, not a repeal of it.
3b8980f35633.sw: Soma dai hilo ni nini na si nini. Halisemi kwamba hakuna msimamizi wa bidii anayeweza kushinda soko — wazi baadhi hufanya hivyo. Linasema kipimo cha wastani cha sarafu kinachosimamiwa kwa bidii lazima kifanye vibaya kuliko cha wastani cha upole baada ya gharama, kama suala la hesabu badala ya ushahidi. Ustadi binafsi ni dai kuhusu mtawanyiko kuzunguka wastani huo, si kuufuta.

3bbb94f2843a.en: A stop-loss you decide on after you're already losing money is not risk management — it's hope with a delay.
3bbb94f2843a.sw: Stop-loss unayoiamua baada ya tayari kuanza kupoteza pesa si usimamizi wa hatari — ni matumaini yaliyochelewa.

3c0e6393166a.en: In "The Foundation of Money and Trade," we covered why currencies exist and why their values float freely today rather than being pegged to gold. This lesson is where that history becomes practical.
3c0e6393166a.sw: Katika "Msingi wa Fedha na Biashara," tulishughulikia kwa nini sarafu zipo na kwa nini thamani zao huelea kwa uhuru leo badala ya kufungwa kwenye dhahabu. Somo hili ndipo historia hiyo inakuwa ya vitendo.

3c2e133f3d24.en: Not quite — re-read both definitions carefully; they describe different correlation behaviors under different conditions.
3c2e133f3d24.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — soma tena maana zote mbili kwa makini; zinaeleza tabia tofauti za uwiano chini ya hali tofauti.

3c4ea03f95e3.en: Paying another party to take on your risk.
3c4ea03f95e3.sw: Kumlipa mtu mwingine abebe hatari yako.

3c5f704360ae.en: Not quite — a standard lot on a yen pair is 1,000 yen per pip, which converts to about 6.67 dollars near a rate of 150. The 10-dollar figure only holds when the quote currency is your account currency.
3c5f704360ae.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — lot sanifu kwenye jozi la yen ni yen 1,000 kwa kila pip, ambayo hubadilika kuwa takriban dola 6.67 karibu na kiwango cha 150. Takwimu ya dola 10 hushikilia tu wakati sarafu ya bei ni sarafu ya akaunti yako.

3c9814a75b53.en: Pull up two charts: one in an obvious strong trend, one moving sideways in a range. Apply Bollinger Bands to both. Count how many lower-band touches would have been profitable mean-reversion buys on each chart. The difference you'll see is this lesson's core point.
3c9814a75b53.sw: Fungua chati mbili: moja ikiwa katika mwelekeo mkali dhahiri, nyingine ikisogea kando ndani ya ukanda. Tumia Bollinger Bands kwa zote mbili. Hesabu ni kugusa kanda ya chini kungapi kungekuwa ununuzi wenye faida wa kurudi kwa wastani kwenye kila chati. Tofauti utakayoiona ndio kiini cha somo hili.

3ce12e776093.en: Crypto: Bitcoin is often called "digital gold" because its supply is capped at 21 million coins. But short-term price volatility has repeatedly overshadowed that case — an asset that can swing 10% in a day doesn't behave like a stable inflation hedge. Rising rates (the usual inflation response) also tend to pull speculative capital out of crypto, often pushing prices down exactly when the "digital gold" narrative would predict a rise.
3ce12e776093.sw: Crypto: Bitcoin mara nyingi huitwa "dhahabu ya kidijitali" kwa sababu ugavi wake una kikomo cha sarafu milioni 21. Lakini mtikisiko wa bei wa muda mfupi umefunika hoja hiyo mara kwa mara — mali inayoweza kuyumba 10% kwa siku moja haitendi kama kinga thabiti dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei. Viwango vya riba vinavyopanda (jibu la kawaida kwa mfumuko wa bei) pia huelekea kuvuta mtaji wa kubahatisha nje ya crypto, mara nyingi zikisukuma bei chini hasa wakati simulizi ya "dhahabu ya kidijitali" ingetabiri kupanda.

3d3cd3f1335b.en: Two careful studies, major US stocks, overlapping years, opposite conclusions. How? A large part of the answer is methodology — and in particular the exit rule. Caginalp and Laurent closed each trade at an averaged price over a fixed short holding period; Marshall, Young and Rose tested differently. The pattern entry was similar; the rule for getting out differed, and the profitability flipped with it.
3d3cd3f1335b.sw: Tafiti mbili makini, hisa kuu za Marekani, miaka inayoingiliana, hitimisho za kinyume. Vipi? Sehemu kubwa ya jibu ni mbinu — na hasa kanuni ya kutoka. Caginalp na Laurent walifunga kila biashara kwa bei ya wastani katika kipindi kifupi thabiti cha kushikilia; Marshall, Young na Rose walijaribu tofauti. Kuingia kwa mtindo kulikuwa sawa; kanuni ya kutoka ilitofautiana, na faida ilibadilika nayo.

3d558f7ea199.en: A monetary system in which a currency is directly backed by, and freely convertible into, a fixed quantity of gold.
3d558f7ea199.sw: Mfumo wa fedha ambapo sarafu inaungwa mkono moja kwa moja na, na inabadilishwa kwa uhuru kuwa, kiasi thabiti cha dhahabu.

3d5771d38799.en: That explanation is not settled, and the course would be misleading you to present it as though it were. More than a hundred papers have since argued about whether the shortfall is really about tax at all, or about market microstructure — the fact that prices historically moved in discrete tick sizes, so the drop could not land exactly on the dividend. The finding that the drop is less than the dividend is robust. Why has been contested for over fifty years.
3d5771d38799.sw: Maelezo hayo hayajakamilika, na kozi ingekupotosha kuyawasilisha kana kwamba yamekamilika. Zaidi ya karatasi mia moja zimebishana tangu wakati huo kuhusu kama upungufu unahusu kodi kabisa, au muundo mdogo wa soko — ukweli kwamba bei kihistoria zilisogea kwa ukubwa wa vipimo tofauti, hivyo kushuka hakungeweza kutua hasa juu ya gawio. Tokeo kwamba kushuka ni kudogo kuliko gawio ni imara. Kwa nini kumebishaniwa kwa zaidi ya miaka hamsini.

3e1f263fd333.en: A pair combining two major currencies, with no U.S. dollar involved — for example, EUR/GBP, GBP/JPY, or CAD/JPY. "Minor" and "cross pair" refer to the same thing.
3e1f263fd333.sw: Jozi linalounganisha sarafu mbili kuu, bila dola ya Marekani kuhusika — kwa mfano, EUR/GBP, GBP/JPY, au CAD/JPY. "Ndogo" na "jozi la kuvuka" hurejelea kitu kile kile.

3ecf4396c6c1.en: The international standard defining three-letter currency codes.
3ecf4396c6c1.sw: Kiwango cha kimataifa kinachofafanua misimbo ya sarafu ya herufi tatu.

3ee227ac1852.en: Yen pairs break the pattern. Because the yen has a much lower per-unit value than currencies like the dollar or euro, USD/JPY and other yen pairs are quoted to only two decimal places — so a pip there is the second decimal place (0.01), not the fourth. If USD/JPY moves from 149.50 to 150.00, that's a 50-pip move, not a 0.5-pip move. This trips up nearly every beginner at least once.
3ee227ac1852.sw: Jozi za yen huvunja mtindo huo. Kwa sababu yen ina thamani ndogo zaidi kwa kila kipimo kuliko sarafu kama dola au euro, USD/JPY na jozi nyingine za yen hunukuliwa kwa nafasi mbili tu za desimali — hivyo pip hapo ni nafasi ya pili ya desimali (0.01), si ya nne. Kama USD/JPY itasogea kutoka 149.50 hadi 150.00, huo ni msogeo wa pip 50, si msogeo wa pip 0.5. Hili huwakwaza karibu kila anayeanza angalau mara moja.

3effdc3fa704.en: A position that profits if the price goes up. You buy now, expecting to sell later at a higher price.
3effdc3fa704.sw: Nafasi inayopata faida kama bei itapanda. Unanunua sasa, ukitarajia kuuza baadaye kwa bei ya juu zaidi.

3f2877b1d915.en: You have already seen this decide outcomes. Carry trades pay beautifully in a calm, risk-on regime and crash violently when volatility spikes — the exact finding from Chapter 2, Lesson 3 and the lived 2008 unwind in Chapter 5, Lesson 2. Momentum thrives in trending regimes and bleeds in ranging ones (Chapter 2, Lesson 1). Reading the regime first is how you avoid bringing the right tool to the wrong market.
3f2877b1d915.sw: Tayari umeona hii ikiamua matokeo. Carry trade hulipa vizuri sana katika hali tulivu ya kukubali hatari na huanguka kwa nguvu mtikisiko unapopanda ghafla — tokeo hasa kutoka Sura ya 2, Somo la 3 na kuvunjika kwa mwaka 2008 kulikoishiwa katika Sura ya 5, Somo la 2. Kasi hustawi katika hali za mwelekeo na hupoteza katika za ukanda (Sura ya 2, Somo la 1). Kusoma hali kwanza ndivyo unavyoepuka kuleta zana sahihi kwenye soko lisilo sahihi.

3f73ace56270.en: True or False: because Bollinger Bands are set at 2 standard deviations, there is genuinely only about a 5% chance of price moving outside them.
3f73ace56270.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kwa sababu Bollinger Bands zimewekwa kwa mikengeuko sanifu 2, kuna nafasi ya takriban 5% tu kweli ya bei kusogea nje yake.

3f7e467e0525.en: Through a broker, the entire vacation-trade scenario above — buy pesos, hold, convert back — happens with a few taps on a phone, in seconds, without a plane ticket, a suitcase, or a currency exchange counter. The broker gives you direct access to the same exchange rate movements that made that $25 vacation profit possible, on demand, for any pair of currencies you choose.
3f7e467e0525.sw: Kupitia broker, hali nzima ya biashara ya likizo hapo juu — nunua peso, shikilia, badilisha tena — hutokea kwa kugusa mara chache kwenye simu, ndani ya sekunde, bila tiketi ya ndege, sanduku, wala kaunta ya kubadilishia fedha. Broker anakupa ufikiaji wa moja kwa moja wa misogeo ile ile ya viwango vya ubadilishaji iliyowezesha faida ile ya $25 ya likizo, wakati wowote, kwa jozi lolote la sarafu unalochagua.

3f820a0f249e.en: Take one thing you have considered buying — a share, a fund, a currency, a token. Write one sentence answering where a gain would come from. If you cannot complete the sentence without referring to someone else selling to you at a higher price, you have identified a zero-sum position, and it needs an edge rather than patience.
3f820a0f249e.sw: Chukua kitu kimoja ambacho umefikiria kununua — hisa, fund, sarafu, token. Andika sentensi moja ikijibu faida ingetoka wapi. Kama huwezi kumaliza sentensi bila kurejelea mtu mwingine akikuuzia kwa bei ya juu zaidi, umetambua nafasi ya jumla-sifuri, na inahitaji faida badala ya subira.

3f8bf47c92d3.sw: Nafasi inayopata faida kama bei itashuka.

3fd974bbd909.en: A handful of major currencies dominate trading, and pairs sort into precise categories — major, minor (cross), and exotic — based on whether USD is present and how liquid the other side is.
3fd974bbd909.sw: Sarafu kuu chache hutawala biashara, na jozi hupangwa katika makundi sahihi — kuu, ndogo (kuvuka), na adimu — kwa msingi wa kama USD ipo na jinsi upande mwingine ulivyo na ukwasi.

3ff3f7d23523.en: When a central bank raises rates, that currency offers investors a higher return. To capture it, foreign investors must buy that currency — raising demand, and with it, the price. So the standard expectation is: higher rates → currency appreciates; lower rates → currency depreciates. This is the single most-cited relationship in forex fundamental analysis.
3ff3f7d23523.sw: Benki kuu inapopandisha viwango, sarafu hiyo huwapa wawekezaji faida kubwa zaidi. Ili kuipata, wawekezaji wa kigeni lazima wanunue sarafu hiyo — wakiongeza mahitaji, na pamoja nayo, bei. Hivyo matarajio ya kawaida ni: viwango vya juu → sarafu huimarika; viwango vya chini → sarafu hudhoofika. Huu ndio uhusiano unaonukuliwa zaidi kuliko wote katika uchambuzi wa kimsingi wa forex.

40482bd89e80.en: Cap weighting has one consequence worth stating plainly, because it surprises people who believe an index fund is automatically diversified. The weights are not fixed. They move with price, so whatever has risen most owns the largest share of the index — and it owns that share precisely because it has already risen.
40482bd89e80.sw: Uzito wa mtaji una tokeo moja linalostahili kuelezwa wazi, kwa sababu huwashangaza watu wanaoamini index fund imesambazwa kiotomatiki. Uzito si thabiti. Husogea na bei, hivyo chochote kilichopanda zaidi humiliki sehemu kubwa zaidi ya index — na humiliki sehemu hiyo hasa kwa sababu tayari kimepanda.

4091f279003d.en: True or False: to profit from a currency's exchange rate movement, you must physically travel and exchange cash in person.
4091f279003d.sw: Kweli au Uongo: ili kupata faida kutoka msogeo wa kiwango cha ubadilishaji cha sarafu, lazima usafiri kimwili na kubadilisha fedha taslimu ana kwa ana.

40a729e22941.en: Because these events are scheduled, you know in advance when a currency is likely to move violently. That's an unusual gift in trading — most risk arrives unannounced. Several free calendars cover this well: ForexFactory, Investing.com, TradingEconomics, DailyFX, and MarketWatch all publish essentially the same underlying schedule with different interfaces.
40a729e22941.sw: Kwa sababu matukio haya yamepangwa, unajua mapema ni lini sarafu inawezekana kusogea kwa nguvu. Hiyo ni zawadi isiyo ya kawaida katika biashara — hatari nyingi hufika bila tangazo. Kalenda kadhaa za bure hushughulikia hili vizuri: ForexFactory, Investing.com, TradingEconomics, DailyFX, na MarketWatch zote huchapisha kimsingi ratiba ile ile ya msingi kwa violesura tofauti.

40d6475745b8.en: A margin call is set off by your equity, not your balance, and it is almost always a symptom of committing too much of the account — using too much effective leverage.
40d6475745b8.sw: Wito wa margin huanzishwa na usawa wako, si salio lako, na karibu daima ni dalili ya kujitolea kwa kiasi kikubwa mno cha akaunti — kutumia leverage halisi kubwa mno.

411a04373a19.en: Correct — support is a level where price has repeatedly reversed in the past, a historical pattern and probability, not a physical barrier. Support levels break all the time.
411a04373a19.sw: Sahihi — msaada ni kiwango ambapo bei imegeuka mara kwa mara hapo awali, mtindo wa kihistoria na uwezekano, si kizuizi cha kimwili. Viwango vya msaada huvunjika mara kwa mara.

4161a8abd512.en: Every fund tracking an index must trade when the index reconstitutes, and it must do so at roughly the same time as every other tracker. Those trades cost money, paid out of the fund. This is one reason a fund never quite matches its index, which is the tracking difference the next lesson defines.
4161a8abd512.sw: Kila fund inayofuatilia index lazima ifanye biashara index inapoundwa upya, na lazima ifanye hivyo takriban wakati mmoja na kila mfuatiliaji mwingine. Biashara hizo hugharimu pesa, zinazolipwa kutoka kwenye fund. Hii ni sababu moja fund haifanani kabisa na index yake, ambayo ndiyo tofauti ya kufuatilia ambayo somo lijalo linaifafanua.

416f32324d57.en: True or False: currency pairs can be written in any order — there's no real convention governing which currency comes first.
416f32324d57.sw: Kweli au Uongo: jozi la sarafu linaweza kuandikwa kwa mpangilio wowote — hakuna makubaliano halisi yanayoongoza ni sarafu ipi inakuja kwanza.

421e8d317838.en: Fundamentals, Valuation, Catalyst, Positioning/Sentiment, Momentum, Carry — scored together for conviction.
421e8d317838.sw: Misingi, Uthaminishaji, Kichocheo, Nafasi za Soko/Hisia, Kasi, Carry — zikipimwa kwa pamoja kwa uhakika.

422cfd41fb7c.en: Diagram showing bid, ask, and spread mechanics, plus where the pip sits for standard pairs versus yen pairs
422cfd41fb7c.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha utaratibu wa bid, ask, na spread, pamoja na mahali pip ilipo kwa jozi za kawaida ikilinganishwa na jozi za yen

424420a4bb3c.en: Currency directly backed by, and convertible into, a fixed quantity of gold.
424420a4bb3c.sw: Sarafu inayoungwa mkono moja kwa moja na, na kubadilishwa kuwa, kiasi thabiti cha dhahabu.

426d5a2df0f1.en: A diversified holding of productive companies has no equivalent fixed edge working against it. Its expected return is uncertain and can be negative over any given decade, but the source of the return is the cash the companies generate rather than another participant's loss. That is the whole of the distinction, and it says nothing about safety.
426d5a2df0f1.sw: Umiliki uliosambazwa wa kampuni zenye tija hauna faida thabiti inayolingana inayofanya kazi dhidi yake. Faida yake inayotarajiwa haina uhakika na inaweza kuwa hasi katika muongo wowote uliopewa, lakini chanzo cha faida ni fedha ambazo kampuni huzalisha badala ya hasara ya mshiriki mwingine. Hiyo ndiyo tofauti yote, na haisemi chochote kuhusu usalama.

42d2798cd469.en: Suppose the ten largest companies rise 20% and the other 490 fall 2%. A cap-weighted index dominated by those ten can show a solid gain. An equal-weighted index of the identical companies shows a small loss. Neither is wrong, and headlines quote only the first.
42d2798cd469.sw: Tuseme kampuni kumi kubwa zaidi zinapanda 20% na zile nyingine 490 zinashuka 2%. Index yenye uzito wa mtaji inayotawaliwa na hizo kumi inaweza kuonyesha faida imara. Index yenye uzito sawa ya kampuni zile zile huonyesha hasara ndogo. Hakuna iliyo batili, na vichwa vya habari hunukuu ya kwanza tu.

42dc84b84db1.en: A fund holding assets that trade on other exchanges can only be priced accurately while those exchanges are open. A European fund holding Asian companies is trading, during the European afternoon, on a best estimate of what those companies are worth, because their market closed hours earlier. The estimate is usually good and the spread widens to reflect the uncertainty.
42dc84b84db1.sw: Fund inayoshikilia mali zinazofanyiwa biashara kwenye masoko mengine inaweza kuwekewa bei kwa usahihi tu wakati masoko hayo yamefunguliwa. Fund ya Ulaya inayoshikilia kampuni za Asia inafanyiwa biashara, wakati wa alasiri ya Ulaya, kwa makadirio bora ya thamani ya kampuni hizo, kwa sababu soko lao lilifungwa saa kadhaa mapema. Makadirio kwa kawaida ni mazuri na spread hupanuka kuakisi kutokuwa na uhakika.

42eff85fbaf8.en: A fixed, disciplined system prevents abuse — but that same rigidity leaves no room to maneuver when a real crisis hits.
42eff85fbaf8.sw: Mfumo thabiti wenye nidhamu huzuia matumizi mabaya — lakini ugumu huo huo hauachi nafasi ya kujimudu janga halisi linapotokea.

42f9ca81ac84.en: Stocks: in the long run, companies can often pass rising costs to consumers. In the short run, rising inflation often pushes stock prices down — a stock's value partly discounts future earnings, and higher inflation increases that discount rate, shrinking the present value of those future profits. Growth stocks, leaning more on distant future earnings, tend to suffer more than value stocks.
42f9ca81ac84.sw: Hisa: kwa muda mrefu, kampuni mara nyingi zinaweza kupitisha gharama zinazopanda kwa walaji. Kwa muda mfupi, mfumuko wa bei unaopanda mara nyingi husukuma bei za hisa chini — thamani ya hisa kwa sehemu hupunguza thamani ya mapato ya baadaye, na mfumuko wa bei mkubwa zaidi huongeza kiwango hicho cha upunguzaji, na kupunguza thamani ya sasa ya faida hizo za baadaye. Hisa za ukuaji, zinazotegemea zaidi mapato ya baadaye ya mbali, huelekea kuathirika zaidi kuliko hisa za thamani.

42fb17ffc559.en: The expensive fund catches up, because higher fees usually buy better management
42fb17ffc559.sw: Fund ghali huipata, kwa sababu ada kubwa kwa kawaida hununua usimamizi bora

433592cf98ad.en: Build these habits: Know the quiet hours for the pairs you trade — thin sessions (deep night for a currency's home market) are where small imbalances become large moves. Treat any stop held through an illiquid period as one that may fill far from its level, exactly as in a gap. Recognise a stop cascade — falling price triggering stops that push price lower still — as the same stop-out mechanism from Chapter 3, Lesson 2 at market scale. And judge your exposure by what a thin-market spike could do to it, not only by whether your directional view is right.
433592cf98ad.sw: Jenga tabia hizi: Jua saa tulivu za jozi unayoyafanyia biashara — vipindi vyembamba (usiku wa manane kwa soko la nyumbani la sarafu) ndipo kutolingana kudogo kunapokuwa misogeo mikubwa. Chukulia stop yoyote inayoshikiliwa katika kipindi kisicho na ukwasi kama inayoweza kutimizwa mbali na kiwango chake, hasa kama katika kuruka. Tambua mfululizo wa stop — bei inayoshuka ikianzisha stop zinazosukuma bei chini zaidi — kama utaratibu ule ule wa stop-out kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 2 kwa kipimo cha soko. Na hukumu uwazi wako kwa kile ambacho mwiba wa soko jembamba ungeweza kufanya kwake, si tu kwa kama mtazamo wako wa mwelekeo ni sahihi.

43465d8d4976.en: Correct — both the classical gambler's-ruin result and Vince's fixed-fractional framework point to position size, the fraction risked per trade, as the dominant factor, ahead of win rate.
43465d8d4976.sw: Sahihi — tokeo la kawaida la kufilisika kwa mchezaji wa kamari na mfumo wa sehemu thabiti wa Vince vyote vinaonyesha ukubwa wa nafasi, sehemu inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara, kama kipengele kikuu, mbele ya kiwango cha ushindi.

44245ce72256.sw: Mchoro wa AUD/JPY likipanda kupitia mkusanyiko wa carry trade hadi kilele karibu na 107.80 mwezi Oktoba 2007 kisha likianguka takriban asilimia 45 hadi karibu 55 mwaka 2008, utaratibu wa biashara (kopa yen karibu na asilimia 0.5, nunua dola za Australia karibu na asilimia 6.75), na ushahidi kwamba mapato ya carry ni fidia kwa hatari ya kuanguka badala ya chakula cha bure
