4495e4909af6.sw: Shughuli ambapo thamani ya jumla inayoshikiliwa na washiriki wote inaweza kukua, kwa sababu thamani inaundwa nje ya miamala yenyewe.

44db902f0a10.en: You break even, because the price did not change

45681a3c43d4.en: Not quite — remember the POW camp example. Money just needs trust and acceptance, not physical value.
45681a3c43d4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kumbuka mfano wa kambi ya wafungwa. Pesa inahitaji tu imani na kukubalika, si thamani ya kimwili.

4580f2d87357.en: A market order crosses the spread on purpose: you take the best price on offer and accept the 0.04. A limit order sits in the book and waits for someone to come to you. If they do, you avoid the spread. If they do not, you simply do not trade — and if the price runs away in the meantime, not trading may have cost more than the spread would have.
4580f2d87357.sw: Agizo la soko huvuka spread kwa makusudi: unachukua bei bora inayotolewa na unakubali ile 0.04. Agizo la kikomo hukaa kwenye kitabu na kusubiri mtu aje kwako. Kama watakuja, unaepuka spread. Kama hawatakuja, hufanyi biashara tu — na kama bei itakimbia wakati huo, kutofanya biashara kunaweza kuwa kumegharimu zaidi ya spread ingegharimu.

4590847b0e27.en: Not quite — Osler (2003) showed the cause is order clustering: stop-loss and take-profit orders bunch at round-number levels, so price genuinely reacts there.
4590847b0e27.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — Osler (2003) alionyesha sababu ni mkusanyiko wa maagizo: maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit hujikusanya kwenye viwango vya namba za mviringo, hivyo bei huitikia hapo kweli.

45d83f4760bc.en: A measure of how closely two assets' prices tend to move in relation to each other, ranging from perfectly together (+1) to perfectly opposite (-1), with 0 meaning no consistent relationship.
45d83f4760bc.sw: Kipimo cha jinsi bei za mali mbili zinavyoelekea kusogea kwa uhusiano na kila mmoja, kuanzia pamoja kabisa (+1) hadi kinyume kabisa (-1), ambapo 0 humaanisha hakuna uhusiano wa kudumu.

45deb3527bf3.en: True or False: the Swiss franc shock shows that a good enough model can be trusted to rule out extreme moves.
45deb3527bf3.sw: Kweli au Uongo: mshtuko wa faranga ya Uswisi unaonyesha kwamba muundo mzuri vya kutosha unaweza kuaminiwa kuondoa uwezekano wa misogeo ya kupindukia.

45e976c72ef8.en: "Price is king" is itself a claim, and this course does not accept claims because they sound confident. Reading a naked chart removes indicator clutter, but it does not remove the hard problem — deciding what the price is likely to do next. The rest of this lesson tests where that decision has real evidence behind it and where it does not.
45e976c72ef8.sw: "Bei ni mfalme" nalo ni dai lenyewe, na kozi hii haikubali madai kwa sababu yanasikika kwa uhakika. Kusoma chati tupu huondoa msongamano wa viashiria, lakini hakuondoi tatizo gumu — kuamua bei inawezekana kufanya nini baadaye. Sehemu iliyobaki ya somo hili hujaribu mahali uamuzi huo una ushahidi halisi nyuma yake na mahali usipokuwa nao.

4611d11cecef.en: The honest distinction is structural, and it has two parts: where the return comes from, and who is on the other side of you.
4611d11cecef.sw: Tofauti ya uaminifu ni ya kimuundo, na ina sehemu mbili: faida inatoka wapi, na ni nani aliye upande mwingine wako.

4637c940efba.en: The gambler's ruin problem is old and well understood: a player with limited money making repeated bets has a calculable chance of eventually losing everything, and the single biggest lever on that chance is not the win rate — it is the fraction of the account risked on each bet. Ralph Vince brought this framework to trading in The Mathematics of Money Management (Wiley, 1992), formalising the "fixed fractional" approach this course has used since Foundations: risk a small, constant fraction of the account each time.
4637c940efba.sw: Tatizo la kufilisika kwa mchezaji wa kamari ni la zamani na linaeleweka vizuri: mchezaji mwenye pesa chache anayefanya mabashiri ya kurudia-rudia ana nafasi inayoweza kukokotolewa ya hatimaye kupoteza kila kitu, na lever kubwa kuliko zote juu ya nafasi hiyo si kiwango cha ushindi — ni sehemu ya akaunti inayohatarishwa kwa kila dau. Ralph Vince alileta mfumo huu kwenye biashara katika The Mathematics of Money Management (Wiley, 1992), akirasimisha mbinu ya "sehemu thabiti" ambayo kozi hii imeitumia tangu Msingi: hatarisha sehemu ndogo thabiti ya akaunti kila mara.

463f4c001fd3.en: You buy EUR/USD at 1.1050 with a 30-pip trailing stop. If price rises to 1.1080, your stop automatically rises to 1.1050 (breakeven). If price continues to 1.1120, your stop rises again to 1.1090 — now locking in 40 pips of profit even if price reverses. The stop only ever moves in your favor; it never moves back.
463f4c001fd3.sw: Unanunua EUR/USD kwa 1.1050 ukiwa na trailing stop ya pip 30. Kama bei itapanda hadi 1.1080, stop yako itapanda kiotomatiki hadi 1.1050 (usawa). Kama bei itaendelea hadi 1.1120, stop yako itapanda tena hadi 1.1090 — sasa ikihifadhi faida ya pip 40 hata kama bei itageuka. Stop husogea kwa manufaa yako tu; hairudi nyuma kamwe.

463f7d60bf86.en: A number an index is divided by so splits and membership changes do not create artificial jumps.
463f7d60bf86.sw: Namba ambayo index hugawanywa kwayo ili mgawanyo na mabadiliko ya uanachama yasizalishe miruko ya bandia.

465f416c1a1c.sw: Wakopeshaji, kwa sababu wana daraja la kwanza katika kila hali

46737f094e4b.en: The total size of your open positions divided by your account equity. Unlike the broker's maximum offered leverage, this is the leverage you are actually using right now.
46737f094e4b.sw: Ukubwa wa jumla wa nafasi zako zilizo wazi kugawanywa kwa usawa wa akaunti yako. Tofauti na leverage ya juu zaidi inayotolewa na broker, hii ndiyo leverage unayoitumia hasa sasa hivi.

468a92f532b1.sw: Mfumuko wa Bei — Ni Nini, na Jinsi Unavyosogeza Kila Soko

46937617d6e3.sw: Huduma inayoahidi faida ya uhakika au kubwa isivyo kawaida

46c9c5b912f9.sw: Wanahisa, kwa sababu dai la mabaki ni dai juu ya chochote kilichobaki baada ya majukumu yote kutimizwa

46dd63dd9a39.sw: Umiliki wa hisa una hatari ndogo, kwa sababu bei za hisa haziwezi kushuka hadi sifuri

46fbbf5d0d60.en: A record of every trade — the setup, entry, stop, target, size, the R-multiple result, and an honest note on whether you followed your plan — kept so you can measure your real expectancy and spot the mistakes you keep repeating.
46fbbf5d0d60.sw: Rekodi ya kila biashara — mpangilio, kuingia, stop, lengo, ukubwa, tokeo la kizidishi-R, na dokezo la uaminifu kama ulifuata mpango wako — inayowekwa ili uweze kupima matarajio yako halisi na kuona makosa unayoyarudia.

470ed3ec2354.en: Most early losses come from a short, repeating list of mistakes the course has already solved — and nearly all of them are the same failure: acting on feeling or hope instead of a pre-decided, evidence-checked rule.
470ed3ec2354.sw: Hasara nyingi za awali hutoka kwenye orodha fupi inayojirudia ya makosa ambayo kozi tayari imeyatatua — na karibu yote ni kushindwa kule kule: kutenda kwa hisia au matumaini badala ya kanuni iliyoamuliwa mapema na kukaguliwa kwa ushahidi.

473058de5709.en: Not quite — the best-analysed ideas outperformed by ~2.8-4.5%/yr while the rest did not beat the market. The edge was concentrated.

480aea2172b7.sw: Sura ya 1 ilielezea wito wa margin kama tukio moja. Katika akaunti hai kwa kawaida kuna viwango viwili, na kujua tofauti kunahusika.

486f670cf9ef.en: Not quite — when nothing aligns, cash is the right position. Forcing a trade is overtrading, which gives edges back.
486f670cf9ef.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — hakuna kinapolingana, fedha taslimu ndiyo nafasi sahihi. Kulazimisha biashara ni kufanya biashara kupita kiasi, ambako hurudisha faida.

489960347da9.en: The resolution is that "best ideas" governs where your conviction goes, while the fixed-fractional risk rule governs how much any single trade can cost you. You concentrate toward your strongest theses, but each one is still sized so that being wrong is survivable — the 1 to 2% risk per trade never gets abandoned because a thesis feels certain. Concentration of conviction, not concentration of risk. The 2015 franc traders who blew up (Chapter 5, Lesson 1) had concentrated risk; that is the opposite of this.
489960347da9.sw: Suluhisho ni kwamba "mawazo bora" huongoza mahali uhakika wako unakokwenda, ilhali kanuni ya hatari ya sehemu thabiti huongoza kiasi ambacho biashara yoyote moja inaweza kukugharimu. Unajikita kuelekea nadharia zako imara zaidi, lakini kila moja bado inapimwa ili kukosea kuweze kunusurika — hatari ya 1 hadi 2% kwa kila biashara haiachwi kamwe kwa sababu nadharia inahisi ya uhakika. Kujikita kwa uhakika, si kujikita kwa hatari. Wafanyabiashara wa faranga wa mwaka 2015 waliolipuka (Sura ya 5, Somo la 1) walikuwa wamejikita kwa hatari; hiyo ni kinyume cha hii.

49c805b92adb.en: A rare, high-impact, hard-to-predict event, rationalised as obvious only in hindsight.
49c805b92adb.sw: Tukio nadra lenye athari kubwa, gumu kutabiri, linalofafanuliwa kama dhahiri kwa kutazama nyuma tu.

4a22a27bd6e4.en: Kelly's original paper, "A New Interpretation of Information Rate," was published in the Bell System Technical Journal — and wasn't even primarily about gambling or trading. Kelly was extending Claude Shannon's information theory, and discovered that the same math describing optimal information transmission also describes optimal bet sizing. The formula requires knowing your real win rate and your reward-to-risk ratio precisely; given those, it tells you exactly what fraction of your capital to risk to grow fastest over time.
4a22a27bd6e4.sw: Karatasi asilia ya Kelly, "A New Interpretation of Information Rate," ilichapishwa katika Bell System Technical Journal — na haikuhusu hata kwanza kamari wala biashara. Kelly alikuwa akipanua nadharia ya taarifa ya Claude Shannon, na akagundua kwamba hisabati ile ile inayoeleza usambazaji bora wa taarifa pia inaeleza upimaji bora wa ukubwa wa dau. Fomula inahitaji kujua kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi na uwiano wako wa tuzo-kwa-hatari kwa usahihi; ukiwa na hivyo, inakuambia hasa sehemu ipi ya mtaji wako ya kuhatarisha ili kukua kwa kasi zaidi kwa muda.

4a375565be91.en: Pairs split into major, minor, and exotic classes, alongside the current 2025 BIS ranking of the major pairs by turnover.
4a375565be91.sw: Jozi hugawanyika katika madaraja ya kuu, ndogo, na adimu, pamoja na daraja la sasa la BIS la mwaka 2025 la jozi kuu kwa mzunguko wa biashara.

4a62ca36d4ca.en: The professional replaces the feeling with a thesis: a set of independent questions, each answered with evidence, that either line up or do not. Conviction then means something real — not "how sure am I?" but "how many separate, evidence-based reasons point the same way?"
4a62ca36d4ca.sw: Mtaalamu hubadilisha hisia kwa nadharia: seti ya maswali huru, kila moja likijibiwa kwa ushahidi, ambayo hulingana au hayalingani. Uhakika basi humaanisha kitu halisi — si "nina uhakika kiasi gani?" bali "ni sababu ngapi tofauti zenye msingi wa ushahidi zinaelekea upande ule ule?"

4a76fe4fda2e.en: That example is Lesson 1 again from another angle, and it is why the balance sheet matters even to someone who never intends to value a company. It tells you how much has to go wrong before the residual is gone.
4a76fe4fda2e.sw: Mfano huo ni Somo la 1 tena kutoka pembe nyingine, na ndiyo sababu mizania inahusika hata kwa mtu asiyekusudia kuthamini kampuni kamwe. Hukuambia mangapi lazima yaende vibaya kabla mabaki hayajaisha.

4a83c7426b1d.en: The distinction between a stop order and a limit order is where beginners lose money without understanding how. A stop order at 45 does not sell at 45. It sends a market order once 45 trades, and that order fills at whatever the book offers next, which in a fast fall may be well below.
4a83c7426b1d.sw: Tofauti kati ya agizo la stop na agizo la kikomo ndipo wanaoanza hupoteza pesa bila kuelewa jinsi gani. Agizo la stop kwa 45 haliuzi kwa 45. Hutuma agizo la soko mara 45 inapofanyiwa biashara, na agizo hilo hutimizwa kwa chochote kitabu kinachotoa baadaye, ambacho katika kushuka kwa kasi kinaweza kuwa chini mno.

4aef140c87fa.en: It falls by 10% only if the company chooses to pay a smaller dividend
4aef140c87fa.sw: Hushuka kwa 10% tu kama kampuni itachagua kulipa gawio dogo zaidi

4afd476679db.en: A perfect read of a chart, paired with no risk management, is still a losing strategy waiting to happen.
4afd476679db.sw: Usomaji kamili wa chati, ukiambatanishwa na kutokuwa na usimamizi wa hatari, bado ni mkakati wa hasara unaosubiri kutokea.

4b1b520638b0.en: That last point ties the whole risk chapter together. Position sizing (Chapter 3, Lesson 1) keeps you alive through the variance. The risk-to-reward ratio and win rate (Chapter 3, Lesson 3) combine into expectancy. Discipline (Lesson 1) is what lets a positive expectancy actually be realised, instead of abandoned in the middle of a normal drawdown. The trading plan is the document that binds all of it into one repeatable process — which is the only thing that turns an edge on paper into money in an account.
4b1b520638b0.sw: Pointi hiyo ya mwisho huunganisha sura nzima ya hatari. Upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1) hukuweka hai katika utofauti. Uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo na kiwango cha ushindi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 3) huungana kuwa matarajio. Nidhamu (Somo la 1) ndicho kinachoruhusu matarajio chanya kutimizwa hasa, badala ya kuachwa katikati ya kushuka kwa kawaida. Mpango wa biashara ndio hati inayounganisha yote kuwa mchakato mmoja unaorudiwa — ambacho ndicho kitu pekee kinachogeuza faida kwenye karatasi kuwa pesa kwenye akaunti.

4b1cb39d10c4.en: Case Study — The 2016 Sterling Flash Crash
4b1cb39d10c4.sw: Uchunguzi wa Tukio — Anguko la Ghafla la Pauni la Mwaka 2016

4b20fd200911.en: Settlement looks like plumbing, and for a long-term holder it is. It becomes visible at exactly two moments: when you need the cash by a specific date, and when a market is under stress. Chapter 5 covers January 2021, when settlement mechanics stopped being invisible and became the story.
4b20fd200911.sw: Kutatua kunaonekana kama mabomba, na kwa mwenye kushikilia muda mrefu ni hivyo. Hujitokeza katika nyakati mbili hasa: unapohitaji fedha kwa tarehe mahususi, na soko linapokuwa chini ya shinikizo. Sura ya 5 inashughulikia Januari 2021, wakati utaratibu wa kutatua uliacha kuwa usioonekana na ukawa simulizi.

4b375d1b2caf.en: A professional does not take a trade just because the case is good; the payoff has to justify the risk. Using the risk-to-reward and break-even math from Chapter 3, Lesson 3, a serious thesis is expected to offer a reward-to-risk of at least roughly 2 to 1, and often more — enough that the trade is worth taking even at a modest win rate, and enough to carry the whole process's expectancy (Chapter 4, Lesson 2) into positive territory after the inevitable losers.
4b375d1b2caf.sw: Mtaalamu hachukui biashara kwa sababu hoja ni nzuri tu; malipo lazima yaihalalishe hatari. Kwa kutumia hisabati ya hatari-kwa-tuzo na kulingana kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 3, nadharia nzito inatarajiwa kutoa tuzo-kwa-hatari ya angalau takriban 2 kwa 1, na mara nyingi zaidi — vya kutosha kwamba biashara inastahili kuchukuliwa hata kwa kiwango cha wastani cha ushindi, na vya kutosha kubeba matarajio ya mchakato mzima (Sura ya 4, Somo la 2) hadi eneo chanya baada ya wapotezaji wasioepukika.

4b7075b8b7ef.en: A related finding sharpens it. Cremers and Petajisto (2009), in The Review of Financial Studies, introduced "Active Share" — how much a portfolio actually differs from its benchmark — and found that the managers who deviated most from the crowd, with the highest Active Share, were the ones who outperformed, before and after fees. Doing something genuinely different from the consensus is where returns come from — but only, both studies imply, when that difference is backed by real analysis rather than mere boldness.
4b7075b8b7ef.sw: Tokeo linalohusiana hulinoa. Cremers na Petajisto (2009), katika The Review of Financial Studies, walianzisha "Active Share" — kiasi ambacho mkusanyiko hutofautiana hasa na kigezo chake — na wakagundua kwamba wasimamizi waliopotoka zaidi kutoka kwa umati, wenye Active Share kubwa zaidi, ndio waliofanya vizuri zaidi, kabla na baada ya ada. Kufanya kitu tofauti kweli na makubaliano ya jumla ndipo faida zinapotoka — lakini tu, tafiti zote mbili zinadokeza, tofauti hiyo inapoungwa mkono na uchambuzi halisi badala ya ujasiri tu.

4b813ef2f2b0.en: Three panels setting out what the income statement, the balance sheet and the cash flow statement each answer, noting that profit involves accounting judgement while cash either arrived or did not.
4b813ef2f2b0.sw: Paneli tatu zikieleza kile ambacho taarifa ya mapato, mizania na taarifa ya mtiririko wa fedha kila moja hujibu, zikibainisha kwamba faida huhusisha hukumu ya kihasibu ilhali fedha ama zilifika au hazikufika.

4b962761b414.en: Pick one high-impact event this week on a pair you follow. Before it lands, note the forecast. When the actual arrives, record: (1) was it a surprise, and in which direction? (2) where was price 5 minutes later? (3) 1 hour later? (4) the next day? Do this for a few events and you'll have something no article can give you — your own evidence base for how that specific release behaves. That's how you earn the right to trade news later, rather than guessing.
4b962761b414.sw: Chagua tukio moja lenye athari kubwa wiki hii kwenye jozi unalolifuatilia. Kabla halijafika, andika utabiri. Halisi inapofika, rekodi: (1) je, ilikuwa mshangao, na kwa mwelekeo upi? (2) bei ilikuwa wapi dakika 5 baadaye? (3) saa 1 baadaye? (4) siku iliyofuata? Fanya hivi kwa matukio machache na utakuwa na kitu ambacho hakuna makala inayoweza kukupa — msingi wako mwenyewe wa ushahidi wa jinsi toleo hilo mahususi linavyotenda. Ndivyo unavyopata haki ya kufanya biashara ya habari baadaye, badala ya kukisia.

4bf1e58b86a6.en: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling and Schrimpf (2012), in The Journal of Finance, showed that carry trade returns are strongly tied to global currency volatility: the strategy earns steadily in calm periods and then suffers sharp, correlated losses exactly when volatility spikes. The broader work on this — including Brunnermeier, Nagel and Pedersen's study "Carry Trades and Currency Crashes" — describes the same shape: carry profits are not a free lunch but compensation for bearing crash risk. The 2008 yen unwind is that theory playing out in the open.
4bf1e58b86a6.sw: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling na Schrimpf (2012), katika The Journal of Finance, walionyesha kwamba faida za carry trade zimefungwa kwa nguvu na mtikisiko wa sarafu duniani: mkakati hupata faida kwa uthabiti katika vipindi tulivu na kisha hupata hasara kali zenye uwiano hasa mtikisiko unapopanda ghafla. Kazi pana juu ya hili — ikiwemo utafiti wa Brunnermeier, Nagel na Pedersen "Carry Trades and Currency Crashes" — huelezea umbo lile lile: faida za carry si chakula cha bure bali fidia kwa kubeba hatari ya kuanguka. Kuvunjika kwa yen kwa mwaka 2008 ni nadharia hiyo ikijitokeza waziwazi.

4bfb66e89f7d.en: Correct — these are precise, different relationships. An asset can be one without being the other.
4bfb66e89f7d.sw: Sahihi — haya ni mahusiano sahihi na tofauti. Mali inaweza kuwa moja bila kuwa nyingine.

4c057ff382bc.en: When a currency can buy more of another currency than before, it has appreciated (strengthened). When it can buy less, it has depreciated (weakened). In the example above, the peso appreciated against the dollar — it took fewer pesos to equal one dollar, which meant each peso was now worth more.
4c057ff382bc.sw: Sarafu inapoweza kununua kiasi kikubwa cha sarafu nyingine kuliko awali, imeimarika. Inapoweza kununua kidogo, imedhoofika. Katika mfano hapo juu, peso iliimarika dhidi ya dola — ilihitaji peso chache kufikia dola moja, jambo lililomaanisha kila peso sasa ilikuwa na thamani kubwa zaidi.

4c0b873f49a9.en: Selling losing trades quickly and letting winners run
4c0b873f49a9.sw: Kuuza biashara za hasara kwa haraka na kuacha washindi wakimbie

4c0fa7058228.en: Here is the catch that undoes beginners who understand everything above. Expectancy is an average over many trades. Any short stretch is dominated by luck, not edge.
4c0fa7058228.sw: Huu hapa mtego unaowamaliza wanaoanza wanaoelewa kila kitu hapo juu. Matarajio ni wastani katika biashara nyingi. Mfululizo wowote mfupi hutawaliwa na bahati, si faida.

4c458f228c25.en: Not quite — the 2015 SNB event proved the opposite: stop-losses triggered correctly but filled far from their set price. A stop-loss guarantees a trigger, not a fill price.
4c458f228c25.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — tukio la SNB la mwaka 2015 lilithibitisha kinyume: stop-loss zilianzishwa kwa usahihi lakini zilitimizwa mbali na bei yao iliyowekwa. Stop-loss huhakikisha kianzishi, si bei ya kutimizwa.

4c668b4143a2.en: It has fallen by 2.00 — the price dropped and the dividend does not compensate
4c668b4143a2.sw: Umeshuka kwa 2.00 — bei ilishuka na gawio halifidii

4c6dd02f82ff.en: Evaluating a currency based on the underlying economic forces that drive its value — interest rates, inflation, growth, employment, and central bank policy — rather than on chart patterns.
4c6dd02f82ff.sw: Kutathmini sarafu kwa msingi wa nguvu za kiuchumi za msingi zinazoendesha thamani yake — viwango vya riba, mfumuko wa bei, ukuaji, ajira, na sera ya benki kuu — badala ya mitindo ya chati.

4ce18ea084c3.en: At the invalidation level — the price or condition at which the thesis is proven wrong
4ce18ea084c3.sw: Kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika — bei au hali ambapo nadharia inathibitishwa kuwa batili

4d4f9a63d2a4.en: Correct — unwinding a yen-funded carry trade means buying yen back. With everyone forced to unwind together in the crisis, the crowded, simultaneous buying sent the yen sharply higher.
4d4f9a63d2a4.sw: Sahihi — kuvunja carry trade iliyofadhiliwa na yen kunamaanisha kununua yen tena. Kila mtu akilazimika kuvunja kwa pamoja katika janga, ununuzi wa msongamano na wa wakati mmoja uliipandisha yen kwa kasi.

4d53a246ea9a.en: In July 1944, representatives of 44 Allied nations met in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, to design a new system: instead of every country backing its own currency with its own gold, every country would peg its currency to the U.S. dollar, and only the dollar would remain convertible to gold — at that same $35-per-ounce rate from 1934.
4d53a246ea9a.sw: Mwezi Julai 1944, wawakilishi wa mataifa 44 ya Washirika walikutana Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, kubuni mfumo mpya: badala ya kila nchi kuunga mkono sarafu yake kwa dhahabu yake yenyewe, kila nchi ingefunga sarafu yake kwenye dola ya Marekani, na dola pekee ndiyo ingebaki inabadilishwa kuwa dhahabu — kwa kiwango kile kile cha $35 kwa wakia cha mwaka 1934.

4d6f364d2cb7.en: Look at the job postings at any serious investment firm. You'll see plenty of listings for risk managers. You will not see a "profit-taking manager." These firms don't primarily focus on how much they're making — they focus on how much they could lose, and how to control it.
4d6f364d2cb7.sw: Angalia matangazo ya kazi katika kampuni yoyote nzito ya uwekezaji. Utaona matangazo mengi ya wasimamizi wa hatari. Hutaona "msimamizi wa kuchukua faida." Kampuni hizi hazizingatii kwanza kiasi wanachopata — zinazingatia kiasi wanachoweza kupoteza, na jinsi ya kukidhibiti.

4d9f06c6da65.en: Recall from Lesson 2: which currency is listed first in a major pair isn't arbitrary — it follows the historical pecking order (EUR, then GBP, then AUD/NZD, then USD, then CAD/CHF/JPY) rooted in sterling's former reserve-currency dominance.
4d9f06c6da65.sw: Kumbuka kutoka Somo la 2: sarafu ipi inaorodheshwa kwanza katika jozi kuu si suala la bahati nasibu — hufuata daraja la kihistoria (EUR, kisha GBP, kisha AUD/NZD, kisha USD, kisha CAD/CHF/JPY) lenye mizizi katika utawala wa zamani wa sterling kama sarafu ya akiba.

4dd8b2eafc77.en: Because the wheel has 37 pockets while the payout is 35 to 1, so the shortfall is built into the game itself
4dd8b2eafc77.sw: Kwa sababu gurudumu lina mifuko 37 ilhali malipo ni 35 kwa 1, hivyo upungufu umejengwa ndani ya mchezo wenyewe

4df60535b920.en: Correct — it's the opposite: the puzzle is that UIP fails, with high-rate currencies historically tending to keep appreciating in the short run, contradicting the theory. Eugene Fama documented it in 1984.
4df60535b920.sw: Sahihi — ni kinyume: fumbo ni kwamba UIP hushindwa, sarafu za viwango vya juu zikielekea kihistoria kuendelea kuimarika kwa muda mfupi, zikipinga nadharia. Eugene Fama aliliandika mwaka 1984.

4e0c7443f070.en: What to look for on any income-focused holding. The payout ratio and whether it is covered by cash flow rather than only by accounting earnings. Whether the dividend has been cut before, and when. Whether the company also buys back shares. And whether the fund or share is being sold to you on yield alone, which the previous paragraph explains is a filter with a bias built into it.
4e0c7443f070.sw: Cha kutazama kwenye umiliki wowote unaolenga mapato. Uwiano wa malipo na kama unafunikwa na mtiririko wa fedha badala ya mapato ya kihasibu tu. Kama gawio limewahi kupunguzwa, na lini. Kama kampuni pia hununua tena hisa. Na kama fund au hisa inauzwa kwako kwa mavuno peke yake, ambacho aya iliyotangulia inaeleza ni chujio chenye upendeleo uliojengwa ndani yake.

4e477fee2968.en: A tenth of a pip — one decimal place further than the standard pip. Many modern brokers quote an extra decimal (e.g., EUR/USD to five decimals instead of four) for finer pricing precision.
4e477fee2968.sw: Sehemu ya kumi ya pip — nafasi moja ya desimali zaidi ya pip sanifu. Mabroker wengi wa kisasa hunukuu desimali ya ziada (mfano, EUR/USD kwa desimali tano badala ya nne) kwa usahihi bora zaidi wa bei.

4e4c1995ff60.en: Correct — Shefrin and Statman named it, and Odean (1998) measured it: investors were 1.5 to 2 times more likely to sell winners than losers, shrinking gains and letting losses run — the opposite of good risk-to-reward.
4e4c1995ff60.sw: Sahihi — Shefrin na Statman waliipa jina, na Odean (1998) aliipima: wawekezaji walikuwa na uwezekano wa mara 1.5 hadi 2 zaidi wa kuuza washindi kuliko wapotezaji, wakipunguza faida na kuacha hasara zikimbie — kinyume cha hatari-kwa-tuzo nzuri.

4e4c37728aba.en: Short-term trading in shares is closest in structure to which of the following, and why?
4e4c37728aba.sw: Biashara ya muda mfupi ya hisa iko karibu zaidi kimuundo na kipi kati ya vifuatavyo, na kwa nini?

4e4c6cf344ec.en: Not quite — a historically rooted pecking order (EUR > GBP > AUD/NZD > USD > CAD/CHF/JPY) sets the conventional order for major pairs.
4e4c6cf344ec.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — daraja lenye mizizi ya kihistoria (EUR > GBP > AUD/NZD > USD > CAD/CHF/JPY) huweka mpangilio wa kawaida wa jozi kuu.

4e5038ed1eb0.en: A system wins 45% of the time, with an average win of 300 dollars and an average loss of 150 dollars. Expectancy = (0.45 times 300) minus (0.55 times 150) = 135 minus 82.50 = +52.50 dollars per trade. Over 200 trades, that is about +10,500 dollars before costs — from a system that loses more often than it wins. Now the warning case: a system wins 60% of the time, but the average win is only 80 dollars against an average loss of 150. Expectancy = (0.60 times 80) minus (0.40 times 150) = 48 minus 60 = minus 12 dollars per trade. A 60% win rate that steadily loses money — Chapter 3, Lesson 3's point, now measured in dollars.
4e5038ed1eb0.sw: Mfumo hushinda 45% ya muda, wenye ushindi wa wastani wa dola 300 na hasara ya wastani ya dola 150. Matarajio = (0.45 mara 300) toa (0.55 mara 150) = 135 toa 82.50 = +dola 52.50 kwa kila biashara. Katika biashara 200, hiyo ni takriban +dola 10,500 kabla ya gharama — kutoka mfumo unaopoteza mara nyingi zaidi kuliko unavyoshinda. Sasa kesi ya onyo: mfumo hushinda 60% ya muda, lakini ushindi wa wastani ni dola 80 tu dhidi ya hasara ya wastani ya 150. Matarajio = (0.60 mara 80) toa (0.40 mara 150) = 48 toa 60 = toa dola 12 kwa kila biashara. Kiwango cha ushindi cha 60% kinachopoteza pesa kwa uthabiti — pointi ya Sura ya 3, Somo la 3, sasa ikipimwa kwa dola.

4e64f6f03a7c.en: A banking system where a bank holds only a fraction of the deposits it's responsible for in actual reserve, and lends out — or issues notes against — the rest. It's genuinely useful (it's how banks fund loans and business investment) but it comes with a structural risk.
4e64f6f03a7c.sw: Mfumo wa kibenki ambapo benki hushikilia sehemu tu ya amana inayowajibika nayo kama akiba halisi, na hukopesha — au hutoa noti dhidi ya — kilichobaki. Ni wa manufaa kweli (ndivyo benki zinavyofadhili mikopo na uwekezaji wa biashara) lakini unakuja na hatari ya kimuundo.

4e7021409427.en: By concentrating conviction toward the strongest theses while still sizing every trade to the fixed-fractional risk rule
4e7021409427.sw: Kwa kujikita kwenye uhakika kuelekea nadharia imara zaidi huku bado ukipima kila biashara kwa kanuni ya hatari ya sehemu thabiti

4ecaa638c487.en: Company B, because it is the larger company
4ecaa638c487.sw: Kampuni B, kwa sababu ni kampuni kubwa zaidi

4efdf107e3ea.en: The window length is the whole personality of the indicator. In a short SMA (say 20 periods), each new candle is 1/20 of the data, so the line reacts quickly and hugs price. In a long SMA (say 50), each new candle is only 1/50 of the data, so the line is smoother and slower — it filters out noise at the cost of reacting late. Neither is "better"; they answer different questions: what has price done recently versus what has price done over the longer stretch.
4efdf107e3ea.sw: Urefu wa dirisha ndio tabia yote ya kiashiria. Katika SMA fupi (tuseme vipindi 20), kila mshumaa mpya ni 1/20 ya data, hivyo mstari huitikia haraka na kushikamana na bei. Katika SMA ndefu (tuseme 50), kila mshumaa mpya ni 1/50 tu ya data, hivyo mstari ni laini na wa polepole zaidi — huchuja kelele kwa gharama ya kuitikia kwa kuchelewa. Hakuna "bora"; zinajibu maswali tofauti: bei imefanya nini hivi karibuni dhidi ya bei imefanya nini kwa kipindi kirefu zaidi.

4f0d2fd2817a.en: Not quite — the base is always the currency listed first, so here it's USD; JPY is the quote.
4f0d2fd2817a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — msingi daima ni sarafu iliyoorodheshwa kwanza, hivyo hapa ni USD; JPY ni bei.

4f14823bf271.en: A lottery, because outcomes are entirely random
4f14823bf271.sw: Bahati nasibu, kwa sababu matokeo ni ya bahati kabisa

4f4699726e27.en: Not quite — conviction here means several independent, evidence-based pillars agreeing, not the strength of a feeling or a single signal.
4f4699726e27.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — uhakika hapa unamaanisha nguzo kadhaa huru zenye msingi wa ushahidi zikikubaliana, si nguvu ya hisia wala ishara moja.

4f538ba97c8a.en: Two feelings do most of the damage, and they are worth naming plainly. Fear, in trading, is the pull to cut a gain short before it can turn, or to avoid the discomfort of admitting a loss. Greed is the pull to want more — a bigger position, one more trade, a target stretched further out. The rest of this lesson is really about the specific, documented mistakes those two feelings produce, and the one thing that actually defends against them.
4f538ba97c8a.sw: Hisia mbili hufanya madhara mengi, na zinastahili kutajwa wazi. Hofu, katika biashara, ni mvuto wa kukata faida kabla haijageuka, au kuepuka usumbufu wa kukiri hasara. Tamaa ni mvuto wa kutaka zaidi — nafasi kubwa zaidi, biashara moja zaidi, lengo lililonyooshwa mbali zaidi. Sehemu iliyobaki ya somo hili kwa kweli inahusu makosa mahususi yaliyoandikwa ambayo hisia hizo mbili huzalisha, na kitu kimoja kinachozilinda hasa.

4f745484b0b2.en: A price level where a rising price has repeatedly stopped rising and reversed downward, as sellers step in.
4f745484b0b2.sw: Kiwango cha bei ambapo bei inayopanda imesimama kupanda mara kwa mara na kugeuka kushuka, wauzaji wanapoingia.

501be5ab809d.en: It's tempting to think a currency's value is fixed or "real," the way a gold coin feels real. It isn't. Every currency's value — including the ones you'll see priced elsewhere in this app — is a reflection of collective trust and expectation. That's precisely why currency values move, and why markets like this one exist at all.
501be5ab809d.sw: Ni rahisi kudhani kwamba thamani ya sarafu ni thabiti au "halisi," jinsi sarafu ya dhahabu inavyohisi halisi. Sivyo. Thamani ya kila sarafu — ikiwemo zile utakazoziona zikiwekewa bei mahali pengine kwenye programu hii — ni onyesho la imani na matarajio ya pamoja. Hiyo ndiyo sababu hasa thamani za sarafu husogea, na kwa nini masoko kama hili yapo kabisa.

506ef3cb06fa.en: Secretly reducing the amount of precious metal in a coin — mixing in cheaper metal — while still presenting it as full value.
506ef3cb06fa.sw: Kupunguza kwa siri kiasi cha madini ya thamani katika sarafu — kwa kuchanganya madini ya bei rahisi — huku ikiendelea kuwasilishwa kama yenye thamani kamili.

507f70518d26.en: Two stacked bars showing the same company in a good year and after a 10 percent fall in revenue. Suppliers take 40, staff 35, interest 10 and tax 5 in both cases, leaving a residual of 10 in the first and nothing in the second, illustrating that a 10 percent fall in revenue can remove the shareholders claim entirely.
507f70518d26.sw: Vipau viwili vilivyorundikwa vinavyoonyesha kampuni ile ile katika mwaka mzuri na baada ya kushuka kwa asilimia 10 kwa mapato. Wasambazaji huchukua 40, wafanyakazi 35, riba 10 na kodi 5 katika kesi zote mbili, zikiacha mabaki ya 10 katika ya kwanza na hakuna katika ya pili, zikionyesha kwamba kushuka kwa asilimia 10 kwa mapato kunaweza kuondoa dai la wanahisa kabisa.

50c3827381d4.en: Not quite. The fee applies to your whole balance every year, not once, so it compounds against you. On 10,000 over 30 years at 7%, the difference between 0.05% and 1.50% is about 25,223 — the expensive fund finishes with roughly two thirds of what the cheap one produced.
50c3827381d4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ada hutumika kwa salio lako lote kila mwaka, si mara moja, hivyo hujikusanya dhidi yako. Kwa 10,000 katika miaka 30 kwa 7%, tofauti kati ya 0.05% na 1.50% ni takriban 25,223 — fund ghali humalizia na takriban theluthi mbili ya kile ile ya bei nafuu ilizalisha.

50d303ab3d06.en: This is why share prices move so much more than a company's revenue does. The residual is the thin layer at the end of a stack, so a small change in the size of the stack is a large change in the layer. A 10% fall in revenue in that example does not reduce the shareholders' claim by 10%. It removes it entirely.
50d303ab3d06.sw: Ndiyo sababu bei za hisa husogea zaidi mno kuliko mapato ya kampuni yanavyosogea. Mabaki ni safu nyembamba mwishoni mwa rundo, hivyo mabadiliko madogo ya ukubwa wa rundo ni mabadiliko makubwa ya safu. Kushuka kwa 10% kwa mapato katika mfano huo hakupunguzi dai la wanahisa kwa 10%. Kunaliondoa kabisa.

50d91e6a9d6c.en: The distinction is not how risky it feels. It is whether anything is being created outside the transactions.
50d91e6a9d6c.sw: Tofauti si jinsi inavyohisi hatari. Ni kama kitu chochote kinaundwa nje ya miamala.

51043a06aaf7.en: A signal generated when a shorter-period moving average crosses a longer-period one. Short crossing above long = recent prices outperforming the longer stretch (buy signal). Short crossing below long = recent prices underperforming (sell signal).
51043a06aaf7.sw: Ishara inayozalishwa wastani wa kipindi kifupi unapokatiza ule wa kipindi kirefu. Fupi kukatiza juu ya ndefu = bei za hivi karibuni kufanya vizuri kuliko kipindi kirefu (ishara ya kununua). Fupi kukatiza chini ya ndefu = bei za hivi karibuni kufanya vibaya (ishara ya kuuza).

514c3456d6ae.en: A stop-loss order becomes a market order once triggered, and a market order fills at the best price available. On 15 January there was almost no price available: buyers vanished exactly as the sell orders arrived. Stop-losses set safely near 1.20 did trigger — and then filled hundreds of pips lower, or not at all. Even the broker's own stop-out (Chapter 3, Lesson 2), meant to close positions before an account goes negative, could not work in a market with no bids to sell into.
514c3456d6ae.sw: Agizo la stop-loss hukuwa agizo la soko mara linapoanzishwa, na agizo la soko hutimizwa kwa bei bora inayopatikana. Tarehe 15 Januari hakukuwa na bei karibu yoyote iliyopatikana: wanunuzi walitoweka hasa maagizo ya kuuza yalipofika. Stop-loss zilizowekwa salama karibu na 1.20 zilianzishwa kweli — kisha zikatimizwa mamia ya pip chini, au hazikutimizwa kabisa. Hata stop-out ya broker mwenyewe (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2), iliyokusudiwa kufunga nafasi kabla akaunti haijawa hasi, haikuweza kufanya kazi katika soko lisilo na bid za kuuzia.

515a1c2db408.en: Correct — a bank run is a confidence problem, not necessarily a wrongdoing problem. The bank can be doing exactly what it always does and still run out if enough people show up at once.
515a1c2db408.sw: Sahihi — kukimbilia benki ni tatizo la imani, si lazima liwe tatizo la kosa. Benki inaweza kuwa inafanya hasa inavyofanya daima na bado ikaishiwa kama watu wa kutosha watafika kwa wakati mmoja.

5164a603d506.en: A written set of rules covering what you trade, the conditions for entering, where the stop and target go, how position size is calculated, the maximum you will risk, and how you review results. Its purpose is to move decisions out of the emotional moment and into calm preparation.
5164a603d506.sw: Seti ya kanuni zilizoandikwa zinazohusu unachofanyia biashara, masharti ya kuingia, mahali stop na lengo huenda, jinsi ukubwa wa nafasi unavyokokotolewa, kiwango cha juu utakachohatarisha, na jinsi unavyopitia matokeo. Kusudi lake ni kuhamisha maamuzi kutoka kwenye wakati wa kihisia hadi kwenye maandalizi ya utulivu.

5171f87c8a41.en: Not quite — the stop fills deep in the plunge, locking in a real loss, and a later recovery cannot undo an exit that already executed.
5171f87c8a41.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — stop hutimizwa ndani kabisa ya kuporomoka, ikihifadhi hasara halisi, na kupona baadaye hakuwezi kubatilisha kutoka kulikotekelezwa tayari.

519ffdaf13d4.en: Keep that distinction in view. "The company is fine" and "the shares are fine" are different statements, and Chapter 5 has case studies where they came apart badly.
519ffdaf13d4.sw: Weka tofauti hiyo mtazamoni. "Kampuni iko sawa" na "hisa ziko sawa" ni kauli tofauti, na Sura ya 5 ina uchunguzi wa matukio ambapo zilitengana vibaya.

51efa1d792a5.en: The price of one currency expressed in terms of another. It tells you how much of one currency you'd get for one unit of the other.
51efa1d792a5.sw: Bei ya sarafu moja iliyoelezwa kwa sarafu nyingine. Inakuambia utapata kiasi gani cha sarafu moja kwa kipimo kimoja cha nyingine.

51f95f5641b3.en: Because the tracking difference measures the total shortfall against the index, and a fund with a slightly higher fee can deliver more of the index
51f95f5641b3.sw: Kwa sababu tofauti ya kufuatilia hupima upungufu wa jumla dhidi ya index, na fund yenye ada kubwa kidogo inaweza kutoa sehemu kubwa zaidi ya index

51fc47a1f7f8.en: Correct — (0.60 times 80) minus (0.40 times 150) = 48 minus 60 = minus 12 dollars. A high win rate does not save a system whose losses are much larger than its wins.
51fc47a1f7f8.sw: Sahihi — (0.60 mara 80) toa (0.40 mara 150) = 48 toa 60 = toa dola 12. Kiwango kikubwa cha ushindi hakiokoi mfumo ambao hasara zake ni kubwa mno kuliko ushindi wake.

520eed9b82f0.en: Support and resistance are not hard physical barriers — they're levels where enough traders have historically reacted that the reaction becomes somewhat self-reinforcing.
520eed9b82f0.sw: Msaada na upinzani si vizuizi vigumu vya kimwili — ni viwango ambapo wafanyabiashara wa kutosha wamekuwa wakiitikia kihistoria kiasi kwamba mwitikio huo unakuwa wa kujiimarisha wenyewe kwa kiasi fulani.

52be2c6ff44e.en: Correct — there's a genuine, historically rooted pecking order (EUR > GBP > AUD/NZD > USD > CAD/CHF/JPY, roughly) that determines the conventional order for major pairs — it's market history, not arbitrary choice.
52be2c6ff44e.sw: Sahihi — kuna daraja halisi lenye mizizi ya kihistoria (EUR > GBP > AUD/NZD > USD > CAD/CHF/JPY, kwa ujumla) linaloamua mpangilio wa kawaida wa jozi kuu — ni historia ya soko, si chaguo la bahati nasibu.

52e26ef2fa47.en: Not quite — a broker delivers the same exposure to exchange rate movement without any travel or physical cash, which is why retail forex exists.
52e26ef2fa47.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — broker hutoa uwazi ule ule kwa msogeo wa kiwango cha ubadilishaji bila safari wala fedha taslimu za kimwili, ndiyo maana forex ya rejareja ipo.

52e9f4e1a498.en: Choose any listed company and open its last three annual reports. Write down six numbers: profit and operating cash flow for each year. Then write one sentence saying whether they moved together. That comparison, done honestly, filters out more bad holdings than any valuation ratio you will learn next lesson.
52e9f4e1a498.sw: Chagua kampuni yoyote iliyoorodheshwa na ufungue ripoti zake tatu za mwisho za mwaka. Andika namba sita: faida na mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli kwa kila mwaka. Kisha andika sentensi moja ikisema kama zilisogea pamoja. Ulinganisho huo, ukifanywa kwa uaminifu, huchuja umiliki mbaya zaidi kuliko uwiano wowote wa uthaminishaji utakaojifunza somo lijalo.

53123c299541.en: The Swiss franc shock taught that a stop-loss may not fill at its level. The sterling flash crash sharpens the point: even without any fundamental reason, the market itself can move against you faster than any exit can keep up — and then move back, having taken out your position on the way.
53123c299541.sw: Mshtuko wa faranga ya Uswisi ulifundisha kwamba stop-loss inaweza isitimizwe kwenye kiwango chake. Anguko la ghafla la pauni hunoa pointi: hata bila sababu yoyote ya msingi, soko lenyewe linaweza kusogea dhidi yako kwa kasi zaidi kuliko kutoka kokote kunavyoweza kuendana — kisha likasogea tena, likiwa limeondoa nafasi yako njiani.

5318b80b2653.en: They show the same open/high/low/close data, but candlesticks add a colored body for faster visual reading
5318b80b2653.sw: Huonyesha data ile ile ya kufungua/juu/chini/kufunga, lakini mishumaa huongeza mwili wenye rangi kwa usomaji wa haraka wa kuona

533279a4daa4.en: Diagram of EUR/CHF holding the 1.20 floor from 2011 until it collapsed about 30 percent to roughly 0.85 on 15 January 2015, the fallout (FXCM's 225 million dollars of client negative balances and 300 million dollar bailout, Alpari UK insolvency, Everest Capital's roughly 1 billion dollar loss), and the survival lesson that small position size and low leverage were what mattered
533279a4daa4.sw: Mchoro wa EUR/CHF ikishikilia sakafu ya 1.20 kutoka 2011 hadi ilipoanguka takriban asilimia 30 hadi karibu 0.85 tarehe 15 Januari 2015, matokeo (salio hasi la wateja la FXCM la dola milioni 225 na uokoaji wa dola milioni 300, kufilisika kwa Alpari UK, hasara ya Everest Capital ya takriban dola bilioni 1), na fundisho la kunusurika kwamba ukubwa mdogo wa nafasi na leverage ndogo ndivyo vilivyohusika

539a5fa633a0.en: When you scan the pillars and the regime and nothing lines up — valuation neutral, no catalyst, momentum flat, positioning unremarkable — the professional answer is not to lower the bar until something qualifies. It is to hold cash and wait.
539a5fa633a0.sw: Unapotazama nguzo na hali na hakuna kinacholingana — uthaminishaji wa kati, hakuna kichocheo, kasi tuli, nafasi za soko za kawaida — jibu la kitaaluma si kushusha kizingiti hadi kitu kistahili. Ni kushikilia fedha taslimu na kusubiri.

53aa2f3796e7.en: They triggered but filled far from their level, because liquidity vanished and there were no buyers nearby
53aa2f3796e7.sw: Yalianzishwa lakini yakatimizwa mbali na kiwango chao, kwa sababu ukwasi ulitoweka na hakukuwa na wanunuzi karibu

53b81951ed3f.en: Valuation — is the currency cheap or expensive versus a sensible measure of fair value? A cheap currency with a reason to rise is a very different trade from an expensive one.
53b81951ed3f.sw: Uthaminishaji — je, sarafu ni rahisi au ghali ikilinganishwa na kipimo chenye busara cha thamani halali? Sarafu rahisi yenye sababu ya kupanda ni biashara tofauti sana na ile ghali.

53f0cbaeb975.en: This is the lived version of the fat tails you met in Chapter 2, Lesson 2, and Mandelbrot's 1963 finding. A standard bell curve model would have called a move this size an event of once in many thousands of years. It happened on an ordinary Thursday. Markets produce extreme moves far more often than tidy models predict — and forex, with its leverage, punishes that fact hardest.
53f0cbaeb975.sw: Hili ndilo toleo la kuishi la mikia minene uliyokutana nayo katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 2, na tokeo la Mandelbrot la mwaka 1963. Muundo sanifu wa mkunjo wa kengele ungeuita msogeo wa ukubwa huu tukio la mara moja katika maelfu mengi ya miaka. Ulitokea Alhamisi ya kawaida. Masoko huzalisha misogeo ya kupindukia mara nyingi zaidi mno kuliko miundo safi inavyotabiri — na forex, kwa leverage yake, huadhibu ukweli huo kwa ukali zaidi.

542ce8081ec4.en: A share trades at 40.00 and pays a 1.00 dividend. On the ex-dividend date it opens at roughly 39.00. A holder who owned it through that date now has a share worth 39.00 and 1.00 in cash — the same 40.00 they had the day before. Nothing was created.
542ce8081ec4.sw: Hisa hufanyiwa biashara kwa 40.00 na hulipa gawio la 1.00. Katika tarehe ya bila-gawio hufunguliwa kwa takriban 39.00. Aliyeishikilia hadi tarehe hiyo sasa ana hisa yenye thamani ya 39.00 na 1.00 ya fedha taslimu — 40.00 ile ile aliyokuwa nayo siku iliyotangulia. Hakuna kilichoundwa.

544d35710977.en: Here's where this course's habit of checking the textbook against real evidence pays off. The clean "higher rates → stronger currency" story runs into one of the most famous anomalies in all of financial economics.
544d35710977.sw: Hapa ndipo tabia ya kozi hii ya kukagua kitabu dhidi ya ushahidi halisi inalipa. Simulizi safi ya "viwango vya juu → sarafu imara zaidi" hukumbana na mojawapo ya matukio yasiyo ya kawaida maarufu zaidi katika uchumi wote wa kifedha.

54636b0ff8d9.en: Diversification isn't about quantity — owning twenty things isn't automatically safer than owning five. It's about relationship.
54636b0ff8d9.sw: Kusambaza uwekezaji si suala la wingi — kumiliki vitu ishirini si salama zaidi kiotomatiki kuliko kumiliki vitano. Ni suala la uhusiano.

54b5ac1606a7.en: Correct — a higher true pip value than the one you sized with means each pip costs more than you assumed, so the same lot size risks more: 127 dollars instead of 100.
54b5ac1606a7.sw: Sahihi — thamani halisi ya pip iliyo juu kuliko ile uliyopima nayo inamaanisha kila pip inagharimu zaidi ya ulivyodhania, hivyo ukubwa ule ule wa lot huhatarisha zaidi: dola 127 badala ya 100.

54e98e29b551.en: Two accounts hold the exact same 50,000 dollar position at the same 50:1 broker leverage — one with 2,000 dollars of equity, one with 10,000 dollars. Which faces a margin call after a much smaller move against it?
54e98e29b551.sw: Akaunti mbili zinashikilia nafasi ile ile hasa ya dola 50,000 kwa leverage ile ile ya broker ya 50:1 — moja yenye usawa wa dola 2,000, nyingine yenye dola 10,000. Ni ipi inayokabiliwa na wito wa margin baada ya msogeo mdogo zaidi dhidi yake?

54fd97e818d6.en: Chapter 1, Lesson 5 gave you the position-sizing formula, and it used a simple figure: on a standard lot, one pip is worth about 10 dollars. That lesson was careful to label it — "USD-quoted pairs" — because it is not the whole story. This lesson tells the whole story.
54fd97e818d6.sw: Sura ya 1, Somo la 5 lilikupa fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi, na lilitumia takwimu rahisi: kwenye lot sanifu, pip moja ina thamani ya takriban dola 10. Somo hilo lilikuwa makini kuiweka lebo — "jozi zinazonukuliwa kwa USD" — kwa sababu si simulizi nzima. Somo hili linaeleza simulizi nzima.

55238935210e.en: A currency strengthening (buying more) or weakening (buying less) relative to another.
55238935210e.sw: Sarafu kuimarika (kununua zaidi) au kudhoofika (kununua kidogo) ikilinganishwa na nyingine.

55b7c5bbfc11.en: The exact percentages are set by each broker, not by law — 100% and 50% are common, but yours may differ. Find your broker's real margin call and stop-out levels before you trade, not during your first losing position.
55b7c5bbfc11.sw: Asilimia kamili huwekwa na kila broker, si kwa sheria — 100% na 50% ni za kawaida, lakini zako zinaweza kutofautiana. Pata viwango halisi vya wito wa margin na stop-out vya broker wako kabla ya kufanya biashara, si wakati wa nafasi yako ya kwanza ya hasara.

55c7869a85bb.en: If EUR/USD moves from 1.0800 to 1.0815, that's a 15-pip move.
55c7869a85bb.sw: Kama EUR/USD itasogea kutoka 1.0800 hadi 1.0815, huo ni msogeo wa pip 15.

55ed41c2cb8e.en: It always balances, because of an identity rather than a coincidence. Everything the company owns was funded either by borrowing or by owners. Assets equal liabilities plus equity — and that equity line is the residual claim from Lesson 1, in accounting form.
55ed41c2cb8e.sw: Daima hulingana, kwa sababu ya utambulisho badala ya sadfa. Kila kitu kampuni inachomiliki kilifadhiliwa ama kwa kukopa au na wamiliki. Mali ni sawa na madeni pamoja na usawa — na mstari huo wa usawa ni dai la mabaki kutoka Somo la 1, katika umbo la kihasibu.

56007f6c1632.en: Take these into any carry-like position: Be suspicious of any strategy that looks like steady, easy income — ask what rare event it is quietly exposed to, and how bad that event would be. Remember that a carry position's real risk is not the daily wiggle but the sudden, correlated unwind, which arrives fastest in a crisis. Notice crowding: if everyone is in the same trade for the same reason, the exit is narrow and the reversal is violent. And size for the crash, not the calm — the quiet years are not the ones that decide whether you survive.
56007f6c1632.sw: Chukua haya katika nafasi yoyote inayofanana na carry: Kuwa na shaka na mkakati wowote unaoonekana kama mapato thabiti na rahisi — uliza ni tukio gani nadra ambalo umefunuliwa nalo kimyakimya, na tukio hilo lingekuwa baya kiasi gani. Kumbuka kwamba hatari halisi ya nafasi ya carry si mtikisiko wa kila siku bali kuvunjika kwa ghafla kwenye uwiano, kunakofika kwa kasi zaidi katika janga. Tambua msongamano: kama kila mtu yuko katika biashara ile ile kwa sababu ile ile, mlango wa kutoka ni mwembamba na mgeuko ni mkali. Na pima kwa anguko, si kwa utulivu — miaka ya kimya si ndiyo inayoamua kama utanusurika.

5604ac7a9f23.en: For over three years, the Swiss National Bank held a floor under EUR/CHF, promising to defend a minimum of 1.20 francs per euro "with the utmost determination" — a cap it set in September 2011 to stop the franc strengthening too far. Traders came to treat that floor as almost a law of nature: you could not lose much buying EUR/CHF near 1.20, because the central bank guaranteed it would not fall below.
5604ac7a9f23.sw: Kwa zaidi ya miaka mitatu, Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilishikilia sakafu chini ya EUR/CHF, ikiahidi kutetea kiwango cha chini cha faranga 1.20 kwa euro "kwa uamuzi wa hali ya juu" — kikomo ilichokiweka Septemba 2011 kuzuia faranga kuimarika mno. Wafanyabiashara walikuja kuichukulia sakafu hiyo karibu kama sheria ya asili: usingeweza kupoteza sana kununua EUR/CHF karibu na 1.20, kwa sababu benki kuu ilihakikisha haitashuka chini yake.

560e596b4050.en: Not quite. Different voting rights do not usually mean a different claim on profits, and they place no restriction on selling. What changes is who controls the company — which means the vote is not your protection, and the position stands or falls on the business itself.
560e596b4050.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Haki tofauti za kupiga kura kwa kawaida hazimaanishi dai tofauti juu ya faida, na haziweki kizuizi chochote juu ya kuuza. Kinachobadilika ni nani anayedhibiti kampuni — ambako kunamaanisha kura si ulinzi wako, na nafasi husimama au huanguka juu ya biashara yenyewe.

566c1095f7f7.sw: Kutumia ukubwa wa juu zaidi wa nafasi

5679826d6a02.en: Higher rates are supposed to pull in foreign demand and lift a currency — the clean chain the evidence then complicates.
5679826d6a02.sw: Viwango vya juu vinapaswa kuvuta mahitaji ya kigeni na kuinua sarafu — mnyororo safi ambao ushahidi kisha huutatiza.

56afc611a1a8.en: No stop, or a moving stop. Trading without a stop-loss, or widening it when price approaches to avoid being closed. Fixed by placing the stop at the invalidation level as an order before entry, and never widening it (Chapter 1, Lesson 7; Chapter 3, Lesson 3).
56afc611a1a8.sw: Hakuna stop, au stop inayosogea. Kufanya biashara bila stop-loss, au kuipanua bei inapokaribia ili kuepuka kufungwa. Hurekebishwa kwa kuweka stop kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika kama agizo kabla ya kuingia, na kutoipanua kamwe (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7; Sura ya 3, Somo la 3).

56f8f1bc41da.en: A convention for selecting complementary timeframes: choose your medium-term chart first (it should reflect your typical holding period), then set the long-term at roughly four times that interval, and the short-term at roughly a quarter of it.
56f8f1bc41da.sw: Desturi ya kuchagua vipindi vinavyokamilishana: chagua chati yako ya muda wa kati kwanza (inapaswa kuakisi muda wako wa kawaida wa kushikilia), kisha weka muda mrefu kwa takriban mara nne ya kipindi hicho, na muda mfupi kwa takriban robo yake.

5746ca8e0a46.en: True or False: keeping a trading journal is mainly useful for tax records, not for improving as a trader.
5746ca8e0a46.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kuweka kumbukumbu ya biashara kuna manufaa hasa kwa rekodi za kodi, si kwa kuboreka kama mfanyabiashara.

575ab83ce01f.en: A company's revenue falls by 10%, and its obligations to suppliers, staff, lenders and tax are unchanged. What happens to the shareholders' claim?
575ab83ce01f.sw: Mapato ya kampuni hushuka kwa 10%, na majukumu yake kwa wasambazaji, wafanyakazi, wakopeshaji na kodi hayajabadilika. Kinatokea nini kwa dai la wanahisa?

575f9dd900a3.en: A currency whose value is fixed, or held within a narrow band, relative to another currency rather than allowed to move freely.
575f9dd900a3.sw: Sarafu ambayo thamani yake ni thabiti, au inashikiliwa ndani ya ukanda mwembamba, ikilinganishwa na sarafu nyingine badala ya kuruhusiwa kusogea kwa uhuru.

57966b40b3bf.en: Support and resistance. You met these in Foundations Chapter 3, Lesson 1: support is a level where falling prices have repeatedly reversed upward, and resistance is a level where rising prices have repeatedly reversed downward. On a naked chart these levels are the primary map. A price-action trader marks them and watches how price behaves as it approaches.
57966b40b3bf.sw: Msaada na upinzani. Ulikutana navyo katika Msingi Sura ya 3, Somo la 1: msaada ni kiwango ambapo bei zinazoshuka zimegeuka kupanda mara kwa mara, na upinzani ni kiwango ambapo bei zinazopanda zimegeuka kushuka mara kwa mara. Kwenye chati tupu viwango hivi ni ramani kuu. Mfanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei huviweka alama na kutazama jinsi bei inavyotenda inapovikaribia.

57ad9c780ef4.en: Nobody — surplus cash returns to the government
57ad9c780ef4.sw: Hakuna — fedha za ziada hurudi serikalini

58749272abac.en: USD/CAD = 1.35 means the U.S. dollar is the base currency, the Canadian dollar is the quote currency, and one U.S. dollar costs 1.35 Canadian dollars.
58749272abac.sw: USD/CAD = 1.35 inamaanisha dola ya Marekani ni sarafu ya msingi, dola ya Kanada ni sarafu ya bei, na dola moja ya Marekani inagharimu dola 1.35 za Kanada.

588e7400ba3a.en: A general, sustained rise in prices that reduces what a currency can buy.
588e7400ba3a.sw: Kupanda kwa jumla na kwa kudumu kwa bei kunakopunguza kile ambacho sarafu inaweza kununua.

58be6d62785a.en: Short-term trading in shares is much closer to the roulette wheel than to ownership. Over a holding period of minutes or days, the businesses underneath have produced almost nothing. Nearly all of what you gain in that window comes from another trader, minus costs — so the activity is close to zero-sum before fees and negative-sum after them. The asset being productive does not make every activity involving it productive.
58be6d62785a.sw: Biashara ya muda mfupi ya hisa iko karibu zaidi na gurudumu la roulette kuliko na umiliki. Katika kipindi cha kushikilia cha dakika au siku, biashara zilizo chini zimezalisha karibu chochote. Karibu kila unachopata katika dirisha hilo hutoka kwa mfanyabiashara mwingine, kutoa gharama — hivyo shughuli iko karibu jumla-sifuri kabla ya ada na jumla-hasi baada yake. Mali kuwa yenye tija hakufanyi kila shughuli inayoihusisha kuwa yenye tija.

59d88f0fa026.en: The reason it matters is precise. The sizing formula turns your account size, your risk percentage, and your stop-loss into an exact position. Every input has to be exact for the output to be exact. Pip value is the one input that quietly changes from pair to pair, and getting it wrong is the most common way a carefully planned "one percent risk" turns into something else entirely.

Kila pembejeo lazima iwe kamili ili tokeo liwe kamili. Thamani ya pip ndiyo pembejeo moja inayobadilika kimyakimya kutoka jozi hadi jozi, na kuikosea ndiyo njia ya kawaida zaidi ambayo "hatari ya asilimia moja" iliyopangwa kwa makini hugeuka kuwa kitu tofauti kabisa.

59f3a90f0bc9.en: Correct — widely repeated statistics often trace back to one non-peer-reviewed original source, just copied and re-copied. Repetition is not independent verification.

5a27248892e2.en: Barber, Lee, Liu and Odean studied the complete transaction records of the Taiwan Stock Exchange. In a typical six-month period, more than 80% of day traders lost money after costs. In the follow-up work published in the Review of Asset Pricing Studies (2020, volume 10, issue 1, pages 61 to 93), they found that profitable and unprofitable traders were almost equally likely to keep trading the following year — roughly 96% against 95%. Losing money did not, in practice, stop people.
5a27248892e2.sw: Barber, Lee, Liu na Odean walisoma rekodi kamili za miamala za Soko la Hisa la Taiwan. Katika kipindi cha kawaida cha miezi sita, zaidi ya 80% ya wafanyabiashara wa siku walipoteza pesa baada ya gharama. Katika kazi iliyofuata iliyochapishwa katika Review of Asset Pricing Studies (2020, juzuu 10, toleo 1, kurasa 61 hadi 93), waligundua kwamba wafanyabiashara wenye faida na wasio na faida walikuwa na uwezekano karibu sawa wa kuendelea kufanya biashara mwaka uliofuata — takriban 96% dhidi ya 95%. Kupoteza pesa hakukuwazuia watu kivitendo.

5b91f4e58995.en: Owning shares in productive businesses is positive-sum. The companies employ people, sell things, and generate cash. That cash accrues to the residual claim you learned about in Lesson 1. If every shareholder in the world held their shares and did nothing, they could still collectively be better off in ten years, because the businesses underneath produced something.
5b91f4e58995.sw: Kumiliki hisa katika biashara zenye tija ni jumla-chanya. Kampuni huajiri watu, huuza vitu, na huzalisha fedha. Fedha hizo hujilimbikizia kwenye dai la mabaki ulilojifunza katika Somo la 1. Kama kila mwanahisa duniani angeshikilia hisa zake na kutofanya chochote, bado wangeweza kwa pamoja kuwa bora zaidi baada ya miaka kumi, kwa sababu biashara zilizo chini yake zilizalisha kitu.

5c7d24277af5.en: Before entering a thesis-driven trade, confirm: Can you state, in one sentence, exactly what would prove this trade wrong — and is your stop at that level rather than an arbitrary distance? Does the trade clear your reward-to-risk minimum from a real target, or are you shrinking the target to make the number work? Have you actually run the pre-mortem — imagined the loss and listed the reasons — or only glanced at the risks? And is the entire exit, including the conditions that kill the thesis, written down before you enter?
5c7d24277af5.sw: Kabla ya kuingia katika biashara inayoendeshwa na nadharia, thibitisha: Je, unaweza kutamka, kwa sentensi moja, ni nini hasa kingethibitisha biashara hii kuwa batili — na je, stop yako iko kwenye kiwango hicho badala ya umbali wa bahati nasibu? Je, biashara inapita kiwango chako cha chini cha tuzo-kwa-hatari kutoka lengo halisi, au unapunguza lengo ili namba ifanye kazi? Je, umefanya pre-mortem hasa — umefikiria hasara na kuorodhesha sababu — au umeangalia tu hatari kwa haraka? Na je, kutoka kote, ikiwemo hali zinazoua nadharia, kumeandikwa kabla hujaingia?

5cade5eb4106.en: Finally, remember what no chart-reading skill can do. When the Swiss National Bank abandoned its currency floor in 2015 (Chapter 1, Lesson 7), EUR/CHF gapped straight through every support level on every chart, and no candlestick warned anyone. Price action reads the normal market well at its best; it offers no protection against the fat-tailed jumps that do the most damage. That is why risk management, not chart-reading, remains the thing that keeps you in the game.
5cade5eb4106.sw: Hatimaye, kumbuka kile ambacho hakuna ustadi wa kusoma chati unaoweza kufanya. Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilipoacha sakafu yake ya sarafu mwaka 2015 (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7), EUR/CHF iliruka moja kwa moja kupitia kila kiwango cha msaada kwenye kila chati, na hakuna mshumaa uliomwonya mtu yeyote. Shughuli ya bei husoma soko la kawaida vizuri ikiwa katika hali yake bora; haitoi ulinzi wowote dhidi ya miruko ya mikia minene inayofanya madhara makubwa zaidi. Ndiyo sababu usimamizi wa hatari, si kusoma chati, unabaki kitu kinachokuweka mchezoni.

5dc4c37ed99e.en: You have a high-conviction short on a currency: fundamentals, valuation, and a rate-decision catalyst all agree. Pre-mortem: it is three weeks later and the trade lost. Why? Perhaps the central bank surprised dovishly the other way; perhaps positioning was already so short that there was no one left to sell (Chapter 5, Lesson 2); perhaps a risk-off shock sent money into the currency as a safe haven; perhaps the move happened in an illiquid session and your stop filled far away (Chapter 5, Lesson 3). Each reason you surface becomes something you plan for now — a wider or differently placed stop, a smaller size, a decision to wait past the event, or a reason not to take the trade at all.
5dc4c37ed99e.sw: Una short ya uhakika wa juu kwenye sarafu: misingi, uthaminishaji, na kichocheo cha uamuzi wa kiwango vyote vinakubaliana. Pre-mortem: ni wiki tatu baadaye na biashara ilipoteza. Kwa nini? Labda benki kuu ilishangaza kwa dovish upande mwingine; labda nafasi za soko tayari zilikuwa short mno kiasi kwamba hakukuwa na aliyebaki kuuza (Sura ya 5, Somo la 2); labda mshtuko wa kukwepa hatari ulipeleka pesa kwenye sarafu kama kimbilio salama; labda msogeo ulitokea katika kipindi kisicho na ukwasi na stop yako ikatimizwa mbali (Sura ya 5, Somo la 3). Kila sababu unayoifichua hukuwa kitu unachokipangia sasa — stop pana au iliyowekwa tofauti, ukubwa mdogo, uamuzi wa kusubiri baada ya tukio, au sababu ya kutochukua biashara kabisa.

5e6b5f29634a.en: Sullivan, Timmermann & White (1999), published in The Journal of Finance, examined the data-snooping problem directly: they took a huge universe of technical trading rules and tested them against 100 years of daily Dow Jones data. The best-performing rule genuinely did beat the benchmark over the original sample period, even after statistically accounting for data-snooping. But when they applied that same best rule to the following ten years of out-of-sample data, it failed to outperform. The rule hadn't found a durable truth about markets — it had found a pattern that fit the data it was selected on.
5e6b5f29634a.sw: Sullivan, Timmermann & White (1999), waliochapisha katika The Journal of Finance, walichunguza tatizo la kupekua data moja kwa moja: walichukua ulimwengu mkubwa wa kanuni za biashara za kiufundi na kuzijaribu dhidi ya miaka 100 ya data ya kila siku ya Dow Jones. Kanuni iliyofanya vizuri zaidi kweli iliushinda mchezo wa kigezo katika kipindi asilia cha sampuli, hata baada ya kuzingatia kitakwimu kupekua data. Lakini walipoitumia kanuni ile ile bora kwa miaka kumi iliyofuata ya data ya nje ya sampuli, ilishindwa kufanya vizuri zaidi. Kanuni haikuwa imepata ukweli wa kudumu kuhusu masoko — ilikuwa imepata mtindo uliolingana na data iliyochaguliwa juu yake.

Ukweli huo nne hubadilisha maana ya namba zaidi kuliko namba yenyewe inavyofanya.

617b735c7afb.en: On a 4-hour NZD/USD chart with a 20 and 50 SMA: the 20 crosses below the 50 → enter short. Price falls; the 20 eventually crosses back above → close the short at a profit, and optionally go long. But the very next long gets stopped almost immediately when a large red candle drags the 20 back below the 50 — a small, quick loss. Then another short signal, another profitable leg. This sequence — several winning trades punctuated by small whipsaw losses — is what crossover trading actually looks like.
617b735c7afb.sw: Kwenye chati ya NZD/USD ya saa 4 yenye SMA ya 20 na 50: 20 inakatiza chini ya 50 → ingia short. Bei inashuka; 20 hatimaye inakatiza tena juu → funga short kwa faida, na kwa hiari nenda long. Lakini long ile inayofuata kabisa inasimamishwa karibu mara moja mshumaa mkubwa mwekundu unapovuta 20 kurudi chini ya 50 — hasara ndogo ya haraka. Kisha ishara nyingine ya short, mguu mwingine wenye faida. Mfululizo huu — biashara kadhaa za ushindi zikiingiliwa na hasara ndogo za whipsaw — ndivyo biashara ya mkatizo inavyoonekana hasa.

61af2f558996.en: Not quite — $5,000 × 2% = $100 risk. $100 ÷ 40 pips = $2.50 per pip needed, and $2.50 ÷ $10 = 0.25 standard lots.
61af2f558996.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — $5,000 × 2% = hatari ya $100. $100 ÷ pip 40 = $2.50 kwa kila pip inayohitajika, na $2.50 ÷ $10 = lot 0.25 sanifu.

61f674d84324.en: Following a pre-committed plan regardless of feeling — a system, not a personality trait.
61f674d84324.sw: Kufuata mpango uliojitolewa mapema bila kujali hisia — mfumo, si sifa ya tabia.

6200354a8c88.en: Decades of evidence show UIP fails badly over short horizons — and fails in the opposite direction to what it predicts. Rather than depreciating, high-interest-rate currencies have historically tended to keep appreciating in the short run. Economist Eugene Fama documented this in 1984, and it's been known ever since as the "forward premium puzzle" (or "Fama puzzle") — described in the literature as one of the most robust empirical regularities in international finance. In plain terms: the simple story isn't just imperfect, the real world has often done the reverse of what the clean theory predicts.
6200354a8c88.sw: Miongo ya ushahidi inaonyesha UIP hushindwa vibaya katika vipindi vifupi — na hushindwa kwa mwelekeo wa kinyume na inavyotabiri. Badala ya kudhoofika, sarafu za viwango vya juu vya riba zimeelekea kihistoria kuendelea kuimarika kwa muda mfupi. Mwanauchumi Eugene Fama aliliandika hili mwaka 1984, na limejulikana tangu wakati huo kama "fumbo la malipo ya mbele" (au "fumbo la Fama") — likielezwa katika fasihi kama mojawapo ya utaratibu imara zaidi wa kimajaribio katika fedha za kimataifa. Kwa lugha rahisi: simulizi rahisi si tu isiyo kamili, dunia halisi mara nyingi imefanya kinyume cha kile nadharia safi inavyotabiri.

620c1e2dd77d.en: Because high-yield shares cannot be held in funds
620c1e2dd77d.sw: Kwa sababu hisa zenye mavuno makubwa haziwezi kushikiliwa katika fund

62c8e175841b.en: A share is quoted with a bid of 40.90 and an ask of 41.10. You buy with a market order and sell again a minute later with another market order, and the book has not moved. What is the result?
62c8e175841b.sw: Hisa imenukuliwa ikiwa na bid ya 40.90 na ask ya 41.10. Unanunua kwa agizo la soko na kuuza tena dakika moja baadaye kwa agizo lingine la soko, na kitabu hakijasogea. Tokeo ni lipi?

62dcca27f54e.en: You will see the figure "90% of day traders lose money" repeated constantly, usually with no source attached. The carefully measured number from complete exchange records is "more than 80% in a typical six-month period" — which is a different and more precise claim. When a striking statistic circulates without a traceable source, treat the statistic itself as the thing to check first. That habit is worth more than the number.
62dcca27f54e.sw: Utaona takwimu "90% ya wafanyabiashara wa siku hupoteza pesa" ikirudiwa kila mara, kwa kawaida bila chanzo. Namba iliyopimwa kwa makini kutoka rekodi kamili za soko ni "zaidi ya 80% katika kipindi cha kawaida cha miezi sita" — ambalo ni dai tofauti na sahihi zaidi. Takwimu ya kushtua inaposambaa bila chanzo kinachoweza kufuatiliwa, chukulia takwimu yenyewe kama kitu cha kukagua kwanza. Tabia hiyo ina thamani zaidi ya namba.

62ef8ddfb590.en: The possibility that an action or decision doesn't go the way you intended, exposing you to a loss or a bad outcome.
62ef8ddfb590.sw: Uwezekano kwamba kitendo au uamuzi hauendi jinsi ulivyokusudia, ukikuweka wazi kwa hasara au matokeo mabaya.

62f91ef1ef76.en: This ordering isn't based on economic size or trading volume — it's rooted in history. The British pound "sat on top" of the hierarchy because sterling was the world's dominant reserve currency before the U.S. dollar took over that role. When euro trading launched on January 4, 1999, brokers initially supported both EUR/GBP and GBP/EUR quote conventions and let the market decide — EUR/GBP won out almost immediately, with the euro effectively inheriting the German mark's position in the pecking order. The convention persists today for reasons of market habit and consistency, not because it's the only logical way to write it.
62f91ef1ef76.sw: Mpangilio huu haujengwi juu ya ukubwa wa kiuchumi wala kiasi cha biashara — una mizizi katika historia. Pauni ya Uingereza "ilikaa juu" ya daraja kwa sababu sterling ilikuwa sarafu kuu ya akiba duniani kabla dola ya Marekani haijachukua nafasi hiyo. Biashara ya euro ilipoanza tarehe 4 Januari 1999, mabroker awali waliunga mkono makubaliano yote mawili ya nukuu ya EUR/GBP na GBP/EUR na kuliacha soko liamue — EUR/GBP ilishinda karibu mara moja, euro ikirithi kwa hakika nafasi ya alama ya Ujerumani katika daraja. Makubaliano yanaendelea leo kwa sababu za mazoea ya soko na uthabiti, si kwa sababu ndiyo njia pekee ya kimantiki ya kuiandika.

6308f4cb101a.en: The mechanics were simple. Borrow (or sell) the low-yielding yen, and buy a high-yielding currency like the Australian dollar, whose central bank paid far more. AUD/JPY became the classic expression of the trade.
6308f4cb101a.sw: Utaratibu ulikuwa rahisi. Kopa (au uza) yen yenye mavuno madogo, na ununue sarafu yenye mavuno makubwa kama dola ya Australia, ambayo benki kuu yake ililipa zaidi mno. AUD/JPY likawa usemi wa kawaida wa biashara hiyo.

6326026b1e16.en: Not quite — the stops did trigger, but a triggered stop fills at the available price, and liquidity had vanished, so they filled far from their level.
6326026b1e16.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — stop zilianzishwa kweli, lakini stop iliyoanzishwa hutimizwa kwa bei inayopatikana, na ukwasi ulikuwa umetoweka, hivyo zilitimizwa mbali na kiwango chao.

633c4529ea45.en: Compensation for bearing a rare but severe crash risk
633c4529ea45.sw: Fidia kwa kubeba hatari nadra lakini kali ya kuanguka

6342ac30b84a.en: The balancing act, echoing Foundations Chapter 2's inflation lesson: raise rates to cool an overheating economy and fight inflation; lower rates to encourage borrowing and spending when growth stalls. Too fast, and inflation erodes the currency; too slow, and unemployment rises.
6342ac30b84a.sw: Tendo la kusawazisha, likiakisi somo la mfumuko wa bei la Sura ya 2 ya Msingi: pandisha viwango kupoza uchumi unaozidi joto na kupambana na mfumuko wa bei; shusha viwango kuhamasisha kukopa na kutumia ukuaji unaposimama. Kwa kasi mno, na mfumuko wa bei humomonyoa sarafu; kwa polepole mno, na ukosefu wa ajira hupanda.

638aa94a8255.en: You open the $50,000 position above with $1,000 margin, on a $5,000 account. The other $4,000 is "free margin," available to absorb losses. If the trade moves against you enough to erode that cushion, your broker will issue a margin call — and if you don't add funds, they'll start closing your positions automatically to protect themselves from your account going negative.
638aa94a8255.sw: Unafungua nafasi ile ya $50,000 hapo juu kwa margin ya $1,000, kwenye akaunti ya $5,000. Ile $4,000 nyingine ni "margin huru," inayopatikana kufyonza hasara. Kama biashara itasogea dhidi yako vya kutosha kumomonyoa mto huo, broker wako atatoa wito wa margin — na kama hutaongeza fedha, wataanza kufunga nafasi zako kiotomatiki ili kujilinda dhidi ya akaunti yako kuwa hasi.

63a4f9afed68.en: Correct — you may exit if the thesis breaks, but never move the stop or target just because price is uncomfortable; that undoes the reward-to-risk and the discipline the plan was built on.
63a4f9afed68.sw: Sahihi — unaweza kutoka kama nadharia itavunjika, lakini kamwe usisogeze stop au lengo kwa sababu tu bei haistarehe; hilo huvunja tuzo-kwa-hatari na nidhamu ambayo mpango ulijengwa juu yake.

63b0d7e11dfb.en: For years it looked like free money: a steady, high return with a calm, rising chart. That appearance is exactly the trap.
63b0d7e11dfb.sw: Kwa miaka ilionekana kama pesa za bure: faida thabiti kubwa yenye chati tulivu inayopanda. Muonekano huo ndio hasa mtego.

646e2c4e1dd4.en: Everything in the next lesson — every valuation multiple — is built from these numbers. A multiple calculated on a profit figure you have not examined is a precise-looking number resting on an unexamined one.

649322405b2c.en: The highest price anyone is currently willing to pay.
649322405b2c.sw: Bei ya juu zaidi ambayo mtu yeyote yuko tayari kuilipa sasa.

64d89e42385b.en: Three growth curves for 10,000 invested over 30 years at an underlying 7 percent return, with annual fees of 0.05 percent, 0.75 percent and 1.50 percent, finishing at about 75,063, about 61,641 and about 49,840 respectively.
64d89e42385b.sw: Mikunjo mitatu ya ukuaji kwa 10,000 zilizowekezwa katika miaka 30 kwa faida ya msingi ya asilimia 7, ikiwa na ada za kila mwaka za asilimia 0.05, asilimia 0.75 na asilimia 1.50, ikimalizia kwa takriban 75,063, takriban 61,641 na takriban 49,840 mtawalia.

651d88891427.en: Correct — the academic evidence had already described exactly this pattern: steady gains punctuated by sudden correlated crashes. The 2008 unwind was that known risk arriving, not a bolt from the blue.
