653a6b8acecd.en: Correct — Risk Limitation is the technique behind a stop-loss: accepting a risk exists, but capping exactly how much it can cost you.
653a6b8acecd.sw: Sahihi — Kupunguza Hatari ndiyo mbinu iliyo nyuma ya stop-loss: kukubali kwamba hatari ipo, lakini kuweka kikomo hasa cha kiasi inachoweza kukugharimu.

653d0e8acae3.en: True or False: MACD provides fundamentally different information than a moving average crossover.
653d0e8acae3.sw: Kweli au Uongo: MACD hutoa taarifa tofauti kimsingi na mkatizo wa wastani unaosogea.

65558d309ecf.en: Not quite — USD/CNY did overtake GBP/USD, reaching 8.1% against GBP/USD's 7.6% in the 2025 BIS survey.
65558d309ecf.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — USD/CNY lililipita GBP/USD kweli, likifikia 8.1% dhidi ya 7.6% ya GBP/USD katika utafiti wa BIS wa mwaka 2025.

655dc50c3abe.en: GBP/USD is "Cable" — dating to the mid-1800s, when exchange rates between London and New York were transmitted via transatlantic telegraph cable (the first successful one completed in 1866). USD/CAD is "the Loonie" — after the loon bird on Canada's one-dollar coin, introduced in 1987. AUD/USD is "the Aussie," NZD/USD is "the Kiwi," and USD/CHF is "the Swissy" — each simply shortened from the country name.
655dc50c3abe.sw: GBP/USD ni "Cable" — likianzia katikati ya miaka ya 1800, viwango vya ubadilishaji kati ya London na New York vilipotumwa kupitia kebo ya telegrafu iliyovuka Atlantiki (ya kwanza iliyofanikiwa ilikamilika mwaka 1866). USD/CAD ni "Loonie" — kwa jina la ndege loon aliye kwenye sarafu ya dola moja ya Kanada, iliyoanzishwa mwaka 1987. AUD/USD ni "Aussie," NZD/USD ni "Kiwi," na USD/CHF ni "Swissy" — kila moja likifupishwa tu kutoka jina la nchi.

6567f9b8f693.en: You have a $10,000 account, and you've decided (per Foundations Chapter 2) to risk 1% per trade — that's $100. You're planning a trade with a 50-pip stop-loss. On a standard lot, each pip is worth $10, so you need to find the lot size where 50 pips of movement costs exactly $100. $100 ÷ 50 pips = $2 of risk per pip needed. Since a standard lot is $10 per pip, $2 ÷ $10 = 0.2 standard lots — 20,000 units, or 2 mini lots. If the trade hits your stop-loss, you lose exactly $100. Not roughly $100. Exactly $100, because you sized the position specifically to make that true.
6567f9b8f693.sw: Una akaunti ya $10,000, na umeamua (kwa mujibu wa Sura ya 2 ya Msingi) kuhatarisha 1% kwa kila biashara — hiyo ni $100. Unapanga biashara yenye stop-loss ya pip 50. Kwenye lot sanifu, kila pip ina thamani ya $10, hivyo unahitaji kupata ukubwa wa lot ambapo pip 50 za msogeo zinagharimu hasa $100. $100 ÷ pip 50 = $2 ya hatari kwa kila pip inayohitajika. Kwa kuwa lot sanifu ni $10 kwa pip, $2 ÷ $10 = lot 0.2 sanifu — vipimo 20,000, au lot 2 ndogo. Kama biashara itagonga stop-loss yako, unapoteza hasa $100. Si takriban $100. Hasa $100, kwa sababu ulipima nafasi mahususi ili kufanya hilo liwe kweli.

6579691bd263.en: The quoted price is the midpoint, and nobody is offering it. The spread is the cost of crossing.
6579691bd263.sw: Bei iliyonukuliwa ni sehemu ya kati, na hakuna anayeitoa. Spread ni gharama ya kuvuka.

6632f432ed19.en: Diagram showing Bollinger Band construction with the normal distribution, the fat-tail reality, and RSI overbought/oversold zones with the wait-for-exit entry rule
6632f432ed19.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha ujenzi wa Bollinger Band pamoja na mtawanyiko wa kawaida, uhalisia wa mkia mnene, na kanda za RSI za kununuliwa kupita kiasi/kuuzwa kupita kiasi pamoja na kanuni ya kusubiri-kutoka kabla ya kuingia

6647e064db7c.en: Foundations Chapter 2 introduced entry price, stop-loss, and take-profit as concepts. This lesson covers the actual order types that implement them.
6647e064db7c.sw: Sura ya 2 ya Msingi ilianzisha bei ya kuingia, stop-loss, na take-profit kama dhana. Somo hili linashughulikia aina halisi za maagizo zinazozitekeleza.

6657aad7eb5f.en: According to the Bank for International Settlements' 2025 Triennial Central Bank Survey — the most authoritative, comprehensive measurement of global currency trading, conducted every three years by central banks worldwide — global foreign exchange turnover reached $9.6 trillion per day in April 2025, up 28% from three years earlier. The U.S. dollar appeared on one side of 89% of all trades. EUR/USD remains the single largest currency pair by volume, though the Chinese yuan's share has been steadily rising — USD/CNY is now the third most-traded pair globally, ahead of GBP/USD.
6657aad7eb5f.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Utafiti wa Benki Kuu wa Kila Miaka Mitatu wa mwaka 2025 wa Benki ya Malipo ya Kimataifa — kipimo chenye mamlaka na kikamilifu zaidi cha biashara ya sarafu duniani, kinachofanywa kila baada ya miaka mitatu na benki kuu duniani kote — mzunguko wa biashara ya fedha za kigeni duniani ulifikia $9.6 trilioni kwa siku mwezi Aprili 2025, ukipanda 28% kutoka miaka mitatu iliyopita. Dola ya Marekani ilijitokeza upande mmoja wa 89% ya biashara zote. EUR/USD linabaki jozi kubwa zaidi la sarafu kwa kiasi, ingawa sehemu ya yuan ya China imekuwa ikipanda kwa uthabiti — USD/CNY sasa ni jozi la tatu linalofanyiwa biashara zaidi duniani, mbele ya GBP/USD.

669ed566d3c3.en: Gold's Problems and the Birth of Paper Money
669ed566d3c3.sw: Matatizo ya Dhahabu na Kuzaliwa kwa Pesa za Karatasi

66a903986c39.en: Not quite — both chart types plot identical underlying data. The difference is purely visual presentation.
66a903986c39.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — aina zote mbili za chati huchora data ile ile ya msingi. Tofauti ni ya uwasilishaji wa kuona tu.

670b2b7e7e1c.en: You buy USD/CAD near a support zone at 1.34, believing the price will rise. Your take-profit sits above your entry. Your stop-loss sits below your entry — near the support zone, where price would have real difficulty falling through if your read is correct. If price falls to your stop instead, you exit there and move on.
670b2b7e7e1c.sw: Unanunua USD/CAD karibu na eneo la msaada kwa 1.34, ukiamini bei itapanda. Take-profit yako iko juu ya kiingilio chako. Stop-loss yako iko chini ya kiingilio chako — karibu na eneo la msaada, ambapo bei ingekuwa na ugumu halisi kupenya kama usomaji wako ni sahihi. Kama bei itashuka hadi stop yako badala yake, unatoka hapo na kuendelea.

67176e779545.en: Not quite — markets trade the surprise, not the raw decision. A hike smaller than expected is effectively a dovish surprise and can weaken the currency.
67176e779545.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — masoko hufanya biashara ya mshangao, si uamuzi ghafi. Kupanda kudogo kuliko ilivyotarajiwa kwa hakika ni mshangao wa dovish na kunaweza kudhoofisha sarafu.

6788131275ff.en: Gold became the dominant choice almost everywhere it was available — scarce, durable, divisible, and easy to verify. The first standardized gold and silver coins date to the Kingdom of Lydia, around 700 B.C. But because money is defined by function and not material, gold was never the only option.
6788131275ff.sw: Dhahabu ikawa chaguo kuu karibu kila mahali ilipopatikana — adimu, ya kudumu, inayoweza kugawanywa, na rahisi kuthibitisha. Sarafu za kwanza sanifu za dhahabu na fedha zilianza katika Ufalme wa Lydia, karibu mwaka 700 K.K. Lakini kwa sababu pesa inafafanuliwa kwa kazi na si kwa dutu, dhahabu haikuwa chaguo pekee kamwe.

683b9a177879.en: Correct — margin = position size ÷ leverage ratio = $50,000 ÷ 50 = $1,000.
683b9a177879.sw: Sahihi — margin = ukubwa wa nafasi ÷ uwiano wa leverage = $50,000 ÷ 50 = $1,000.

684af3fcfab7.en: Correct — both show the same four data points per period; candlesticks just make the open/close relationship easier to scan visually.
684af3fcfab7.sw: Sahihi — zote mbili huonyesha pointi zile zile nne za data kwa kila kipindi; mishumaa hurahisisha tu kutazama uhusiano wa kufungua/kufunga.

689bda465052.en: Asness, Moskowitz and Pedersen (2013), in The Journal of Finance, studied value and momentum across eight different markets and asset classes at once and found both earn consistent return premia everywhere they looked, with a common structure — and, usefully, that value and momentum are negatively correlated, so they complement each other. Separately, Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen and Vrugt (2018), in the Journal of Financial Economics, showed that carry — long studied only in currencies — predicts returns across global bonds, equities, commodities, and more, a genuinely general phenomenon.
689bda465052.sw: Asness, Moskowitz na Pedersen (2013), katika The Journal of Finance, walisoma thamani na kasi katika masoko na madaraja nane tofauti ya mali kwa wakati mmoja na wakagundua zote mbili hupata malipo thabiti ya ziada ya faida kila mahali walipotazama, zikiwa na muundo wa pamoja — na, kwa manufaa, kwamba thamani na kasi zina uwiano hasi, hivyo hukamilishana. Kwa tofauti, Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen na Vrugt (2018), katika Journal of Financial Economics, walionyesha kwamba carry — iliyosomwa kwa muda mrefu katika sarafu tu — hutabiri faida katika hatifungani za kimataifa, hisa, bidhaa, na zaidi, jambo la jumla kweli.

689e7f87976b.en: Shows the same open/high/low/close data as a bar chart, with a colored "body" between open and close, making bullish and bearish periods obvious at a glance.
689e7f87976b.sw: Huonyesha data ile ile ya kufungua/juu/chini/kufunga kama chati ya vipau, ikiwa na "mwili" wenye rangi kati ya kufungua na kufunga, jambo linalofanya vipindi vya kupanda na vya kushuka vionekane wazi kwa mtazamo mmoja.

6915b902565f.sw: Hakuna — bei ya ETF huwekwa kwa kujitegemea na ugavi na mahitaji

6a7b93b30617.en: What to look for when you read a set of accounts. Compare profit with operating cash flow across at least three years and note whether the gap is stable or widening. Check whether free cash flow is positive after capital spending. Look at how fast receivables and inventory are growing relative to revenue. And read the notes to the accounts, which is where anything genuinely awkward is disclosed in the smallest available typeface.
6a7b93b30617.sw: Cha kutazama unaposoma seti ya hesabu. Linganisha faida na mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli katika angalau miaka mitatu na utambue kama pengo ni thabiti au linapanuka. 6b174c25d0cc.en: Not quite — think about the Bulkowski example. Repetition across blogs doesn't mean independent verification happened.
6b174c25d0cc.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — fikiria mfano wa Bulkowski. Kurudiwa katika blogu mbalimbali hakumaanishi uthibitisho huru ulifanyika.

6b74d1720df1.en: Correct. A payout ratio of 130% means the company is distributing more than it earns. The money has to come from somewhere else, and none of the available sources are permanent. The market usually anticipates the cut before it is announced.
6b74d1720df1.sw: Sahihi. Uwiano wa malipo wa 130% unamaanisha kampuni inagawa zaidi ya inayopata. Pesa lazima zitoke mahali pengine, na hakuna kati ya vyanzo vinavyopatikana ni cha kudumu. Soko kwa kawaida hutabiri kupunguzwa kabla hakujatangazwa.

6b8c269a5657.en: So "the market" depends on which index you mean. A day when a few very large companies fall and most smaller ones rise can be a down day for a cap-weighted index and an up day for an equally-weighted one covering the same companies. Neither number is lying. They are answering different questions.
6b8c269a5657.sw: Hivyo "soko" hutegemea unamaanisha index ipi. Siku ambapo kampuni chache kubwa mno hushuka na nyingi ndogo hupanda inaweza kuwa siku ya kushuka kwa index yenye uzito wa mtaji na siku ya kupanda kwa ile yenye uzito sawa inayohusu kampuni zile zile. Hakuna namba inayodanganya. Zinajibu maswali tofauti.

6bbb357cbd5e.en: A stop-loss you decide on after you're already losing money is not risk management — it's hope with a delay. The entire value of a stop-loss comes from setting it before you enter, while you're still thinking clearly.
6bbb357cbd5e.sw: Stop-loss unayoiamua baada ya tayari kuanza kupoteza pesa si usimamizi wa hatari — ni matumaini yaliyochelewa. Thamani yote ya stop-loss inatokana na kuiweka kabla ya kuingia, ukiwa bado unafikiri kwa uwazi.

6bf49b5d3210.en: A major currency paired with the currency of a smaller or emerging economy — for example, USD/MXN, USD/TRY, or USD/ZAR.
6bf49b5d3210.sw: Sarafu kuu iliyowekwa pamoja na sarafu ya uchumi mdogo au unaoibukia — kwa mfano, USD/MXN, USD/TRY, au USD/ZAR.

6c1d61a8c22b.en: The gap between bid and ask — a real cost paid when you trade, not billed separately.
6c1d61a8c22b.sw: Pengo kati ya bid na ask — gharama halisi inayolipwa unapofanya biashara, isiyotozwa tofauti.

6c2271fe360f.en: Correct — in a violent gap the stop-out can fill far from its level; the 2015 Swiss franc move pushed many accounts negative. That is why negative balance protection exists — the stop-out is a strong safeguard, not an absolute guarantee.
6c2271fe360f.sw: Sahihi — katika kuruka kwa nguvu stop-out inaweza kutimizwa mbali na kiwango chake; msogeo wa faranga ya Uswisi wa mwaka 2015 ulisukuma akaunti nyingi kuwa hasi. Ndiyo sababu ulinzi wa salio hasi upo — stop-out ni kinga imara, si uhakika kabisa.

6c64b73de484.en: Osler (2003), published in The Journal of Finance, examined the actual order books behind the market. Stop-loss and take-profit orders turned out to be strongly clustered at round numbers — almost 10 percent of all such orders sat at rates ending in "00," such as 1.1000. Those round numbers are exactly the levels traders draw as support and resistance. Take-profit orders bunched at a level push price back from it, which is why trends reverse at support and resistance. Stop-loss orders bunched just beyond it accelerate price once the level breaks, which is why a decisive break tends to run.
6c64b73de484.sw: Osler (2003), aliyechapisha katika The Journal of Finance, alichunguza vitabu halisi vya maagizo nyuma ya soko. Maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit yaligundulika kujikusanya kwa nguvu kwenye namba za mviringo — karibu asilimia 10 ya maagizo yote hayo yalikaa kwenye viwango vinavyoishia kwa "00," kama 1.1000. Namba hizo za mviringo ni hasa viwango ambavyo wafanyabiashara huchora kama msaada na upinzani. Maagizo ya take-profit yaliyojikusanya kwenye kiwango husukuma bei kurudi kutoka kwake, ndiyo maana mielekeo hugeuka kwenye msaada na upinzani. Maagizo ya stop-loss yaliyojikusanya nje kidogo yake huharakisha bei mara kiwango kinapovunjika, ndiyo maana kuvunjika kwa uamuzi huelekea kukimbia.

6c66e0b51794.en: Correct. A stop order specifies a trigger, not a price. Once the level is reached it sends a market order, which fills at whatever the book offers — in a gap down, well below the stop level. This is the single most common misunderstanding about protective orders.
6c66e0b51794.sw: Sahihi. Agizo la stop hubainisha kianzishi, si bei. Mara kiwango kinapofikiwa hutuma agizo la soko, ambalo hutimizwa kwa chochote kitabu kinachotoa — katika kuruka chini, chini mno ya kiwango cha stop. Hili ndilo kutoelewana kunakojulikana zaidi kuhusu maagizo ya kinga.

6c6964b65639.en: A company you own shares in is sold, and after all debts are repaid there is cash left over. Who has a claim on it?
6c6964b65639.sw: Kampuni unayomiliki hisa zake huuzwa, na baada ya madeni yote kulipwa kuna fedha zilizobaki. Ni nani mwenye dai juu yake?

6c77726aab26.sw: Kampuni hutoa madaraja mawili ya hisa yenye madai yanayofanana juu ya faida, lakini moja hubeba kura kumi kwa kila hisa na lingine hubeba moja. Kinafuata nini kwa mtu anayenunua daraja la kura moja?

6c787963e0ae.en: Not quite — Glosten and Milgrom showed a positive spread emerges even at zero expected profit, from the need to protect against adverse selection, plus order-processing costs and inventory risk.
6c787963e0ae.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — Glosten na Milgrom walionyesha spread chanya hujitokeza hata kwa faida sifuri inayotarajiwa, kutokana na hitaji la kujilinda dhidi ya uteuzi mbaya, pamoja na gharama za kushughulikia maagizo na hatari ya hifadhi.

6cd84adabaf1.en: There's a failure mode specific to this technique, and it's worth naming clearly because it feels like diligence.
6cd84adabaf1.sw: Kuna hali ya kushindwa mahususi kwa mbinu hii, na inastahili kutajwa wazi kwa sababu inahisi kama bidii.

6d23b87b0ae9.sw: Mabadiliko ya bei pamoja na gawio lililowekezwa tena — kilichotokea hasa kwa pesa zako.

6d3182aac756.sw: Aina ya hisa ndani ya kampuni ile ile. Madaraja tofauti yanaweza kubeba haki tofauti za kupiga kura huku yakiwa na dai linalofanana juu ya faida.

6d6387411f24.en: Why three, specifically? Fewer than three and you lose context — you end up trading against a trend you can't see. More than three and you get contradictory signals, over-analysis, and paralysis. This is the same trap Lesson 1 warned about with indicators: more inputs is not more insight.
6d6387411f24.sw: Kwa nini vitatu, mahususi? Chini ya vitatu na unapoteza muktadha — unaishia kufanya biashara dhidi ya mwelekeo usiouona. Zaidi ya vitatu na unapata ishara zinazopingana, uchambuzi wa kupita kiasi, na kupooza. Huu ni mtego ule ule ambao Somo la 1 lilionya kuhusu viashiria: pembejeo nyingi zaidi si ufahamu zaidi.

6d786d240c9c.en: How to read a calendar entry, and why the surprise — not the event — is what moves price.

6dedbd6b7fac.en: Correct — money is defined by function, not material. Cigarettes in a WWII POW camp worked as real money.

6e19bcc53bfd.en: Correct. On 10,000 over 30 years the cheap fund produces about 75,063 and the expensive one about 49,840 — roughly 66% of it. The fee is charged on the entire balance every year, so it compounds, which is why a 1.45% annual difference turns into about a third of the final pot rather than 1.45% of it.

Ada hutozwa juu ya salio lote kila mwaka, hivyo hujikusanya, ndiyo sababu tofauti ya kila mwaka ya 1.45% hugeuka kuwa takriban theluthi moja ya chungu cha mwisho badala ya 1.45% yake.

700a3b484faa.en: A currency exchange counter at an airport is a real but inefficient way to do this — there are fees, poor rates, and you physically have to show up. Nobody trading forex seriously does it this way.

7021294fa857.en: Case A — the quote currency is your account currency. For a US-dollar account trading EUR/USD, Step 1 already gives 10 US dollars per pip. Step 2 changes nothing. Pip value is exactly 10 dollars. This is the case Chapter 1 used, and it is the only one where the shortcut is exact.

Hatua ya 2 haibadilishi chochote. Thamani ya pip ni dola 10 hasa. Hii ndiyo kesi ambayo Sura ya 1 ilitumia, na ndiyo pekee ambapo njia ya mkato ni kamili.

7037437d35bc.en: The full calculation is always the same two steps, whatever the pair. Step 1 is to find the pip value in the quote currency: multiply the pip size by the number of units you are trading.

70a22007946d.en: Practically, the chain is a map of where to hunt. If a major central bank shifts, the first, cleanest expression is often in FX and rates; the later links (equities, commodities, crypto) may offer follow-on trades as the shock propagates. You look along the chain from the source.

Kama benki kuu kubwa itabadilika, usemi wa kwanza na safi zaidi mara nyingi uko katika FX na viwango; viungo vya baadaye (hisa, bidhaa, crypto) vinaweza kutoa biashara za kufuatia mshtuko unaposambaa. 71fd808982d9.en: The spread and the depth behind it are separate things. A share can show a narrow spread with very little volume behind the best prices, so a larger order eats through several levels and achieves an average price far from the quote. Check the volume traded, not only the spread.
71fd808982d9.sw: Spread na kina kilicho nyuma yake ni vitu tofauti. Hisa inaweza kuonyesha spread finyu ikiwa na kiasi kidogo mno nyuma ya bei bora, hivyo agizo kubwa hula kupitia viwango kadhaa na hufikia bei ya wastani mbali na nukuu. Kagua kiasi kilichofanyiwa biashara, si spread tu.

7395dba72e56.sw: Akaunti nyingi hupotea si kwa uchambuzi mbaya bali kwa tabia mbili zilizoandikwa — athari ya kuachana na nafasi na kufanya biashara kupita kiasi — na kinga pekee ya kutegemewa ni mpango uliojitolewa mapema, si nia thabiti.

73a1b31658dc.en: A stop-loss that automatically moves in your favor as price moves.
73a1b31658dc.sw: Stop-loss inayosogea kiotomatiki kwa manufaa yako bei inaposogea.

73aa4440f955.en: A hybrid: once the stop price triggers, it becomes a limit order rather than a market order, giving you price control at the cost of a real chance it doesn't fill at all.
73aa4440f955.sw: Mchanganyiko: mara bei ya stop inapoanzisha, linakuwa agizo la kikomo badala ya agizo la soko, likikupa udhibiti wa bei kwa gharama ya nafasi halisi kwamba halitimizwi kabisa.

73be6fc9727f.sw: "Athari ya kuachana na nafasi" inaeleza nini?

73edb602f432.en: Paying someone else to take on your risk — like insurance, or options/hedging in trading. Comes at an ongoing cost that erodes returns if overused.
73edb602f432.sw: Kumlipa mtu mwingine abebe hatari yako — kama bima, au options/hedging katika biashara. Inakuja na gharama ya kudumu inayomomonyoa faida ikitumika kupita kiasi.

740f147605bf.en: The practical takeaway is small and worth keeping. There is no single price — there is a bid, an ask, and a gap you pay to cross. You choose whether to cross it. And the trade you agree today is not finished until it settles.
740f147605bf.sw: Fundisho la kivitendo ni dogo na linastahili kuwekwa. Hakuna bei moja — kuna bid, ask, na pengo unalolipa kulivuka. Wewe huchagua kama unalivuka. Na biashara unayoikubali leo haijamaliza hadi itatuliwe.

743153ecfb85.en: The second is not necessarily doomed. It is carrying a cost the first is not, and it needs a genuine edge just to break even against the first. Chapter 4 puts real numbers on what that costs over a lifetime.
743153ecfb85.sw: Wa pili si lazima ahukumiwe. Anabeba gharama ambayo wa kwanza haibebi, na anahitaji faida halisi ili tu kulingana na wa kwanza. Sura ya 4 inaweka namba halisi juu ya hilo linagharimu nini katika maisha yote.

7473a2621ce5.en: A standardized trade size — 100,000 units for a standard lot.
7473a2621ce5.sw: Ukubwa sanifu wa biashara — vipimo 100,000 kwa lot sanifu.

7499958c369b.en: Both show the same result, since the companies are identical
7499958c369b.sw: Zote mbili huonyesha tokeo lile lile, kwa kuwa kampuni zinafanana

74a5cb601eaf.en: Correct — from Lesson 1, an indicator can only highlight what's already in price. The price-action trader reads the same underlying information directly, not less of it.
74a5cb601eaf.sw: Sahihi — kutoka Somo la 1, kiashiria kinaweza tu kuangazia kilicho tayari katika bei. Mfanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei husoma taarifa zile zile za msingi moja kwa moja, si chache zaidi.

74ac7fe91c09.en: Reading a list of mistakes does not prevent them. Two simple habits do most of the work.
74ac7fe91c09.sw: Kusoma orodha ya makosa hakuyazuii. Tabia mbili rahisi hufanya kazi nyingi.

75209c20ce3e.en: Correct. Lending generates income that can offset costs, so it is not simply a negative. But it introduces a relationship with a borrower who may fail, and the terms — how much may be lent, what collateral is held, what share of the fee the manager keeps — are in the documentation rather than the marketing.
75209c20ce3e.sw: Sahihi. Kukopesha huzalisha mapato yanayoweza kupunguza gharama, hivyo si hasi tu. Lakini huanzisha uhusiano na mkopaji anayeweza kushindwa, na masharti — kiasi gani kinaweza kukopeshwa, dhamana gani inashikiliwa, sehemu gani ya ada msimamizi huweka — yako katika nyaraka badala ya matangazo.

755e112da1ae.en: Managers have no skill at all

75a305f99cb4.en: Be honest about the limit: no one eliminates fear and greed, professionals included. The difference is that experienced traders build rules and automation that make the feelings irrelevant to the decision, rather than trying to win an emotional battle in real time. Aim for a process that does not depend on you being calm at the worst possible moment.
75a305f99cb4.sw: Kuwa mwaminifu kuhusu kikomo: hakuna anayeondoa hofu na tamaa, wataalamu wakiwemo. Tofauti ni kwamba wafanyabiashara wenye uzoefu hujenga kanuni na uendeshaji wa kiotomatiki unaofanya hisia zisihusike na uamuzi, badala ya kujaribu kushinda vita ya kihisia kwa wakati halisi. Lenga mchakato usiotegemea wewe kuwa mtulivu wakati mbaya zaidi unaowezekana.

75b0056a65a7.en: This is exactly the gap a forex broker fills.
75b0056a65a7.sw: Hii ndiyo hasa pengo ambalo broker wa forex analiziba.

75d511a3fd85.en: Both people in a trade must want exactly what the other has, at the same time.
75d511a3fd85.sw: Watu wote wawili katika biashara lazima watake hasa kile ambacho mwenzake anacho, kwa wakati mmoja.

75f9aa4ab0fc.en: Caginalp and Laurent (1998), in Applied Mathematical Finance, tested candlestick reversal patterns on S&P 500 stocks from 1992 to 1996 and found them profitable — a return of roughly 0.9 percent over a two-day holding period, a result they reported as strongly significant. Eight years later, Marshall, Young and Rose (2006), in the Journal of Banking & Finance, tested candlestick strategies on Dow Jones stocks over 1992 to 2001 using a bootstrap method and found no value at all.
75f9aa4ab0fc.sw: Caginalp na Laurent (1998), katika Applied Mathematical Finance, walijaribu mitindo ya mgeuko ya mishumaa kwenye hisa za S&P 500 kutoka 1992 hadi 1996 na wakaipata yenye faida — faida ya takriban asilimia 0.9 katika kipindi cha kushikilia cha siku mbili, tokeo walilolieleza kama lenye maana kubwa. Miaka minane baadaye, Marshall, Young na Rose (2006), katika Journal of Banking & Finance, walijaribu mikakati ya mishumaa kwenye hisa za Dow Jones kwa 1992 hadi 2001 wakitumia mbinu ya bootstrap na hawakupata thamani yoyote kabisa.

760ef0ad8ff7.en: The two questions can be turned into arithmetic, which is more useful than the labels.
760ef0ad8ff7.sw: Maswali hayo mawili yanaweza kugeuzwa kuwa hesabu, ambayo ina manufaa zaidi kuliko lebo.

7620c68e9e90.en: To supply the world with dollars, the U.S. ran persistent deficits. But the more dollars circulated abroad, the harder it became to credibly promise every one could still convert to gold — especially as domestic inflation and war spending meant more dollars were printed than gold reserves could realistically back.
7620c68e9e90.sw: Ili kuipa dunia dola, Marekani iliendesha nakisi za kudumu. Lakini kadri dola nyingi zilivyozunguka nje ya nchi, ndivyo ilivyokuwa vigumu zaidi kuahidi kwa uaminifu kwamba kila moja ingeweza bado kubadilishwa kuwa dhahabu — hasa kadri mfumuko wa bei wa ndani na matumizi ya vita vilimaanisha dola nyingi zaidi zilichapishwa kuliko akiba za dhahabu zingeweza kuziunga mkono kihalisia.

762aae474852.en: The process of screening many possible trades down to a few worth taking: a wide scan of the regime and the pillars, narrowing to the handful of theses that genuinely align, and narrowing again to the few that also clear the risk and reward-to-risk bars.
762aae474852.sw: Mchakato wa kuchuja biashara nyingi zinazowezekana hadi chache zinazostahili kuchukuliwa: uchunguzi mpana wa hali na nguzo, ukipunguzwa hadi nadharia chache zinazolingana kweli, na kupunguzwa tena hadi chache zinazopita pia vizingiti vya hatari na tuzo-kwa-hatari.

76a7726f39c8.en: Share price on its own says nothing about the size of a company. A company can halve its share price tomorrow by splitting its shares two-for-one, without anything about the business changing. In a price-weighted index that split permanently reduces the company's influence. This is why price weighting is generally regarded as a historical artefact rather than a good design — it was easy to compute in 1896, when the arithmetic was done by hand.
76a7726f39c8.sw: Bei ya hisa peke yake haisemi chochote kuhusu ukubwa wa kampuni. Kampuni inaweza kupunguza nusu bei ya hisa yake kesho kwa kugawanya hisa zake mbili-kwa-moja, bila chochote kuhusu biashara kubadilika. Katika index yenye uzito wa bei mgawanyo huo hupunguza kabisa ushawishi wa kampuni. Ndiyo sababu uzito wa bei kwa ujumla huchukuliwa kama mabaki ya kihistoria badala ya muundo mzuri — ulikuwa rahisi kukokotoa mwaka 1896, hesabu ilipofanywa kwa mkono.

7714d6282d60.en: True or False: a bank run happens because the bank did something wrong that specific day.
7714d6282d60.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kukimbilia benki hutokea kwa sababu benki ilifanya kitu kibaya siku hiyo mahususi.

777b10151a0f.en: The amount of money gained or lost for each pip of price movement, for a given position size, expressed in your account's currency.
777b10151a0f.sw: Kiasi cha pesa kinachopatikana au kupotea kwa kila pip ya msogeo wa bei, kwa ukubwa fulani wa nafasi, kikielezwa kwa sarafu ya akaunti yako.

77d45ce8d1cc.en: Chapter 3, Lesson 3 gave you the break-even win rate — whether a ratio can survive a given hit rate. Expectancy is the full accounting: not just whether you break even, but how much you make or lose per trade on average.
77d45ce8d1cc.sw: Sura ya 3, Somo la 3 lilikupa kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana — kama uwiano unaweza kunusurika kiwango fulani cha kugonga. Matarajio ni uhesabuji kamili: si tu kama unalingana, bali unapata au kupoteza kiasi gani kwa kila biashara kwa wastani.

780ebbb0de78.en: Correct. Price weighting looks only at the price per share, so A has six times the influence of B despite being an eighth of the size. A cap-weighted index would do the opposite. This is exactly why it matters which rule an index uses before you read anything into its movement.
780ebbb0de78.sw: Sahihi. Uzito wa bei hutazama bei kwa kila hisa tu, hivyo A ina ushawishi mara sita ya B licha ya kuwa moja ya nane ya ukubwa. Index yenye uzito wa mtaji ingefanya kinyume. Ndiyo hasa sababu inahusika ni kanuni ipi index inayotumia kabla hujasoma chochote katika msogeo wake.

781672d3f721.en: Diagram of the six-pillar trade thesis — fundamentals, valuation, catalyst, positioning/sentiment, momentum, and carry — scored together so that conviction means how many independent evidence-based pillars agree, with the note that value, momentum, and carry are documented return factors (Asness/Moskowitz/Pedersen 2013; Koijen et al. 2018) and that best-analysed ideas outperform (Anton/Cohen/Polk)
781672d3f721.sw: Mchoro wa nadharia ya biashara ya nguzo sita — misingi, uthaminishaji, kichocheo, nafasi za soko/hisia, kasi, na carry — zikipimwa kwa pamoja ili uhakika umaanishe nguzo ngapi huru zenye msingi wa ushahidi zinakubaliana, ukiwa na dokezo kwamba thamani, kasi, na carry ni vipengele vya faida vilivyoandikwa (Asness/Moskowitz/Pedersen 2013; Koijen et al. 2018) na kwamba mawazo yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi hufanya vizuri zaidi (Anton/Cohen/Polk)

781b148df084.en: A currency widely held by governments and institutions for global trade and finance.
781b148df084.sw: Sarafu inayoshikiliwa kwa upana na serikali na taasisi kwa biashara na fedha za kimataifa.

785fd549b753.en: Correct. A market order crosses the spread, so you bought at 41.10 and sold at 40.90 — a loss of 0.20 per share, close to 0.5% of the value, on an unchanged market. Crossing the spread twice is what a round trip costs, before any commission at all.
785fd549b753.sw: Sahihi. Agizo la soko huvuka spread, hivyo ulinunua kwa 41.10 na kuuza kwa 40.90 — hasara ya 0.20 kwa kila hisa, karibu 0.5% ya thamani, kwenye soko lisilobadilika. Kuvuka spread mara mbili ndicho safari ya kwenda na kurudi inagharimu, kabla ya kamisheni yoyote kabisa.

7867d80e535d.en: The position sizing formula worked through step by step, turning account size, risk percentage, and stop-loss into an exact lot size.
7867d80e535d.sw: Fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi ikipitiwa hatua kwa hatua, ikigeuza ukubwa wa akaunti, asilimia ya hatari, na stop-loss kuwa ukubwa kamili wa lot.

788c21583ddf.en: True or False: according to Glosten and Milgrom's (1985) research, bid-ask spreads exist purely because market makers want to profit, with no other cause.
788c21583ddf.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kwa mujibu wa utafiti wa Glosten na Milgrom (1985), spread za bid-ask zipo kwa sababu tu watengeneza-soko wanataka faida, bila sababu nyingine yoyote.

78b32c3a611b.en: Correct — USD is listed first, making it the base; JPY is the quote, meaning one US dollar costs 149.50 yen.
78b32c3a611b.sw: Sahihi — USD imeorodheshwa kwanza, jambo linaloifanya kuwa msingi; JPY ni bei, ikimaanisha dola moja ya Marekani inagharimu yen 149.50.

78ce8074f47a.en: None of this makes shares safe. Foundations Chapter 2 made the point that being right often is not the same as trading well, and it holds here: the positive-sum nature of ownership is a statement about the long run and about diversified baskets, not a promise about any single company or any single year.
78ce8074f47a.sw: Hakuna kati ya haya kinachofanya hisa kuwa salama. Sura ya 2 ya Msingi ilitoa pointi kwamba kuwa sahihi mara nyingi si sawa na kufanya biashara vizuri, na hushikilia hapa: hali ya jumla-chanya ya umiliki ni kauli kuhusu muda mrefu na kuhusu vikapu vilivyosambazwa, si ahadi kuhusu kampuni yoyote moja au mwaka wowote mmoja.

78cfb8aa6384.en: What makes this case different from the Swiss franc shock is that there was no single dramatic announcement behind it. No central bank moved. No headline number was released. A currency of a major economy simply lost a large fraction of its value in minutes and then partly reappeared, in a market that is supposed to be the most liquid on earth.
78cfb8aa6384.sw: Kinachofanya kesi hii kuwa tofauti na mshtuko wa faranga ya Uswisi ni kwamba hakukuwa na tangazo moja la kushtua nyuma yake. Hakuna benki kuu iliyosogea. Hakuna namba ya kichwa cha habari iliyotolewa. Sarafu ya uchumi mkubwa ilipoteza tu sehemu kubwa ya thamani yake ndani ya dakika chache na kisha ikajitokeza tena kwa sehemu, katika soko linalopaswa kuwa lenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi duniani.

791634ab4748.en: Every lesson in this chapter so far has added a tool on top of the chart: moving averages, MACD, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Fibonacci levels. Price action trading goes the other way. It strips all of that off and reads the raw price movement directly.
791634ab4748.sw: Kila somo katika sura hii hadi sasa limeongeza zana juu ya chati: wastani unaosogea, MACD, Bollinger Bands, RSI, viwango vya Fibonacci. Biashara ya shughuli ya bei huenda njia nyingine. Huvua vyote hivyo na kusoma msogeo ghafi wa bei moja kwa moja.

79201fc29347.en: Finally, no fund tracks its index exactly. Fees, trading costs, and the timing of dividends all cause small gaps.
79201fc29347.sw: Hatimaye, hakuna fund inayofuatilia index yake hasa. Ada, gharama za biashara, na muda wa gawio vyote husababisha mapengo madogo.

792d5753a1cf.en: The bid, the ask, and the spread between them — and how the pip shifts decimal place for yen pairs.
792d5753a1cf.sw: Bid, ask, na spread iliyo kati yao — na jinsi pip inavyohamisha nafasi ya desimali kwa jozi za yen.

79347fb4c5b4.en: An instruction to trade only at a stated price or better. Certain in price, uncertain whether it executes at all.
79347fb4c5b4.sw: Maelekezo ya kufanya biashara kwa bei iliyotajwa au bora zaidi tu. Ya uhakika kwa bei, isiyo na uhakika kama itatekelezwa kabisa.

7949df718297.en: Something that holds its purchasing power over time.
7949df718297.sw: Kitu kinachoshikilia uwezo wake wa kununua kwa muda.

797ed1331efa.en: Carry these forward: For any pair pinned by a central bank policy (a peg or a floor), remember that "it cannot move past here" is a promise that can be withdrawn without notice. Never assume a stop-loss guarantees your exit price — it guarantees a trigger, not a fill, and in a gap the two can be far apart. Size every position so that a violent gap through your stop is a survivable loss, not an account-ending one. And confirm your broker offers negative balance protection, but treat it as a backstop, never as permission to size larger.
797ed1331efa.sw: Beba haya mbele: Kwa jozi lolote lililobanwa na sera ya benki kuu (kufungwa au sakafu), kumbuka kwamba "haiwezi kusogea zaidi ya hapa" ni ahadi inayoweza kuondolewa bila taarifa. Kamwe usidhani stop-loss inahakikisha bei yako ya kutoka — inahakikisha kianzishi, si kutimizwa, na katika kuruka hizo mbili zinaweza kuwa mbali sana. Pima kila nafasi ili kuruka kwa nguvu kupitia stop yako kuwe hasara inayoweza kunusurika, si inayomaliza akaunti. Na thibitisha broker wako anatoa ulinzi wa salio hasi, lakini uchukulie kama kizuizi, kamwe si ruhusa ya kupima kubwa zaidi.

79e884aa14c0.en: Before entering, run these checks: Can you state the trade's risk-to-reward ratio as a number, from a real stop price and a real target price? Does that ratio clear its break-even win rate with room to spare, given a win rate you can honestly expect rather than a hoped-for one? Are your stop and target placed at meaningful levels — invalidation, support, resistance — or chosen to manufacture a nice-looking ratio? And do you ever widen a stop or pull in a target mid-trade? That is the ratio quietly collapsing, the one habit this lesson most wants you to catch.
79e884aa14c0.sw: Kabla ya kuingia, fanya ukaguzi huu: Je, unaweza kutamka uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo wa biashara kama namba, kutoka bei halisi ya stop na bei halisi ya lengo? Je, uwiano huo unapita kiwango chake cha ushindi cha kulingana kwa nafasi ya ziada, kwa kuzingatia kiwango cha ushindi unachoweza kukitarajia kwa uaminifu badala ya kile unachokitumaini? Je, stop na lengo lako vimewekwa kwenye viwango vyenye maana — kuvunjika, msaada, upinzani — au vimechaguliwa kutengeneza uwiano unaoonekana mzuri? Na je, unawahi kupanua stop au kuvuta lengo karibu katikati ya biashara? Huo ni uwiano ukiporomoka kimyakimya, tabia moja ambayo somo hili linataka zaidi ukamate.

7a01757d355d.en: According to the Bank for International Settlements' 2025 Triennial Survey — the definitive, authoritative measurement of global currency trading — the U.S. dollar was on one side of 89% of all FX trades. The euro was second at 28.9%. That works out to the dollar being traded roughly three times more than the euro — a real, current, precisely sourced number, not a rough guess.
7a01757d355d.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Utafiti wa Kila Miaka Mitatu wa mwaka 2025 wa Benki ya Malipo ya Kimataifa — kipimo cha uhakika na chenye mamlaka cha biashara ya sarafu duniani — dola ya Marekani ilikuwa upande mmoja wa 89% ya biashara zote za FX. Euro ilikuwa ya pili kwa 28.9%. Hilo linatokea kuwa dola inafanyiwa biashara takriban mara tatu zaidi ya euro — namba halisi, ya sasa, yenye chanzo sahihi, si kadirio la jumla.

7aa12f04f4bb.en: The company is in distress, because capital spending exceeds profit
7aa12f04f4bb.sw: Kampuni iko katika dhiki, kwa sababu matumizi ya mtaji yanazidi faida

7afcd21e9d79.en: You enter a long position on a currency pair at 1.50. Where should your stop-loss sit relative to your entry?
7afcd21e9d79.sw: Unaingia katika nafasi ya long kwenye jozi la sarafu kwa 1.50. Stop-loss yako inapaswa kuwa wapi ikilinganishwa na kiingilio chako?

7b17fc148d22.en: A fund's annual fee as a percentage of assets, deducted from the fund rather than billed.
7b17fc148d22.sw: Ada ya kila mwaka ya fund kama asilimia ya mali, inayotolewa kutoka kwenye fund badala ya kutozwa bili.

7b775fb58e43.en: Correction: an earlier version of this lesson stated USD/CNY was the "fourth" most-traded pair. Checking the precise 2025 BIS breakdown (EUR/USD 21.2%, USD/JPY 14.3%, USD/CNY 8.1%, GBP/USD 7.6%), it's actually third, ahead of GBP/USD. Flagging this directly rather than quietly fixing it — checking a specific number against the actual data, even your own course's earlier claim, is exactly the habit this course is trying to build.
7b775fb58e43.sw: Marekebisho: toleo la awali la somo hili lilisema USD/CNY lilikuwa jozi la "nne" linalofanyiwa biashara zaidi. Kukagua mgawanyo kamili wa BIS wa mwaka 2025 (EUR/USD 21.2%, USD/JPY 14.3%, USD/CNY 8.1%, GBP/USD 7.6%), kwa kweli ni la tatu, mbele ya GBP/USD. Tunaliweka wazi moja kwa moja badala ya kulirekebisha kimyakimya — kukagua namba mahususi dhidi ya data halisi, hata dai la awali la kozi yako mwenyewe, ndiyo hasa tabia ambayo kozi hii inajaribu kuijenga.

7bb00a4561f9.en: Cryptocurrencies are worth a specific note, because they are often assumed to be a world apart. Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu (2022), in The Journal of Finance, found that cryptocurrency returns are captured by just three factors — a crypto market factor, size, and momentum — a structure that echoes the factor logic of ordinary asset markets rather than escaping it. In a risk-off transmission wave, crypto has tended to behave as a high-beta risk asset, falling hardest, not as an independent safe haven.
7bb00a4561f9.sw: Sarafu za crypto zinastahili dokezo mahususi, kwa sababu mara nyingi hudhaniwa kuwa dunia tofauti. Liu, Tsyvinski na Wu (2022), katika The Journal of Finance, waligundua kwamba faida za sarafu za crypto hunaswa na vipengele vitatu tu — kipengele cha soko la crypto, ukubwa, na kasi — muundo unaoakisi mantiki ya vipengele ya masoko ya kawaida ya mali badala ya kuikwepa. Katika wimbi la usambazaji la kukwepa hatari, crypto imeelekea kutenda kama mali hatarishi ya beta kubwa, ikianguka kwa nguvu zaidi, si kama kimbilio salama huru.

7bb05b202eef.en: Not quite — judge the decision and thesis, not only the money. Good processes lose to variance and bad ones win by luck.
7bb05b202eef.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — hukumu uamuzi na nadharia, si pesa tu. Michakato mizuri hupoteza kwa utofauti na mibaya hushinda kwa bahati.

7bbd9644cf62.en: EUR/USD shows a bid of 1.08500 and an ask of 1.08510. What is the spread?
7bbd9644cf62.sw: EUR/USD inaonyesha bid ya 1.08500 na ask ya 1.08510. Spread ni ipi?

7c233c9611a1.en: Each common mistake mapped to the lesson that already solves it, plus the checklist and journal that catch them before and after.
7c233c9611a1.sw: Kila kosa la kawaida likiunganishwa na somo linalolitatua tayari, pamoja na orodha ya ukaguzi na kumbukumbu zinazoyakamata kabla na baada.

7c250f135b69.en: Before and during a leveraged trade, check: Do you actually know your broker's margin call and stop-out levels, in numbers, before you need them? What is your effective leverage right now — total open position size divided by equity — a small number or a large one? Could your free-margin cushion absorb a realistic adverse move without triggering a margin call? And are you relying on the stop-out as a safety net, or sizing your positions so that you never come close to it?
7c250f135b69.sw: Kabla na wakati wa biashara ya leverage, kagua: Je, unajua kweli viwango vya wito wa margin na stop-out vya broker wako, kwa namba, kabla ya kuvihitaji? Leverage yako halisi ni ipi sasa hivi — ukubwa wa jumla wa nafasi zilizo wazi kugawanywa kwa usawa — namba ndogo au kubwa? Je, mto wako wa margin huru ungeweza kufyonza msogeo mbaya halisi bila kuanzisha wito wa margin? Na je, unategemea stop-out kama wavu wa usalama, au unapima nafasi zako ili usikaribie kamwe?

7c783514a42a.en: Lesson 3 ended on a specific idea: markets trade the surprise, not the raw decision. The economic calendar is the tool that makes that idea usable in practice.
7c783514a42a.sw: Somo la 3 lilimalizia kwa wazo mahususi: masoko hufanya biashara ya mshangao, si uamuzi ghafi. Kalenda ya kiuchumi ndiyo zana inayofanya wazo hilo litumike kivitendo.

7cd4b3b5de9e.en: Miller and Modigliani addressed this in 1961, in the Journal of Business (volume 34, pages 411 to 433). Under a set of idealised assumptions — no taxes, no transaction costs, and investment decisions held fixed — they showed that dividend policy does not affect the value of the firm. A shareholder wanting cash can sell a small part of their holding, and one not wanting cash can reinvest the dividend. The two are equivalent.
7cd4b3b5de9e.sw: Miller na Modigliani walishughulikia hili mwaka 1961, katika Journal of Business (juzuu 34, kurasa 411 hadi 433). Chini ya seti ya dhana bora — hakuna kodi, hakuna gharama za miamala, na maamuzi ya uwekezaji yamewekwa thabiti — walionyesha kwamba sera ya gawio haiathiri thamani ya kampuni. Mwanahisa anayetaka fedha anaweza kuuza sehemu ndogo ya umiliki wake, na asiyetaka fedha anaweza kuwekeza tena gawio. Hizo mbili zinalingana.

7d2d7209dcb2.en: Here is the misunderstanding that this lesson exists to fix. The broker advertises a maximum leverage — 30:1, 50:1, sometimes far more. That number is a ceiling on what you are allowed to do. It says nothing about the risk you are actually running. That is a different number.
7d2d7209dcb2.sw: Hapa hapa kutoelewana ambako somo hili lipo kulirekebisha. Broker hutangaza leverage ya juu zaidi — 30:1, 50:1, wakati mwingine zaidi mno. Namba hiyo ni dari ya kile unachoruhusiwa kufanya. Haisemi chochote kuhusu hatari unayoiendesha hasa. Hiyo ni namba tofauti.

7d4de8aeedd9.en: Inflation doesn't affect every market the same way — and it doesn't even affect any one market the same way every time.
7d4de8aeedd9.sw: Mfumuko wa bei hauathiri kila soko kwa njia ile ile — na hata hauathiri soko lolote moja kwa njia ile ile kila mara.

7d6d76eb6002.en: To fix both problems — too many competing currencies, and the instability of fractional reserve banking — countries began establishing central banks. The Bank of England, founded in 1694, is one of the earliest examples: a single, trusted institution issuing one national currency and regulating the banks around it.
7d6d76eb6002.sw: Ili kutatua matatizo yote mawili — sarafu nyingi sana zinazoshindana, na kutokuwa imara kwa benki ya akiba ya sehemu — nchi zilianza kuanzisha benki kuu. Benki ya Uingereza, iliyoanzishwa mwaka 1694, ni mojawapo ya mifano ya awali kabisa: taasisi moja inayoaminika inayotoa sarafu moja ya taifa na kudhibiti benki zinazoizunguka.

7d72da340b48.en: Correct — a long position profits when price rises, so the stop-loss sits below, where a fall would prove the trade against you.
7d72da340b48.sw: Sahihi — nafasi ya long hupata faida bei inapopanda, hivyo stop-loss inakaa chini, ambapo kushuka kungethibitisha biashara imekwenda kinyume nawe.

7d72ff07e19a.en: Correct — Nixon announced the U.S. would suspend converting dollars into gold, which effectively ended Bretton Woods.
7d72ff07e19a.sw: Sahihi — Nixon alitangaza kwamba Marekani ingesimamisha kubadilisha dola kuwa dhahabu, jambo ambalo kwa hakika lilimaliza Bretton Woods.

7d87372f6647.en: Holding the market in proportion, tracking an index rather than trying to beat it.
7d87372f6647.sw: Kushikilia soko kwa uwiano, kufuatilia index badala ya kujaribu kuishinda.

7dc05adce77f.en: It worked — until a war forced every participating country to choose between keeping its promise to gold and paying for the war. When World War I began in 1914, major economies suspended gold convertibility so they could print the money needed to fund it.
7dc05adce77f.sw: Ulifanya kazi — hadi vita vilipolazimisha kila nchi iliyoshiriki kuchagua kati ya kushikilia ahadi yake kwa dhahabu na kulipia vita. Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia vilipoanza mwaka 1914, uchumi mkubwa ulisimamisha ubadilishaji wa dhahabu ili uweze kuchapisha pesa zilizohitajika kuvifadhili.

7e0ce3cf6a84.en: Readers who took the Forex track have met this already, in Chapter 1 Lesson 4. The mechanism is identical; only the units differ. Currency traders count it in pips, share traders count it in cents, and both are paying the same thing.
7e0ce3cf6a84.sw: Wasomaji waliochukua njia ya Forex tayari wamekutana na hili, katika Sura ya 1 Somo la 4. Utaratibu unafanana; vipimo tu ndivyo vinavyotofautiana. Wafanyabiashara wa sarafu huihesabu kwa pip, wafanyabiashara wa hisa huihesabu kwa senti, na wote wanalipa kitu kile kile.

7e2715c2ee13.en: How easily an asset can be bought or sold in reasonable size without moving its price. High volume and a narrow spread together indicate it; either alone does not.
7e2715c2ee13.sw: Jinsi mali inavyoweza kununuliwa au kuuzwa kwa urahisi kwa ukubwa wa busara bila kusogeza bei yake. Kiasi kikubwa na spread finyu kwa pamoja huionyesha; kimojawapo peke yake hakiionyeshi.

7e39ff1b17a8.en: Turn a thesis into a survivable trade by placing the stop at the invalidation level, demanding a reward-to-risk that justifies it, running a pre-mortem to surface hidden failure modes, and writing the full exit before entry.
7e39ff1b17a8.sw: Geuza nadharia kuwa biashara inayoweza kunusurika kwa kuweka stop kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika, kudai tuzo-kwa-hatari inayoihalalisha, kufanya pre-mortem kufichua hali fichi za kushindwa, na kuandika kutoka kamili kabla ya kuingia.

7e5ac697d1a3.en: Reconstitution triggers a tax charge for all holders
7e5ac697d1a3.sw: Kuunda upya huanzisha malipo ya kodi kwa wote wanaoshikilia

7e7d0d0ab08c.en: Two shares each yield 5%. One pays 2.50 on a 50.00 price after years of steady increases. The other paid 2.50 on a price that has fallen from 100.00 to 50.00 in eighteen months. The yield is identical and the situations have nothing in common. Only looking at the yield makes them look like the same investment.
7e7d0d0ab08c.sw: Hisa mbili kila moja hutoa mavuno ya 5%. Moja hulipa 2.50 kwa bei ya 50.00 baada ya miaka ya ongezeko thabiti. Nyingine ililipa 2.50 kwa bei iliyoshuka kutoka 100.00 hadi 50.00 katika miezi kumi na minane. Mavuno yanafanana na hali hazina chochote cha pamoja. Kutazama mavuno tu hufanya zionekane kama uwekezaji ule ule.

7e966fc13ea6.en: A common measure for comparing the value of different things.
7e966fc13ea6.sw: Kipimo cha pamoja cha kulinganisha thamani ya vitu tofauti.

7e969c72e7fb.en: Not quite — the dominant lever is position size, the fraction of the account risked per trade, ahead of the win rate.
7e969c72e7fb.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — lever kuu ni ukubwa wa nafasi, sehemu ya akaunti inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara, mbele ya kiwango cha ushindi.

7e9c59eff3cc.en: Elton and Gruber studied this in 1970, in the Review of Economics and Statistics (volume 52, pages 68 to 74), using dividends paid between April 1966 and March 1967. They found the price drop was significantly less than the dividend, on average — and argued the gap reflected tax, since dividends were then taxed more heavily than capital gains, so a dividend was worth less than its face value to the marginal holder.
7e9c59eff3cc.sw: Elton na Gruber walisoma hili mwaka 1970, katika Review of Economics and Statistics (juzuu 52, kurasa 68 hadi 74), wakitumia gawio lililolipwa kati ya Aprili 1966 na Machi 1967. Waligundua kushuka kwa bei kulikuwa kudogo kwa kiasi kikubwa kuliko gawio, kwa wastani — na wakahoji kwamba pengo lilionyesha kodi, kwa kuwa gawio wakati huo lilitozwa kodi zaidi kuliko faida za mtaji, hivyo gawio lilikuwa na thamani ndogo kuliko thamani yake ya uso kwa mwenye kushikilia wa pembeni.

7ee77e0ccac0.en: A pair combining two major currencies, with no USD involved.
7ee77e0ccac0.sw: Jozi linalounganisha sarafu mbili kuu, bila USD kuhusika.

7ef15ee9f6e5.en: Searching many possibilities for one that fits your data, then mistaking it for a real discovery.
7ef15ee9f6e5.sw: Kutafuta uwezekano mwingi kwa moja inayolingana na data yako, kisha kuikosea kuwa ugunduzi halisi.

7f79c3cbf0d9.en: Profit is an opinion shaped by accounting choices. Cash is a fact. That is why the three statements exist rather than one.
7f79c3cbf0d9.sw: Faida ni maoni yaliyoumbwa na chaguo za uhasibu. Fedha ni ukweli. Ndiyo sababu taarifa tatu zipo badala ya moja.

7f9f752031e7.en: Find the fact sheet for any broad index fund and locate the combined weight of its ten largest holdings. Write the figure down. Then decide honestly whether you would have chosen to put that proportion of your money into those ten companies as a deliberate decision. The rule made that choice for you, and the fact sheet is where you find out what it chose.
7f9f752031e7.sw: Tafuta karatasi ya taarifa ya index fund yoyote pana na upate uzito wa pamoja wa umiliki wake kumi mkubwa zaidi. Andika takwimu hiyo. Kisha amua kwa uaminifu kama ungechagua kuweka uwiano huo wa pesa zako katika kampuni hizo kumi kama uamuzi wa makusudi. Kanuni ilikufanyia chaguo hilo, na karatasi ya taarifa ndipo unapogundua ilichagua nini.

7fd1fa8c193f.en: What did the Nixon Shock actually announce?
7fd1fa8c193f.sw: Mshtuko wa Nixon ulitangaza nini hasa?

7fd5ecc3891d.en: What does fractional reserve banking actually allow a bank to do?
7fd5ecc3891d.sw: Benki ya akiba ya sehemu inairuhusu benki kufanya nini hasa?

7fe23216bdeb.en: A bank holding 100 gold coins but promising 500 IOUs can only cover a fraction of holders if they all show up at once.
7fe23216bdeb.sw: Benki inayoshikilia sarafu 100 za dhahabu lakini ikiahidi hati 500 za IOU inaweza kulipa sehemu tu ya wenye nazo kama wote watafika kwa wakati mmoja.

80530aa9028b.en: There's a long-standing hierarchy — sometimes called a "pecking order" — that determines which currency conventionally sits as the base when two major currencies are paired: the euro outranks the British pound, which outranks the Australian and New Zealand dollars, which outrank the U.S. dollar itself, which outranks the Canadian dollar, Swiss franc, and Japanese yen. That's why the market quotes EUR/USD and USD/CAD, but never USD/EUR or CAD/USD.
80530aa9028b.sw: Kuna daraja la muda mrefu — wakati mwingine huitwa "pecking order" — linaloamua ni sarafu ipi kwa kawaida hukaa kama msingi sarafu mbili kuu zinapowekwa pamoja: euro huizidi pauni ya Uingereza, ambayo huzidi dola za Australia na New Zealand, ambazo huzidi dola ya Marekani yenyewe, ambayo huzidi dola ya Kanada, faranga ya Uswisi, na yen ya Japani. Ndiyo maana soko hunukuu EUR/USD na USD/CAD, lakini kamwe si USD/EUR au CAD/USD.

80a3916699e2.en: Not quite — it's the opposite. Defending a fixed gold peg during a recession usually means tightening money, not loosening it.
80a3916699e2.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — ni kinyume chake. Kutetea kifungo thabiti cha dhahabu wakati wa mdororo kwa kawaida kunamaanisha kubana pesa, si kuzilegeza.

8120b6dc45c6.en: The tendency for many traders' stop-loss and take-profit orders to pile up at the same round-number price levels, making those levels act as real support and resistance.
8120b6dc45c6.sw: Mwelekeo wa maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit ya wafanyabiashara wengi kurundikana kwenye viwango vile vile vya bei za namba za mviringo, na kufanya viwango hivyo vitende kama msaada na upinzani halisi.

812cad3990ce.en: Central banks don't actually target any specific inflation rate
812cad3990ce.sw: Benki kuu hazilengi kiwango chochote mahususi cha mfumuko wa bei kwa kweli

816528008626.en: Free cash flow is about 10 million, so very little of the reported profit is genuinely available to owners
816528008626.sw: Mtiririko huru wa fedha ni takriban milioni 10, hivyo sehemu ndogo mno ya faida iliyoripotiwa inapatikana kweli kwa wamiliki

8180072c21f7.en: That word roughly is carrying real weight, and the honest version of this is more interesting than the tidy one.
8180072c21f7.sw: Neno hilo takriban linabeba uzito halisi, na toleo la uaminifu la hili linavutia zaidi kuliko lile safi.

81b7568fbe01.en: Two funds track the same index. The first charges 0.07% and lagged the index by 0.19% a year. The second charges 0.12% and lagged by 0.10%. The second is more expensive on the page and cheaper in reality, and only the tracking difference reveals it.
81b7568fbe01.sw: Fund mbili hufuatilia index ile ile. Ya kwanza hutoza 0.07% na ilikawia index kwa 0.19% kwa mwaka. Ya pili hutoza 0.12% na ilikawia kwa 0.10%. Ya pili ni ghali zaidi kwenye karatasi na nafuu zaidi kiuhalisia, na tofauti ya kufuatilia tu ndiyo hulionyesha.

81be167d149f.en: Recognizing a risk is too high relative to the benefit, and simply not taking the action. Example: skipping a major central bank announcement rather than holding a position through it.
81be167d149f.sw: Kutambua kwamba hatari ni kubwa mno ikilinganishwa na manufaa, na kutochukua kitendo hicho tu. Mfano: kuruka tangazo kuu la benki kuu badala ya kushikilia nafasi wakati wa tangazo hilo.

81fb3f9d5480.en: Every piece of that maps onto something you already know. Thin liquidity is the flip side of the bid-ask spread from Chapter 1, Lesson 4 — when few participants are willing to trade, prices move much further for a given order. The stop-loss cascade is the stop-out mechanics of Chapter 3, Lesson 2 at market scale: falling prices trigger stops, which become market sell orders, which push prices lower, which trigger more stops. And the timing is the mirror image of the economic-calendar discipline in Chapter 2, Lesson 4 — the market was fragile precisely because it was the hour when almost no one was trading.
81fb3f9d5480.sw: Kila kipande cha hicho kinaunganika na kitu unachokijua tayari. Ukwasi mdogo ni upande wa pili wa spread ya bid-ask kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 4 — washiriki wachache wanapokuwa tayari kufanya biashara, bei husogea mbali zaidi mno kwa agizo fulani. Mfululizo wa stop-loss ni utaratibu wa stop-out wa Sura ya 3, Somo la 2 kwa kipimo cha soko: bei zinazoshuka huanzisha stop, ambazo hukuwa maagizo ya soko ya kuuza, ambayo husukuma bei chini, ambayo huanzisha stop zaidi. Na muda ni kioo cha nidhamu ya kalenda ya kiuchumi katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 4 — soko lilikuwa dhaifu hasa kwa sababu ilikuwa saa ambayo karibu hakuna aliyekuwa akifanya biashara.

821422b441a1.en: This is also why a rate cut — or even a signal of future cuts — can weaken a currency. If the Fed unexpectedly holds rates low when markets expected a hike, the dollar often falls, because the anticipated demand boost doesn't arrive. In a pair like GBP/USD, a falling USD (the quote currency) pushes the pair up.
821422b441a1.sw: Hii pia ndiyo sababu kupunguza kiwango — au hata ishara ya kupunguza baadaye — kunaweza kudhoofisha sarafu. Kama Fed itashikilia viwango chini bila kutarajiwa wakati masoko yalitarajia kupanda, dola mara nyingi hushuka, kwa sababu ongezeko la mahitaji lililotarajiwa halifiki. Katika jozi kama GBP/USD, USD inayoshuka (sarafu ya bei) husukuma jozi juu.

82352ab54ab4.en: The construction is logical once you know the rule: the first two letters usually match the currency's country under a separate country-code standard (ISO 3166), and the third letter is typically the first letter of the currency's name. JPY breaks down as JP (Japan) + Y (Yen). CAD is CA (Canada) + D (Dollar).
82352ab54ab4.sw: Ujenzi ni wa kimantiki mara ukijua kanuni: herufi mbili za kwanza kwa kawaida hulingana na nchi ya sarafu chini ya kiwango tofauti cha misimbo ya nchi (ISO 3166), na herufi ya tatu kwa kawaida ni herufi ya kwanza ya jina la sarafu. JPY inagawanyika kama JP (Japan) + Y (Yen). CAD ni CA (Canada) + D (Dollar).

823bce3c4dd2.en: The probability that losses reduce an account past recovery; driven mainly by the fraction risked per trade.
823bce3c4dd2.sw: Uwezekano kwamba hasara hupunguza akaunti zaidi ya kupona; unaoendeshwa hasa na sehemu inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara.

824e3d93048d.en: You go long EUR/USD at 1.1000 with your stop at 1.0970, a 30-pip risk. That stop distance is your 1R. If you set your target at 1.1060 — 60 pips away, twice the stop distance — the trade is a 1:2 risk-to-reward. If price reaches the target you gain 2R; if it hits the stop you lose 1R.
824e3d93048d.sw: Unaenda long EUR/USD kwa 1.1000 ukiwa na stop yako kwa 1.0970, hatari ya pip 30. Umbali huo wa stop ni 1R yako. Kama utaweka lengo lako kwa 1.1060 — pip 60 mbali, mara mbili ya umbali wa stop — biashara ni hatari-kwa-tuzo ya 1:2. Kama bei itafikia lengo unapata 2R; kama itagonga stop unapoteza 1R.

8269083e6fee.en: The intuitive mean-reversion play: price touches the lower band (stretched low) → buy → exit at the middle band. Price touches the upper band (stretched high) → short → exit at the middle. Tighter bands (2 SD) give more frequent, earlier signals; wider bands (3 SD) give fewer, more extreme ones. This logic works best on instruments that genuinely oscillate around a mean — for example, currency pairs between similar, linked economies (CAD and AUD-style pairs), which tend to deviate and re-converge — and works badly on anything in a strong trend, where "stretched" just keeps stretching.
8269083e6fee.sw: Mchezo wa kueleweka wa kurudi kwa wastani: bei inagusa kanda ya chini (imenyooshwa chini) → nunua → toka kwenye kanda ya kati. Bei inagusa kanda ya juu (imenyooshwa juu) → fanya short → toka katikati. Kanda finyu (SD 2) hutoa ishara za mara kwa mara na za mapema zaidi; kanda pana (SD 3) hutoa chache na za kupindukia zaidi. Mantiki hii hufanya kazi vizuri zaidi kwenye vyombo vinavyoyumba kweli kuzunguka wastani — kwa mfano, jozi za sarafu kati ya uchumi unaofanana na uliounganishwa (jozi za mtindo wa CAD na AUD), ambazo huelekea kupotoka na kuungana tena — na hufanya kazi vibaya kwenye chochote kilicho katika mwelekeo mkali, ambapo "kunyooshwa" kunaendelea kunyooka tu.

828f27bcd505.en: Not quite — re-read the definitions. The technique behind a stop-loss caps a known risk rather than avoiding or transferring it.
828f27bcd505.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — soma tena maana. Mbinu iliyo nyuma ya stop-loss huweka kikomo cha hatari inayojulikana badala ya kuiepuka au kuihamisha.

82c1fe1d0bb8.en: What does the evidence say? One of the most-cited academic studies of technical analysis — Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), Journal of Finance — tested exactly these moving-average rules on nearly a century of Dow Jones data and found they showed genuine predictive ability. But the follow-up literature matters just as much: later research questioned how well those results survive transaction costs and the risk of data-snooping (testing many rules and reporting the ones that happened to work). Meanwhile the recent FX-specific study you met in Foundations Chapter 3 — Ghanem et al. (2024), 497 rules, 10 currencies, 22 years — found technical rules do significantly predict currency movements. The honest summary: crossovers are one of the few indicator families with real academic support, and also one where the support comes with genuine caveats. Use them as a tool, not a truth.
82c1fe1d0bb8.sw: Ushahidi unasema nini? Mojawapo ya tafiti za kitaaluma zinazonukuliwa zaidi za uchambuzi wa kiufundi — Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), Journal of Finance — ilijaribu kanuni hizi hizi za wastani unaosogea kwa karibu karne moja ya data ya Dow Jones na ikagundua zilionyesha uwezo halisi wa kutabiri. Lakini fasihi iliyofuata inahusika kwa kiasi kile kile: utafiti wa baadaye ulihoji jinsi matokeo hayo yanavyonusurika gharama za miamala na hatari ya kupekua data (kujaribu kanuni nyingi na kuripoti zile zilizobahatika kufanya kazi). Wakati huo huo utafiti wa hivi karibuni mahususi wa FX uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 3 ya Msingi — Ghanem et al. (2024), kanuni 497, sarafu 10, miaka 22 — uligundua kanuni za kiufundi hutabiri kwa kiasi kikubwa misogeo ya sarafu. Muhtasari wa uaminifu: mikatizo ni mojawapo ya familia chache za viashiria zenye uungwaji mkono halisi wa kitaaluma, na pia mojawapo ambapo uungwaji mkono huo unakuja na maonyo halisi. Zitumie kama zana, si ukweli.

82c2062ca3c0.en: True or False: a statistic repeated across many trading websites is more likely to be accurate because so many sources agree on it.
82c2062ca3c0.sw: Kweli au Uongo: takwimu inayorudiwa katika tovuti nyingi za biashara ina uwezekano mkubwa wa kuwa sahihi kwa sababu vyanzo vingi vinakubaliana nayo.

82cb6e41bec8.en: A tenth of a pip — finer modern pricing precision.
82cb6e41bec8.sw: Sehemu ya kumi ya pip — usahihi bora zaidi wa bei wa kisasa.

82dab2ac54bc.en: The lowest price anyone is currently willing to sell for.
82dab2ac54bc.sw: Bei ya chini zaidi ambayo mtu yeyote yuko tayari kuuzia sasa.

831ddc3446e6.en: The official institution that issues a country's currency and regulates its banks.
831ddc3446e6.sw: Taasisi rasmi inayotoa sarafu ya nchi na kudhibiti benki zake.

833c7d21deb3.en: True or False: professional traders typically use the full Kelly Criterion bet size because it's mathematically optimal.
833c7d21deb3.sw: Kweli au Uongo: wafanyabiashara wa kitaaluma kwa kawaida hutumia ukubwa kamili wa dau wa Kelly Criterion kwa sababu ni bora kihisabati.

8347c9565dc2.en: Not quite — the most active traders underperformed the market by over six points a year; the study ties the excessive trading to overconfidence.
8347c9565dc2.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — wafanyabiashara wenye shughuli zaidi walifanya vibaya kuliko soko kwa zaidi ya pointi sita kwa mwaka; utafiti unaunganisha biashara ya kupita kiasi na kujiamini kupita kiasi.

837dcf61c29b.en: The logic is genuinely intuitive: if the 20-period average falls below the 50-period average, the last 20 periods were worse than the last 50 — recent momentum has turned down relative to the bigger picture. The crossover marks that shift.
837dcf61c29b.sw: Mantiki ni ya kueleweka kweli: kama wastani wa vipindi 20 utashuka chini ya wastani wa vipindi 50, vipindi 20 vya mwisho vilikuwa vibaya kuliko 50 vya mwisho — kasi ya hivi karibuni imegeuka chini ikilinganishwa na picha kubwa. Mkatizo huashiria mabadiliko hayo.

83c94371cc6b.en: Diagram showing the interest-rate-to-currency transmission chain, hawkish vs dovish stances, and the academic complication from the forward premium puzzle
83c94371cc6b.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha mnyororo wa usambazaji kutoka kiwango cha riba hadi sarafu, misimamo ya hawkish dhidi ya dovish, na utata wa kitaaluma kutoka fumbo la malipo ya mbele

83da00b2d86d.en: Diagram of portfolio-level discipline — the research funnel narrowing many scanned ideas down to the few traded, the evidence that best-analysed ideas outperform by about 2.8 to 4.5 percent a year (Anton/Cohen/Polk) and that high Active Share backed by analysis outperforms (Cremers & Petajisto 2009), the rule to concentrate conviction but not risk, and post-trade review that judges the decision rather than the result
83da00b2d86d.sw: Mchoro wa nidhamu ya kiwango cha mkusanyiko — faneli ya utafiti ikipunguza mawazo mengi yaliyochunguzwa hadi machache yanayofanyiwa biashara, ushahidi kwamba mawazo yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi hufanya vizuri zaidi kwa takriban asilimia 2.8 hadi 4.5 kwa mwaka (Anton/Cohen/Polk) na kwamba Active Share kubwa inayoungwa mkono na uchambuzi hufanya vizuri zaidi (Cremers & Petajisto 2009), kanuni ya kujikita kwa uhakika lakini si hatari, na ukaguzi wa baada ya biashara unaohukumu uamuzi badala ya tokeo

83f3062df971.en: The 1944 international agreement under which most currencies were pegged to the U.S. dollar, while the dollar itself remained convertible to gold at a fixed rate.
83f3062df971.sw: Makubaliano ya kimataifa ya mwaka 1944 ambapo sarafu nyingi zilifungwa kwenye dola ya Marekani, huku dola yenyewe ikibaki inabadilishwa kuwa dhahabu kwa kiwango thabiti.

8420a1379931.en: "Dollar," "peso," and "franc" are used by many different, unrelated currencies — the peso alone belongs to Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, the Philippines, and several other countries, each a completely separate currency. A currency name is genuinely ambiguous. A three-letter ISO code is not — which is the entire reason the standard exists.
8420a1379931.sw: "Dola," "peso," na "faranga" hutumiwa na sarafu nyingi tofauti zisizohusiana — peso peke yake ni ya Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Kolombia, Ufilipino, na nchi nyingine kadhaa, kila moja ikiwa sarafu tofauti kabisa. Jina la sarafu lina utata kweli. Msimbo wa ISO wa herufi tatu hauna — ndiyo sababu yote ya kuwepo kwa kiwango hicho.

84274f973aed.en: Correct — at 1:2, break-even is 33.3%, so a 40% win rate is profitable (+0.2R per trade). At 1:1, break-even is 50%, so the same 40% win rate loses. The ratio, not the win rate, flips the outcome.
84274f973aed.sw: Sahihi — kwa 1:2, kulingana ni 33.3%, hivyo kiwango cha ushindi cha 40% kina faida (+0.2R kwa kila biashara). Kwa 1:1, kulingana ni 50%, hivyo kiwango kile kile cha ushindi cha 40% hupoteza. Uwiano, si kiwango cha ushindi, ndio hubadilisha tokeo.

84a3af0373f2.en: Risk management is what makes a good trader — not the ability to predict market direction.

8577d2a0797a.en: This sharpens the stop-loss from Chapter 3. A beginner puts a stop "far enough away to not get hit." A professional puts it exactly where the thesis breaks: below the support that the whole case rested on, or beyond the level that would mean the catalyst failed. If price reaches the invalidation level, you are not unlucky — you were wrong, and the stop is simply recording that.
8577d2a0797a.sw: Hii hunoa stop-loss kutoka Sura ya 3. Anayeanza huweka stop "mbali vya kutosha isigongwe." Mtaalamu huiweka hasa pale nadharia inapovunjika: chini ya msaada ambao hoja yote ilikaa juu yake, au zaidi ya kiwango ambacho kingemaanisha kichocheo kimeshindwa. Kama bei itafikia kiwango cha kuvunjika, huna bahati mbaya — ulikosea, na stop inarekodi hilo tu.

8582474da6b8.en: The first is a pre-trade checklist — a handful of yes-or-no questions you run before every entry. Did a planned setup actually trigger? Is the stop at a real invalidation level, placed as an order? Does the risk-to-reward clear my minimum? Is my size within my risk percentage? Am I trading a rule, or chasing? If any answer is no, there is no trade. The checklist catches mistakes in advance, while you can still not make them.
8582474da6b8.sw: Ya kwanza ni orodha ya ukaguzi ya kabla ya biashara — maswali machache ya ndiyo-au-hapana unayoyapitia kabla ya kila kuingia. Je, mpangilio uliopangwa ulianzishwa hasa? Je, stop iko kwenye kiwango halisi cha kuvunjika, imewekwa kama agizo? Je, hatari-kwa-tuzo inapita kiwango changu cha chini? Je, ukubwa wangu uko ndani ya asilimia yangu ya hatari? Je, ninafanya biashara ya kanuni, au ninafukuza? Kama jibu lolote ni hapana, hakuna biashara. Orodha ya ukaguzi hukamata makosa mapema, ukiwa bado unaweza kutoyafanya.

85d94ac53729.en: Most of the time, slippage is a minor, routine cost — a fraction of a pip here or there as prices move in the instant between your order and its execution. Academic research tracking real retail futures orders end-to-end, from submission to fill, found execution is generally fast and not systematically biased against retail traders, contrary to a common complaint that "the system" favors professionals.
85d94ac53729.sw: Mara nyingi, slippage ni gharama ndogo ya kawaida — sehemu ya pip hapa au pale bei zinaposogea katika kitambo kati ya agizo lako na utekelezaji wake. Utafiti wa kitaaluma unaofuatilia maagizo halisi ya rejareja ya futures kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho, kutoka kuwasilisha hadi kutimizwa, uligundua utekelezaji kwa ujumla ni wa haraka na hauna upendeleo wa kimfumo dhidi ya wafanyabiashara wa rejareja, kinyume na lalamiko la kawaida kwamba "mfumo" unapendelea wataalamu.

8649e42a1e89.en: The proportion of a company's earnings paid out as dividends. A ratio above 100% means the company is paying out more than it earned.
8649e42a1e89.sw: Uwiano wa mapato ya kampuni yanayolipwa kama gawio. Uwiano ulio juu ya 100% unamaanisha kampuni inalipa zaidi ya iliyopata.

8650ad7b6296.en: As you apply MTFA: always start on the highest timeframe, and if you catch yourself opening the 5-minute chart first, stop and go back up; if the higher timeframe disagrees with the trade you want, the correct action is no trade, not a smaller timeframe; fix your three timeframes before you start looking and don't change them mid-analysis to justify an entry; and notice that a better entry shrinks your stop distance — a direct, quantifiable benefit, not just a feeling.
8650ad7b6296.sw: Unapotumia MTFA: daima anza kwenye kipindi cha juu zaidi, na ukijikuta unafungua chati ya dakika 5 kwanza, simama na urudi juu; kama kipindi cha juu zaidi hakikubaliani na biashara unayoitaka, hatua sahihi ni kutokufanya biashara, si kipindi kidogo zaidi; weka vipindi vyako vitatu kabla hujaanza kutazama na usivibadilishe katikati ya uchambuzi ili kuhalalisha kuingia; na tambua kwamba kuingia bora hupunguza umbali wako wa stop — manufaa ya moja kwa moja yanayopimika, si hisia tu.

8695a1f4cba8.en: There is a third weighting method, less common but useful because it isolates what the other two are doing.
8695a1f4cba8.sw: Kuna mbinu ya tatu ya uzito, isiyo ya kawaida sana lakini yenye manufaa kwa sababu hutenga kile ambacho hizo mbili zinafanya.

86bd6cfa9ae4.en: Pip value in two steps, the three cases for a US-dollar account, and how the $10 shortcut mis-sizes a trade.
86bd6cfa9ae4.sw: Thamani ya pip kwa hatua mbili, kesi tatu kwa akaunti ya dola ya Marekani, na jinsi njia ya mkato ya $10 inavyopima biashara vibaya.

86c7d9c9f946.sw: Nadharia kwamba sarafu za viwango vya juu zinapaswa kudhoofika ili kufuta faida yao ya kiwango.

8726ce0451ac.en: Read the same pair across three timeframes in a fixed top-down order — direction, then setup, then entry — instead of shopping charts for the one that agrees with the trade you already want.
8726ce0451ac.sw: Soma jozi lile lile katika vipindi vitatu kwa mpangilio thabiti wa juu-kwenda-chini — mwelekeo, kisha mpangilio, kisha kuingia — badala ya kutafuta chati inayokubaliana na biashara ambayo tayari unaitaka.

872f304cf3d1.en: Chapter 4 returns to this with the full picture across a lifetime. For now the practical instruction is small: before buying any fund, find the expense ratio, and compare it to the alternatives that hold roughly the same thing. It is a two-minute check with a larger effect on your outcome than almost anything else you will do.
872f304cf3d1.sw: Sura ya 4 hurudi kwenye hili kwa picha kamili katika maisha yote. Kwa sasa maelekezo ya kivitendo ni madogo: kabla ya kununua fund yoyote, pata uwiano wa gharama, na ulinganishe na mbadala zinazoshikilia takriban kitu kile kile. Ni ukaguzi wa dakika mbili wenye athari kubwa juu ya tokeo lako kuliko karibu kitu chochote kingine utakachofanya.

87ee75ee581b.en: As you apply these tools, keep four checks in mind: Is the instrument actually ranging, or trending? The same signal means opposite things in the two regimes. When any tool invokes probability ("95% of price action stays inside the bands"), remember fat tails — markets break statistical containment far more often than the bell curve promises. With RSI, the signal isn't entering the extreme zone, it's exiting it. And when a level "works," ask why: genuine market structure, or many traders watching the same line? Both are tradeable, but the second can evaporate.
87ee75ee581b.sw: Unapotumia zana hizi, weka ukaguzi nne akilini: Je, chombo kiko kwenye ukanda hasa, au kina mwelekeo? Ishara ile ile inamaanisha vitu vya kinyume katika hali hizo mbili. Zana yoyote inapoita uwezekano ("95% ya shughuli ya bei hukaa ndani ya kanda"), kumbuka mikia minene — masoko huvunja kubebwa kwa takwimu mara nyingi zaidi kuliko mkunjo wa kengele unavyoahidi. Kwa RSI, ishara si kuingia kwenye kanda ya kupindukia, ni kutoka ndani yake. Na kiwango kinapo"fanya kazi," uliza kwa nini: muundo halisi wa soko, au wafanyabiashara wengi wanaotazama mstari ule ule? Vyote viwili vinaweza kufanyiwa biashara, lakini cha pili kinaweza kutoweka.

882234941a15.en: It is worth knowing what actually happens to people who do this seriously, rather than guessing. The evidence here is unusually good, because Taiwan's stock exchange gave researchers a complete record of every trade and every trader for years at a time — something no other market has published at that granularity.
882234941a15.sw: Inastahili kujua kinachotokea hasa kwa watu wanaofanya hivi kwa uzito, badala ya kukisia. Ushahidi hapa ni mzuri isivyo kawaida, kwa sababu soko la hisa la Taiwan liliwapa watafiti rekodi kamili ya kila biashara na kila mfanyabiashara kwa miaka kadhaa mfululizo — kitu ambacho hakuna soko lingine limekichapisha kwa undani huo.

8853bc3e683a.en: The win fraction needed to break even at a given ratio — equal to 1 / (1 + R).
8853bc3e683a.sw: Sehemu ya ushindi inayohitajika kulingana kwa uwiano fulani — sawa na 1 / (1 + R).

8922f00b9abd.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Matarajio hasi hutoka kwa muundo wa mchezo: matokeo 37 yanayowezekana yakilipa 35 kwa 1. Hakuna anachofanya mchezaji kinachobadilisha hilo, ambacho ndicho hasa kinachoutofautisha na kumiliki mali zenye tija.

8957f356203a.en: Step 2 — Medium-term chart: find the setup. Typically 4-hour or 1-hour. This is your main working chart, and it should roughly match how long you actually hold trades. You're looking for a setup that agrees with the direction established in Step 1. If nothing agrees, there is no trade — that's a valid, complete outcome.
8957f356203a.sw: Hatua 2 — Chati ya muda wa kati: pata mpangilio. Kwa kawaida ya saa 4 au saa 1. Hii ndiyo chati yako kuu ya kazi, na inapaswa kulingana kwa ujumla na muda unaoshikilia biashara hasa. Unatafuta mpangilio unaokubaliana na mwelekeo uliobainishwa katika Hatua 1. Kama hakuna kinachokubaliana, hakuna biashara — hilo ni tokeo halali na kamili.

89a7ebcb7304.sw: Mfululizo wa vilele vya chini zaidi na mabonde ya chini zaidi kwa muda.

89f01cb2e5d4.en: It is cleanest to measure both in the "R" unit from Foundations Chapter 2. Your risk on the trade — the stop distance, turned into money by the pip value and position size from Lessons 1 and 2 — is one R. A target twice as far away is two R; three times as far is three R.
89f01cb2e5d4.sw: Ni safi zaidi kupima vyote viwili kwa kipimo cha "R" kutoka Sura ya 2 ya Msingi. Hatari yako kwenye biashara — umbali wa stop, ukigeuzwa kuwa pesa kwa thamani ya pip na ukubwa wa nafasi kutoka Masomo 1 na 2 — ni R moja. Lengo lililo mbali mara mbili ni R mbili; mara tatu ni R tatu.

89fc4d6a960d.en: Be honest about the limit. "Best ideas" means best-analysed, not most strongly felt — the two are easy to confuse and it is the confusion this whole lesson exists to break. Evidence-backed factors are also not guarantees; they have long stretches of underperformance, which is exactly why you need several pillars and, still, the risk control of Chapter 3. A thesis raises your odds. It never removes the need to be sized to be wrong.
89fc4d6a960d.sw: Kuwa mwaminifu kuhusu kikomo. "Mawazo bora" inamaanisha yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi, si yanayohisiwa kwa nguvu zaidi — hizo mbili ni rahisi kuzichanganya na ni mkanganyiko huo ambao somo hili lote lipo kulivunja. Vipengele vinavyoungwa mkono na ushahidi pia si uhakika; vina vipindi virefu vya utendaji duni, ambayo ndiyo hasa sababu unahitaji nguzo kadhaa na, bado, udhibiti wa hatari wa Sura ya 3. Nadharia huongeza uwezekano wako. Kamwe haiondoi hitaji la kupimwa ili ukosee.

8a1784a8130d.en: A standardised annual cost figure for a fund, covering management and most operating costs. Also encountered as the total expense ratio, and broadly comparable to the American expense ratio.
8a1784a8130d.sw: Takwimu sanifu ya gharama ya kila mwaka kwa fund, inayohusu usimamizi na gharama nyingi za uendeshaji. Pia hukutana nayo kama uwiano wa jumla wa gharama, na inalinganika kwa upana na uwiano wa gharama wa Marekani.
