8cac4b1ecf3b.en: Two people put 1,000 into the same company on the same day. One buys shares. One lends the company 1,000 at 6% interest. Over five years the company does extremely well. The lender receives 60 a year and their 1,000 back — exactly what was agreed, and not a unit more. The shareholder receives whatever the residual has become, which may be far more, or nothing.
8cac4b1ecf3b.sw: Watu wawili huweka 1,000 kila mmoja katika kampuni ile ile siku ile ile. Mmoja hununua hisa. Mmoja huikopesha kampuni 1,000 kwa riba ya 6%. Katika miaka mitano kampuni hufanya vizuri sana. Mkopeshaji hupokea 60 kwa mwaka na 1,000 yake kurudi — hasa kile kilichokubaliwa, na si kipimo zaidi. Mwanahisa hupokea chochote mabaki yamekuwa, ambacho kinaweza kuwa zaidi mno, au bila kitu.

8ce01c206cd7.en: A company can increase its total profit while its profit per share falls, if it issued more shares along the way. It can also raise profit per share without the business improving at all, by buying shares back. Neither is dishonest, and both change the number most people quote without changing the business behind it.
8ce01c206cd7.sw: Kampuni inaweza kuongeza faida yake ya jumla huku faida yake kwa kila hisa ikishuka, kama ilitoa hisa nyingi zaidi njiani. Inaweza pia kupandisha faida kwa kila hisa bila biashara kuboreka kabisa, kwa kununua hisa tena. Hakuna kilicho cha udanganyifu, na vyote viwili hubadilisha namba ambayo watu wengi huinukuu bila kubadilisha biashara iliyo nyuma yake.

8ce23d656ede.en: The August 1971 announcement suspending the U.S. dollar's convertibility to gold, effectively ending the Bretton Woods system.

8cf0f5e3d313.en: So a share is an asymmetric instrument. Bounded loss, unbounded gain. That asymmetry is the single most important structural fact about equities, and it is what makes them behave so differently from the currency pairs in the Forex track, where both sides of a position are open-ended.

Kutokuwa na usawa huko ndio ukweli muhimu zaidi wa kimuundo kuhusu hisa, na ndicho kinachozifanya zitende tofauti sana na jozi za sarafu katika njia ya Forex, ambapo pande zote mbili za nafasi ziko wazi.

8d194b45879a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — tokeo linahusu mawazo yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi, si yanayohisiwa kwa nguvu zaidi. Linahoji ukamilifu, si kujiamini.

8d5285e71d60.en: Correct. The creation and redemption mechanism turns the gap into an arbitrage opportunity, and pursuing it adds ETF supply and underlying demand until the gap closes. Nobody sets the price by decree — the profit motive does the work. Note that this weakens when the underlying is hard to trade, which is when premiums and discounts widen.
8d5285e71d60.sw: Sahihi. Utaratibu wa kuunda na kukomboa hugeuza pengo kuwa fursa ya arbitrage, na kuifukuza huongeza ugavi wa ETF na mahitaji ya msingi hadi pengo lifungwe. Hakuna anayeweka bei kwa amri — lengo la faida hufanya kazi. Tambua kwamba hii hudhoofika msingi unapokuwa mgumu kufanyiwa biashara, ambako ndipo malipo ya ziada na punguzo hupanuka.

8db7d732ea5d.en: ESMA's own 2018 analysis of national regulators' data found that 74–89% of retail CFD accounts lose money, with average losses per client ranging from €1,600 to €29,000. That statistic — not just general caution — is the documented basis for the EU's leverage restriction.
8db7d732ea5d.sw: Uchambuzi wa ESMA wenyewe wa mwaka 2018 wa data ya wadhibiti wa kitaifa uligundua kwamba 74–89% ya akaunti za CFD za rejareja hupoteza pesa, ambapo hasara za wastani kwa kila mteja zilianzia €1,600 hadi €29,000. Takwimu hiyo — si tahadhari ya jumla tu — ndio msingi ulioandikwa wa vikwazo vya leverage vya Umoja wa Ulaya.

8de8169aa762.en: Look back at the list and a single pattern appears. Almost every mistake is the same failure wearing different clothes: acting on feeling or hope instead of a pre-decided, evidence-checked rule. That is precisely the spine this whole course was built on — risk management ahead of prediction, verifying a claim before trusting it, remembering that a textbook rule is an instinct rather than a law, and sizing so that fat-tailed surprises cannot end you. The common mistakes are just those four principles, violated.
8de8169aa762.sw: Tazama nyuma orodha na mtindo mmoja hujitokeza. Karibu kila kosa ni kushindwa kule kule kukiwa kumevaa nguo tofauti: kutenda kwa hisia au matumaini badala ya kanuni iliyoamuliwa mapema na kukaguliwa kwa ushahidi. Hiyo ndiyo hasa mgongo ambao kozi hii nzima ilijengwa juu yake — usimamizi wa hatari mbele ya utabiri, kuthibitisha dai kabla ya kuliamini, kukumbuka kwamba kanuni ya kitabu ni silika badala ya sheria, na kupima ili mishangao ya mikia minene isiweze kukumaliza. Makosa ya kawaida ni kanuni hizo nne tu, zikivunjwa.

8e1ddb18a46c.en: The order types side by side, plus the 2015 SNB case study showing when a stop-loss fails to protect.
8e1ddb18a46c.sw: Aina za maagizo kando kwa kando, pamoja na uchunguzi wa tukio la SNB la mwaka 2015 unaoonyesha stop-loss inaposhindwa kulinda.

8e3d21920b3a.en: In USD/MXN, USD is the base currency and MXN is the quote currency. A quote of 1 USD/MXN = 20 means one U.S. dollar costs 20 Mexican pesos. The base currency always answers "how much is one of this worth?" — the quote currency is the answer.
8e3d21920b3a.sw: Katika USD/MXN, USD ni sarafu ya msingi na MXN ni sarafu ya bei. Nukuu ya 1 USD/MXN = 20 inamaanisha dola moja ya Marekani inagharimu peso 20 za Mexico. Sarafu ya msingi daima hujibu "moja ya hii ina thamani gani?" — sarafu ya bei ndiyo jibu.

8e41997364fa.en: No — it must be converted from yen, and at a rate near 150 it is about 6.67 dollars
8e41997364fa.sw: Hapana — lazima ibadilishwe kutoka yen, na kwa kiwango karibu na 150 ni takriban dola 6.67

8e620aa82b92.en: Choosing the medium timeframe first, then long ≈ ×4 and short ≈ ÷4.
8e620aa82b92.sw: Kuchagua kipindi cha kati kwanza, kisha kirefu ≈ ×4 na kifupi ≈ ÷4.

8e658e5010a6.en: A guaranteed return set by central banks
8e658e5010a6.sw: Faida ya uhakika iliyowekwa na benki kuu

8e74fca1990d.en: Timeframe-shopping is that exact error in miniature: you search a set of charts for the one that fits your bias, then treat it as confirmation. The discipline of a fixed, pre-chosen sequence exists precisely to stop you from doing this.
8e74fca1990d.sw: Kutafuta vipindi ni kosa hilo hasa kwa udogo: unatafuta katika seti ya chati ile inayolingana na upendeleo wako, kisha unaichukulia kama uthibitisho. Nidhamu ya mfululizo thabiti uliochaguliwa mapema ipo hasa kukuzuia kufanya hivi.

8eeb6762e83b.en: Invalidation, reward-to-risk, the pre-mortem, and writing the whole exit before the entry.
8eeb6762e83b.sw: Kuvunjika, tuzo-kwa-hatari, pre-mortem, na kuandika kutoka kote kabla ya kuingia.

8ef17c83ee36.en: Correct — USD/CNY reached 8.1% market share, edging past GBP/USD at 7.6% — a real, current shift reflecting the yuan's rising role in global trade.
8ef17c83ee36.sw: Sahihi — USD/CNY lilifikia sehemu ya soko ya 8.1%, likipita GBP/USD kwa 7.6% — mabadiliko halisi ya sasa yanayoakisi nafasi inayopanda ya yuan katika biashara ya kimataifa.

8f386aa04dc7.en: This is where casual explanations (including informal trading lectures) often blur three genuinely distinct terms.
8f386aa04dc7.sw: Hapa ndipo maelezo ya kawaida (ikiwemo mihadhara isiyo rasmi ya biashara) mara nyingi huchanganya maneno matatu yaliyo tofauti kweli.

8f899a489212.en: Overrating your own judgement — the driver behind overtrading and its cost to returns.
8f899a489212.sw: Kukadiria kupita kiasi hukumu yako mwenyewe — kichocheo nyuma ya kufanya biashara kupita kiasi na gharama yake kwa faida.

8f9c7bea3f7a.en: The rate a central bank sets as its primary policy tool. It ripples through the whole economy: it's effectively the price of money, shaping what banks charge for loans and pay on savings.
8f9c7bea3f7a.sw: Kiwango ambacho benki kuu huiweka kama zana yake kuu ya sera. Hupenya uchumi mzima: kwa hakika ni bei ya pesa, ikitengeneza kile benki hutoza kwa mikopo na kulipa kwa akiba.

8fcd712a24fe.en: Securities lending income can offset a fund's costs, which sounds purely good. It introduces a counterparty relationship the fund did not otherwise have, and the borrower is frequently a short seller. The relevant questions are what proportion of the fund can be lent, how much of the fee is returned to investors rather than kept by the manager, and what collateral is held. All three are in the documentation and none are in the advertisement.
8fcd712a24fe.sw: Mapato ya kukopesha dhamana yanaweza kupunguza gharama za fund, jambo linalosikika zuri kabisa. Huanzisha uhusiano wa mshirika ambao fund haikuwa nao vinginevyo, na mkopaji mara nyingi ni muuzaji wa short. Maswali yanayohusika ni sehemu gani ya fund inaweza kukopeshwa, kiasi gani cha ada hurudishwa kwa wawekezaji badala ya kuwekwa na msimamizi, na dhamana gani inashikiliwa. Vyote vitatu viko katika nyaraka na hakuna kilicho katika tangazo.

8ff94cbda616.en: On a four-decimal pair, one pip is 0.0001. A standard lot is 100,000 units. So 0.0001 x 100,000 = 10 units of the quote currency per pip. On a yen pair, one pip is 0.01, so 0.01 x 100,000 = 1,000 units of the quote currency (yen) per pip. Notice this is denominated in the quote currency, not dollars.
8ff94cbda616.sw: Kwenye jozi la desimali nne, pip moja ni 0.0001. Lot sanifu ni vipimo 100,000. Hivyo 0.0001 x 100,000 = vipimo 10 vya sarafu ya bei kwa kila pip. Kwenye jozi la yen, pip moja ni 0.01, hivyo 0.01 x 100,000 = vipimo 1,000 vya sarafu ya bei (yen) kwa kila pip. Tambua hii imeelezwa kwa sarafu ya bei, si dola.

904bbef454ee.en: One practical note, stated plainly and only once. Running this full six-pillar process on a live trade — researching each pillar, verifying the evidence, sizing and reviewing — takes hours and a skill built over time. For someone who wants the output of this framework on a specific trade without building that skill themselves, a completed trade thesis is something the Scere Training platform offers as a service. The framework above is taught here in full and holds nothing back; the service simply exists for people who want the result without the hours. Everything you need to do it yourself is in this course.
904bbef454ee.sw: Dokezo moja la kivitendo, likielezwa wazi na mara moja tu. Kuendesha mchakato huu kamili wa nguzo sita kwenye biashara hai — kutafiti kila nguzo, kuthibitisha ushahidi, kupima na kupitia — huchukua saa nyingi na ustadi uliojengwa kwa muda. Kwa mtu anayetaka tokeo la mfumo huu kwenye biashara mahususi bila kujenga ustadi huo mwenyewe, nadharia ya biashara iliyokamilika ni kitu ambacho jukwaa la Scere Training hutoa kama huduma. Mfumo hapo juu unafundishwa hapa kikamilifu na hauzuii chochote; huduma ipo tu kwa watu wanaotaka tokeo bila saa nyingi. Kila unachohitaji kufanya mwenyewe kiko katika kozi hii.

9053127dd66a.en: A trade's result expressed as a multiple of the amount risked on it. A trade that makes twice its risk is +2R; a trade stopped out for its full risk is -1R. Every trade, on any pair, in any size, collapses to a single R number.
9053127dd66a.sw: Tokeo la biashara likielezwa kama kizidishi cha kiasi kilichohatarishwa juu yake. Biashara inayopata mara mbili ya hatari yake ni +2R; biashara iliyosimamishwa kwa hatari yake yote ni -1R. Kila biashara, kwenye jozi lolote, kwa ukubwa wowote, huanguka kuwa namba moja ya R.

90b842ad9b54.en: A pair with a wide spread

90e3827e1cb9.en: Neither figure is the truth on its own. What you are looking for is whether they move together over time. Profit rising while operating cash flow stagnates, year after year, is the pattern worth understanding rather than dismissing.
90e3827e1cb9.sw: Hakuna takwimu iliyo ukweli peke yake. Unachotafuta ni kama zinasogea pamoja kwa muda. Faida ikipanda ilhali mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli unasimama, mwaka baada ya mwaka, ndio mtindo unaostahili kueleweka badala ya kupuuzwa.

9118ea020037.en: The spread isn't only about adverse selection, though — the broader research on this (often traced to work by Hans Stoll and others) identifies a few real components stacked together: order-processing costs (the genuine overhead of running the infrastructure that executes trades), inventory risk (a market maker holding currency exposure they didn't necessarily want, and pricing in the risk of holding it), and adverse selection (the Glosten-Milgrom effect above). The spread you see quoted is these forces combined into one number.
9118ea020037.sw: Hata hivyo spread haihusu uteuzi mbaya peke yake — utafiti mpana juu ya hili (mara nyingi unaofuatiliwa hadi kazi ya Hans Stoll na wengine) hubainisha vipengele halisi vichache vilivyorundikwa pamoja: gharama za kushughulikia maagizo (gharama halisi ya kuendesha miundombinu inayotekeleza biashara), hatari ya hifadhi (mtengeneza-soko anayeshikilia uwazi wa sarafu ambao si lazima aliutaka, na kuweka bei ya hatari ya kuushikilia), na uteuzi mbaya (athari ya Glosten-Milgrom hapo juu). Spread unayoiona ikinukuliwa ni nguvu hizi zilizounganishwa kuwa namba moja.

912377c4480f.en: As you weigh a signal, run three checks: Is the market trending or ranging right now? Crossover signals earn their keep in trends and bleed in ranges. When one indicator "confirms" another, are they actually independent, or two calculations of the same thing (like MACD and an MA crossover)? And would you take this signal if the indicator weren't there — can you see the shift in raw price? If not, be suspicious.
912377c4480f.sw: Unapopima ishara, fanya ukaguzi mitatu: Je, soko lina mwelekeo au liko kwenye ukanda sasa hivi? Ishara za mkatizo hujilipia katika mielekeo na hupoteza katika kanda. Kiashiria kimoja kinapo"thibitisha" kingine, je, kwa kweli vinajitegemea, au ni hesabu mbili za kitu kile kile (kama MACD na mkatizo wa MA)? Na je, ungechukua ishara hii kama kiashiria kisingekuwepo — unaweza kuona mabadiliko katika bei ghafi? Kama sivyo, kuwa na shaka.

91533a101760.en: That losing trade in the middle is called a whipsaw, and it is not a malfunction — it's the known cost of the method. Crossovers work when price trends and bleed small losses when price moves sideways, because a flat market makes the two averages braid around each other, generating false signals. No setting eliminates this; risk management (Chapter 1, Lessons 5–7) is what makes the losses survivable and small relative to the trending wins.
91533a101760.sw: Biashara ile ya hasara katikati inaitwa whipsaw, na si hitilafu — ni gharama inayojulikana ya mbinu hiyo. Mikatizo hufanya kazi bei inapoelekea na hupoteza hasara ndogo bei inaposogea kando, kwa sababu soko tulivu hufanya wastani hizo mbili zisukane, zikizalisha ishara za uongo. Hakuna mpangilio unaoondoa hili; usimamizi wa hatari (Sura ya 1, Masomo 5–7) ndicho kinachofanya hasara ziweze kunusurika na ziwe ndogo ikilinganishwa na ushindi wa mwelekeo.

91608da8f9a0.en: The return from price change and dividends together, with dividends assumed reinvested. Price return counts only the price change.
91608da8f9a0.sw: Faida kutoka mabadiliko ya bei na gawio kwa pamoja, gawio likidhaniwa limewekezwa tena. Faida ya bei huhesabu mabadiliko ya bei tu.

9172ccf70fff.en: Correct — this is the naive diversification trap. Highly correlated holdings can behave like one concentrated bet, no matter how many there are.
9172ccf70fff.sw: Sahihi — huu ndio mtego wa kusambaza kwa kijinga. Umiliki wenye uwiano mkubwa unaweza kutenda kama dau moja lililojikita, bila kujali ni mingapi.

917a41b464c4.en: Correct. The average return is about 0.973 units for every unit staked, a loss of roughly 2.7% per spin. It is a property of the wheel, not of the player, which is why no amount of skill or discipline changes it.
917a41b464c4.sw: Sahihi. Faida ya wastani ni takriban vipimo 0.973 kwa kila kipimo kilichowekwa, hasara ya takriban 2.7% kwa kila mzunguko. Ni sifa ya gurudumu, si ya mchezaji, ndiyo sababu hakuna kiasi cha ustadi au nidhamu kinachobadilisha hilo.

917dc4c57148.en: Major Currencies, Major Pairs & Cross Pairs
917dc4c57148.sw: Sarafu Kuu, Jozi Kuu na Jozi za Kuvuka

91a54ee7e0a5.en: Positioning and sentiment — is everyone already on your side? A trade the whole market has piled into is crowded, and crowded trades unwind violently (the 2008 carry unwind, Chapter 5, Lesson 2). Extreme positioning is a reason for caution, sometimes a reason to fade the crowd.
91a54ee7e0a5.sw: Nafasi za soko na hisia — je, kila mtu tayari yuko upande wako? Biashara ambayo soko zima limerundikana ndani yake ina msongamano, na biashara zenye msongamano huvunjika kwa nguvu (kuvunjika kwa carry kwa mwaka 2008, Sura ya 5, Somo la 2). Nafasi za soko za kupindukia ni sababu ya tahadhari, wakati mwingine sababu ya kwenda kinyume na umati.

91a5634c1760.en: A thesis you cannot disprove is not a thesis — it is a belief. The professional's first move after building the six-pillar case (Lesson 1) is to ask the opposite question: what would have to happen for this to be wrong?
91a5634c1760.sw: Nadharia usiyoweza kuithibitisha kuwa batili si nadharia — ni imani. Hatua ya kwanza ya mtaalamu baada ya kujenga hoja ya nguzo sita (Somo la 1) ni kuuliza swali la kinyume: ni nini kingelazimika kutokea ili hii iwe batili?

91d7397faf42.en: The same tension keeps showing up: a disciplined system builds trust, but that discipline can be too rigid in a crisis. You'll see this exact trade-off again with the gold standard itself in the next lesson.
91d7397faf42.sw: Mvutano ule ule unaendelea kujitokeza: mfumo wenye nidhamu hujenga imani, lakini nidhamu hiyo inaweza kuwa ngumu mno wakati wa janga. Utaona mchanganyiko huu hasa tena na kiwango cha dhahabu chenyewe katika somo lijalo.

91e0e60cedf6.en: A technical indicator is computed entirely from price, so it can only make a pattern already in the chart easier to see — never reveal something the price doesn't already contain.
91e0e60cedf6.sw: Kiashiria cha kiufundi hukokotolewa kabisa kutoka bei, hivyo kinaweza tu kurahisisha kuona mtindo ambao tayari uko kwenye chati — kamwe hakiwezi kufichua kitu ambacho bei haina tayari.

920ff9cd98e3.en: This is the sign flip that defines the carry trade: the position pays small, steady, positive returns for a long time, then delivers a large, sudden, correlated loss. And the losses hit everyone in the trade at once, because they are all forced to unwind together — precisely when markets are already in crisis and least forgiving.
920ff9cd98e3.sw: Hii ndiyo mabadiliko ya ishara yanayofafanua carry trade: nafasi hulipa faida ndogo, thabiti, chanya kwa muda mrefu, kisha hutoa hasara kubwa, ya ghafla, yenye uwiano. Na hasara hugonga kila mtu aliye katika biashara kwa pamoja, kwa sababu wote wanalazimika kuvunja kwa pamoja — hasa wakati masoko tayari yako kwenye janga na hayasamehe hata kidogo.

9216a649fed8.en: To assume the trade has already failed and generate the reasons, surfacing risks that optimism hides
9216a649fed8.sw: Kudhania biashara tayari imeshindwa na kuzalisha sababu, ikifichua hatari ambazo matumaini huzificha

921f8b985d8d.en: An activity where all participants can gain together, because value is created outside the transactions.
921f8b985d8d.sw: Shughuli ambapo washiriki wote wanaweza kupata faida pamoja, kwa sababu thamani inaundwa nje ya miamala.

92471ca69388.en: A single timeframe gives you an incomplete picture by construction. A 5-minute chart cannot show you a three-month trend, and a weekly chart cannot show you a good entry price. These aren't competing views to pick between — they're different questions, and you need all of them answered in the right order.
92471ca69388.sw: Kipindi kimoja hukupa picha isiyokamilika kwa muundo wake. Chati ya dakika 5 haiwezi kukuonyesha mwelekeo wa miezi mitatu, na chati ya wiki haiwezi kukuonyesha bei nzuri ya kuingia. Hizi si mitazamo inayoshindana ya kuchagua kati yake — ni maswali tofauti, na unahitaji yote yajibiwe kwa mpangilio sahihi.

92a05d674f13.en: According to the BIS report, what best explains the severity of the 2016 sterling flash crash?
92a05d674f13.sw: Kwa mujibu wa ripoti ya BIS, ni nini kinachoeleza vizuri zaidi ukali wa anguko la ghafla la pauni la mwaka 2016?

92a30e04645f.en: You lose 0.20 per share — you bought at the ask and sold at the bid
92a30e04645f.sw: Unapoteza 0.20 kwa kila hisa — ulinunua kwa ask na kuuza kwa bid

92e32bf741aa.en: You size a EUR/GBP trade using a 10-dollar pip value, but the true pip value is 12.70 dollars. Compared with your intended 1% risk, what actually happens?
92e32bf741aa.sw: Unapima biashara ya EUR/GBP ukitumia thamani ya pip ya dola 10, lakini thamani halisi ya pip ni dola 12.70. Ikilinganishwa na hatari yako uliyokusudia ya 1%, kinatokea nini hasa?

92eb39b11dd6.en: Correct — same market and period, yet the most active traders underperformed by more than six percentage points a year. The study attributes the excessive trading to overconfidence.
92eb39b11dd6.sw: Sahihi — soko lile lile na kipindi kile kile, hata hivyo wafanyabiashara wenye shughuli zaidi walifanya vibaya kwa zaidi ya pointi sita za asilimia kwa mwaka. Utafiti unahusisha biashara ya kupita kiasi na kujiamini kupita kiasi.

9329dae88133.en: Not quite. Paying out more than you earn is not a sign of strength. The shortfall must be funded from cash reserves, borrowing or asset sales, and each of those has a limit — which is why a very high yield is often a forecast of a cut.
9329dae88133.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kulipa zaidi ya unavyopata si ishara ya nguvu. Upungufu lazima ufadhiliwe kutoka akiba za fedha, kukopa au kuuza mali, na kila kimoja kina kikomo — ndiyo sababu mavuno makubwa mno mara nyingi ni utabiri wa kupunguzwa.

932b320bedef.en: A system wins 60% of trades, but its average win is 80 dollars and its average loss is 150 dollars. What is its expectancy per trade?
932b320bedef.sw: Mfumo hushinda 60% ya biashara, lakini ushindi wake wa wastani ni dola 80 na hasara yake ya wastani ni dola 150. Matarajio yake kwa kila biashara ni yapi?

936cb39b4106.en: Correct — the move was nearly unpredictable, so ruin was not about direction. It was about size: over-leveraged accounts had no cushion for a gap that large, and some went negative.
936cb39b4106.sw: Sahihi — msogeo ulikuwa karibu hautabiriki, hivyo uharibifu haukuhusu mwelekeo. Ulihusu ukubwa: akaunti zenye leverage kubwa mno hazikuwa na mto wa kuruka kukubwa hivyo, na baadhi zikawa hasi.

93b303548827.en: A strategy of borrowing (or selling) a low-interest-rate currency to buy a high-interest-rate one, aiming to pocket the interest rate difference — provided the exchange rate doesn't move enough to wipe out that gain.
93b303548827.sw: Mkakati wa kukopa (au kuuza) sarafu ya kiwango cha chini cha riba ili kununua ya kiwango cha juu, ukilenga kuweka mfukoni tofauti ya kiwango cha riba — mradi kiwango cha ubadilishaji hakisogei vya kutosha kufuta faida hiyo.

93da7f3bcb45.en: Correct — under fixed pegs there wasn't much to actively trade. Once rates floated freely after 1973, currency values became a live, moving target — which is exactly what created the modern forex market.
93da7f3bcb45.sw: Sahihi — chini ya vifungo thabiti hakukuwa na kitu kingi cha kufanyia biashara kwa bidii. Mara viwango vilipoelea kwa uhuru baada ya 1973, thamani za sarafu zikawa lengo hai, linalosogea — ambalo ndilo hasa lililounda soko la kisasa la forex.

93f05db43b9a.en: Correct — that's all a crossover is: recent average prices underperforming the longer-window average. It's read as a bearish shift, but it guarantees nothing.
93f05db43b9a.sw: Sahihi — hicho ndicho tu mkatizo ulivyo: bei za wastani za hivi karibuni kufanya vibaya kuliko wastani wa dirisha refu zaidi. Husomwa kama mabadiliko ya kushuka, lakini haihakikishi chochote.

940f8c28654d.en: That study is on stock investors, and it is worth being honest about that — but the mechanism transfers directly, and forex makes it worse. Every trade pays the bid-ask spread (Chapter 1, Lesson 4), so more trades means more guaranteed cost before you are even right or wrong. Add leverage (Chapter 3, Lesson 2), and the damage from acting too often compounds faster than it would in a plain stock account.
940f8c28654d.sw: Utafiti huo ni juu ya wawekezaji wa hisa, na inastahili kuwa mwaminifu kuhusu hilo — lakini utaratibu huhamishika moja kwa moja, na forex huufanya kuwa mbaya zaidi. Kila biashara hulipa spread ya bid-ask (Sura ya 1, Somo la 4), hivyo biashara nyingi zaidi inamaanisha gharama zaidi ya uhakika kabla hata hujawa sahihi au si sahihi. Ongeza leverage (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2), na madhara ya kutenda mara nyingi mno hujikusanya kwa kasi zaidi kuliko yangefanya katika akaunti ya kawaida ya hisa.

941020b5475a.en: Not quite — a pre-mortem assumes the trade already failed and lists why, surfacing risks that optimism about your own idea hides.
941020b5475a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — pre-mortem hudhania biashara tayari imeshindwa na huorodhesha kwa nini, ikifichua hatari ambazo matumaini kuhusu wazo lako mwenyewe huzificha.

943e73ab7573.en: True or False: Anton, Cohen and Polk's "best ideas" finding shows that traders should simply act more confidently.
943e73ab7573.sw: Kweli au Uongo: tokeo la "mawazo bora" la Anton, Cohen na Polk linaonyesha kwamba wafanyabiashara wanapaswa kutenda kwa kujiamini zaidi tu.

9440c90feb1f.en: The dividend divided by the share price. Rises when the price falls, which is often why it is high.
9440c90feb1f.sw: Gawio kugawanywa kwa bei ya hisa. Hupanda bei inaposhuka, ambayo mara nyingi ndiyo sababu yako makubwa.

9443c1639ff4.en: The exchange of shares for money after a trade is agreed — T+1 in the United States since 28 May 2024.
9443c1639ff4.sw: Kubadilishana hisa kwa pesa baada ya biashara kukubaliwa — T+1 nchini Marekani tangu 28 Mei 2024.

94597b958bee.en: Take the same 50,000 dollar position, at the same 50:1 broker leverage, on two different accounts. On the 2,000 dollar account above, effective leverage is 50,000 / 2,000 = 25:1, and you saw the margin call arrive after just 200 pips. On a 10,000 dollar account, the identical position is only 50,000 / 10,000 = 5:1 effective leverage — and now the margin call does not arrive until a floating loss of 9,000 dollars, an 18% move of about 1,800 pips. Same broker, same leverage cap, same trade. One account dies at 200 pips; the other survives to 1,800. The only difference is how much of the account was committed.
94597b958bee.sw: Chukua nafasi ile ile ya dola 50,000, kwa leverage ile ile ya broker ya 50:1, kwenye akaunti mbili tofauti. Kwenye akaunti ya dola 2,000 hapo juu, leverage halisi ni 50,000 / 2,000 = 25:1, na uliona wito wa margin ukifika baada ya pip 200 tu. Kwenye akaunti ya dola 10,000, nafasi ile ile ni leverage halisi ya 50,000 / 10,000 = 5:1 tu — na sasa wito wa margin haufiki hadi hasara inayoelea ya dola 9,000, msogeo wa 18% wa takriban pip 1,800. Broker yule yule, kikomo kile kile cha leverage, biashara ile ile. Akaunti moja hufa kwa pip 200; nyingine hunusurika hadi 1,800. Tofauti pekee ni kiasi gani cha akaunti kilichojitolewa.

94607c525a85.en: True or False: the broker's stop-out level is a guaranteed floor, so your account can never go below it.

9467191e5fea.en: Receivables growing considerably faster than revenue is one of the oldest warning signs in company analysis. It can be ordinary growth in a business that bills before it collects. 94831bf7817b.en: End on an honest note, because the course would not be worth much otherwise. Even doing all of this correctly, most retail accounts still lose money — trading is difficult, and nothing here guarantees a profit. What a disciplined process can do is remove the self-inflicted losses: the blown accounts from over-leverage, the giving-back from the disposition effect, the bleed from overtrading, the scams. Take those away, and you are left facing only the market's real difficulty, instead of your own avoidable errors. That is a far better place to stand than where most beginners start.

The shareholders were wiped out while the lenders were merely worried.

992115660381.en: One honest detail worth knowing: the 50% level isn't a Fibonacci ratio at all. (The ratios do have genuinely elegant mathematical relationships — √0.382 ≈ 0.618, √0.618 ≈ 0.786 — which is part of the tool's aesthetic appeal.)

If trading were only those things, a careful beginner would do fine. Most accounts are not lost to bad arithmetic, though. They are lost to good rules abandoned under emotion.
9b9aa072a26a.sw: Sura ya 1 hadi 3 zilikupa utaratibu na hisabati: jozi na pip, upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi, margin, uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo. Kama biashara ingekuwa mambo hayo tu, anayeanza kwa makini angefanya vizuri. Hata hivyo akaunti nyingi hazipotei kwa hesabu mbaya. Zinapotea kwa kanuni nzuri zilizoachwa chini ya hisia.

9ba84f70cfed.en: According to the RSI discipline in this lesson, when is the higher-quality moment to buy an oversold currency?
9ba84f70cfed.sw: Kwa mujibu wa nidhamu ya RSI katika somo hili, ni wakati gani wenye ubora zaidi wa kununua sarafu iliyouzwa kupita kiasi?

9c11746981c0.en: A broker's demand for additional funds, or automatic closure of positions, when a losing trade pushes margin level down to a critical threshold.
9c11746981c0.sw: Dai la broker la fedha za ziada, au kufungwa kwa nafasi kiotomatiki, biashara ya hasara inaposukuma kiwango cha margin chini hadi kizingiti muhimu.

9c36ea848228.en: Everything in this chapter so far — moving averages, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Fibonacci — has been technical analysis: reading price itself. This lesson introduces the opposite lens.
9c36ea848228.sw: Kila kitu katika sura hii hadi sasa — wastani unaosogea, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Fibonacci — kimekuwa uchambuzi wa kiufundi: kusoma bei yenyewe. Somo hili linaanzisha lenzi ya kinyume.

9c3937eb59ec.en: The order is cancelled because 45 never traded
9c3937eb59ec.sw: Agizo hufutwa kwa sababu 45 haikufanyiwa biashara kamwe

9c478e28d1e1.en: Profit is an opinion shaped by accounting choices. Cash is a fact. That is why there are three statements.
9c478e28d1e1.sw: Faida ni maoni yaliyoumbwa na chaguo za uhasibu. Fedha ni ukweli. Ndiyo sababu kuna taarifa tatu.

9c49e7ac5356.en: It falls by more than 10%, because the residual absorbs the whole shortfall
9c49e7ac5356.sw: Hushuka kwa zaidi ya 10%, kwa sababu mabaki hufyonza upungufu wote

9cb228d1f3fa.en: True or False: the best traders are the ones who predict market direction correctly most often.
9cb228d1f3fa.sw: Kweli au Uongo: wafanyabiashara bora ni wale wanaotabiri mwelekeo wa soko kwa usahihi mara nyingi zaidi.

9cb4574e6dd1.en: You are still not ready to place a trade. The single most important topic in this course is risk management. Skilled analysis without risk management doesn't produce a successful trader — it produces someone who is right sometimes and wiped out eventually.
9cb4574e6dd1.sw: Bado hujawa tayari kufanya biashara. Mada muhimu kuliko zote katika kozi hii ni usimamizi wa hatari. Uchambuzi wa ustadi bila usimamizi wa hatari hautoi mfanyabiashara aliyefanikiwa — hutoa mtu ambaye ni sahihi mara nyingine na hatimaye anafutika kabisa.

9ce5d0407156.en: Correct — margin level is measured from equity, not balance. It is the live value including open trades' floating loss that determines when a margin call or stop-out fires.
9ce5d0407156.sw: Sahihi — kiwango cha margin hupimwa kutoka usawa, si salio. Ni thamani hai ikijumuisha hasara inayoelea ya biashara zilizo wazi ndiyo inayoamua ni lini wito wa margin au stop-out huwaka.

9d6b5ef9a673.en: A schedule of upcoming data releases and policy announcements, with expected impact.
9d6b5ef9a673.sw: Ratiba ya matoleo ya data na matangazo ya sera yanayokuja, yenye athari inayotarajiwa.

9db2c714a4ba.en: Notice the pattern: nearly everything on that list matters because it changes expectations about future interest rates. Short-term rates are the dominant factor in currency valuation, and most other indicators are watched mainly as clues to where rates are heading.
9db2c714a4ba.sw: Tambua mtindo: karibu kila kitu kwenye orodha hiyo kinahusika kwa sababu kinabadilisha matarajio kuhusu viwango vya riba vya baadaye. Viwango vya muda mfupi ndicho kipengele kikuu katika kuthamini sarafu, na viashiria vingine vingi hutazamwa hasa kama dalili za mahali viwango vinakoelekea.

9e21f4bfb11e.en: The fix is structural, not emotional. You will not reliably out-argue an instinct this strong in the heat of an open trade. What works is deciding the exit before you enter — a stop and a target set as orders, ideally linked so one cancels the other (the OCO order from Chapter 1, Lesson 7) — and then letting them execute without your interference. Pre-commitment beats willpower.
9e21f4bfb11e.sw: Suluhisho ni la kimuundo, si la kihisia. Hutashinda kwa hoja silika hii yenye nguvu kwa kutegemewa katikati ya joto la biashara iliyo wazi. Kinachofanya kazi ni kuamua kutoka kabla ya kuingia — stop na lengo vikiwekwa kama maagizo, ikiwezekana vikiunganishwa ili moja lifute lingine (agizo la OCO kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 7) — kisha kuviacha vitekelezwe bila kuingiliwa nawe. Kujitolea mapema hushinda nia thabiti.

9e5f16c6cb51.en: Where cash actually came from and went over a period. It answers: did money genuinely move?
9e5f16c6cb51.sw: Fedha zilitoka wapi hasa na kwenda wapi katika kipindi. Hujibu: je, pesa zilisogea kweli?

9ed2acca30a9.en: An activity where one participant's gain is exactly another's loss.
9ed2acca30a9.sw: Shughuli ambapo faida ya mshiriki mmoja ni hasara ya mwingine hasa.

9edd3db7fdd5.en: A plan you keep only in your head is not a plan — it is an intention, and Lesson 1 showed exactly how intentions bend under fear and greed. Writing it down is what makes it a rule you can be held to, by yourself, when the moment tries to talk you out of it.
9edd3db7fdd5.sw: Mpango unaouweka kichwani tu si mpango — ni nia, na Somo la 1 lilionyesha hasa jinsi nia zinavyopinda chini ya hofu na tamaa. Kuuandika ndicho kinachoufanya kuwa kanuni unayoweza kuwajibishwa nayo, na wewe mwenyewe, wakati huo unapojaribu kukushawishi uache.

9ee732a7e800.en: The Bank for International Settlements — the same body behind the currency-turnover survey you met in Chapter 1 — convened its Markets Committee to study the event. Its report concluded that a range of factors, not one trigger, combined to cause the crash. The time of day made the sterling market unusually thin, so order flow was easily overwhelmed. On top of that came genuine selling pressure — including demand to sell pounds to hedge options positions — and, critically, the execution of stop-loss orders, with algorithmic systems adding to the selling into a market with almost no one on the other side.
9ee732a7e800.sw: Benki ya Malipo ya Kimataifa — chombo kile kile kilicho nyuma ya utafiti wa mzunguko wa sarafu uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 1 — iliitisha Kamati yake ya Masoko kusoma tukio hilo. Ripoti yake ilihitimisha kwamba mambo kadhaa, si kichocheo kimoja, yaliungana kusababisha anguko. Muda wa siku ulifanya soko la pauni liwe jembamba isivyo kawaida, hivyo mtiririko wa maagizo ulizidiwa kwa urahisi. Juu ya hilo kulikuja shinikizo halisi la kuuza — ikiwemo mahitaji ya kuuza pauni kulinda nafasi za options — na, muhimu zaidi, utekelezaji wa maagizo ya stop-loss, mifumo ya algoriti ikiongeza kuuza katika soko lisilo na karibu mtu yeyote upande wa pili.

9ef7bf6a802d.en: None, since a narrow spread means the trade will be cheap
9ef7bf6a802d.sw: Hakuna, kwa kuwa spread finyu inamaanisha biashara itakuwa ya bei nafuu

9f32dc7705c2.en: An authorised participant buys the underlying basket, exchanges it for new ETF shares and sells them, which pushes the two prices together
9f32dc7705c2.sw: Mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa hununua kikapu cha msingi, huibadilisha kwa hisa mpya za ETF na kuziuza, jambo linalosukuma bei hizo mbili pamoja

9fa6b44c3325.en: An accumulating fund reinvests dividends inside the fund. A distributing fund pays them out to you as cash.
9fa6b44c3325.sw: Fund ya kukusanya huwekeza tena gawio ndani ya fund. Fund ya kugawa hulilipa kwako kama fedha taslimu.

9fd017ee1828.en: Osler (2000), published in the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's Economic Policy Review, tested the support and resistance levels that six real forex firms published to their customers. The finding was positive: the levels genuinely helped predict where intraday exchange-rate trends would be interrupted. The predictive power was not uniform — it was stronger for dollar-yen and dollar-pound than for dollar-mark, and it varied by firm — but for most firms it lasted at least five business days after the levels were published.
9fd017ee1828.sw: Osler (2000), aliyechapisha katika Economic Policy Review ya Federal Reserve Bank of New York, alijaribu viwango vya msaada na upinzani ambavyo kampuni sita halisi za forex zilichapisha kwa wateja wao. Tokeo lilikuwa chanya: viwango hivyo vilisaidia kweli kutabiri mahali mielekeo ya viwango vya ubadilishaji vya ndani ya siku ingekatizwa. Nguvu ya kutabiri haikuwa sawa — ilikuwa imara zaidi kwa dola-yen na dola-pauni kuliko dola-alama, na ilitofautiana kwa kampuni — lakini kwa kampuni nyingi ilidumu angalau siku tano za kazi baada ya viwango kuchapishwa.

a03a22ea2e0c.en: Acknowledging a risk exists and choosing to take on the entire potential downside, with no limit. Never used deliberately in trading — it means being willing to lose everything on one position.
a03a22ea2e0c.sw: Kutambua kwamba hatari ipo na kuchagua kubeba hasara yote inayowezekana, bila kikomo. Haitumiki kamwe kwa makusudi katika biashara — inamaanisha kuwa tayari kupoteza kila kitu katika nafasi moja.

a05d79559ce5.en: Put the sizing discipline into practice: before entering any trade, can you state the exact lot size the formula produces — not a round number you picked by feel? Does your position size actually make your maximum loss equal your intended risk percentage, or just approximately? And stay skeptical of any sizing approach — including "optimal" formulas — that requires knowing numbers, like your true win rate, that you can't actually know in advance with real confidence.
a05d79559ce5.sw: Weka nidhamu ya upimaji katika vitendo: kabla ya kuingia katika biashara yoyote, unaweza kutamka ukubwa kamili wa lot ambao fomula inautoa — si namba ya mviringo uliyoichagua kwa hisia? Je, ukubwa wa nafasi yako kwa kweli unafanya hasara yako ya juu kabisa ilingane na asilimia yako ya hatari uliyokusudia, au ni takriban tu? Na endelea kuwa na shaka na mbinu yoyote ya upimaji — ikiwemo fomula "bora" — inayohitaji kujua namba, kama kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi, ambazo huwezi kuzijua mapema kwa uhakika halisi.

a0990cc996ed.en: A share is a residual claim on a business — last in line, unlimited on the upside, and capped at zero on the downside.
a0990cc996ed.sw: Hisa ni dai la mabaki juu ya biashara — la mwisho kwenye foleni, lisilo na kikomo upande wa juu, na lenye kikomo cha sifuri upande wa chini.

a09d63f4cfe0.en: None of this means MTFA doesn't work. Ghanem, Harasheh, Sbaih & Ajmal (2024) — the same study cited back in Foundations Chapter 3 — found that technical analysis can be effective across multiple timeframes, from daily to weekly. The point is narrower and more useful: the method has support; the shopping does not. Choose your timeframes in advance and hold yourself to them.
a09d63f4cfe0.sw: Hakuna kati ya haya kinachomaanisha MTFA haifanyi kazi. Ghanem, Harasheh, Sbaih & Ajmal (2024) — utafiti ule ule uliotajwa nyuma katika Sura ya 3 ya Msingi — waligundua kwamba uchambuzi wa kiufundi unaweza kuwa na ufanisi katika vipindi vingi, kutoka kila siku hadi kila wiki. Pointi ni finyu zaidi na yenye manufaa zaidi: mbinu ina uungwaji mkono; kutafuta hakuna. Chagua vipindi vyako mapema na ujiwajibishe kwavyo.

a140c719f4ee.en: By risking everything on one idea
a140c719f4ee.sw: Kwa kuhatarisha kila kitu kwenye wazo moja

a1473bbbb46b.en: Which of these correctly describes an exotic currency pair?
a1473bbbb46b.sw: Ni kipi kati ya hivi kinachoeleza kwa usahihi jozi adimu la sarafu?

a14995479c69.en: Correct — widening a stop destroys the risk-to-reward you planned (Chapter 3, Lesson 3). The fix is to set the stop at a real invalidation level as an order before entry, and leave it.
a14995479c69.sw: Sahihi — kupanua stop huharibu hatari-kwa-tuzo uliyopanga (Sura ya 3, Somo la 3). Suluhisho ni kuweka stop kwenye kiwango halisi cha kuvunjika kama agizo kabla ya kuingia, na kuiacha.

a164a7ab65da.en: The core fix was simple: instead of physically carrying gold everywhere, leave it with someone trustworthy for safekeeping, and trade the paper receipt instead.
a164a7ab65da.sw: Suluhisho la msingi lilikuwa rahisi: badala ya kubeba dhahabu kila mahali kimwili, iache kwa mtu wa kuaminika kwa usalama, na ubadilishane risiti ya karatasi badala yake.

a190016f876f.en: Glosten & Milgrom (1985), published in the Journal of Financial Economics, proved something genuinely counterintuitive: a positive bid-ask spread emerges even when the market maker is making zero expected profit on average. The reason is adverse selection. A market maker quoting prices to a stream of traders can't tell in advance who's trading on real information (an "informed" trader who knows something about where the price is headed) and who's just trading for ordinary reasons (an "uninformed" trader). Since informed traders systematically win at the market maker's expense, the market maker must widen the spread just to break even against that risk — even with no profit motive at all. This paper remains foundational; researchers were still directly building on and citing it in market microstructure papers as recently as 2026.
a190016f876f.sw: Glosten & Milgrom (1985), waliochapisha katika Journal of Financial Economics, walithibitisha jambo lisilotarajiwa kweli: spread chanya ya bid-ask hujitokeza hata mtengeneza-soko akiwa hapati faida yoyote inayotarajiwa kwa wastani. Sababu ni uteuzi mbaya. Mtengeneza-soko anayenukuu bei kwa mkondo wa wafanyabiashara hawezi kutambua mapema ni nani anayefanya biashara kwa taarifa halisi (mfanyabiashara "mwenye taarifa" anayejua kitu kuhusu bei inakoelekea) na ni nani anayefanya biashara kwa sababu za kawaida tu (mfanyabiashara "asiye na taarifa"). Kwa kuwa wafanyabiashara wenye taarifa hushinda kwa utaratibu kwa gharama ya mtengeneza-soko, mtengeneza-soko lazima apanue spread ili tu alingane dhidi ya hatari hiyo — hata bila lengo lolote la faida. Karatasi hii inabaki ya msingi; watafiti walikuwa bado wakijenga juu yake na kuinukuu moja kwa moja katika karatasi za muundo mdogo wa soko hivi karibuni kama mwaka 2026.

a1d9f4cf3003.en: Correct — the difference (1.08510 − 1.08500 = 0.00010) equals one pip for a standard pair.
a1d9f4cf3003.sw: Sahihi — tofauti (1.08510 − 1.08500 = 0.00010) ni sawa na pip moja kwa jozi sanifu.

a1ee9ae43688.en: What to look for, applied to any activity someone describes as investing. Ask where the money comes from if you win. If the answer is that a business produced it, the activity is ownership. If the answer is that another participant lost it, the activity is a wager however respectable its packaging. And if the answer is that later entrants pay earlier ones, the activity is neither and you should leave.
a1ee9ae43688.sw: Cha kutazama, kikitumika kwa shughuli yoyote ambayo mtu huiita kuwekeza. Uliza pesa hutoka wapi kama utashinda. Kama jibu ni kwamba biashara ilizizalisha, shughuli ni umiliki. Kama jibu ni kwamba mshiriki mwingine alizipoteza, shughuli ni dau bila kujali ufungashaji wake unavyoheshimika. Na kama jibu ni kwamba wanaoingia baadaye hulipa wa awali, shughuli si yoyote kati yao na unapaswa kuondoka.

a26e47877975.en: Case C — neither currency is your account currency, which is any cross pair. For a US-dollar account trading EUR/GBP, Step 1 gives 10 British pounds per pip, and you must convert pounds into dollars using GBP/USD.
a26e47877975.sw: Kesi C — hakuna kati ya sarafu ni sarafu ya akaunti yako, ambayo ni jozi lolote la kuvuka. Kwa akaunti ya dola ya Marekani inayofanyia biashara EUR/GBP, Hatua ya 1 hutoa pauni 10 za Uingereza kwa kila pip, na lazima ubadilishe pauni kuwa dola ukitumia GBP/USD.

a2a8d55efac9.en: The intuition: if recent up-candles are much larger than recent down-candles, buyers are dominating and RSI pushes toward 100. If down-candles dominate, RSI falls toward 0. (The precise formula averages the gains and losses of closing prices over 14 periods, but the candle intuition is faithful to what it measures.)
a2a8d55efac9.sw: Ufahamu: kama mishumaa ya juu ya hivi karibuni ni mikubwa zaidi kuliko mishumaa ya chini ya hivi karibuni, wanunuzi wanatawala na RSI husukuma kuelekea 100. Kama mishumaa ya chini itatawala, RSI hushuka kuelekea 0. (Fomula kamili huwastani faida na hasara za bei za kufunga katika vipindi 14, lakini ufahamu wa mshumaa ni mwaminifu kwa kile inachopima.)

a2cb2c0eee40.en: Buy one share of a broad index ETF and you own a small slice of every company in that index, in the proportions the index rule specifies. That is the appeal: diversification in a single transaction, at a cost that Lesson 7 will put numbers to.
a2cb2c0eee40.sw: Nunua hisa moja ya ETF pana ya index na unamiliki kipande kidogo cha kila kampuni katika index hiyo, kwa uwiano ambao kanuni ya index inabainisha. Hicho ndicho kivutio: usambazaji katika muamala mmoja, kwa gharama ambayo Somo la 7 litaweka namba juu yake.

a2ccb0632bb5.en: This is the calculation Foundations Chapter 2 flagged but never actually solved: once you know your stop-loss distance (Chapter 2, Lesson 2) and pip value (Chapter 1, Lesson 4), you can calculate exactly how large a position should be.
a2ccb0632bb5.sw: Hii ndiyo hesabu ambayo Sura ya 2 ya Msingi iliionyesha lakini haikuitatua kamwe: mara utakapojua umbali wa stop-loss yako (Sura ya 2, Somo la 2) na thamani ya pip (Sura ya 1, Somo la 4), unaweza kukokotoa hasa nafasi inapaswa kuwa kubwa kiasi gani.

a2e6fd531956.en: With the last tie between money and gold severed, the world entered the era of fiat currency — the system every major economy uses today.
a2e6fd531956.sw: Kwa kifungo cha mwisho kati ya pesa na dhahabu kukatwa, dunia iliingia enzi ya sarafu ya fiat — mfumo ambao kila uchumi mkubwa hutumia leo.

a2f6a233d80e.en: Treat "500:1 leverage available" as marketing, not a feature. The number tells you the most rope the broker will hand you; it says nothing about how much you should take. Your effective leverage, set by your position size, is the figure to watch — and to keep small.
a2f6a233d80e.sw: Chukulia "leverage ya 500:1 inapatikana" kama matangazo, si kipengele. Namba inakuambia kamba ndefu zaidi ambayo broker atakukabidhi; haisemi chochote kuhusu kiasi unachopaswa kuchukua. Leverage yako halisi, iliyowekwa na ukubwa wa nafasi yako, ndiyo takwimu ya kutazama — na kuiweka ndogo.

a3215e38bc6d.en: A cap-weighted index of the same 500 companies concentrates: if the largest handful grow to a third of the total value, a third of your return depends on those few. An equal-weighted version of the identical list gives each company the same share, so it leans more on the smaller members. Same companies, same day, different number.
a3215e38bc6d.sw: Index yenye uzito wa mtaji ya kampuni zile zile 500 hujikita: kama chache kubwa zaidi zitakua hadi theluthi moja ya thamani ya jumla, theluthi moja ya faida yako hutegemea hizo chache. Toleo lenye uzito sawa la orodha ile ile hutoa kila kampuni sehemu ile ile, hivyo hutegemea zaidi wanachama wadogo. Kampuni zile zile, siku ile ile, namba tofauti.

a3302ab9b98d.en: Correct. The return from owning productive businesses comes from value created outside the transactions themselves, so all holders can gain together. A casino game creates nothing, so one player's gain is another's loss minus the house edge. Note that this defence applies to long-term ownership — short-term trading in the same shares is close to zero-sum before costs.
a3302ab9b98d.sw: Sahihi. Faida kutoka kumiliki biashara zenye tija hutoka kwa thamani inayoundwa nje ya miamala yenyewe, hivyo wote wanaoshikilia wanaweza kupata faida pamoja. Mchezo wa kasino hauundi chochote, hivyo faida ya mchezaji mmoja ni hasara ya mwingine kutoa faida ya kasino. Tambua kwamba utetezi huu unahusu umiliki wa muda mrefu — biashara ya muda mfupi ya hisa zile zile iko karibu jumla-sifuri kabla ya gharama.

a331e68d46a3.en: A portfolio split evenly across ten tech stocks looks diversified by holding count — but if all ten tend to rise and fall together, it behaves like one large bet, not ten independent ones. This is naive diversification: mistaking the number of holdings for actual risk reduction.
a331e68d46a3.sw: Mkusanyiko uliogawanywa sawasawa katika hisa kumi za teknolojia unaonekana umesambazwa kwa idadi ya umiliki — lakini kama zote kumi zinaelekea kupanda na kushuka pamoja, unatenda kama dau moja kubwa, si kumi yaliyo huru. Huku ndiko kusambaza kwa kijinga: kudhania kwamba idadi ya umiliki ni sawa na kupunguza hatari halisi.

a33b14cfa9ae.en: The levels are self-fulfilling magic with no real cause
a33b14cfa9ae.sw: Viwango ni uchawi unaojitimiza bila sababu halisi

a36b231735b6.en: Negative — about minus 12 dollars per trade
a36b231735b6.sw: Hasi — takriban toa dola 12 kwa kila biashara

a392b6f94b88.en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average works this way. It adds the share prices of its 30 companies and divides by its own divisor. The consequence is that influence tracks the price per share and not the size of the business.
a392b6f94b88.sw: Dow Jones Industrial Average hufanya kazi hivi. Huongeza bei za hisa za kampuni zake 30 na kugawanya kwa kigawanyaji chake. Tokeo ni kwamba ushawishi hufuata bei kwa kila hisa na si ukubwa wa biashara.

a39360e53cb5.en: An asset with an average positive but imperfect correlation to your holdings.
a39360e53cb5.sw: Mali yenye uwiano chanya wa wastani lakini usio kamili na umiliki wako.

a3b74fb47077.en: An ETF is trading at 100.40 while the basket it holds is worth 100.00 a share. An authorised participant buys the underlying shares for 100.00, delivers them to the fund, receives new ETF shares, and sells them at 100.40. Doing this adds supply to the ETF and demand to the underlying, pushing the two prices together. The profit exists only while the gap does.
a3b74fb47077.sw: ETF inafanyiwa biashara kwa 100.40 ilhali kikapu inachoshikilia kina thamani ya 100.00 kwa hisa. Mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa hununua hisa za msingi kwa 100.00, huziwasilisha kwa fund, hupokea hisa mpya za ETF, na huziuza kwa 100.40. Kufanya hivi huongeza ugavi kwa ETF na mahitaji kwa msingi, zikisukuma bei hizo mbili pamoja. Faida ipo tu wakati pengo lipo.

a3c51665dc1e.en: Holding only part of deposits in reserve, lending out the rest.
a3c51665dc1e.sw: Kushikilia sehemu tu ya amana kama akiba, kukopesha kilichobaki.

a3cb63763f07.en: Here's the real, current ranking by share of global turnover, from the same 2025 BIS survey: EUR/USD leads at 21.2%, followed by USD/JPY at 14.3%. The genuinely interesting shift: USD/CNY (the Chinese yuan) has climbed to third place at 8.1%, overtaking GBP/USD (now fourth, at 7.6%) — a dramatic rise from just 0.8% in 2010. USD/CAD, AUD/USD, and USD/CHF round out the majors, each in the 4–5% range.
a3cb63763f07.sw: Hili hapa daraja halisi la sasa kwa sehemu ya mzunguko wa biashara duniani, kutoka utafiti ule ule wa BIS wa mwaka 2025: EUR/USD linaongoza kwa 21.2%, likifuatiwa na USD/JPY kwa 14.3%. Mabadiliko yenye kuvutia kweli: USD/CNY (yuan ya China) limepanda hadi nafasi ya tatu kwa 8.1%, likipita GBP/USD (sasa la nne, kwa 7.6%) — kupanda kwa kushangaza kutoka 0.8% tu mwaka 2010. USD/CAD, AUD/USD, na USD/CHF yanakamilisha jozi kuu, kila moja likiwa katika kiwango cha 4–5%.

a3fceeba7127.en: The price at which you plan to exit if the position moves in your favor.
a3fceeba7127.sw: Bei ambayo kwayo unapanga kutoka kama nafasi itasogea kwa manufaa yako.

a710b1be780c.en: A system wins 40% of trades with an average win of 2R. Expectancy = (0.40 times 2) minus (0.60 times 1) = 0.80 minus 0.60 = +0.20R per trade. Over 100 trades that is +20R. If 1R is 1% of a 10,000 dollar account — 100 dollars — that is +2,000 dollars, produced by a system that is wrong 60% of the time. Because R strips out account and position size, two completely different systems can be compared directly by their expectancy in R alone.
a710b1be780c.sw: Mfumo hushinda 40% ya biashara wenye ushindi wa wastani wa 2R. Matarajio = (0.40 mara 2) toa (0.60 mara 1) = 0.80 toa 0.60 = +0.20R kwa kila biashara. Katika biashara 100 hiyo ni +20R. Kama 1R ni 1% ya akaunti ya dola 10,000 — dola 100 — hiyo ni +dola 2,000, iliyozalishwa na mfumo unaokosea 60% ya muda. Kwa sababu R huondoa ukubwa wa akaunti na nafasi, mifumo miwili tofauti kabisa inaweza kulinganishwa moja kwa moja kwa matarajio yao kwa R peke yake.

a7641eea7b01.en: As you look at any quote, ask yourself: can you immediately identify which side is the base and which is the quote, and what that means for the price shown? If a currency code looks unfamiliar, check it against the ISO 4217 standard rather than guessing from the currency's common name. If a quote looks "backwards," check the convention before assuming an error. And when citing FX statistics like total volume or which pairs dominate, is the source authoritative like the BIS survey, or an unsourced blog claim?
a7641eea7b01.sw: Unapotazama nukuu yoyote, jiulize: unaweza kutambua mara moja ni upande upi ni msingi na upi ni bei, na hilo linamaanisha nini kwa bei inayoonyeshwa? Kama msimbo wa sarafu unaonekana usiofahamika, ukague dhidi ya kiwango cha ISO 4217 badala ya kukisia kutoka jina la kawaida la sarafu. Kama nukuu inaonekana "kinyume," kagua makubaliano kabla ya kudhani ni kosa. Na unapotaja takwimu za FX kama kiasi cha jumla au ni jozi yapi yanatawala, je, chanzo kina mamlaka kama utafiti wa BIS, au ni dai la blogu lisilo na chanzo?

a78ae30c3c42.en: When the Great Depression hit in 1929, countries still on the gold standard faced an impossible choice: defending a fixed gold peg meant keeping interest rates high and the money supply tight — the opposite of what a struggling economy needs to recover.

a7907ff62f27.en: The expense ratio is also not the whole cost. Lesson 3 covered the spread you pay each time you trade. Funds pay spreads too, inside the fund, when they buy and sell — so a fund that trades a lot carries costs beyond its published fee. Taxes are a third layer, and depend on your own circumstances.

Fund hulipa spread pia, ndani ya fund, zinaponunua na kuuza — hivyo fund inayofanya biashara sana hubeba gharama zaidi ya ada yake iliyochapishwa. Kodi ni safu ya tatu, na hutegemea hali yako mwenyewe.

aaed5bd40ca8.en: If a thesis is compelling but the nearest sensible target is barely further than the stop, the correct decision is often no trade — the analysis was right and the trade still is not worth it. This is the discipline beginners find hardest: a good thesis with a poor reward-to-risk is a pass, not a trade you shrink your target to justify.

Hii ndiyo nidhamu ambayo wanaoanza huipata kuwa ngumu zaidi: nadharia nzuri yenye tuzo-kwa-hatari mbaya ni kupita, si biashara ambayo unapunguza lengo lako ili kuihalalisha.

ab76bf78dd4d.en: A payout ratio comfortably below 100% means the payment is covered by what the business earns and has room to survive a bad year. A ratio persistently above it means the dividend is being funded from cash reserves, from borrowing, or from selling assets. None of those can continue indefinitely, and the market usually works this out before the announcement.

Uwiano ulio juu yake kwa kudumu unamaanisha gawio linafadhiliwa kutoka akiba za fedha, kutoka kukopa, au kutoka kuuza mali. Hakuna kati ya hizo kinachoweza kuendelea milele, na soko kwa kawaida hulibaini hili kabla ya tangazo.

ad3320fa295c.en: Lo, Mamaysky & Wang (2000), published in The Journal of Finance, built an automated, objective system to detect chart patterns and tested it on decades of U.S. stock data. They found several patterns, including head-and-shoulders and double bottoms, provided statistically significant information beyond random chance — but added an important caveat: statistical detectability is not the same as profitability after real-world costs.

Waligundua mitindo kadhaa, ikiwemo head-and-shoulders na double bottoms, ilitoa taarifa yenye maana kitakwimu zaidi ya bahati nasibu — lakini wakaongeza onyo muhimu: kutambulika kitakwimu si sawa na kupata faida baada ya gharama za dunia halisi.

ad4751d18e9e.en: A calendar shows a high-impact event with Forecast 1.75% and Previous 1.75%. The actual arrives at exactly 1.75%. What's the most likely currency reaction?
ad4751d18e9e.sw: Kalenda inaonyesha tukio lenye athari kubwa lenye Utabiri 1.75% na Iliyopita 1.75%. Halisi inafika hasa kwa 1.75%. Ni mwitikio upi wa sarafu unaowezekana zaidi?

ad4a725d40c3.en: Not quite — the issue was the exchange rate Britain rejoined at, not the money supply or a ban on gold.
ad4a725d40c3.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — tatizo lilikuwa kiwango cha ubadilishaji ambacho Uingereza ilirudi nacho, si ugavi wa pesa wala marufuku ya dhahabu.

ad4dbad1e371.en: The value of everything the fund holds, divided by the number of fund shares outstanding — what one share is actually backed by.
ad4dbad1e371.sw: Thamani ya kila kitu fund inachoshikilia, kugawanywa kwa idadi ya hisa za fund zilizotolewa — kile ambacho hisa moja inaungwa mkono nacho hasa.

ad6d281bd6d8.en: That last point is easy to miss and matters enormously: a triggered stop order is not guaranteed to fill at your stop price. It's guaranteed to fill — at whatever price is actually available once it converts to a market order. In a fast-moving or illiquid market, those can be very different numbers. The slippage section below covers exactly how different.
ad6d281bd6d8.sw: Pointi hiyo ya mwisho ni rahisi kuikosa na inahusika mno: agizo la stop lililoanzishwa halihakikishiwi kutimizwa kwa bei yako ya stop. Linahakikishiwa kutimizwa — kwa bei yoyote inayopatikana hasa mara linapogeuka kuwa agizo la soko. Katika soko linalosogea kwa kasi au lisilo na ukwasi, hizo zinaweza kuwa namba tofauti sana. Sehemu ya slippage hapo chini inaeleza hasa tofauti kiasi gani.

ad75dd03a428.en: A share you own at 60.00 pays a 2.00 dividend. On the ex-dividend date the price opens near 58.00. What has happened to your wealth?
ad75dd03a428.sw: Hisa unayoimiliki kwa 60.00 hulipa gawio la 2.00. Katika tarehe ya bila-gawio bei hufunguliwa karibu na 58.00. Kimetokea nini kwa utajiri wako?

ada027ef46ee.en: Foundations Chapter 1 introduced central banks historically (the Bank of England, 1694; the Fed). Here's why they matter to a trader every single week.
ada027ef46ee.sw: Sura ya 1 ya Msingi ilianzisha benki kuu kihistoria (Benki ya Uingereza, 1694; Fed). Hii hapa sababu zinavyomhusu mfanyabiashara kila wiki moja.

ade55e4e01c3.en: Not quite. What matters is where the return comes from, not what is being traded. Over minutes or days the companies have produced nothing new, so the gain must come from another participant — and costs make that a losing proposition on average.
ade55e4e01c3.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kinachohusika ni faida hutoka wapi, si kinachofanyiwa biashara. Katika dakika au siku kampuni hazijazalisha chochote kipya, hivyo faida lazima itoke kwa mshiriki mwingine — na gharama hufanya hilo liwe pendekezo la hasara kwa wastani.

adff65611b0c.en: A bank holds 100 gold coins but has issued 500 IOU notes against them. On an ordinary day this works fine — only a few people ever ask for their gold at once. But if confidence drops and everyone tries to redeem on the same day, the bank runs out of gold long before it runs out of notes to honor. The panic itself becomes the crisis.
adff65611b0c.sw: Benki inashikilia sarafu 100 za dhahabu lakini imetoa noti 500 za IOU dhidi yake. Siku ya kawaida hii inafanya kazi vizuri — ni watu wachache tu wanaowahi kuomba dhahabu yao kwa wakati mmoja. Lakini kama imani itashuka na kila mtu akajaribu kukomboa siku hiyo hiyo, benki inaishiwa dhahabu kabla ya kuishiwa noti za kulipia. Hofu yenyewe inakuwa ndiyo janga.

ae76e0c427e2.en: A share priced at 40.00 the day before a 1.00 dividend, and on the ex-dividend date shown as a 39.00 share price plus 1.00 of cash. The total held is 40.00 in both cases.
ae76e0c427e2.sw: Hisa yenye bei ya 40.00 siku moja kabla ya gawio la 1.00, na katika tarehe ya bila-gawio ikionyeshwa kama bei ya hisa ya 39.00 pamoja na 1.00 ya fedha taslimu. Jumla iliyoshikiliwa ni 40.00 katika kesi zote mbili.

aebecb838af6.en: Searching charts until one agrees with a trade you already wanted — a bias, not a method.
aebecb838af6.sw: Kutafuta chati hadi moja ikubaliane na biashara uliyoitaka tayari — upendeleo, si mbinu.

aed8142fa7c4.en: Judge the decision, not just the result. A trade that won because the market bailed out a sloppy thesis is a warning, not a success; a well-built thesis that lost to a genuine surprise may have been exactly right to take. Rewarding yourself for luck and punishing yourself for variance trains the wrong habits.
aed8142fa7c4.sw: Hukumu uamuzi, si tokeo tu. Biashara iliyoshinda kwa sababu soko liliokoa nadharia iliyoachwa ovyo ni onyo, si mafanikio; nadharia iliyojengwa vizuri iliyopoteza kwa mshangao halisi huenda ilikuwa sahihi kabisa kuchukuliwa. Kujizawadia kwa bahati na kujiadhibu kwa utofauti hukufundisha tabia zisizo sahihi.

aeebe36256fb.en: The order sells near 38, because a stop becomes a market order once triggered and fills at whatever is available
aeebe36256fb.sw: Agizo huuza karibu na 38, kwa sababu stop hukuwa agizo la soko mara linapoanzishwa na hutimizwa kwa chochote kinachopatikana

aef53c3a3c57.en: A currency held in significant quantities by governments and institutions worldwide for trade and finance — the U.S. dollar has held this role since Bretton Woods.
aef53c3a3c57.sw: Sarafu inayoshikiliwa kwa wingi mkubwa na serikali na taasisi duniani kote kwa biashara na fedha — dola ya Marekani imeshikilia nafasi hii tangu Bretton Woods.

af14d5cc1902.en: Diversification reduces risk. It does not remove it. During a genuine broad market shock, correlations across many assets tend to rise together — the calm-market relationships you diversified around can break down exactly when you need them most.
af14d5cc1902.sw: Kusambaza uwekezaji hupunguza hatari. Hakuiondoi. Wakati wa mshtuko halisi mpana wa soko, uwiano katika mali nyingi huelekea kupanda pamoja — mahusiano ya soko tulivu uliyoyasambazia yanaweza kuvunjika hasa wakati unapoyahitaji zaidi.

af72d86de9a2.en: You gain 0.20 per share, because you captured the spread
af72d86de9a2.sw: Unapata 0.20 kwa kila hisa, kwa sababu ulinasa spread

af79536b0c08.en: Correct — rates reprice currencies and bonds first, then flow to credit and equities, then commodities, then the most risk-sensitive assets like crypto.
af79536b0c08.sw: Sahihi — viwango hupanga upya bei za sarafu na hatifungani kwanza, kisha hupenya hadi mikopo na hisa, kisha bidhaa, kisha mali nyeti zaidi kwa hatari kama crypto.

af7e0278a1de.en: A major currency paired with an emerging-market currency.
af7e0278a1de.sw: Sarafu kuu iliyowekwa pamoja na sarafu ya soko linaloibukia.

af7fe17cbc1a.en: Weight capital toward your best-analysed theses (which outperform), while still sizing every trade to the fixed-fractional rule — concentrate conviction, not risk — and review closed trades for the quality of the decision, not just the result.
af7fe17cbc1a.sw: Elekeza mtaji zaidi kwenye nadharia zako zilizochambuliwa vizuri zaidi (ambazo hufanya vizuri zaidi), huku bado ukipima kila biashara kwa kanuni ya sehemu thabiti — jikite kwenye uhakika, si hatari — na pitia biashara zilizofungwa kwa ubora wa uamuzi, si tokeo tu.

af9b67669b60.en: Step back from the individual tools and the deeper pattern of this chapter emerges:
af9b67669b60.sw: Rudi nyuma kutoka zana binafsi na mtindo wa kina zaidi wa sura hii unajitokeza:

afed7ef38265.en: The important detail is what happens to the share price when the dividend is paid. The cash leaves the company. A company holding one unit less cash is worth one unit less, and the share price reflects that.
afed7ef38265.sw: Kipengele muhimu ni kinachotokea kwa bei ya hisa gawio linapolipwa. Fedha huondoka kampunini. Kampuni inayoshikilia kipimo kimoja pungufu cha fedha ina thamani ya kipimo kimoja pungufu, na bei ya hisa huakisi hilo.

b04d2ff3288b.en: That $35-per-ounce rate is not a random number — it is exactly the rate Bretton Woods would formalize internationally ten years later, in 1944. Keep it in mind for the next lesson.
b04d2ff3288b.sw: Kiwango hicho cha $35 kwa wakia si namba ya bahati nasibu — ni hasa kiwango ambacho Bretton Woods ingekirasimisha kimataifa miaka kumi baadaye, mwaka 1944. Kikumbuke kwa somo lijalo.

b06b0fd54646.en: The price is guaranteed to fall

b13281038c88.en: Share ownership is positive-sum — the businesses underneath produce value — while the casino game only redistributes what players bring
b13281038c88.sw: Umiliki wa hisa ni jumla-chanya — biashara zilizo chini huzalisha thamani — ilhali mchezo wa kasino hugawanya upya tu kile wachezaji huleta

b151383e8180.en: The honest, uncomfortable takeaway: you cannot reliably predict a black swan, and you cannot count on your stop filling where you set it. The only defence that works is structural — being small enough, and unleveraged enough, that even a failed stop cannot end you. Survival is not built on being right. It is built on being sized to be wrong.
b151383e8180.sw: Fundisho la uaminifu na lisilostarehesha: huwezi kutabiri black swan kwa kutegemewa, na huwezi kutegemea stop yako itimizwe pale uliipoiweka. Kinga pekee inayofanya kazi ni ya kimuundo — kuwa mdogo vya kutosha, na bila leverage vya kutosha, kiasi kwamba hata stop iliyoshindwa haiwezi kukumaliza. Kunusurika hakujengwi juu ya kuwa sahihi. Kunajengwa juu ya kupimwa ili ukosee.

b18fef0804a4.en: And the honest close the course has earned the right to make: doing all of this well is genuinely hard and takes real time to build. It is not a shortcut to guaranteed profit — nothing is, and most retail accounts still lose (Chapter 4, Lesson 3). What this process does is put the odds, and your own behaviour, on the right side, which is the most any method honestly can.
b18fef0804a4.sw: Na mwisho wa uaminifu ambao kozi imepata haki ya kuufanya: kufanya haya yote vizuri ni kugumu kweli na huchukua muda halisi kujenga. Si njia ya mkato kwa faida ya uhakika — hakuna kitu kilicho hivyo, na akaunti nyingi za rejareja bado hupoteza (Sura ya 4, Somo la 3). Kile ambacho mchakato huu hufanya ni kuweka uwezekano, na tabia yako mwenyewe, upande sahihi, ambacho ndicho kingi zaidi ambacho njia yoyote inaweza kufanya kwa uaminifu.

b1a0c0f5474a.en: The fee is what you are charged. The tracking difference is what you actually lost against the index, and it includes the fee plus everything else. Choosing purely on the advertised number can occasionally pick the fund that delivered less of the index. The correct comparison is the shortfall over several years, and the fee is the best single predictor of it rather than a substitute for it.
b1a0c0f5474a.sw: Ada ni unachotozwa. Tofauti ya kufuatilia ni ulichopoteza hasa dhidi ya index, na inajumuisha ada pamoja na kila kitu kingine. Kuchagua kwa namba iliyotangazwa peke yake kunaweza mara chache kuchagua fund iliyotoa sehemu ndogo ya index. Ulinganisho sahihi ni upungufu katika miaka kadhaa, na ada ndiyo kitabiri kimoja bora chake badala ya mbadala wake.

b1b91d7d8a52.en: Position sizing turns your stop-loss distance and risk percentage into an exact trade size, so a losing trade costs exactly what you decided in advance.
b1b91d7d8a52.sw: Upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi hugeuza umbali wa stop-loss yako na asilimia yako ya hatari kuwa ukubwa kamili wa biashara, ili biashara ya hasara igharimu hasa kile ulichoamua mapema.

b1bf770271fd.en: The 1971 suspension of the dollar's convertibility to gold.
b1bf770271fd.sw: Kusimamishwa kwa mwaka 1971 kwa ubadilishaji wa dola kuwa dhahabu.

b204f9db4bea.en: That 0.16% is the entry fee for a round trip. Pay it once a decade and it is irrelevant. Pay it forty times a year, as the active trader in the previous lesson did, and it becomes one of the largest costs you face — which is exactly why the arithmetic there was so unforgiving.
b204f9db4bea.sw: Hiyo 0.16% ni ada ya kuingia kwa safari ya kwenda na kurudi. Ilipe mara moja kwa muongo na haihusiki. Ilipe mara arobaini kwa mwaka, kama mfanyabiashara wa bidii katika somo lililotangulia alivyofanya, na inakuwa mojawapo ya gharama kubwa zaidi unazokabiliana nazo — ambako ndiyo hasa sababu hesabu hapo ilikuwa haisamehe hivyo.

b24b0f59b424.en: What Is Risk, and How Do You Manage It?

b2b5fafb458a.en: Risk isn't unique to trading — it's in everything. Skydiving carries risk. Flying to a vacation destination carries risk. Driving to work carries risk. The actual skill isn't avoiding risk altogether — that's impossible. It's judging whether a given risk is worth taking, and controlling it wherever you can.
b2b5fafb458a.sw: Hatari si ya kipekee kwa biashara — ipo katika kila kitu. Kuruka kwa parachuti kuna hatari. Kusafiri kwa ndege kwenda likizo kuna hatari. Kuendesha gari kwenda kazini kuna hatari. Ustadi halisi si kuepuka hatari kabisa — hilo haliwezekani. Ni kuhukumu kama hatari fulani inastahili kuchukuliwa, na kuidhibiti pale unapoweza.

b2ce1131cdb9.en: A single indicator giving a clear signal

b2f29bdd12cf.en: The EU's cap wasn't a guess. ESMA published its actual reasoning:
b2f29bdd12cf.sw: Kikomo cha Umoja wa Ulaya hakikuwa kisio. ESMA ilichapisha hoja yake halisi:

b354b40f75e4.en: You place a stop order to sell at 45. Overnight news causes the share to open at 38. What happens?
b354b40f75e4.sw: Unaweka agizo la stop la kuuza kwa 45. Habari za usiku husababisha hisa kufunguliwa kwa 38. Kinatokea nini?

b366d15b8f4a.en: The stop-out closes your position at the best price available when it fires — and in a violent gap, there may be no price nearby, exactly as you saw with stop-loss orders in Chapter 1, Lesson 7. When the Swiss National Bank floor broke in 2015, stop-outs triggered correctly but filled far below their levels, and many accounts went negative — traders ended up owing money they never deposited. This is precisely why negative balance protection exists as a rule in the EU, UK, and Australia (Chapter 1, Lesson 6).
b366d15b8f4a.sw: Stop-out hufunga nafasi yako kwa bei bora inayopatikana inapowaka — na katika kuruka kwa nguvu, huenda kusiwe na bei karibu, hasa kama ulivyoona na maagizo ya stop-loss katika Sura ya 1, Somo la 7. Sakafu ya Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilipovunjika mwaka 2015, stop-out zilianzishwa kwa usahihi lakini zilitimizwa chini mno ya viwango vyao, na akaunti nyingi zikawa hasi — wafanyabiashara waliishia kudaiwa pesa ambazo hawakuwahi kuziweka. Ndiyo sababu hasa ulinzi wa salio hasi upo kama kanuni katika Umoja wa Ulaya, Uingereza, na Australia (Sura ya 1, Somo la 6).

b40a4afe700e.en: A dividend is not free money. The share price drops by roughly the payment — what matters is total return, not the yield.
b40a4afe700e.sw: Gawio si pesa za bure. Bei ya hisa hushuka kwa takriban malipo — kinachohusika ni faida ya jumla, si mavuno.

b41b2fffb2e1.en: The economic theory that a currency with higher interest rates should depreciate over time by exactly enough to cancel out its interest advantage — so that, in theory, there's no free profit in simply chasing high-rate currencies.
b41b2fffb2e1.sw: Nadharia ya kiuchumi kwamba sarafu yenye viwango vya juu vya riba inapaswa kudhoofika kwa muda kwa kiasi hasa cha kufuta faida yake ya riba — ili, kinadharia, kusiwe na faida ya bure katika kufukuza tu sarafu za viwango vya juu.

b455aaa3658b.en: Not quite — taking the long there is timeframe-shopping. The higher timeframe sets the permitted direction; the short-term chart only times the entry.
b455aaa3658b.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kuchukua long hapo ni kutafuta vipindi. Kipindi cha juu zaidi huweka mwelekeo unaoruhusiwa; chati ya muda mfupi hupanga wakati wa kuingia tu.

b471dde68778.en: Correct — entering the oversold zone shows one-sided selling; exiting it shows that pressure has actually broken. Waiting for the exit trades a little upside for real confirmation — markets can stay oversold far longer than your account can stay solvent.
b471dde68778.sw: Sahihi — kuingia kwenye kanda ya kuuzwa kupita kiasi kunaonyesha uuzaji wa upande mmoja; kutoka ndani yake kunaonyesha kwamba shinikizo hilo limevunjika hasa. Kusubiri kutoka kunabadilisha faida kidogo kwa uthibitisho halisi — masoko yanaweza kubaki yameuzwa kupita kiasi kwa muda mrefu zaidi kuliko akaunti yako inavyoweza kubaki na uwezo wa kulipa.

b4cf610373ea.en: Risk limitation is the technique you'll use the most. This lesson makes it concrete: every time you enter a position, there are three prices to think through.
b4cf610373ea.sw: Kupunguza hatari ndiyo mbinu utakayoitumia zaidi. Somo hili linaifanya iwe halisi: kila unapoingia katika nafasi, kuna bei tatu za kufikiria.

b51565b6141e.en: They will receive a smaller share of any dividend
b51565b6141e.sw: Watapokea sehemu ndogo ya gawio lolote

b53937afcdb5.en: Not quite — Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) found an asymmetry: bad news moves prices more than equally-sized good news.
b53937afcdb5.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) waligundua kutokuwa na usawa: habari mbaya husogeza bei zaidi kuliko habari njema ya ukubwa sawa.

b53e3f8c2a35.en: The United States formally adopted the gold standard in 1879 — every dollar in circulation became directly redeemable for a fixed amount of gold, for ordinary citizens, not just foreign governments. Britain had done the same decades earlier, in 1821.
b53e3f8c2a35.sw: Marekani ilikubali rasmi kiwango cha dhahabu mwaka 1879 — kila dola iliyokuwa katika mzunguko ikawa inaweza kukombolewa moja kwa moja kwa kiasi thabiti cha dhahabu, kwa raia wa kawaida, si serikali za kigeni tu. Uingereza ilikuwa imefanya hivyo miongo kadhaa mapema, mwaka 1821.

b5537689b8d0.en: A fund holding a basket of assets, whose own shares trade on an exchange throughout the day like an ordinary share.
b5537689b8d0.sw: Fund inayoshikilia kikapu cha mali, ambayo hisa zake zenyewe hufanyiwa biashara sokoni mchana kutwa kama hisa ya kawaida.

b553b8153560.en: Account equity relative to margin in use, as a percentage.
b553b8153560.sw: Usawa wa akaunti ikilinganishwa na margin inayotumika, kama asilimia.

b573c81b0838.en: The expensive fund ends up about 1.45% behind, matching the fee difference
b573c81b0838.sw: Fund ghali humalizia takriban 1.45% nyuma, ikilingana na tofauti ya ada

b5935331b5b0.en: Not quite — dropping below 30 only shows one-sided selling. The higher-quality signal is RSI crossing back above 30, confirming the selling pressure has actually broken.
b5935331b5b0.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kushuka chini ya 30 kunaonyesha tu uuzaji wa upande mmoja. Ishara yenye ubora zaidi ni RSI kukatiza tena juu ya 30, ikithibitisha shinikizo la kuuza limevunjika hasa.

b5a88548d631.en: Why is the advertised fee not always sufficient to choose between two funds tracking the same index?
b5a88548d631.sw: Kwa nini ada iliyotangazwa haitoshi daima kuchagua kati ya fund mbili zinazofuatilia index ile ile?

b5d8f0b6be4a.en: Correct. Yield is the dividend divided by the price, so a falling price raises it mechanically. The screen therefore over-represents companies the market has marked down, and it misses companies returning large amounts of cash through buybacks, which show up in per-share figures rather than in yield.
b5d8f0b6be4a.sw: Sahihi. Mavuno ni gawio kugawanywa kwa bei, hivyo bei inayoshuka huyapandisha kimitambo. Hivyo chujio huwakilisha kupita kiasi kampuni ambazo soko limezishusha, na hukosa kampuni zinazorudisha kiasi kikubwa cha fedha kupitia ununuzi upya, ambao hujitokeza katika takwimu za kwa-hisa badala ya mavuno.

b60ac556978f.en: Leverage lets you control a position far larger than your capital — amplifying losses by exactly the same factor as gains, which is why regulators cap it for retail traders.
b60ac556978f.sw: Leverage hukuruhusu kudhibiti nafasi kubwa mno kuliko mtaji wako — ikizidisha hasara kwa kipimo kile kile hasa cha faida, ndiyo sababu wadhibiti huiwekea kikomo kwa wafanyabiashara wa rejareja.

b60adc5ced1b.en: The distinction that matters most is between the first and the third, and it comes down to timing.
b60adc5ced1b.sw: Tofauti inayohusika zaidi ni kati ya ya kwanza na ya tatu, na inatokana na muda.

b6217c2fdec9.en: A note on the exponential moving average (EMA): it's a variant that weights recent prices more heavily. Some traders prefer it; the simple version teaches the same concepts and is what this course uses. MACD (below) is built from EMAs — worth knowing the term exists.
b6217c2fdec9.sw: Dokezo kuhusu wastani wa kielelezo unaosogea (EMA): ni toleo linalozipa bei za hivi karibuni uzito mkubwa zaidi. Baadhi ya wafanyabiashara huipendelea; toleo rahisi hufundisha dhana zile zile na ndilo kozi hii inalotumia. MACD (hapo chini) imejengwa kutoka EMA — inastahili kujua neno hilo lipo.

b6381866254d.en: True or False: because indicators are computed from price, a price-action trader who reads the naked chart is looking at less information than an indicator user.
b6381866254d.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kwa sababu viashiria hukokotolewa kutoka bei, mfanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei anayesoma chati tupu anatazama taarifa chache kuliko mtumiaji wa viashiria.

b6a688b2b9b7.en: Fund A, because its fee is lower
b6a688b2b9b7.sw: Fund A, kwa sababu ada yake iko chini zaidi

b6ef01cf29d0.en: Not quite — indicators add no information price doesn't already contain. The naked-chart trader reads the same information directly, not less of it.
b6ef01cf29d0.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — viashiria haviongezi taarifa ambayo bei haina tayari. Mfanyabiashara wa chati tupu husoma taarifa zile zile moja kwa moja, si chache zaidi.

b71237885e02.en: Every entry gives you the same core fields. Time — when the data drops, usually to the minute; currency pairs can move within seconds of it. Currency — which currency the event affects; critically, check both sides of your pair, because a EUR event moves EUR/USD just as surely as a USD event does. Impact — a colour-coded severity rating (typically yellow = low, orange = medium, red = high). Actual / Forecast / Previous — the released number, what analysts expected, and last period's reading.
b71237885e02.sw: Kila kiingilio hukupa sehemu zile zile za msingi. Muda — data inapoanguka, kwa kawaida hadi dakika; jozi za sarafu zinaweza kusogea ndani ya sekunde chache baada yake. Sarafu — ni sarafu ipi tukio linaloathiri; muhimu, kagua pande zote mbili za jozi lako, kwa sababu tukio la EUR husogeza EUR/USD kwa uhakika kama tukio la USD linavyofanya. Athari — daraja la ukali lenye mfumo wa rangi (kwa kawaida njano = ndogo, chungwa = ya kati, nyekundu = kubwa). Halisi / Utabiri / Iliyopita — namba iliyotolewa, kile wachambuzi walitarajia, na usomaji wa kipindi kilichopita.

b7294a4a5a9b.en: Correct — a broker gives you the same exposure to exchange rate movement without any physical travel or cash exchange — that's the entire reason retail forex trading exists.
b7294a4a5a9b.sw: Sahihi — broker anakupa uwazi ule ule kwa msogeo wa kiwango cha ubadilishaji bila safari yoyote ya kimwili wala ubadilishanaji wa fedha taslimu — hiyo ndiyo sababu yote ya kuwepo kwa biashara ya forex ya rejareja.

b74b0a8abc78.en: But avoidance alone wastes the opportunity. The genuinely valuable habit is to watch the events you're sitting out.
