b807659acdb0.en: You have a 2,000 dollar account and open a 50,000 dollar EUR/USD position at 50:1 leverage. Used margin is 50,000 / 50 = 1,000 dollars, leaving 1,000 dollars of free margin, and your margin level starts at 2,000 / 1,000 = 200%. Now price moves against you. A 1,000 dollar floating loss — a 2% move, about 200 pips — drops equity to 1,000 dollars, so margin level hits 100%: the margin call. If the loss reaches 1,500 dollars — a 3% move, about 300 pips — equity is 500 dollars, margin level is 50%, and the stop-out closes the trade for you. A 300-pip move has ended this position, whatever you wanted.
b807659acdb0.sw: Una akaunti ya dola 2,000 na unafungua nafasi ya EUR/USD ya dola 50,000 kwa leverage ya 50:1. Margin iliyotumika ni 50,000 / 50 = dola 1,000, ikiacha dola 1,000 za margin huru, na kiwango chako cha margin huanza kwa 2,000 / 1,000 = 200%. Sasa bei inasogea dhidi yako. Hasara inayoelea ya dola 1,000 — msogeo wa 2%, takriban pip 200 — hushusha usawa hadi dola 1,000, hivyo kiwango cha margin hufikia 100%: wito wa margin. Kama hasara itafikia dola 1,500 — msogeo wa 3%, takriban pip 300 — usawa ni dola 500, kiwango cha margin ni 50%, na stop-out hufunga biashara kwa niaba yako. Msogeo wa pip 300 umeimaliza nafasi hii, chochote ulichotaka.

b9a96056a5d4.en: The argument is arithmetic, not empirical, which is what makes it strong. All the shares in a market are held by someone. The passively managed money holds the market in proportion, so it earns the market return before costs. The remaining money is actively managed and, taken together, must therefore also hold the rest of the market in proportion — so it too earns the market return before costs. Active management as a whole cannot beat the market before costs, because in aggregate it is the market. After costs, and active costs are higher, it must on average do worse.

Pesa zilizobaki husimamiwa kwa bidii na, kwa pamoja, lazima kwa hivyo pia zishikilie soko lililobaki kwa uwiano — hivyo nazo hupata faida ya soko kabla ya gharama. Usimamizi wa bidii kwa ujumla hauwezi kushinda soko kabla ya gharama, kwa sababu kwa jumla ndio soko. Baada ya gharama, na gharama za bidii ziko juu zaidi, lazima kwa wastani ufanye vibaya zaidi.

bf94f292a3fb.en: Now the evidence — because Fibonacci retracements are exactly the kind of widely-repeated claim this course has taught you to check. The research is genuinely mixed, and knowing the shape of that disagreement is more useful than either blind faith or blanket dismissal. As early as 1977, Arthur Merrill's systematic study of market swings found no reliably standard retracement level. A rigorous 2021 study in Expert Systems with Applications built an algorithm to detect retracements objectively across Dow Jones, NASDAQ, and DAX stocks and found prices do bounce at Fibonacci levels somewhat more often than at arbitrary levels — but the authors explicitly note this doesn't necessarily translate into a profitable trading strategy. And multiple reviews find that standalone Fibonacci levels perform about as well as random levels, improving only when combined with independent evidence like support/resistance or trend. The most defensible reading: Fibonacci levels work partly because thousands of traders watch the same levels and place orders there — a self-fulfilling coordination point, not market magic. Treat them as zones where a reaction is plausible and other traders are paying attention — never as a guarantee, and never as a standalone system.
bf94f292a3fb.sw: Sasa ushahidi — kwa sababu kurudi nyuma kwa Fibonacci ni hasa aina ya dai linalorudiwa kwa upana ambalo kozi hii imekufundisha kulikagua. Utafiti umechanganyika kweli, na kujua umbo la mgogoro huo ni la manufaa zaidi kuliko imani ya kipofu au kukataa kwa jumla. Mapema kama mwaka 1977, utafiti wa kimfumo wa Arthur Merrill wa mizunguko ya soko haukupata kiwango chochote sanifu cha kutegemewa cha kurudi nyuma. Utafiti makini wa mwaka 2021 katika Expert Systems with Applications ulijenga algoriti ya kubaini kurudi nyuma kwa lengo katika hisa za Dow Jones, NASDAQ, na DAX na ukagundua bei huruka kwenye viwango vya Fibonacci mara nyingi kidogo zaidi kuliko kwenye viwango vya bahati nasibu — lakini waandishi wanabainisha wazi kwamba hili si lazima litafsirike kuwa mkakati wa biashara wenye faida. Na mapitio kadhaa hugundua kwamba viwango vya Fibonacci vinavyosimama peke yake hufanya kazi karibu sawa na viwango vya bahati nasibu, vikiboreka tu vinapounganishwa na ushahidi huru kama msaada/upinzani au mwelekeo. Usomaji unaotetewa zaidi: viwango vya Fibonacci hufanya kazi kwa sehemu kwa sababu maelfu ya wafanyabiashara hutazama viwango vile vile na kuweka maagizo hapo — mahali pa kuratibu panapojitimiza penyewe, si uchawi wa soko. Vichukulie kama kanda ambapo mwitikio unawezekana na wafanyabiashara wengine wanazingatia — kamwe si uhakika, na kamwe si mfumo unaosimama peke yake.

bfa7c6c25d1b.en: Total open position size divided by account equity — the leverage you are actually running.
bfa7c6c25d1b.sw: Ukubwa wa jumla wa nafasi zilizo wazi kugawanywa kwa usawa wa akaunti — leverage unayoiendesha hasa.

bfd1d44a9c3e.en: Inflation from rising production costs being passed on to consumers.
bfd1d44a9c3e.sw: Mfumuko wa bei unaotokana na gharama za uzalishaji zinazopanda kupitishwa kwa walaji.

bfdae7febe22.en: Spreading exposure across different assets, sectors, regions, or markets so that a single holding's poor performance doesn't dominate your overall result.
bfdae7febe22.sw: Kueneza uwazi katika mali, sekta, kanda, au masoko tofauti ili utendaji mbaya wa umiliki mmoja usitawale matokeo yako ya jumla.

bfdd838eba71.en: Chasing news; fix by ignoring the calendar
bfdd838eba71.sw: Kufukuza habari; rekebisha kwa kupuuza kalenda

bfdff4663cd8.en: Trading from the movement of price itself, without indicators derived from it.
bfdff4663cd8.sw: Kufanya biashara kutoka msogeo wa bei yenyewe, bila viashiria vinavyotokana nayo.

c070af460d88.en: Correct — they documented a sign effect: bad news has a greater impact than good news of comparable magnitude.
c070af460d88.sw: Sahihi — waliandika athari ya ishara: habari mbaya ina athari kubwa zaidi kuliko habari njema ya ukubwa unaolingana.

c0a1786d72ae.en: The risk a market maker faces from trading against better-informed counterparties.
c0a1786d72ae.sw: Hatari ambayo mtengeneza-soko anakabiliana nayo kutokana na kufanya biashara dhidi ya wenzake wenye taarifa bora zaidi.

c0b4d1efce8a.en: The price at which you plan to exit if the position moves against you, capping your loss at a known, fixed amount.
c0b4d1efce8a.sw: Bei ambayo kwayo unapanga kutoka kama nafasi itasogea dhidi yako, ikiweka kikomo cha hasara yako kwa kiasi kinachojulikana na thabiti.

c0c825754811.en: Not quite — discipline is following a pre-committed plan so the key decisions are not made live. It is a system, not a calm feeling you have to summon.
c0c825754811.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — nidhamu ni kufuata mpango uliojitolewa mapema ili maamuzi muhimu yasifanywe hai. Ni mfumo, si hisia ya utulivu unayolazimika kuiita.

c0db0e76757b.en: The margin level at which the broker forcibly closes positions, below the margin call level.
c0db0e76757b.sw: Kiwango cha margin ambapo broker hufunga nafasi kwa lazima, chini ya kiwango cha wito wa margin.

c0f079b01c4f.en: The index level is then the total float-adjusted market value of the constituents, divided by a number called the divisor. The divisor exists so that mechanical events — a stock split, a company joining or leaving — do not make the index jump when nothing real has happened. S&P Dow Jones Indices publishes both the index-mathematics and float-adjustment methodologies openly, which is worth knowing: the rule is not a secret, and you can read it.
c0f079b01c4f.sw: Kiwango cha index kisha ni thamani ya jumla ya soko iliyorekebishwa kwa float ya washiriki, kugawanywa kwa namba inayoitwa kigawanyaji. Kigawanyaji kipo ili matukio ya kimitambo — kugawanywa kwa hisa, kampuni kujiunga au kuondoka — yasifanye index iruke wakati hakuna kilichotokea halisi. S&P Dow Jones Indices huchapisha mbinu zote za hisabati ya index na marekebisho ya float waziwazi, jambo linalostahili kujulikana: kanuni si siri, na unaweza kuisoma.

c0f1ff2cf713.en: Currency pairs pairing the U.S. dollar with another major currency. These are the most liquid, most widely traded pairs in the market.
c0f1ff2cf713.sw: Jozi za sarafu zinazoweka pamoja dola ya Marekani na sarafu nyingine kuu. Haya ndiyo jozi yenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi na yanayofanyiwa biashara kwa upana zaidi sokoni.

c0fefdc76e92.en: In Cases B and C, pip value is not fixed — it floats with the exchange rate you convert through. As USD/JPY moves, the dollar value of a pip on that pair moves too. This means your dollar risk drifts slightly as rates change, so recompute pip value at the current rate rather than reusing a number from last week. This is a genuine, if small, way that "fixed" risk in forex is never perfectly fixed.
c0fefdc76e92.sw: Katika Kesi B na C, thamani ya pip si thabiti — huelea pamoja na kiwango cha ubadilishaji unachobadilisha kupitia. USD/JPY inaposogea, thamani ya dola ya pip kwenye jozi hilo husogea pia. Hii inamaanisha hatari yako ya dola husogea kidogo viwango vinapobadilika, hivyo kokotoa upya thamani ya pip kwa kiwango cha sasa badala ya kutumia tena namba ya wiki iliyopita. Hii ni njia halisi, ingawa ndogo, ambayo hatari "thabiti" katika forex si thabiti kikamilifu kamwe.

c1106ca6f93f.en: The loss if a trade hits its stop versus the gain if it hits its target (e.g., 1:2).
c1106ca6f93f.sw: Hasara kama biashara itagonga stop yake dhidi ya faida kama itagonga lengo lake (mfano, 1:2).

c138a4dca350.en: The first currency in a pair — the one being measured as "1."
c138a4dca350.sw: Sarafu ya kwanza katika jozi — ile inayopimwa kama "1."

c13da41acf61.en: The number of shares the company has issued. Earnings per share, book value per share and dividends per share are all divided by it.
c13da41acf61.sw: Idadi ya hisa ambazo kampuni imezitoa. Mapato kwa kila hisa, thamani ya kitabu kwa kila hisa na gawio kwa kila hisa vyote hugawanywa kwayo.

c15500b506fe.en: A naked-chart trade reads like this. On the 4-hour EUR/USD chart, price has twice reversed upward near 1.0975 — that is support. Price falls to it a third time and forms a bullish reversal candle. A price-action trader enters long at 1.1005 with a stop just below the level at 1.0975 — a distance of 30 pips (1.1005 − 1.0975 = 0.0030). No indicator was used; the decision came from the level and the candle alone. Whether that decision has an edge is the question the evidence has to answer.
c15500b506fe.sw: Biashara ya chati tupu husomeka hivi. Kwenye chati ya EUR/USD ya saa 4, bei imegeuka juu mara mbili karibu na 1.0975 — huo ni msaada. Bei inashuka kwake mara ya tatu na kuunda mshumaa wa mgeuko wa kupanda. Mfanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei anaingia long kwa 1.1005 akiwa na stop chini kidogo ya kiwango kwa 1.0975 — umbali wa pip 30 (1.1005 − 1.0975 = 0.0030). Hakuna kiashiria kilichotumika; uamuzi ulitoka kwenye kiwango na mshumaa peke yake. Kama uamuzi huo una faida ndilo swali ambalo ushahidi lazima ulijibu.

c1682dec2315.en: The most heavily traded currencies globally (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF).
c1682dec2315.sw: Sarafu zinazofanyiwa biashara kwa wingi zaidi duniani (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF).

c18647723535.en: There is even evidence that conviction, defined properly, pays. Anton, Cohen and Polk, in their study "Best Ideas," found that the single stocks in which professional managers show the most ex-ante conviction outperform both the market and the managers' own other holdings by roughly 2.8 to 4.5% per year — while the rest of what those managers hold does not beat the market at all. The lesson is not "be confident." It is that a manager's best-analysed idea, the one where the case is strongest, is where the edge lives — and the six pillars are how you find which idea that is.
c18647723535.sw: Kuna hata ushahidi kwamba uhakika, ukifafanuliwa ipasavyo, hulipa. Anton, Cohen na Polk, katika utafiti wao "Best Ideas," waligundua kwamba hisa moja moja ambazo wasimamizi wa kitaaluma huonyesha uhakika mkubwa zaidi mapema hufanya vizuri kuliko soko na kuliko umiliki mwingine wa wasimamizi wenyewe kwa takriban 2.8 hadi 4.5% kwa mwaka — ilhali kilichobaki wanachoshikilia wasimamizi hao hakishindi soko kabisa. Fundisho si "jiamini." Ni kwamba wazo lililochambuliwa vizuri zaidi la msimamizi, lile ambalo hoja yake ni imara zaidi, ndipo faida inapoishi — na nguzo sita ndio jinsi unavyopata ni wazo lipi hilo.

c1acf4e456e7.en: A central bank's primary policy tool — effectively the price of money.
c1acf4e456e7.sw: Zana kuu ya sera ya benki kuu — kwa hakika bei ya pesa.

c1c06b5c653b.en: The 2,000 dollar account, because its effective leverage (25:1) is far higher
c1c06b5c653b.sw: Akaunti ya dola 2,000, kwa sababu leverage yake halisi (25:1) iko juu zaidi mno

c1c553d2da52.en: Correct — this is the precise, nuanced finding: real signal, not a guarantee of profit.
c1c553d2da52.sw: Sahihi — hili ndilo tokeo sahihi na lenye upambanuzi: ishara halisi, si uhakika wa faida.

c1cd2f2c1d53.en: An authorised participant can do something you cannot. It can deliver the underlying basket of shares to the fund and receive newly created ETF shares in return, or hand back a block of ETF shares and receive the underlying basket. The US Securities and Exchange Commission describes this creation and redemption process in its investor bulletin on ETFs, and it is the structural feature that makes the whole thing work.
c1cd2f2c1d53.sw: Mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa anaweza kufanya kitu ambacho huwezi. Anaweza kuwasilisha kikapu cha msingi cha hisa kwa fund na kupokea hisa mpya za ETF zilizoundwa badala yake, au kurudisha kifurushi cha hisa za ETF na kupokea kikapu cha msingi. Tume ya Usalama na Ubadilishaji ya Marekani inaelezea mchakato huu wa kuunda na kukomboa katika taarifa yake kwa wawekezaji kuhusu ETF, na ni sifa ya kimuundo inayofanya kila kitu kifanye kazi.

c1cd701b6964.en: The assumptions are obviously not the real world, and that is the point of the result rather than a flaw in it. It tells you where to look. If dividend policy matters in practice, it must matter because of one of the things the model assumed away: tax, costs, or what the payment reveals about management's intentions. It is not because cash paid out is inherently superior to value retained.
c1cd701b6964.sw: Dhana wazi si dunia halisi, na hiyo ndiyo pointi ya tokeo badala ya udhaifu ndani yake. Hukuambia mahali pa kutazama. Kama sera ya gawio inahusika kivitendo, lazima ihusike kwa sababu ya mojawapo ya vitu ambavyo muundo uliviondoa: kodi, gharama, au kile ambacho malipo hufichua kuhusu nia za usimamizi. Si kwa sababu fedha zilizolipwa nje ni bora kimsingi kuliko thamani iliyohifadhiwa.

c294f152c6d0.sw: Maelekezo ya kununua au kuuza mara moja kwa bei bora inayopatikana sasa. Huhakikisha utekelezaji. Haihakikishi bei.

c2c0425f68e9.sw: ETF inayofanyiwa biashara juu ya NAV yake iko kwenye malipo ya ziada; chini yake, punguzo.

c2c2098b1150.en: Put it into practice before using leverage: calculate your actual required margin and confirm your account can absorb realistic adverse moves without a margin call. Remember that leverage changes how much capital you need to open a position — it does not by itself determine how much you're risking; position sizing and stop-loss placement are what actually control that. And treat "maximum available leverage" marketing claims with real skepticism, since regulators cap leverage precisely because higher leverage is associated with worse trader outcomes, not better ones.
c2c2098b1150.sw: Iweke katika vitendo kabla ya kutumia leverage: kokotoa margin yako halisi inayohitajika na uthibitishe kwamba akaunti yako inaweza kufyonza misogeo mibaya halisi bila wito wa margin. Kumbuka kwamba leverage hubadilisha kiasi cha mtaji unaohitaji kufungua nafasi — haiamui yenyewe kiasi unachohatarisha; upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi na uwekaji wa stop-loss ndivyo vinavyodhibiti hilo hasa. Na chukulia madai ya matangazo ya "leverage ya juu zaidi inayopatikana" kwa shaka halisi, kwa kuwa wadhibiti huweka kikomo cha leverage hasa kwa sababu leverage kubwa zaidi inahusishwa na matokeo mabaya zaidi ya wafanyabiashara, si bora zaidi.

c2e11f026fb0.en: Correct. The claim on profits is identical, so the two classes rise and fall broadly together. What differs is control, and control was never realistic for a small holder anyway. The honest conclusion is to stop treating the vote as protection and judge the holding purely on the business.
c2e11f026fb0.sw: Sahihi. Dai juu ya faida linafanana, hivyo madaraja hayo mawili hupanda na kushuka kwa ujumla pamoja. Kinachotofautiana ni udhibiti, na udhibiti haukuwahi kuwa halisi kwa mwenye umiliki mdogo hata hivyo. Hitimisho la uaminifu ni kuacha kuchukulia kura kama ulinzi na kuhukumu umiliki kwa msingi wa biashara tu.

c3258d8fb2d6.en: Take any share with a yield above 6%. Find its payout ratio and its dividend history over the last five years. Then write one sentence explaining why the market is pricing that yield so high. If the honest sentence is that the market expects the payment to be cut, you have learned what the yield was actually telling you.
c3258d8fb2d6.sw: Chukua hisa yoyote yenye mavuno juu ya 6%. Pata uwiano wake wa malipo na historia yake ya gawio katika miaka mitano iliyopita. Kisha andika sentensi moja ikieleza kwa nini soko linaweka bei ya mavuno hayo juu hivyo. Kama sentensi ya uaminifu ni kwamba soko linatarajia malipo yatapunguzwa, umejifunza mavuno yalikuwa yakikuambia nini hasa.

c3a0e77b8424.en: Paid track — currency trading from first principles: the mechanics of a trade, then reading the market with honest evidence.
c3a0e77b8424.sw: Njia ya kulipia — biashara ya sarafu kuanzia misingi ya kwanza: utaratibu wa biashara, kisha kusoma soko kwa ushahidi wa uaminifu.

c4561506b091.en: Not quite. The dividend is paid out of the company, so the company — and therefore the share — is worth less by about that amount. You have not gained 2.00 or lost 2.00; you now hold a share worth about 58.00 plus 2.00 in cash. This is why total return, not yield, is the number that describes what happened.
c4561506b091.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Gawio hulipwa kutoka kampunini, hivyo kampuni — na kwa hivyo hisa — ina thamani ndogo kwa takriban kiasi hicho. Hujapata 2.00 wala kupoteza 2.00; sasa unashikilia hisa yenye thamani ya takriban 58.00 pamoja na 2.00 ya fedha taslimu. Ndiyo sababu faida ya jumla, si mavuno, ndiyo namba inayoeleza kilichotokea.

c4778858d2b7.en: A calculation derived entirely from an instrument's price history and/or trading volume, plotted on or below a chart. It uses nothing else: no news, no economic data, no opinion — only the chart in front of you.
c4778858d2b7.sw: Hesabu inayotokana kabisa na historia ya bei ya chombo na/au kiasi cha biashara, ikichorwa juu au chini ya chati. Haitumii kitu kingine chochote: hakuna habari, hakuna data ya kiuchumi, hakuna maoni — chati iliyo mbele yako tu.

c499c5711096.en: The tendency to sell winning positions too early, to lock in a sure gain, while holding losing positions too long, hoping they recover. The term was coined by Shefrin and Statman (1985).
c499c5711096.sw: Mwelekeo wa kuuza nafasi zenye ushindi mapema mno, kuhifadhi faida ya uhakika, huku ukishikilia nafasi za hasara muda mrefu mno, ukitumaini zitapona. Neno hilo lilibuniwa na Shefrin na Statman (1985).

c63ac25aa3e2.sw: Mfumuko mdogo wa bei hutoa nafasi kwa sera ya fedha kufanya kazi na husaidia kuepuka hatari za mporomoko wa bei

c697cf2296f7.en: Conventional RSI thresholds: above 70 = overbought (buying has been unusually one-sided), below 30 = oversold (selling has been unusually one-sided). More conservative traders use 80/20.
c697cf2296f7.sw: Vizingiti vya kawaida vya RSI: juu ya 70 = kununuliwa kupita kiasi (ununuzi umekuwa wa upande mmoja isivyo kawaida), chini ya 30 = kuuzwa kupita kiasi (uuzaji umekuwa wa upande mmoja isivyo kawaida). Wafanyabiashara wenye tahadhari zaidi hutumia 80/20.

c6c83f7ac893.en: Not quite — full Kelly can produce 50–80% drawdowns and requires numbers you can't know precisely, so most professionals use fractional Kelly or a fixed-percentage approach.
c6c83f7ac893.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — Kelly kamili inaweza kuzalisha kushuka kwa 50–80% na inahitaji namba usizoweza kuzijua kwa usahihi, hivyo wataalamu wengi hutumia Kelly ya sehemu au mbinu ya asilimia thabiti.

c71dc3442a7c.en: The currency your account is denominated in — the currency all risk is finally measured in.
c71dc3442a7c.sw: Sarafu ambayo akaunti yako imeelezwa kwayo — sarafu ambayo hatari yote hupimwa kwayo hatimaye.

c74ec9151267.en: It is tempting to treat the stop-out as a guaranteed floor: the worst that happens is you get closed at 50%. Usually true. Not always.
c74ec9151267.sw: Ni rahisi kuchukulia stop-out kama sakafu ya uhakika: baya zaidi linaloweza kutokea ni kufungwa kwa 50%. Kwa kawaida kweli. Si daima.

c7b80a1b4c8e.en: The practical consequence is to avoid trading a fund during the periods when its underlying market is shut, and to avoid the first and last minutes of any session. Both are moments when the mechanism that keeps the price near its net asset value is working with less information, and you pay for that in the spread.
c7b80a1b4c8e.sw: Tokeo la kivitendo ni kuepuka kufanyia biashara fund wakati wa vipindi ambavyo soko lake la msingi limefungwa, na kuepuka dakika za kwanza na za mwisho za kipindi chochote. Zote mbili ni nyakati ambapo utaratibu unaoweka bei karibu na thamani halisi ya mali unafanya kazi kwa taarifa chache, na unalipia hilo katika spread.

c7d2b15e4acb.en: One figure drawn from the cash flow statement is worth more than most ratios, because it answers the question an owner actually has.
c7d2b15e4acb.sw: Takwimu moja iliyochukuliwa kutoka taarifa ya mtiririko wa fedha ina thamani zaidi ya uwiano mwingi, kwa sababu hujibu swali ambalo mmiliki analo hasa.

c7d61eb2887a.sw: Ni tofauti gani ya kimuundo kati ya umiliki wa hisa wa muda mrefu na mchezo wa kasino?

c7e1648b9ccf.en: A risk exercise, introduced by psychologist Gary Klein (Harvard Business Review, 2007), in which you imagine that a plan has already failed and then generate all the plausible reasons for its failure — surfacing risks that optimism about your own idea would otherwise hide.

c832b6579b3b.en: A European roulette wheel has 37 pockets. A bet on a single number pays 35 to 1. Multiply the outcomes by their probabilities and the expected value of every unit staked is about 0.973 units returned — a loss of 2.7% per spin, on average, forever. Nothing about the player changes that figure. It is a property of the wheel.
c832b6579b3b.sw: Gurudumu la roulette la Ulaya lina mifuko 37. Dau juu ya namba moja hulipa 35 kwa 1. Zidisha matokeo kwa uwezekano wao na thamani inayotarajiwa ya kila kipimo kilichowekwa ni takriban vipimo 0.973 vinavyorudishwa — hasara ya 2.7% kwa kila mzunguko, kwa wastani, milele. Hakuna kuhusu mchezaji kinachobadilisha takwimu hiyo. Ni sifa ya gurudumu.

c8a6901f6a79.en: Before taking a price-action trade, check: is the level a genuine round number or repeatedly-tested price, where orders actually cluster — or a line you drew after the fact to fit what already happened? Are you treating support or resistance as raising the odds of a reversal, not as a guarantee? For a candlestick pattern, ask what happens to its edge if you change the exit rule, and be skeptical if it's fragile to that. And have you set your stop and size for the case where the level simply breaks — including a violent gap that no chart could have flagged?
c8a6901f6a79.sw: Kabla ya kuchukua biashara ya shughuli ya bei, kagua: je, kiwango ni namba halisi ya mviringo au bei iliyojaribiwa mara kwa mara, ambapo maagizo hujikusanya hasa — au mstari uliouchora baadaye ili ulingane na kilichotokea tayari? Je, unachukulia msaada au upinzani kama kinachoongeza uwezekano wa mgeuko, si kama uhakika? Kwa mtindo wa mishumaa, uliza kinachotokea kwa faida yake ukibadilisha kanuni ya kutoka, na uwe na shaka kama ni dhaifu kwa hilo. Na je, umeweka stop yako na ukubwa kwa hali ambapo kiwango kinavunjika tu — ikiwemo kuruka kwa nguvu ambako hakuna chati ingeweza kukionyesha?

c8a8ba4d2546.en: One correction worth making carefully: China's currency is officially called the renminbi (RMB), meaning "the people's currency" — the yuan is the base unit of the renminbi, the same relationship as "sterling" and "pound" in the UK. The ISO code CNY refers specifically to the yuan unit. In practice, "yuan" and "renminbi" are used almost interchangeably in everyday conversation, but the formal distinction is: renminbi is the currency, yuan is the unit it's counted in.
c8a8ba4d2546.sw: Marekebisho moja yanayostahili kufanywa kwa makini: sarafu ya China rasmi inaitwa renminbi (RMB), ikimaanisha "sarafu ya watu" — yuan ni kipimo cha msingi cha renminbi, uhusiano ule ule wa "sterling" na "pound" nchini Uingereza. Msimbo wa ISO CNY unarejelea mahususi kipimo cha yuan. Kivitendo, "yuan" na "renminbi" hutumiwa karibu kwa kubadilishana katika mazungumzo ya kila siku, lakini tofauti rasmi ni: renminbi ni sarafu, yuan ni kipimo kinachohesabiwa kwacho.

But the headline point stands: a dividend moves value from one pocket to another rather than creating it.

c95db9d6f0c8.en: Here's the honest problem, and it's a big one: financial prices do not actually follow a bell curve. This isn't a technicality — it's one of the most important findings in the history of finance. Benoit Mandelbrot demonstrated it in 1963 ("The Variation of Certain Speculative Prices," Journal of Business 36, 394–419): real price changes have fat tails — extreme moves occur far, far more often than the normal distribution predicts. Moves the bell curve calls once-in-thousands-of-years events happen every few years. You've already met the perfect example: the 2015 EUR/CHF collapse from Chapter 1, Lesson 7 — a move so far outside the bands that the clean "95% containment" math becomes meaningless. Practical consequence: price will pierce your bands more often than the statistics imply, sometimes violently. Bollinger Bands remain a genuinely useful volatility-adaptive tool — but never size a position as if the 95% figure were literally true.
c95db9d6f0c8.sw: Hili hapa tatizo la uaminifu, na ni kubwa: bei za kifedha kwa kweli hazifuati mkunjo wa kengele. Hii si suala la kiufundi — ni mojawapo ya matokeo muhimu zaidi katika historia ya fedha. Benoit Mandelbrot alilionyesha mwaka 1963 ("The Variation of Certain Speculative Prices," Journal of Business 36, 394–419): mabadiliko halisi ya bei yana mikia minene — misogeo ya kupindukia hutokea mara nyingi zaidi, zaidi sana, kuliko mtawanyiko wa kawaida unavyotabiri. Misogeo ambayo mkunjo wa kengele huiita matukio ya mara moja katika maelfu ya miaka hutokea kila baada ya miaka michache. Tayari umekutana na mfano kamili: kuanguka kwa EUR/CHF kwa mwaka 2015 kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 7 — msogeo ulio nje mno ya kanda kiasi kwamba hisabati safi ya "kubeba 95%" inakuwa isiyo na maana. Matokeo ya kivitendo: bei itapenya kanda zako mara nyingi zaidi kuliko takwimu zinavyodokeza, wakati mwingine kwa nguvu. Bollinger Bands zinabaki zana yenye manufaa kweli inayojirekebisha kwa mtikisiko — lakini kamwe usipime nafasi kana kwamba takwimu ya 95% ni kweli kihalisi.

c9a6d60c6e9c.en: Cash is a position. Choosing not to trade when nothing aligns is not inactivity — it is the active decision that preserves your capital and your discipline for when the odds are actually in your favour. This is the direct antidote to the overtrading of Chapter 4, Lesson 1: the urge to always have a position on is exactly what the all-quiet regime punishes. The best traders spend a great deal of time doing nothing, deliberately.

Hii ndiyo dawa ya moja kwa moja ya kufanya biashara kupita kiasi kwa Sura ya 4, Somo la 1: hamu ya kuwa na nafasi daima ndicho hasa ambacho hali ya utulivu kamili huadhibu. ca0383e5ff3e.en: Notice who was ruined: not the people who predicted the move — almost nobody did — but the people who were over-sized when it came. Traders who owed money on a single trade were not wrong about direction. They were simply too large for a gap to survive. This is the whole argument of Chapter 3, Lessons 1 and 2, written in losses.

ca06879112d8.en: The construction borrows a famous idea from statistics: in a normal distribution (the "bell curve"), about 68% of values fall within one standard deviation of the average, about 95% within two, and about 99.7% within three. Apply that to the last 20 closing prices, and bands at ±2 standard deviations "should" contain roughly 95% of price action — so a touch of the outer band suggests price is statistically stretched.
ca06879112d8.sw: Ujenzi hukopa wazo maarufu kutoka takwimu: katika mtawanyiko wa kawaida ("mkunjo wa kengele"), takriban 68% ya thamani huanguka ndani ya mkengeuko sanifu mmoja wa wastani, takriban 95% ndani ya miwili, na takriban 99.7% ndani ya mitatu. Tumia hilo kwa bei 20 za mwisho za kufunga, na kanda kwa ±2 za mkengeuko sanifu "zinapaswa" kubeba takriban 95% ya shughuli ya bei — hivyo kugusa kanda ya nje kunaashiria bei imenyooshwa kitakwimu.

ca368dc51668.en: Odean (1998), in The Journal of Finance, examined the trading records of 10,000 real discount-brokerage accounts. Investors were 1.5 to 2 times more likely to sell a winning stock than a losing one, even after accounting for taxes and portfolio rebalancing. And it was not shrewd: the winning stocks they sold went on to outperform the losing stocks they held. The instinct to bank the sure profit and give the loser room to recover measurably cost these investors money.
ca368dc51668.sw: Odean (1998), katika The Journal of Finance, alichunguza rekodi za biashara za akaunti 10,000 halisi za udalali wa punguzo. Wawekezaji walikuwa na uwezekano wa mara 1.5 hadi 2 zaidi wa kuuza hisa yenye ushindi kuliko yenye hasara, hata baada ya kuzingatia kodi na kusawazisha mkusanyiko. Na haikuwa busara: hisa zenye ushindi walizoziuza ziliendelea kufanya vizuri kuliko hisa zenye hasara walizozishikilia. Silika ya kuweka benki faida ya uhakika na kumpa mpotezaji nafasi ya kupona iliwagharimu wawekezaji hawa pesa kwa kiasi kinachopimika.

ca56c5cfea15.en: Put it into practice: before placing an order, know exactly what it guarantees — execution, price, or neither absolutely. Recognize which pairs carry unusual gap risk, since a pair tied to a central bank policy peg (like EUR/CHF was) can behave very differently from a normal floating pair. Confirm whether your broker offers negative balance protection before trading with real leverage. And remember that a rare, catastrophic event doesn't invalidate a risk-management tool — it's a reason position sizing and broker protections matter as a second layer, not a substitute for the first.
ca56c5cfea15.sw: Iweke katika vitendo: kabla ya kuweka agizo, jua hasa linahakikisha nini — utekelezaji, bei, au hakuna kabisa. Tambua ni jozi yapi yanabeba hatari isiyo ya kawaida ya kuruka, kwa kuwa jozi lililofungwa kwenye sera ya benki kuu (kama EUR/CHF ilivyokuwa) linaweza kutenda tofauti sana na jozi la kawaida linaloelea. Thibitisha kama broker wako anatoa ulinzi wa salio hasi kabla ya kufanya biashara kwa leverage halisi. Na kumbuka kwamba tukio nadra la maafa halibatilishi zana ya usimamizi wa hatari — ni sababu ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi na ulinzi wa broker kuhusika kama safu ya pili, si mbadala wa ya kwanza.

cc5db920e540.en: The spread is not fixed. It widens when few people are trading — early morning, late afternoon, holidays, and above all during the sharp moves when you are most likely to want out. Forex Chapter 5's case studies are the extreme version of this: in a genuine liquidity vacuum the book can empty, and a market order fills at a price far from the last one quoted. A market order is a promise to execute, never a promise about the price.

Uchunguzi wa matukio wa Sura ya 5 ya Forex ni toleo la kupindukia la hili: katika ombwe halisi la ukwasi kitabu kinaweza kuwa tupu, na agizo la soko hutimizwa kwa bei mbali na iliyonukuliwa mwisho. Agizo la soko ni ahadi ya kutekeleza, kamwe si ahadi kuhusu bei.

ce8f205f9a36.en: The term's exact origin is genuinely disputed — some say it stands for "Percentage in Point," others "Price Interest Point," and several serious sources note this may be a case of false etymology, a plausible-sounding backronym invented after the fact rather than the term's true origin. What's better established: the word came into wide use among European forex traders in the 1970s and 80s, as electronic trading standardized currency quotes to four decimal places and traders needed a fast, unambiguous way to talk about tiny price changes.
ce8f205f9a36.sw: Asili kamili ya neno hilo ina mgogoro kweli — wengine husema linasimama kwa "Percentage in Point," wengine "Price Interest Point," na vyanzo kadhaa vizito vinabainisha kwamba hii inaweza kuwa kesi ya asili ya uongo, ufupisho unaoonekana wa kuaminika uliobuniwa baadaye badala ya asili halisi ya neno. Kilicho na msingi bora zaidi: neno lilianza kutumika kwa upana miongoni mwa wafanyabiashara wa forex wa Ulaya katika miaka ya 1970 na 80, biashara ya kielektroniki ilipoweka nukuu za sarafu kwa nafasi nne za desimali na wafanyabiashara wakahitaji njia ya haraka na isiyo na utata ya kuzungumzia mabadiliko madogo ya bei.

ceb27dab2f23.en: What the company earned and spent over a period. It answers: was the business profitable during these months?
ceb27dab2f23.sw: Kampuni ilipata na kutumia nini katika kipindi. Hujibu: je, biashara ilikuwa na faida katika miezi hii?

cf33309114ef.en: There is a hard tension here that an honest course has to name. Concentration raises returns and raises risk. Putting more weight on fewer trades increases the damage when one is wrong, and Chapter 3, Lesson 1 showed exactly where that leads: the fraction risked per trade is the dominant lever on the risk of ruin.
cf33309114ef.sw: Kuna mvutano mgumu hapa ambao kozi ya uaminifu lazima iutaje. Kujikita huongeza faida na huongeza hatari. Kuweka uzito zaidi kwenye biashara chache huongeza madhara wakati moja inapokosea, na Sura ya 3, Somo la 1 lilionyesha hasa mahali hilo linakoelekea: sehemu inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara ndiyo lever kuu juu ya hatari ya kufilisika.

cf71efc98513.en: If a company has multiple share classes, check which one you are buying and what it can vote on. This is not usually a reason to avoid the company. It is a reason to stop imagining the vote is your protection, and to judge the position purely on whether the business will be worth more later.
cf71efc98513.sw: Kama kampuni ina madaraja mengi ya hisa, kagua ni lipi unalinunua na linaweza kupigia kura nini. Hii kwa kawaida si sababu ya kuepuka kampuni. Ni sababu ya kuacha kufikiria kwamba kura ndiyo ulinzi wako, na kuhukumu nafasi kwa msingi wa kama biashara itakuwa na thamani zaidi baadaye tu.

cffa31aa6876.en: A fund lending the shares it holds to other market participants in exchange for a fee, while holding collateral against the loan.
cffa31aa6876.sw: Fund kukopesha hisa inazoshikilia kwa washiriki wengine wa soko kwa ada, huku ikishikilia dhamana dhidi ya mkopo.

d022e8a117bf.en: The two-minute plunge, the BIS finding of no single cause, and where each factor was met earlier in the course.
d022e8a117bf.sw: Kuporomoka kwa dakika mbili, tokeo la BIS la kutokuwa na sababu moja, na mahali kila kipengele kilipokutana awali katika kozi.

d02e6b185e0c.en: Not quite — by the rule of four the short-term is about a quarter of the medium and the long-term about four times it: 15-minute and 4-hour.
d02e6b185e0c.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kwa kanuni ya nne muda mfupi ni takriban robo ya wa kati na muda mrefu takriban mara nne yake: dakika 15 na saa 4.

d0360d69a7b5.en: The honest takeaway, and the reason this lesson matters: "higher rates strengthen a currency" is a genuinely useful starting instinct — but it is not a reliable mechanical rule. Whether a move is already priced in, which direction the surprise breaks, and what global volatility is doing can all override it. Fundamentals tell you where pressure is building; they don't hand you a guaranteed outcome.
d0360d69a7b5.sw: Fundisho la uaminifu, na sababu somo hili linahusika: "viwango vya juu huimarisha sarafu" ni silika ya kuanzia yenye manufaa kweli — lakini si kanuni ya kimitambo ya kutegemewa. Kama msogeo tayari umewekewa bei, mshangao unavunjika mwelekeo upi, na mtikisiko wa kimataifa unafanya nini — vyote vinaweza kuizidi nguvu. Misingi hukuambia mahali shinikizo linapojengeka; haikupi tokeo la uhakika.

d05011242cbd.en: Correct — rejoining at the old pre-war rate overvalued the pound relative to the real post-war economy, straining it for years.
d05011242cbd.sw: Sahihi — kurudi kwa kiwango cha zamani cha kabla ya vita kuliizidishia pauni thamani ikilinganishwa na uchumi halisi wa baada ya vita, na kuibana kwa miaka mingi.

d0a39a419fbd.sw: Akaunti yako haikai tu kwenye hitaji thabiti la margin — inasogea biashara inaposogea.

d0b0ff277cad.en: Not quite — a short profits on a fall, so ask which direction would hurt it. That's where the stop goes.
d0b0ff277cad.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — short hupata faida bei ikishuka, hivyo jiulize ni mwelekeo upi ungeiumiza. Hapo ndipo stop huenda.

d0c038fd6d55.en: Activity feels like work, and work feels like it should be rewarded. Trading inverts that intuition: beyond the trades your rules actually call for, each extra one is a cost, not an effort. For most retail traders, doing less is the higher-skill move.
d0c038fd6d55.sw: Shughuli huhisi kama kazi, na kazi huhisi kama inapaswa kulipwa. Biashara hugeuza silika hiyo: zaidi ya biashara ambazo kanuni zako zinaziita hasa, kila moja ya ziada ni gharama, si juhudi. Kwa wafanyabiashara wengi wa rejareja, kufanya kidogo ndiyo hatua ya ustadi wa juu zaidi.

d0f30ab92f4b.en: A written plan pre-decides every recurring choice, and expectancy — (win rate x avg win) minus (loss rate x avg loss) — is the one number that says whether that plan actually makes money over time.
d0f30ab92f4b.sw: Mpango ulioandikwa huamua mapema kila chaguo linalojirudia, na matarajio — (kiwango cha ushindi x ushindi wa wastani) toa (kiwango cha hasara x hasara ya wastani) — ndio namba moja inayosema kama mpango huo hupata pesa hasa kwa muda.

d0f48856316c.en: Diagram: a farmer with vegetables wanting shoes cannot trade directly with a shoemaker who wants meat instead — money removes this problem
d0f48856316c.sw: Mchoro: mkulima mwenye mboga anayetaka viatu hawezi kubadilishana moja kwa moja na mshona-viatu anayetaka nyama badala yake — pesa huondoa tatizo hili

d19535393c67.en: The disciplined sequence uses tools you already have. Put the stop where the trade idea is actually wrong — the invalidation level from Foundations Chapter 2 and the multi-timeframe method in Chapter 2, Lesson 5. Put the target at a genuine obstacle — a support or resistance level from Foundations Chapter 3 that price would realistically reach and stall at. Then read off the ratio those two honest prices produce, and only take the trade if that ratio clears your minimum given a win rate you can actually expect.
d19535393c67.sw: Mfululizo wenye nidhamu hutumia zana ambazo tayari unazo. Weka stop mahali ambapo wazo la biashara si sahihi hasa — kiwango cha kuvunjika kutoka Sura ya 2 ya Msingi na mbinu ya vipindi vingi katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 5. Weka lengo kwenye kizuizi halisi — kiwango cha msaada au upinzani kutoka Sura ya 3 ya Msingi ambacho bei ingekifikia kihalisia na kusimama hapo. Kisha soma uwiano ambao bei hizo mbili za uaminifu huzalisha, na uchukue biashara tu kama uwiano huo unapita kiwango chako cha chini kwa kuzingatia kiwango cha ushindi unachoweza kukitarajia hasa.

d1bada0555e4.en: True or False: a standard stop-loss order guarantees your position will close at exactly the price you set, even during extreme volatility.
d1bada0555e4.sw: Kweli au Uongo: agizo sanifu la stop-loss huhakikisha nafasi yako itafungwa kwa bei hasa uliyoiweka, hata wakati wa mtikisiko mkubwa mno.

d1c1d134683b.en: The lowest price anyone is currently willing to sell it for. Also called the offer.
d1c1d134683b.sw: Bei ya chini zaidi ambayo mtu yeyote yuko tayari kuiuzia sasa. Pia huitwa offer.

d1cf31ead324.en: Every pillar can be invalidated, and a real thesis names how. If your trade rests on a rate-hike catalyst and the central bank holds, the thesis is dead regardless of price — that is an invalidation too. Writing these down in advance is what stops you from inventing reasons to stay in a losing trade, the disposition effect from Chapter 4, Lesson 1.
d1cf31ead324.sw: Kila nguzo inaweza kuvunjwa, na nadharia halisi hutaja jinsi gani. Kama biashara yako inakaa juu ya kichocheo cha kupanda kwa kiwango na benki kuu ikashikilia, nadharia imekufa bila kujali bei — hiyo ni kuvunjika pia. Kuandika haya mapema ndicho kinachokuzuia kubuni sababu za kubaki katika biashara ya hasara, athari ya kuachana na nafasi kutoka Sura ya 4, Somo la 1.

d21857aa93df.en: Correct — 15-minute and 4-hour. The short-term is roughly a quarter of the medium (60 ÷ 4 = 15) and the long-term roughly four times it (60 × 4 = 240 minutes = 4 hours).
d21857aa93df.sw: Sahihi — dakika 15 na saa 4. Muda mfupi ni takriban robo ya wa kati (60 ÷ 4 = 15) na muda mrefu takriban mara nne yake (60 × 4 = dakika 240 = saa 4).

d341b8124a72.en: In the United States, the CFTC has capped retail forex leverage at 50:1 for major currency pairs (20:1 for others) since October 2010, under authority granted by the Dodd-Frank Act. In the European Union, ESMA capped retail leverage at 30:1 for major pairs in 2018 — a rule the UK's FCA kept in place independently after Brexit, and Australia's ASIC adopted a similar 30:1 cap in 2021.
d341b8124a72.sw: Nchini Marekani, CFTC imeweka kikomo cha leverage ya forex ya rejareja cha 50:1 kwa jozi kuu za sarafu (20:1 kwa nyingine) tangu Oktoba 2010, chini ya mamlaka iliyotolewa na Sheria ya Dodd-Frank. Katika Umoja wa Ulaya, ESMA iliweka kikomo cha leverage ya rejareja cha 30:1 kwa jozi kuu mwaka 2018 — kanuni ambayo FCA ya Uingereza iliiweka mahali pake kwa kujitegemea baada ya Brexit, na ASIC ya Australia ilikubali kikomo kinachofanana cha 30:1 mwaka 2021.

d38887fd05a3.en: Accepting a risk exists, but capping how much it can cost you. This is what a stop-loss does mechanically — and it's the technique you'll use the most, by far.
d38887fd05a3.sw: Kukubali kwamba hatari ipo, lakini kuweka kikomo cha kiasi inachoweza kukugharimu. Hiki ndicho stop-loss inachofanya kimitambo — na ndiyo mbinu utakayoitumia zaidi kuliko zote, kwa mbali.

d39d67b6f971.sw: Kweli au Uongo: "fumbo la malipo ya mbele" hurejelea tokeo la kimajaribio kwamba sarafu za viwango vya juu vya riba hudhoofika kwa kutegemewa, hasa kama Usawa wa Riba Usiofunikwa unavyotabiri.

d4211f1868b7.en: Correct — effective leverage is position size divided by equity: 25:1 versus 5:1. The smaller account has a thinner free-margin cushion, so a 200-pip move calls it while the larger account can absorb about 1,800.
d4211f1868b7.sw: Sahihi — leverage halisi ni ukubwa wa nafasi kugawanywa kwa usawa: 25:1 dhidi ya 5:1. Akaunti ndogo ina mto mwembamba zaidi wa margin huru, hivyo msogeo wa pip 200 huiita ilhali akaunti kubwa inaweza kufyonza takriban 1,800.

d44a4a44dee6.en: You have seen this exact trap before. In Lesson 5, Sullivan, Timmermann and White showed that a trading rule can look profitable purely because it was the best-fitting choice among many — the data-snooping problem. Candlestick results that hinge on which exit rule you happen to pick are that same warning in a new place. If a strategy's profit appears or vanishes depending on an arbitrary exit choice, the profit was never solid ground.
d44a4a44dee6.sw: Umeuona mtego huu hasa awali. Katika Somo la 5, Sullivan, Timmermann na White walionyesha kwamba kanuni ya biashara inaweza kuonekana yenye faida kwa sababu tu ilikuwa chaguo lililolingana vizuri zaidi kati ya mengi — tatizo la kupekua data. Matokeo ya mishumaa yanayotegemea kanuni ipi ya kutoka unayochagua ni onyo lile lile katika mahali papya. Kama faida ya mkakati inajitokeza au inatoweka kutegemea chaguo la bahati nasibu la kutoka, faida haikuwa msingi imara kamwe.

d47099aaa634.en: Not quite — break-even win rate = 1 / (1 + R) = 1 / 4 = 25% at 1:3.
d47099aaa634.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana = 1 / (1 + R) = 1 / 4 = 25% kwa 1:3.

d48cf545e994.en: Why do most central banks target a low, positive inflation rate (commonly around 2%) instead of 0%?
d48cf545e994.sw: Kwa nini benki kuu nyingi hulenga kiwango cha chini na chanya cha mfumuko wa bei (kwa kawaida karibu 2%) badala ya 0%?

d4f34ff086d8.en: The market's aggregated expectation for an upcoming data release, compiled from economists' and analysts' predictions. It's the benchmark the actual number gets judged against.
d4f34ff086d8.sw: Matarajio yaliyokusanywa ya soko kwa toleo la data linalokuja, yaliyokusanywa kutoka utabiri wa wachumi na wachambuzi. Ndiyo kigezo ambacho namba halisi hupimwa dhidi yake.

d4fe02c867a2.en: Correct — Caginalp and Laurent (1998) found candlesticks profitable; Marshall, Young and Rose (2006) did not, largely because of differing methodology including the exit rule. An edge that depends on an arbitrary exit choice is exactly the fragility Lesson 5 warned about.
d4fe02c867a2.sw: Sahihi — Caginalp na Laurent (1998) waliipata mishumaa yenye faida; Marshall, Young na Rose (2006) hawakuipata, kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa sababu ya mbinu tofauti ikiwemo kanuni ya kutoka. Faida inayotegemea chaguo la bahati nasibu la kutoka ni hasa udhaifu ambao Somo la 5 lilionya kuhusu.

d51e8060b199.en: Proof that high-rate currencies always rise
d51e8060b199.sw: Uthibitisho kwamba sarafu za viwango vya juu daima hupanda

d5265e3ded1b.en: The highest price anyone is currently willing to pay for the share.
d5265e3ded1b.sw: Bei ya juu zaidi ambayo mtu yeyote yuko tayari kuilipa kwa hisa sasa.

d57d82da6de4.en: Two currencies quoted against each other, expressing the value of one in terms of the other.
d57d82da6de4.sw: Sarafu mbili zinazonukuliwa dhidi ya kila mmoja, zikieleza thamani ya moja kwa nyingine.

d5c1ef122645.en: So the account splits cleanly: used margin (locked as collateral for your open positions) plus free margin (everything else) equals your equity. When a trade moves against you, its floating loss lowers your equity, which shrinks your free margin, which drives your margin level down. Watching that chain is the whole skill of this lesson.
d5c1ef122645.sw: Hivyo akaunti hugawanyika safi: margin iliyotumika (iliyofungwa kama dhamana ya nafasi zako zilizo wazi) pamoja na margin huru (kila kitu kingine) ni sawa na usawa wako. Biashara inaposogea dhidi yako, hasara yake inayoelea hushusha usawa wako, ambao hupunguza margin yako huru, ambayo husukuma kiwango chako cha margin chini. Kutazama mnyororo huo ndio ustadi wote wa somo hili.

d5fbb2104d78.en: The currency your trading account is denominated in. Every risk figure, in the end, has to be expressed in it, because that is the currency you actually win or lose.
d5fbb2104d78.sw: Sarafu ambayo akaunti yako ya biashara imeelezwa kwayo. Kila takwimu ya hatari, hatimaye, lazima ielezwe kwayo, kwa sababu hiyo ndiyo sarafu unayoshinda au kupoteza hasa.

d5fe92f81827.en: There are hundreds of indicators, and anyone can invent a new one — many are redundant or worthless. Piling many onto one chart doesn't add insight; it adds conflict. This mirrors a general principle from statistics: adding more and more weakly-informative variables to a prediction degrades it rather than improving it. Pick a small number of tools you genuinely understand. Fifteen out of twenty indicators "agreeing" means far less than it sounds like — many are computing near-identical things from the same prices.
d5fe92f81827.sw: Kuna mamia ya viashiria, na mtu yeyote anaweza kubuni kipya — vingi ni vya marudio au visivyo na thamani. Kurundika vingi kwenye chati moja hakuongezi ufahamu; kunaongeza mgongano. Hii inaakisi kanuni ya jumla kutoka takwimu: kuongeza vigezo vingi zaidi visivyo na taarifa nyingi kwenye utabiri hukudhoofisha badala ya kukuboresha. Chagua idadi ndogo ya zana unazozielewa kweli. Viashiria kumi na tano kati ya ishirini "kukubaliana" kunamaanisha kidogo mno kuliko inavyosikika — vingi vinakokotoa vitu vinavyokaribia kufanana kutoka bei zile zile.

d61ff04ba512.en: The usual answer is that investing is sensible and gambling is reckless, or that investing is slow and gambling is fast. Neither survives contact with reality. Buying a single speculative company with your savings is investing by that definition, and it is plainly a gamble. A structured bet with a known edge is gambling by that definition, and it is plainly not reckless.
d61ff04ba512.sw: Jibu la kawaida ni kwamba kuwekeza ni jambo la busara na kamari ni uzembe, au kwamba kuwekeza ni polepole na kamari ni haraka. Hakuna kinachonusurika kukutana na uhalisia. Kununua kampuni moja ya kubahatisha kwa akiba yako ni kuwekeza kwa maana hiyo, na ni kamari waziwazi. Dau lililopangwa lenye faida inayojulikana ni kamari kwa maana hiyo, na si uzembe waziwazi.

d62591dbdf9f.en: An approach to trading that bases decisions on the movement of price itself — its highs, lows, and the shapes it forms — without using indicators derived from that price.
d62591dbdf9f.sw: Mbinu ya biashara inayojenga maamuzi juu ya msogeo wa bei yenyewe — vilele vyake, mabonde, na maumbo inayoyaunda — bila kutumia viashiria vinavyotokana na bei hiyo.

d63581a0d1e2.en: Timeframe-shopping is cycling through charts until you find one that agrees with a trade you already want to make. If the daily says down, the 4-hour says down, and the 9-minute says up — and you take the long — you haven't done multi-timeframe analysis. You've searched a set of options for the answer you wanted. The direction of travel must be top-down, decided in sequence, and you have to accept the answer the higher timeframe gives you.
d63581a0d1e2.sw: Kutafuta vipindi ni kuzunguka chati hadi upate moja inayokubaliana na biashara ambayo tayari unataka kuifanya. Kama ya kila siku inasema chini, ya saa 4 inasema chini, na ya dakika 9 inasema juu — na unachukua long — hujafanya uchambuzi wa vipindi vingi. Umetafuta katika seti ya chaguo jibu ulilolitaka. Mwelekeo wa safari lazima uwe juu-kwenda-chini, ukiamuliwa kwa mfululizo, na lazima ukubali jibu ambalo kipindi cha juu zaidi kinakupa.

d662fbb04f61.en: Never move the target closer, or the stop wider, after entry to rescue a trade — that quietly destroys the ratio you planned. Widening a stop to avoid being closed turns a 1:2 trade into a 1:1 or worse, and the arithmetic above shows exactly what that does to the win rate you now need. The ratio is a decision made before the trade, and then defended.
d662fbb04f61.sw: Kamwe usisogeze lengo karibu, wala stop pana, baada ya kuingia ili kuokoa biashara — hilo huharibu kimyakimya uwiano uliopanga. Kupanua stop ili kuepuka kufungwa hugeuza biashara ya 1:2 kuwa 1:1 au mbaya zaidi, na hesabu hapo juu inaonyesha hasa hilo linafanya nini kwa kiwango cha ushindi unachohitaji sasa. Uwiano ni uamuzi unaofanywa kabla ya biashara, kisha kutetewa.

d6d025ec1504.en: Gold was excellent as money for a long time — but as trade grew larger and more complex, it ran into four real problems: it could be secretly debased, its value could shift when new gold was discovered, it was heavy and risky to transport, and there was often not enough of it in circulation to match the pace of trade.
d6d025ec1504.sw: Dhahabu ilikuwa bora sana kama pesa kwa muda mrefu — lakini biashara ilipokua kubwa na tata zaidi, ilikumbana na matatizo manne halisi: ingeweza kupunguzwa ubora kwa siri, thamani yake ingeweza kubadilika dhahabu mpya ilipogunduliwa, ilikuwa nzito na hatari kusafirisha, na mara nyingi haikuwepo ya kutosha katika mzunguko kulingana na kasi ya biashara.

d72c54ab726f.en: It prevents the fund from tracking its index

d734dc49cd05.en: Favouring higher rates (to fight inflation) / lower rates (to boost growth).
d734dc49cd05.sw: Kupendelea viwango vya juu (kupambana na mfumuko wa bei) / viwango vya chini (kukuza ukuaji).

d7355b6fa2ec.en: A price level where falling prices have repeatedly reversed upward.
d7355b6fa2ec.sw: Kiwango cha bei ambapo bei zinazoshuka zimegeuka kupanda mara kwa mara.

d747316e3751.en: Because market-moving events are scheduled, the economic calendar tells you in advance when a currency is likely to move — and price reacts to the gap between the forecast and the actual number, not to the event itself.

d7aadbcd7aeb.en: Not quite — with a poor risk-to-reward ratio, even a 70% win rate can barely break even or lose. Win rate alone does not decide profitability.

d9fe38a8b898.en: The path by which a change in monetary policy ripples across markets: interest rates move first, then flow through to currencies and bonds, then to credit and equities, then to commodities, and on to risk assets like crypto.

da37d0ef7dd0.en: The single most important RSI discipline — and the mistake that costs beginners the most: do not buy simply because something is oversold, and do not short simply because it's overbought. Markets can stay overbought or oversold for a very long time while continuing in the same direction — an oversold currency can keep getting more oversold, day after day. Buying it on the way down is catching a falling knife with a statistics label on it.
da37d0ef7dd0.sw: Nidhamu muhimu kuliko zote ya RSI — na kosa linalowagharimu wanaoanza zaidi: usinunue tu kwa sababu kitu kimeuzwa kupita kiasi, na usifanye short tu kwa sababu kimenunuliwa kupita kiasi. Masoko yanaweza kubaki yamenunuliwa au kuuzwa kupita kiasi kwa muda mrefu sana huku yakiendelea kwa mwelekeo ule ule — sarafu iliyouzwa kupita kiasi inaweza kuendelea kuuzwa zaidi kupita kiasi, siku baada ya siku. Kuinunua ikishuka ni kukamata kisu kinachoanguka chenye lebo ya takwimu.

db16e18008b3.en: An indicator (created by Gerald Appel in the 1970s) that plots the difference between two exponential moving averages (typically 12- and 26-period), plus a 9-period "signal line" of that difference. When the MACD line crosses its signal line, that's the buy/sell trigger.
db16e18008b3.sw: Kiashiria (kilichoundwa na Gerald Appel katika miaka ya 1970) kinachochora tofauti kati ya wastani wawili wa kielelezo unaosogea (kwa kawaida vipindi 12 na 26), pamoja na "mstari wa ishara" wa vipindi 9 wa tofauti hiyo. Mstari wa MACD unapokatiza mstari wake wa ishara, huo ndio kianzishi cha kununua/kuuza.

db8c31cfba28.en: Compare the two ends. The difference in fee is 1.45% a year. The difference in outcome is about 25,223 — the expensive option finishes with roughly 66% of what the cheap one produced. A 1.45% annual charge consumed about a third of the final pot.
db8c31cfba28.sw: Linganisha ncha hizo mbili. Tofauti ya ada ni 1.45% kwa mwaka. Tofauti ya tokeo ni takriban 25,223 — chaguo ghali humalizia na takriban 66% ya kile chaguo la bei nafuu kilizalisha. Malipo ya kila mwaka ya 1.45% yalimeza takriban theluthi moja ya chungu cha mwisho.

db9d1b280ec6.en: Diagram of GBP/USD falling about 6 percent in two minutes to a 31-year low near 1.18 in the thin overnight session then mostly recovering, the BIS finding of no single cause (thin time-of-day liquidity, options-hedging sell flow, stop-loss cascade, and algorithms), and the lesson that thin liquidity and timing are real execution risks
db9d1b280ec6.sw: Mchoro wa GBP/USD likishuka takriban asilimia 6 ndani ya dakika mbili hadi kiwango cha chini cha miaka 31 karibu na 1.18 katika kipindi chembamba cha usiku kisha likipona kwa kiasi kikubwa, tokeo la BIS la kutokuwa na sababu moja (ukwasi mdogo wa muda wa siku, mtiririko wa kuuza wa kulinda options, mfululizo wa stop-loss, na algoriti), na fundisho kwamba ukwasi mdogo na muda ni hatari halisi za utekelezaji

db9eab6c347f.en: Diagram of the two documented behaviours that drain trading accounts — the disposition effect (Odean 1998: investors 1.5 to 2 times more likely to sell winners than losers) and overtrading (Barber and Odean 2000: the most active traders earned 11.4 percent a year versus the market's 17.9 percent) — and discipline as the structural fix using pre-committed OCO orders and preset position size
db9eab6c347f.sw: Mchoro wa tabia mbili zilizoandikwa zinazokausha akaunti za biashara — athari ya kuachana na nafasi (Odean 1998: wawekezaji wana uwezekano wa mara 1.5 hadi 2 zaidi wa kuuza washindi kuliko wapotezaji) na kufanya biashara kupita kiasi (Barber na Odean 2000: wafanyabiashara wenye shughuli zaidi walipata asilimia 11.4 kwa mwaka dhidi ya asilimia 17.9 ya soko) — na nidhamu kama suluhisho la kimuundo kwa kutumia maagizo ya OCO yaliyojitolewa mapema na ukubwa wa nafasi uliowekwa mapema

dc4f556071b9.en: What the vote buys you is worth being realistic about. In theory shareholders elect the board and the board hires the management. In practice a holding of a few hundred shares in a company with billions outstanding is not a meaningful lever, and most private investors never vote at all.
dc4f556071b9.sw: Kile ambacho kura hukununulia kinastahili kuwa halisi. Kinadharia wanahisa huchagua bodi na bodi huajiri usimamizi. Kivitendo umiliki wa hisa mia chache katika kampuni yenye mabilioni yaliyotolewa si lever yenye maana, na wawekezaji binafsi wengi hawapigi kura kamwe.

dceeb668a2c0.en: One consequence is that the two positions are wrong in different ways. The lender is wrong when the company cannot pay, which is rare and severe. The shareholder is wrong far more often and usually less severely — but their claim can be wiped out while the company survives, because the residual can go to zero without the obligations going unpaid.
dceeb668a2c0.sw: Tokeo moja ni kwamba nafasi hizo mbili hukosea kwa njia tofauti. Mkopeshaji hukosea kampuni isipoweza kulipa, jambo ambalo ni nadra na kali. Mwanahisa hukosea mara nyingi zaidi mno na kwa kawaida kwa ukali mdogo — lakini dai lao linaweza kufutwa huku kampuni ikinusurika, kwa sababu mabaki yanaweza kwenda sifuri bila majukumu kutolipwa.

dd3eeef0f12d.en: Everything so far has been about not losing: sizing, stops, discipline, avoiding the classic mistakes. This final chapter is about the other half — how a serious trader decides what is actually worth trading in the first place. It is the most advanced material in the course, and it assumes everything before it.

Ni nyenzo ya juu zaidi katika kozi, na inadhania kila kitu kilichoitangulia.

de7637a77045.en: This closes the loop on everything Foundations has covered. A chart, a candlestick pattern, a support level — all of it is information. None of it is a decision by itself. Risk management is what turns information into a controlled decision. A perfect read of a chart, paired with no risk management, is still a losing strategy waiting to happen. A mediocre read, paired with real risk management, can still be around to trade another day.
de7637a77045.sw: Hii inafunga mzunguko wa kila kitu ambacho Msingi umeshughulikia. Chati, mtindo wa mshumaa, kiwango cha msaada — vyote ni taarifa. Hakuna kimojawapo ni uamuzi chenyewe. Usimamizi wa hatari ndicho kinachogeuza taarifa kuwa uamuzi unaodhibitiwa. Usomaji kamili wa chati, ukiambatanishwa na kutokuwa na usimamizi wa hatari, bado ni mkakati wa hasara unaosubiri kutokea. Usomaji wa wastani, ukiambatanishwa na usimamizi halisi wa hatari, unaweza bado kubaki hai kufanya biashara siku nyingine.

dec0ff102db7.en: Not quite. No one resets the price by hand and trading is not halted. An authorised participant can trade directly with the fund, so a gap between the ETF price and the value of its holdings becomes a profit opportunity — and acting on it is what pushes the two back together.

Mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa anaweza kufanya biashara moja kwa moja na fund, hivyo pengo kati ya bei ya ETF na thamani ya umiliki wake hukuwa fursa ya faida — na kutenda juu yake ndicho kinachozisukuma hizo mbili pamoja tena.

ded5685209e5.en: What to look for before buying any fund. The ongoing charge in the official document rather than a comparison website. The platform or custody fee, which is charged separately and often quietly. The tracking difference over three years. And the total of all recurring charges written on one line, because no provider will ever present that total for you.

Ada ya jukwaa au ya uhifadhi, ambayo hutozwa tofauti na mara nyingi kimyakimya. Tofauti ya kufuatilia katika miaka mitatu. Na jumla ya malipo yote ya kudumu ikiandikwa kwenye mstari mmoja, kwa sababu hakuna mtoa huduma atakayewahi kukuwasilishia jumla hiyo.

df5cc46d93a6.en: Limited liability caps what you can lose on one company. It does not cap what you can lose overall, and it does not apply if you borrow to buy the shares. Money borrowed on margin is still owed after the shares are worthless — the loss stops at zero for the share, not for you. Chapter 3 covers this properly.
df5cc46d93a6.sw: Dhima yenye kikomo huweka kikomo cha unachoweza kupoteza kwenye kampuni moja. Haiwekei kikomo unachoweza kupoteza kwa ujumla, na haitumiki kama utakopa kununua hisa. Pesa iliyokopwa kwa margin bado inadaiwa baada ya hisa kuwa bila thamani — hasara husimama kwa sifuri kwa hisa, si kwako. Sura ya 3 inashughulikia hili ipasavyo.

df784fcfed33.en: Trusting unverified claims. Paying a signal group, following a tip, or believing a promise of guaranteed or unusually high returns. This one is the course's whole reason for existing: verify claims rather than accept them, and treat any guaranteed-return promise as the clearest warning sign there is.
df784fcfed33.sw: Kuamini madai yasiyothibitishwa. Kulipia kikundi cha ishara, kufuata dokezo, au kuamini ahadi ya faida ya uhakika au kubwa isivyo kawaida. Hili ndilo sababu yote ya kuwepo kwa kozi: thibitisha madai badala ya kuyakubali, na chukulia ahadi yoyote ya faida ya uhakika kama ishara ya onyo iliyo wazi zaidi iliyopo.

dfa4108ef346.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha mtiririko wa kazi wa juu-kwenda-chini wa vipindi vitatu, kanuni ya nne ya kuchagua vipindi, na tahadhari ya kupekua data dhidi ya kutafuta vipindi

dfba223492eb.en: That last point is worth making explicit: a sharper entry doesn't just feel better — it mathematically reduces the distance to your stop, which is a direct input to how much you're risking. MTFA isn't just about being right more often; it's about being wrong more cheaply.
dfba223492eb.sw: Pointi hiyo ya mwisho inastahili kuelezwa wazi: kuingia kwa usahihi zaidi hakufanyi tu ujisikie vizuri — kunapunguza kihisabati umbali hadi stop yako, ambao ni pembejeo ya moja kwa moja ya kiasi unachohatarisha. MTFA si kuhusu kuwa sahihi mara nyingi zaidi tu; ni kuhusu kukosea kwa gharama ndogo zaidi.

dfd0e214ef9e.en: The average result of an activity if it were repeated many times: each possible outcome multiplied by its probability, all added together.
dfd0e214ef9e.sw: Tokeo la wastani la shughuli kama ingerudiwa mara nyingi: kila tokeo linalowezekana likizidishwa kwa uwezekano wake, yote yakiongezwa pamoja.

dfd948404a5a.en: Classify each of these: EUR/GBP, USD/ZAR, GBP/JPY, USD/CHF. Which are majors, which are minors (cross pairs), and which are exotics? Work through the definitions above before checking — the rule is simply whether USD is present, and if so, whether the other side is a major or an emerging-market currency.
dfd948404a5a.sw: Ainisha kila moja ya haya: EUR/GBP, USD/ZAR, GBP/JPY, USD/CHF. Ni yapi ni kuu, yapi ni ndogo (jozi za kuvuka), na yapi ni adimu? Pitia maana zilizo hapo juu kabla ya kukagua — kanuni ni kama USD ipo tu, na kama ndiyo, kama upande mwingine ni sarafu kuu au ya soko linaloibukia.

dfdee477f598.en: This is the number that actually describes what happened to your money, and it is why comparing two shares on dividend yield alone is a mistake. A high yield can mean a generous payment. It can equally mean a falling price, since yield is the dividend divided by the price — the denominator shrinking raises the yield just as reliably as the numerator growing.
dfdee477f598.sw: Hii ndiyo namba inayoeleza hasa kilichotokea kwa pesa zako, na ndiyo sababu kulinganisha hisa mbili kwa mavuno ya gawio peke yake ni kosa. Mavuno makubwa yanaweza kumaanisha malipo ya ukarimu. Yanaweza vivyo hivyo kumaanisha bei inayoshuka, kwa kuwa mavuno ni gawio kugawanywa kwa bei — kigawanyaji kinachopungua hupandisha mavuno kwa uhakika kama vile kizidishaji kinachokua.

dffee3a17576.en: An equal-weighted version of the same 500 companies gives the smallest constituent exactly the influence of the largest. It therefore tells you what the typical company did, while the cap-weighted version tells you what the typical unit of money did. Those two questions have different answers, and in a market led by a handful of very large companies they can differ substantially over a year.
dffee3a17576.sw: Toleo lenye uzito sawa la kampuni zile zile 500 hutoa mshiriki mdogo zaidi ushawishi hasa wa mkubwa zaidi. Kwa hivyo hukuambia kampuni ya kawaida ilifanya nini, ilhali toleo lenye uzito wa mtaji hukuambia kipimo cha kawaida cha pesa kilifanya nini. Maswali hayo mawili yana majibu tofauti, na katika soko linaloongozwa na kampuni chache kubwa mno yanaweza kutofautiana kwa kiasi kikubwa katika mwaka.

e052595c9344.en: What a share actually is, what it costs to own, and what the evidence says about owning them well.
e052595c9344.sw: Hisa ni nini hasa, inagharimu nini kuimiliki, na ushahidi unasema nini kuhusu kuzimiliki vizuri.

e0549e4a0921.en: Correct. The fee is one input to the shortfall, not the shortfall itself. Trading costs, dividend timing and lending income all contribute. Tracking difference measures the whole gap, and by that measure the more expensive fund delivered more of the index.
e0549e4a0921.sw: Sahihi. Ada ni pembejeo moja ya upungufu, si upungufu wenyewe. Gharama za biashara, muda wa gawio na mapato ya kukopesha vyote huchangia. Tofauti ya kufuatilia hupima pengo lote, na kwa kipimo hicho fund ghali zaidi ilitoa sehemu kubwa zaidi ya index.

e0b0161e5560.en: Jesse Livermore built his reputation on tape reading, starting as a teenager reading ticker tape in the 1890s. His core idea: the tape records actual transactions, not opinions — and actual transactions reflect real buying and selling pressure in a way a chart, updated only after the fact, cannot. Ticker tape disappeared decades ago, replaced by Level II data and order-flow software — but the underlying idea survives in those modern tools.
e0b0161e5560.sw: Jesse Livermore alijenga sifa yake kwa kusoma tepu, akianza akiwa kijana akisoma tepu ya bei katika miaka ya 1890. Wazo lake kuu: tepu hurekodi miamala halisi, si maoni — na miamala halisi huonyesha shinikizo halisi la kununua na kuuza kwa njia ambayo chati, inayosasishwa baada tu ya tukio, haiwezi. Tepu ya bei ilitoweka miongo iliyopita, ikibadilishwa na data ya Level II na programu ya mtiririko wa maagizo — lakini wazo la msingi linaendelea kuishi katika zana hizo za kisasa.

e0fceaba0ea3.en: Correct — a market order fills immediately at whatever price is available: guaranteed execution, unguaranteed price. A triggered stop order carries this same guarantee once it converts.
e0fceaba0ea3.sw: Sahihi — agizo la soko hutimizwa mara moja kwa bei yoyote inayopatikana: utekelezaji wa uhakika, bei isiyo ya uhakika. Agizo la stop lililoanzishwa hubeba uhakika huu huu mara linapogeuka.

e10208bbe46b.sw: Kwa nini thamani inayotarajiwa ya dau la namba moja la roulette ni hasi bila kujali mchezaji ana ustadi kiasi gani?

e215b04251f6.en: But those losses are not spread evenly across a thousand different errors. They cluster around a small, repeating set of mistakes — and nearly every one of them is something this course has already solved in an earlier lesson. This lesson gathers them in one place so you can check yourself against the list, because recognising a mistake by name is most of what it takes to stop making it.
e215b04251f6.sw: Lakini hasara hizo hazijasambaa sawasawa katika makosa elfu tofauti. Hujikusanya kuzunguka seti ndogo inayojirudia ya makosa — na karibu kila mmoja wao ni kitu ambacho kozi hii tayari imekitatua katika somo la awali. Somo hili linayakusanya mahali pamoja ili uweze kujikagua dhidi ya orodha, kwa sababu kutambua kosa kwa jina ni sehemu kubwa ya kinachohitajika kuacha kulifanya.

e21d2ff39eda.en: Neither — they are identical because the broker leverage is the same
e21d2ff39eda.sw: Hakuna — zinafanana kwa sababu leverage ya broker ni ile ile

e23c09272ec9.en: A rare, high-impact event that is very hard to predict in advance and is often rationalised as obvious only afterwards. The term was popularised by Nassim Taleb; the franc shock is a textbook case.
e23c09272ec9.sw: Tukio nadra lenye athari kubwa ambalo ni gumu mno kutabiri mapema na mara nyingi hufafanuliwa kama dhahiri baadaye tu. Neno hilo lilipewa umaarufu na Nassim Taleb; mshtuko wa faranga ni kesi ya kitabu.

e2bcf223fd92.en: When the global financial crisis struck in 2008, risk appetite evaporated, and the trade reversed with terrifying speed.
e2bcf223fd92.sw: Janga la kifedha la kimataifa lilipopiga mwaka 2008, hamu ya hatari ilififia, na biashara ikageuka kwa kasi ya kutisha.

e2ea78385461.en: Candlestick patterns are the most heavily marketed part of price action, and they are where the evidence is weakest and most contested. Two well-known studies show the problem clearly.
e2ea78385461.sw: Mitindo ya mishumaa ndiyo sehemu inayotangazwa zaidi ya shughuli ya bei, na ndipo ushahidi ulipo dhaifu zaidi na wenye mgogoro zaidi. Tafiti mbili zinazojulikana zinaonyesha tatizo wazi.

e3110132ab43.en: Two further features of a fund affect what you actually receive, and neither appears in the headline description.
e3110132ab43.sw: Sifa mbili zaidi za fund huathiri unachopokea hasa, na hakuna inayojitokeza katika maelezo ya kichwa cha habari.

e31ac26f59cf.en: Reviewing closed trades for the soundness of the decision and thesis, not only the profit or loss.
e31ac26f59cf.sw: Kupitia biashara zilizofungwa kwa uimara wa uamuzi na nadharia, si faida au hasara tu.
