e39ef73b80c4.sw: Ilichapisha pesa nyingi mno mwaka huo

e3e60347655a.en: This isn't an academic footnote — it's why the carry trade has historically made money at all. If high-rate currencies fell as UIP predicts, carry trades wouldn't work. They've worked precisely because the theory fails. But there's a sting in the tail:
e3e60347655a.sw: Hii si tanbihi ya kitaaluma — ndiyo sababu carry trade imepata pesa kabisa kihistoria. Kama sarafu za viwango vya juu zingeshuka kama UIP inavyotabiri, carry trade zisingefanya kazi. Zimefanya kazi hasa kwa sababu nadharia hushindwa. Lakini kuna mchomo mkiani:

e3eb0edd6688.en: If a market maker widens the spread specifically around a major news release (like a central bank rate decision), which of the three cost components above do you think is driving that — and why would uncertainty about upcoming news make that component larger?
e3eb0edd6688.sw: Kama mtengeneza-soko atapanua spread mahususi wakati wa tangazo kuu la habari (kama uamuzi wa kiwango cha riba cha benki kuu), unadhani ni kipengele kipi kati ya vitatu vya gharama hapo juu kinachoendesha hilo — na kwa nini kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu habari zinazokuja kungefanya kipengele hicho kiwe kikubwa zaidi?

e4110f76d63a.en: This extends the trading journal of Chapter 4, Lesson 3 up to the level of theses. The question is never only "did it make money?" — a bad process can win by luck and a good one can lose by variance (Chapter 4, Lesson 2). The question is "was the thesis sound, was it sized right, did I follow the plan?" Reviewing that, over many trades, is how a process actually improves instead of just accumulating outcomes.
e4110f76d63a.sw: Hii hupanua kumbukumbu ya biashara ya Sura ya 4, Somo la 3 hadi kiwango cha nadharia. Swali si tu "je, ilipata pesa?" kamwe — mchakato mbaya unaweza kushinda kwa bahati na mzuri unaweza kupoteza kwa utofauti (Sura ya 4, Somo la 2). Swali ni "je, nadharia ilikuwa imara, je, ilipimwa sawa, je, nilifuata mpango?" Kupitia hilo, katika biashara nyingi, ndivyo mchakato unavyoboreka hasa badala ya kurundika matokeo tu.

e45d92fbdf53.en: The payout is not covered by earnings and is being funded from reserves, borrowing or asset sales, which cannot continue indefinitely
e45d92fbdf53.sw: Malipo hayafunikwi na mapato na yanafadhiliwa kutoka akiba, kukopa au kuuza mali, ambako hakuwezi kuendelea milele

e484c2bc67ce.en: This single event is the real-world reason "negative balance protection" — mentioned in Lesson 6 as a regulatory requirement in the EU, UK, and Australia — exists as a rule at all. A stop-loss order is a real risk-management tool, not a guarantee. In a genuine liquidity gap, it can fail to protect you at exactly the moment you need it most.
e484c2bc67ce.sw: Tukio hili moja ndiyo sababu ya dunia halisi ya kuwepo kwa "ulinzi wa salio hasi" — lililotajwa katika Somo la 6 kama hitaji la udhibiti katika Umoja wa Ulaya, Uingereza, na Australia — kama kanuni kabisa. Agizo la stop-loss ni zana halisi ya usimamizi wa hatari, si uhakika. Katika pengo halisi la ukwasi, linaweza kushindwa kukulinda hasa wakati unapolihitaji zaidi.

e486f6cf80a5.en: A buyback and a dividend both return cash to owners. The dividend arrives as money you can see. The buyback arrives as a larger ownership proportion, which you cannot see and which shows up only in per-share figures later. A company returning a great deal through buybacks can appear stingy on any dividend screen.
e486f6cf80a5.sw: Ununuzi upya na gawio vyote hurudisha fedha kwa wamiliki. Gawio hufika kama pesa unazoweza kuziona. Ununuzi upya hufika kama uwiano mkubwa zaidi wa umiliki, ambao huwezi kuuona na unaojitokeza katika takwimu za kwa-hisa baadaye tu. Kampuni inayorudisha kiasi kikubwa kupitia ununuzi upya inaweza kuonekana bahili kwenye chujio lolote la gawio.

e503ffde1e27.sw: Mfumuko wa Bei wa Kuvutwa na Mahitaji

e5b3e8eb543a.en: The first currency listed in a pair. It's the currency being measured — always treated as a single unit ("1") for the purpose of the quote.
e5b3e8eb543a.sw: Sarafu ya kwanza iliyoorodheshwa katika jozi. Ndiyo sarafu inayopimwa — daima huchukuliwa kama kipimo kimoja ("1") kwa madhumuni ya nukuu.

e5c044a59401.en: From the invalidation level you get your risk — the distance to the stop, turned into money by position sizing (Chapter 3, Lesson 1). Now the thesis has to clear a bar.
e5c044a59401.sw: Kutoka kiwango cha kuvunjika unapata hatari yako — umbali hadi stop, ukigeuzwa kuwa pesa kwa upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1). Sasa nadharia lazima ipite kizingiti.

e5c482afbcc0.en: This matters practically: if you ever read a quote that looks "backwards" compared to what you expect, it's not necessarily wrong — check which convention is actually being used before assuming a mistake.
e5c482afbcc0.sw: Hili linahusika kivitendo: kama utawahi kusoma nukuu inayoonekana "kinyume" ikilinganishwa na unavyotarajia, si lazima iwe batili — kagua ni makubaliano yapi yanayotumika hasa kabla ya kudhani ni kosa.

e5d0b0154273.en: Chapter 1, Lesson 6 gave you the fixed parts: leverage, margin, the margin level formula, and the idea of a margin call. This lesson watches those numbers move in real time, because that is where the risk actually lives.
e5d0b0154273.sw: Sura ya 1, Somo la 6 lilikupa sehemu thabiti: leverage, margin, fomula ya kiwango cha margin, na wazo la wito wa margin. Somo hili hutazama namba hizo zikisogea kwa wakati halisi, kwa sababu hapo ndipo hatari inapoishi hasa.

e5d0f2211a8c.en: A professional replaces a strong feeling with a written six-pillar thesis (fundamentals, valuation, catalyst, positioning, momentum, carry); conviction means how many independent, evidence-based pillars agree — three of which are documented return factors.
e5d0f2211a8c.sw: Mtaalamu hubadilisha hisia kali kwa nadharia iliyoandikwa ya nguzo sita (misingi, uthaminishaji, kichocheo, nafasi za soko, kasi, carry); uhakika unamaanisha nguzo ngapi huru zenye msingi wa ushahidi zinakubaliana — tatu kati yao zikiwa vipengele vya faida vilivyoandikwa.

e64abe301111.en: This is worth carrying into the next lesson, because when you buy an index fund you are not buying "the market". You are buying a specific rule, and you should know which one.
e64abe301111.sw: Hili linastahili kubebwa hadi somo lijalo, kwa sababu ununuapo index fund hununui "soko". Unanunua kanuni mahususi, na unapaswa kujua ni ipi.

e68806ab9429.en: Not quite. A stop order does not guarantee the stop price. It guarantees that an order is sent once the level is reached, and that order then fills at whatever prices are actually available, which after a gap can be far lower.
e68806ab9429.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Agizo la stop halihakikishi bei ya stop. Linahakikisha kwamba agizo linatumwa mara kiwango kinapofikiwa, na agizo hilo kisha hutimizwa kwa bei zinazopatikana hasa, ambazo baada ya kuruka zinaweza kuwa chini mno.

e6969c5c2c94.en: Before any trade, run the thesis check: Can you write down which of the six pillars support it, with a reason for each, not just a direction? Are the supporting pillars actually independent, or are you counting the same story twice? Is there a catalyst — a thesis with no reason to move now is a reason to wait, not to enter? And are you calling a trade high conviction because the analysis is strong, or only because the feeling is strong? Only the first is an edge.
e6969c5c2c94.sw: Kabla ya biashara yoyote, fanya ukaguzi wa nadharia: Je, unaweza kuandika ni nguzo zipi kati ya sita zinazoiunga mkono, ukiwa na sababu kwa kila moja, si mwelekeo tu? Je, nguzo zinazoiunga mkono kwa kweli zinajitegemea, au unahesabu simulizi ile ile mara mbili? Je, kuna kichocheo — nadharia isiyo na sababu ya kusogea sasa ni sababu ya kusubiri, si kuingia? Na je, unaiita biashara ya uhakika wa juu kwa sababu uchambuzi ni imara, au kwa sababu tu hisia ni kali? Ya kwanza tu ndiyo faida.

e6d5c49d4c7c.en: That is the whole point of the lesson in one example. The shortcut does not just round a little. On one pair it made you risk a third less than planned; on another, a quarter more. The careful "exactly 100 dollars" guarantee from Chapter 1 only holds if the pip value feeding the formula is the real one.
e6d5c49d4c7c.sw: Hiyo ndiyo pointi yote ya somo katika mfano mmoja. Njia ya mkato haizungushi kidogo tu. Kwenye jozi moja ilikufanya uhatarishe theluthi moja pungufu ya ulivyopanga; kwenye lingine, robo moja zaidi. Uhakika makini wa "dola 100 hasa" kutoka Sura ya 1 hushikilia tu kama thamani ya pip inayolisha fomula ni ile halisi.

e6d99cb79975.en: The emotional logic is easy to feel. A winning trade offers the pleasure of being right, available right now if you close it — so you do. A losing trade would force you to admit you were wrong, so you wait, and hope. Both impulses push directly against the risk-to-reward discipline from Chapter 3, Lesson 3: they shrink your winners and let your losers run — exactly backwards.
e6d99cb79975.sw: Mantiki ya kihisia ni rahisi kuihisi. Biashara yenye ushindi hutoa raha ya kuwa sahihi, inayopatikana sasa hivi kama utaifunga — hivyo unafunga. Biashara ya hasara ingekulazimisha ukiri ulikosea, hivyo unasubiri, na kutumaini. Misukumo yote miwili husukuma moja kwa moja dhidi ya nidhamu ya hatari-kwa-tuzo kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 3: hupunguza washindi wako na huacha wapotezaji wako wakimbie — kinyume kabisa.

e6e3b05d3688.en: Lend out or issue notes for more than it holds in reserve
e6e3b05d3688.sw: Kukopesha au kutoa noti kwa kiasi kikubwa kuliko inachoshikilia kama akiba

e7206cb69d31.en: Not quite — re-read the EUR/USD example. The "textbook" direction didn't hold that time.
e7206cb69d31.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — soma tena mfano wa EUR/USD. Mwelekeo wa "kitabu" haukushikilia wakati ule.

e737e1932797.en: An instruction to trade immediately at whatever price is currently available. Certain to execute, uncertain in price.
e737e1932797.sw: Maelekezo ya kufanya biashara mara moja kwa bei yoyote inayopatikana sasa. Ya uhakika kutekelezwa, isiyo na uhakika kwa bei.

e76b5488684c.en: Trading goods or services directly, without using money.
e76b5488684c.sw: Kubadilishana bidhaa au huduma moja kwa moja, bila kutumia pesa.

e775a549685d.en: Spreads are not fixed. They widen measurably during low-liquidity periods (the Asian trading session, for instance) and around major scheduled news events, exactly when uncertainty about the "true" price is highest — a direct, practical echo of the adverse-selection and inventory-risk theory above. A spread that looks tight on a demo account during the London session can widen noticeably at other times.
e775a549685d.sw: Spread si thabiti. Hupanuka kwa kiasi kinachopimika wakati wa vipindi vya ukwasi mdogo (kipindi cha biashara cha Asia, kwa mfano) na wakati wa matukio makubwa ya habari yaliyopangwa, hasa wakati kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu bei "halisi" kuko juu zaidi — mwangwi wa moja kwa moja na wa kivitendo wa nadharia ya uteuzi mbaya na hatari ya hifadhi hapo juu. Spread inayoonekana finyu kwenye akaunti ya majaribio wakati wa kipindi cha London inaweza kupanuka kwa kiasi kinachoonekana nyakati nyingine.

e77ee8262c9b.en: The single most important nuance in this entire lesson: an expected rate move is usually "priced in" before it happens. If the whole market already expects a hike, the currency has largely already moved by the time the announcement lands. The big, violent moves come from surprises — when a central bank confounds expectations. This is why two traders can watch the same rate hike and see the currency fall: if the market expected an even larger hike, the "smaller than expected" hike is effectively dovish. You're not trading the rate. You're trading the gap between the decision and what was already expected.
e77ee8262c9b.sw: Upambanuzi muhimu kuliko wote katika somo hili lote: msogeo wa kiwango unaotarajiwa kwa kawaida huwa "umewekewa bei" kabla haujatokea. Kama soko lote tayari linatarajia kupanda, sarafu tayari imesogea kwa kiasi kikubwa wakati tangazo linapofika. Misogeo mikubwa na yenye nguvu hutoka kwenye mishangao — benki kuu inapokinzana na matarajio. Ndiyo sababu wafanyabiashara wawili wanaweza kutazama kupanda kwa kiwango kile kile na kuona sarafu ikishuka: kama soko lilitarajia kupanda kukubwa zaidi, kupanda "kudogo kuliko ilivyotarajiwa" kwa hakika ni dovish. Hufanyi biashara ya kiwango. Unafanya biashara ya pengo kati ya uamuzi na kile kilichotarajiwa tayari.

e788d010ccc4.en: The share is undervalued relative to its income
e788d010ccc4.sw: Hisa haijathaminiwa ipasavyo ikilinganishwa na mapato yake

e788d897f185.en: A calculation derived solely from price and/or volume, plotted on a chart.
e788d897f185.sw: Hesabu inayotokana na bei na/au kiasi peke yake, ikichorwa kwenye chati.

e790e7d93daf.en: If you trade 1 standard lot of EUR/USD, you're controlling €100,000. A 1-pip move in your favor or against you is worth roughly $10. Trade 1 micro lot instead (1,000 units), and that same 1-pip move is worth $0.10 — a hundred times smaller.
e790e7d93daf.sw: Kama utafanya biashara ya lot 1 sanifu ya EUR/USD, unadhibiti €100,000. Msogeo wa pip 1 kwa manufaa yako au dhidi yako una thamani ya takriban $10. Fanya biashara ya lot 1 ndogo sana badala yake (vipimo 1,000), na msogeo ule ule wa pip 1 una thamani ya $0.10 — mara mia ndogo zaidi.

e79193106a95.en: The fallout was severe and specific. The retail broker FXCM saw its customers left with roughly 225 million dollars in negative balances — accounts that owed the broker more than they held — and FXCM needed an emergency infusion of about 300 million dollars from Leucadia to survive. The UK broker Alpari (UK) entered insolvency that same day. And it was not only amateurs: the hedge fund Everest Capital Global, which had bet against the franc, lost close to a billion dollars and was shut down. A Bank of England study later found that algorithmic traders pulling liquidity made the crash worse.
e79193106a95.sw: Matokeo yalikuwa makali na mahususi. Broker wa rejareja FXCM aliona wateja wake wakiachwa na takriban dola milioni 225 katika salio hasi — akaunti zilizodaiwa na broker zaidi ya walichoshikilia — na FXCM ilihitaji uingizaji wa dharura wa takriban dola milioni 300 kutoka Leucadia ili kuendelea kuishi. Broker wa Uingereza Alpari (UK) aliingia kufilisika siku hiyo hiyo. Na hawakuwa wanaoanza tu: hedge fund Everest Capital Global, iliyokuwa imebashiri dhidi ya faranga, ilipoteza karibu dola bilioni moja na ikafungwa. Utafiti wa Benki ya Uingereza baadaye uligundua kwamba wafanyabiashara wa algoriti waliovuta ukwasi walifanya anguko liwe baya zaidi.

e79a36738433.en: Not quite — the BIS found no single cause: thin overnight liquidity, options hedging, stop-loss execution and algorithms combined.
e79a36738433.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — BIS haikupata sababu moja: ukwasi mdogo wa usiku, kulinda options, utekelezaji wa stop-loss na algoriti viliungana.

e7ce4036b49b.en: The margin level at which the broker stops asking and starts acting: it automatically closes your positions, usually the largest loser first, to stop your equity falling below the margin backing them. It sits below the margin call level.
e7ce4036b49b.sw: Kiwango cha margin ambapo broker huacha kuomba na kuanza kutenda: hufunga nafasi zako kiotomatiki, kwa kawaida ile yenye hasara kubwa zaidi kwanza, kuzuia usawa wako kushuka chini ya margin inayoziunga mkono. Kinakaa chini ya kiwango cha wito wa margin.

e7cfb082616b.en: True or False: a trading strategy with a 70% win rate is guaranteed to be profitable.
e7cfb082616b.sw: Kweli au Uongo: mkakati wa biashara wenye kiwango cha ushindi cha 70% umehakikishiwa kuwa na faida.

e7d162dc6ca9.en: Diagram showing the expectancy formula in dollars and in R, a worked positive example (40 percent win rate at plus 2R gives plus 0.2R per trade) and a warning example (60 percent win rate with small wins gives minus 12 dollars per trade), and a note that expectancy is a long-run average that a short run of trades hides
e7d162dc6ca9.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha fomula ya matarajio kwa dola na kwa R, mfano chanya uliopitiwa (kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 40 kwa jumlisha 2R hutoa jumlisha 0.2R kwa kila biashara) na mfano wa onyo (kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 60 chenye ushindi mdogo hutoa toa dola 12 kwa kila biashara), na dokezo kwamba matarajio ni wastani wa muda mrefu ambao mfululizo mfupi wa biashara huuficha

e7d985f4382b.en: What is the purpose of a pre-mortem?

e7d9afb2d4b0.en: A fund that trades like a share. A creation and redemption mechanism is what stops its price drifting away from what it holds.
e7d9afb2d4b0.sw: Fund inayofanyiwa biashara kama hisa. Utaratibu wa kuunda na kukomboa ndio unaozuia bei yake kupotoka kutoka kile inachoshikilia.

e7f1c01a4a7d.en: Given everything in this lesson: is the right response to this event "never use a stop-loss, since it might not work," or something more precise? What role does position sizing (Lesson 5) play in surviving an event like this even when a stop-loss doesn't fill where expected?
e7f1c01a4a7d.sw: Kwa kuzingatia kila kitu katika somo hili: je, jibu sahihi kwa tukio hili ni "usitumie stop-loss kamwe, kwa kuwa inaweza isifanye kazi," au kitu sahihi zaidi? Upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi (Somo la 5) una nafasi gani katika kunusurika tukio kama hili hata stop-loss isipotimizwa palipotarajiwa?

e87152f0c70c.en: This is why screening for high dividend yield is a weak filter. It excludes companies returning cash a different way, and it selects for companies whose price has fallen, since yield rises when price falls. A screen built on yield alone is partly a screen for recent disappointment.
e87152f0c70c.sw: Ndiyo sababu kuchuja kwa mavuno makubwa ya gawio ni chujio dhaifu. Hutenga kampuni zinazorudisha fedha kwa njia tofauti, na huchagua kampuni ambazo bei yake imeshuka, kwa kuwa mavuno hupanda bei inaposhuka. Chujio lililojengwa juu ya mavuno peke yake ni kwa sehemu chujio la kukatishwa tamaa kwa hivi karibuni.

e889ba41a01c.en: Gold solved barter — but its own weight and fixed supply created problems that paper money was invented to fix.
e889ba41a01c.sw: Dhahabu ilitatua tatizo la kubadilishana bidhaa — lakini uzito wake na ugavi wake thabiti vilizua matatizo ambayo pesa za karatasi zilivumbuliwa kuyatatua.

e89b233d886a.en: Not quite. A price-weighted index adds share prices and divides — it never looks at how large the company is. Company A at 300 a share has six times the influence of Company B at 50, even though B is eight times the business. Size only drives the weighting in a market-capitalisation index.
e89b233d886a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Index yenye uzito wa bei huongeza bei za hisa na kugawanya — haitazami kamwe kampuni ni kubwa kiasi gani. Kampuni A kwa 300 kwa hisa ina ushawishi mara sita ya Kampuni B kwa 50, hata kama B ni biashara mara nane. Ukubwa huendesha uzito katika index ya mtaji-soko tu.

e8ab3230ef19.en: In plain terms, the interest edge was real, but you were being paid to hold a currency position that could drop violently at the worst possible moment. That is not a flaw in the carry trade — it is what the carry trade fundamentally is. The steady income is the market paying you to insure everyone else against a crash, and 2008 was the year the insurance was called.
e8ab3230ef19.sw: Kwa lugha rahisi, faida ya riba ilikuwa halisi, lakini ulikuwa unalipwa kushikilia nafasi ya sarafu inayoweza kushuka kwa nguvu wakati mbaya zaidi unaowezekana. Huo si udhaifu katika carry trade — ndicho carry trade ilivyo kimsingi. Mapato thabiti ni soko likikulipa uwakatie kila mtu mwingine bima dhidi ya anguko, na 2008 ulikuwa mwaka bima ilipoitwa.

e8db2cfece2c.en: You bring $100 USD to the exchange counter and convert it: 100 × 20 = 2,000 pesos. You spend the week in Mexico — but your friends cover everything. You don't spend a single peso. When you fly home, you still have all 2,000 pesos, and you convert them back to dollars. But the exchange rate has moved while you were away. It's no longer 20 — it's now 1 USD = 16 MXN. To convert back: 2,000 ÷ 16 = $125 USD. You left with $100. You came back with $125. You made $25 — without spending a cent, without working, and without any plan to trade at all. It happened purely because the exchange rate moved in your favor while you held pesos.
e8db2cfece2c.sw: Unaleta $100 USD kwenye kaunta ya ubadilishaji na kuzibadilisha: 100 × 20 = peso 2,000. Unatumia wiki nzima Mexico — lakini marafiki zako wanalipia kila kitu. Hutumii hata peso moja. Unaporudi nyumbani kwa ndege, bado una peso zote 2,000, na unazibadilisha tena kuwa dola. Lakini kiwango cha ubadilishaji kimesogea ulipokuwa mbali. Si tena 20 — sasa ni 1 USD = 16 MXN. Kubadilisha tena: 2,000 ÷ 16 = $125 USD. Uliondoka na $100. Umerudi na $125. Umepata $25 — bila kutumia senti moja, bila kufanya kazi, na bila mpango wowote wa kufanya biashara kabisa. Ilitokea kwa sababu tu kiwango cha ubadilishaji kilisogea kwa manufaa yako ulipokuwa unashikilia peso.

e9b002a14d47.en: The one rule that protects all of this: you may exit early if the thesis breaks, but you may never move the stop or target simply because price is uncomfortable. Changing the plan mid-trade to avoid a loss is how every earlier chapter's discipline is quietly undone. The plan is decided when you are calm, and defended when you are not.

Tofauti inakaa katika madeni ya wateja — mauzo yaliyofanywa lakini bado hayajakusanywa. Namba zote mbili ni sahihi. Kwa pamoja zinasema kitu ambacho hakuna inayosema peke yake: biashara inauza, na bado hailipwi.

ea2c01ba5879.en: In the United States that period is one business day. The Securities and Exchange Commission shortened it from two days to one under Exchange Act Rule 15c6-1(a), effective 28 May 2024. The convention is written as T+1 — trade date plus one business day.

ea35eb25bb3d.en: The S&P 500 uses a refinement of this called float adjustment. It counts only the shares actually available for the public to buy, excluding blocks held by governments, founders and other companies. The reasoning is that shares nobody can purchase should not affect a measure of what the investable market is doing.

eb13adba16a7.en: Revenue is recorded when it is earned, not when it is paid. A company that delivers goods in March and is paid in July records the sale in March. That is not a trick — it describes the business more faithfully than waiting for the cheque. But it opens a gap between reported profit and money in the bank.

eb72efb87073.en: Two people each put 5,000 into the market on the same morning. One buys a broad index fund and does not look at it again for a decade. The other trades it actively, in and out, forty times a year. Ignoring skill entirely, they face completely different structures: the first collects whatever the underlying businesses produced, minus a small fee. The second collects whatever the businesses produced, minus a small fee, minus forty rounds of spread and commission, plus or minus whatever they gained or lost against the other side of each trade.
eb72efb87073.sw: Watu wawili kila mmoja huweka 5,000 sokoni asubuhi ile ile. Mmoja hununua index fund pana na hairudii kuiangalia kwa muongo. Mwingine huifanyia biashara kwa bidii, kuingia na kutoka, mara arobaini kwa mwaka. Kwa kupuuza ustadi kabisa, wanakabiliwa na miundo tofauti kabisa: wa kwanza hukusanya chochote biashara zilizo chini zilizalisha, kutoa ada ndogo. Wa pili hukusanya chochote biashara zilizalisha, kutoa ada ndogo, kutoa raundi arobaini za spread na kamisheni, pamoja au kutoa chochote walichopata au kupoteza dhidi ya upande mwingine wa kila biashara.

ebb7e58725fa.en: That is a caveat, not an argument against index funds. The alternatives have their own weighting problems, and the fee arithmetic in Lesson 7 is a powerful counterweight. ecdda075a302.en: You sell shares on a Monday under T+1. The trade is agreed on Monday at Monday's price, and the cash settles on Tuesday. If you sell on a Friday, settlement lands on the following Monday, because the count is in business days and the weekend does not count.

Once written, the plan is executed, ideally through pre-placed orders (the OCO order of Chapter 1, Lesson 7) so that discipline does not depend on your nerve in the moment (Chapter 4).

eeb0470e0bbe.en: A 4-period SMA on a daily chart, with closes of 10, 11, 12, 14: the average is (10+11+12+14) ÷ 4 = 11.75. Next day the price drops to 9. The window slides: the oldest value (10) drops out, the new close (9) enters, and the new average is (11+12+14+9) ÷ 4 = 11.50. That sliding window is the entire mechanism — the average "moves" because its data window moves.
eeb0470e0bbe.sw: SMA ya vipindi 4 kwenye chati ya kila siku, yenye bei za kufunga za 10, 11, 12, 14: wastani ni (10+11+12+14) ÷ 4 = 11.75. Siku inayofuata bei inashuka hadi 9. Dirisha linateleza: thamani ya zamani zaidi (10) inatoka, bei mpya ya kufunga (9) inaingia, na wastani mpya ni (11+12+14+9) ÷ 4 = 11.50. Dirisha hilo linaloteleza ndio utaratibu mzima — wastani "unasogea" kwa sababu dirisha lake la data linasogea.

f010daadad45.sw: Zana ya kuchora chati inayonyooka kutoka bonde la mzunguko hadi kilele cha mzunguko (au kinyume chake) na kuweka alama za viwango vya mlalo kwa 23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%, na 78.6% ya msogeo huo — ikipendekezwa kama maeneo yanayowezekana kwa kurudi nyuma kusimama au kugeuka kabla mwelekeo haujaendelea.

f028e83ce8b3.en: Reading a Company and a Market

f0525bdc1009.en: It always depends only on the raw rate, not expectations
f0525bdc1009.sw: Daima hutegemea kiwango ghafi tu, si matarajio

f07ea9235edb.en: Two major currencies paired without USD
f07ea9235edb.sw: Sarafu mbili kuu zilizowekwa pamoja bila USD

f0998c33c96d.en: A written set of rules (what, when, stop, target, size, risk, review) that pre-decides trades.
f0998c33c96d.sw: Seti ya kanuni zilizoandikwa (nini, lini, stop, lengo, ukubwa, hatari, kupitia) inayoamua biashara mapema.

f0a67d70f135.en: A price chart with no indicators — just candles and drawn levels.
f0a67d70f135.sw: Chati ya bei isiyo na viashiria — mishumaa na viwango vilivyochorwa tu.

f0ba8c4de6b3.en: A rule for combining chosen shares into a single trackable number.
f0ba8c4de6b3.sw: Kanuni ya kuunganisha hisa zilizochaguliwa kuwa namba moja inayoweza kufuatiliwa.

f0bf0f934fb6.en: Money owed to the company by customers who have been billed but have not yet paid.
f0bf0f934fb6.sw: Pesa ambazo kampuni inadaiwa na wateja waliotumiwa bili lakini bado hawajalipa.

f0e23008a9b7.en: The trade will be rejected by the exchange

f12e6bf67d9b.en: For most of the 2000s, Japan held interest rates near zero while other economies paid much more. That gap was an open invitation, and traders took it — exactly the carry trade you met in Chapter 2, Lesson 3.
f12e6bf67d9b.sw: Kwa sehemu kubwa ya miaka ya 2000, Japani ilishikilia viwango vya riba karibu na sifuri ilhali uchumi mwingine ulilipa zaidi mno. Pengo hilo lilikuwa mwaliko wa wazi, na wafanyabiashara waliuchukua — hasa carry trade uliyokutana nayo katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 3.

f16b5e96143e.en: You control whether you pay it, through the type of order you place.
f16b5e96143e.sw: Unadhibiti kama unailipa, kupitia aina ya agizo unaloliweka.

f1a92403ee6a.en: The yen carry trade paid a steady interest edge for years, then delivered a violent correlated crash in 2008 — the exact shape the carry-trade evidence had already described, showing the income was payment for crash risk.
f1a92403ee6a.sw: Carry trade ya yen ililipa faida thabiti ya riba kwa miaka, kisha ikatoa anguko kali lenye uwiano mwaka 2008 — umbo hasa ambalo ushahidi wa carry trade ulikuwa tayari umeueleza, ukionyesha mapato yalikuwa malipo kwa hatari ya kuanguka.

f1e1e7fadaba.en: In a market-making context, the risk a market maker faces that the person on the other side of a trade knows something they don't, and is trading on that advantage.
f1e1e7fadaba.sw: Katika muktadha wa kutengeneza soko, hatari ambayo mtengeneza-soko anakabiliana nayo kwamba mtu aliye upande wa pili wa biashara anajua kitu ambacho yeye hakijui, na anafanya biashara kwa faida hiyo.

f20899d41c28.en: That is the honest core of "leverage risk." The danger was never the broker's headline ratio on its own — it is how much of that ceiling you choose to use. And that choice is exactly position sizing from Lesson 1. A correctly sized position leaves a large free-margin cushion, which keeps effective leverage low and the margin call far away. A margin call is, almost always, a position-sizing mistake showing up one step later.
f20899d41c28.sw: Hicho ndicho kiini cha uaminifu cha "hatari ya leverage." Hatari haikuwa kamwe uwiano wa kichwa cha habari wa broker peke yake — ni kiasi gani cha dari hilo unachochagua kutumia. Na chaguo hilo ni hasa upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi kutoka Somo la 1. Nafasi iliyopimwa kwa usahihi huacha mto mkubwa wa margin huru, ambao huweka leverage halisi chini na wito wa margin mbali. Wito wa margin ni, karibu daima, kosa la upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi likijitokeza hatua moja baadaye.

f21fbf6df8e2.en: The balance sheet answers a different question again: not how the year went, but what the company is made of.
f21fbf6df8e2.sw: Mizania hujibu swali tofauti tena: si mwaka ulivyokwenda, bali kampuni imetengenezwa na nini.

f24c60ab59a5.en: A diversifier only applies to forex

f25a096b9e06.en: Here is the honest part, and it connects straight back to Lesson 1. You learned there that an indicator can only ever highlight something already visible in price, because every indicator is computed from price and nothing else. Price action traders take that same fact to its logical end: if the indicator only echoes the price, read the price directly and skip the echo. The philosophy is not mystical. It is the Lesson 1 principle, followed one step further.
f25a096b9e06.sw: Hii hapa sehemu ya uaminifu, na inaunganika moja kwa moja na Somo la 1. Ulijifunza hapo kwamba kiashiria kinaweza tu kuangazia kitu ambacho tayari kinaonekana katika bei, kwa sababu kila kiashiria hukokotolewa kutoka bei na si kitu kingine. Wafanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei huchukua ukweli huo huo hadi mwisho wake wa kimantiki: kama kiashiria kinarudia tu bei, soma bei moja kwa moja na uruke mwangwi. Falsafa si ya kifumbo. Ni kanuni ya Somo la 1, ikifuatwa hatua moja zaidi.

f26158ef9d65.en: The international standard defining three-letter alphabetic codes (and three-digit numeric codes) for every active currency, first published in 1978 and maintained by SIX Financial Information AG on behalf of the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).
f26158ef9d65.sw: Kiwango cha kimataifa kinachofafanua misimbo ya herufi tatu (na misimbo ya tarakimu tatu) kwa kila sarafu inayotumika, kilichochapishwa kwa mara ya kwanza mwaka 1978 na kinachodumishwa na SIX Financial Information AG kwa niaba ya Shirika la Kimataifa la Viwango (ISO).

f2ac0cf0bbe3.en: A medium of exchange (widely accepted in trade), a store of value (holds its worth over time so you can save it), and a unit of account (a common measure for comparing the value of very different things — how many chickens is a cow worth?).
f2ac0cf0bbe3.sw: Njia ya kubadilishana (inayokubalika kwa upana katika biashara), hifadhi ya thamani (inashikilia thamani yake kwa muda ili uweze kuiweka akiba), na kipimo cha hesabu (kipimo cha pamoja cha kulinganisha thamani ya vitu tofauti sana — ng'ombe ana thamani ya kuku wangapi?).

f2aeb872ed85.en: Borrowed buying power that lets a trader control a position much larger than their own capital alone would allow, expressed as a ratio (e.g., 50:1).
f2aeb872ed85.sw: Uwezo wa kununua uliokopwa unaomruhusu mfanyabiashara kudhibiti nafasi kubwa zaidi kuliko mtaji wake mwenyewe ungeruhusu, ukielezwa kama uwiano (mfano, 50:1).

f2e10d365ebc.en: None of this means candlestick reading is worthless. It means the confident claims — "this three-candle shape predicts reversals" — rest on far thinner and more contested evidence than the support-and-resistance core. The wider technical-analysis literature is mixed in the same honest way: Brock, Lakonishok and LeBaron (Lesson 1) found real predictive ability in moving-average rules on a century of Dow data, while the forex-specific Ghanem et al. study you met in Foundations Chapter 3 found technical rules do predict currency moves. Support has a mechanism and forex-specific evidence; candlestick patterns have neither at the same strength. Weight them accordingly.
f2e10d365ebc.sw: Hakuna kati ya haya kinachomaanisha usomaji wa mishumaa hauna thamani. Kunamaanisha madai ya uhakika — "umbo hili la mishumaa mitatu hutabiri migeuko" — yanategemea ushahidi mwembamba zaidi na wenye mgogoro zaidi kuliko kiini cha msaada-na-upinzani. Fasihi pana ya uchambuzi wa kiufundi imechanganyika kwa njia ile ile ya uaminifu: Brock, Lakonishok na LeBaron (Somo la 1) walipata uwezo halisi wa kutabiri katika kanuni za wastani unaosogea kwenye karne moja ya data ya Dow, ilhali utafiti mahususi wa forex wa Ghanem et al. uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 3 ya Msingi uligundua kanuni za kiufundi hutabiri misogeo ya sarafu. Msaada una utaratibu na ushahidi mahususi wa forex; mitindo ya mishumaa haina wala kimoja kwa nguvu ile ile. Vipe uzito ipasavyo.

f3285a77dd2d.en: A statistical measure of how spread out values are around their average. The more volatile the prices, the larger the standard deviation — so the bands automatically widen in volatile markets and tighten in calm ones.
f3285a77dd2d.sw: Kipimo cha kitakwimu cha jinsi thamani zilivyotawanyika kuzunguka wastani wao. Kadri bei zinavyokuwa na mtikisiko zaidi, ndivyo mkengeuko sanifu unavyokuwa mkubwa zaidi — hivyo kanda hupanuka kiotomatiki katika masoko yenye mtikisiko na kubana katika yaliyo tulivu.

f3302227be0e.en: Not quite — standard models called this move nearly impossible and it happened anyway. Fat tails are normal; no model rules extreme moves out.
f3302227be0e.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — miundo sanifu iliuita msogeo huu karibu hauwezekani na ulitokea hata hivyo. Mikia minene ni ya kawaida; hakuna muundo unaoondoa misogeo ya kupindukia.

f341df7e616d.en: True or False: a strict gold standard makes it easier for a government to fight a recession.
f341df7e616d.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kiwango kikali cha dhahabu hurahisisha serikali kupambana na mdororo wa uchumi.

f36fd5e2d039.en: As you look at any pair or liquidity claim, ask yourself: is a "most traded" or "most liquid" claim backed by a specific, current, named source — or just stated as common knowledge? For an unfamiliar pair, does it include USD, and if so is the other side a major or an emerging currency? If there's no USD at all, it's a minor/cross pair. And remember that rankings change over time — treat any specific ranking as a snapshot, not a permanent fact.
f36fd5e2d039.sw: Unapotazama jozi lolote au dai lolote la ukwasi, jiulize: je, dai la "linalofanyiwa biashara zaidi" au "lenye ukwasi zaidi" linaungwa mkono na chanzo mahususi, cha sasa, kilichotajwa — au limetamkwa tu kama maarifa ya kawaida? Kwa jozi lisilofahamika, je, linajumuisha USD, na kama ndiyo, je, upande mwingine ni sarafu kuu au inayoibukia? Kama hakuna USD kabisa, ni jozi ndogo/la kuvuka. Na kumbuka madaraja hubadilika kwa muda — chukulia daraja lolote mahususi kama picha ya wakati, si ukweli wa kudumu.

f3b9ba461034.en: Not quite — a trader with an excellent prediction record can still fail without proper risk management. One large, uncontrolled loss can erase many small wins.
f3b9ba461034.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — mfanyabiashara mwenye rekodi bora ya utabiri anaweza bado kushindwa bila usimamizi sahihi wa hatari. Hasara moja kubwa isiyodhibitiwa inaweza kufuta ushindi mdogo mwingi.

f3ce758c76a9.en: A roulette wheel is not like this. The wheel produces nothing. Every unit won by one player is a unit lost by another, minus the house edge — which makes it negative-sum for the players taken together.
f3ce758c76a9.sw: Gurudumu la roulette si hivi. Gurudumu halizalishi chochote. Kila kipimo kinachoshindwa na mchezaji mmoja ni kipimo kinachopotea kwa mwingine, kutoa faida ya kasino — ambako hufanya iwe jumla-hasi kwa wachezaji kwa pamoja.

f45c20bf5682.en: Positive expected value is not a guarantee and it is not comfort. It says the average of many repetitions is favourable. You get one life, not many repetitions, which is exactly why position sizing exists and why Chapter 3 spends a chapter on it.
f45c20bf5682.sw: Thamani chanya inayotarajiwa si uhakika na si faraja. Inasema wastani wa marudio mengi ni wa manufaa. Unapata maisha moja, si marudio mengi, ambayo ndiyo hasa sababu upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi upo na kwa nini Sura ya 3 hutumia sura nzima juu yake.

f4651c347d7e.en: Fat tails (Chapter 2, Lesson 2). The trader who internalised that extreme moves are normal, not impossible, sized and prepared for one. The trader who trusted the once-in-ten-thousand-years math did not.
f4651c347d7e.sw: Mikia minene (Sura ya 2, Somo la 2). Mfanyabiashara aliyeingiza ndani yake kwamba misogeo ya kupindukia ni ya kawaida, si isiyowezekana, alipima na kujiandaa kwa moja. Mfanyabiashara aliyeamini hisabati ya mara moja katika miaka elfu kumi hakufanya hivyo.

f4891bc9d4ed.en: Because casinos change the odds for skilled players
f4891bc9d4ed.sw: Kwa sababu kasino hubadilisha uwezekano kwa wachezaji wenye ustadi

f492dc2e6523.en: The single best-documented trading mistake has a name, and once you know it you will see it everywhere — including in your own account.
f492dc2e6523.sw: Kosa la biashara lililoandikwa vizuri zaidi lina jina, na mara ukilijua utaliona kila mahali — ikiwemo katika akaunti yako mwenyewe.

f53ff1ed70de.en: An exchange rate set by open market supply and demand.
f53ff1ed70de.sw: Kiwango cha ubadilishaji kilichowekwa na ugavi na mahitaji ya soko huria.

f55322fe8746.en: The difference between two EMAs plus a signal line — a formalized crossover.
f55322fe8746.sw: Tofauti kati ya EMA mbili pamoja na mstari wa ishara — mkatizo uliorasimishwa.

f5af113a89e5.en: The average profit or loss to expect per trade over many trades, calculated as (win rate times average win) minus (loss rate times average loss). Positive expectancy means the system makes money over time; negative means it loses, however good it feels along the way.
f5af113a89e5.sw: Faida au hasara ya wastani ya kutarajia kwa kila biashara katika biashara nyingi, inayokokotolewa kama (kiwango cha ushindi mara ushindi wa wastani) toa (kiwango cha hasara mara hasara ya wastani). Matarajio chanya yanamaanisha mfumo hupata pesa kwa muda; hasi inamaanisha hupoteza, hata ukihisi vizuri kiasi gani njiani.

f5afa5ebabc5.en: Neither moves, because the gains and losses cancel out
f5afa5ebabc5.sw: Hakuna inayosogea, kwa sababu faida na hasara hufutana

f5cc3cb810c1.sw: MACD (Muunganiko na Utengano wa Wastani Unaosogea)

f5cd569c27a9.en: The reality that extreme price moves occur far more often than the bell curve predicts.
f5cd569c27a9.sw: Uhalisia kwamba misogeo ya kupindukia ya bei hutokea mara nyingi zaidi kuliko mkunjo wa kengele unavyotabiri.

f5d56ade0473.en: Diagram of a naked candlestick chart bouncing at a round-number support level, with the order-flow mechanism annotated, above a verdict strip contrasting the strong forex-specific evidence for support and resistance against the contested evidence for candlestick patterns
f5d56ade0473.sw: Mchoro wa chati tupu ya mishumaa ikiruka kwenye kiwango cha msaada cha namba ya mviringo, ukiwa na utaratibu wa mtiririko wa maagizo ukielezwa, juu ya ukanda wa hukumu unaolinganisha ushahidi imara mahususi wa forex kwa msaada na upinzani dhidi ya ushahidi wenye mgogoro kwa mitindo ya mishumaa

f5ea65dc0b8d.en: In the pair USD/JPY = 149.50, which currency is the base currency?
f5ea65dc0b8d.sw: Katika jozi USD/JPY = 149.50, sarafu ipi ni sarafu ya msingi?

f61b2c9e5086.en: The index provider charges investors a fee at each review
f61b2c9e5086.sw: Mtoa index hutoza wawekezaji ada katika kila ukaguzi

f6362c968873.en: Inflation from demand growing faster than supply.
f6362c968873.sw: Mfumuko wa bei unaotokana na mahitaji kukua kwa kasi zaidi kuliko ugavi.

f658f990dc86.en: Search any chart pattern's "success rate" and you'll find numbers like "70% for head-and-shoulders" or "88% for a double bottom." These trace back overwhelmingly to one source: Thomas Bulkowski, a private investor who published his own backtested statistics in books and on a personal website — not peer-reviewed, not independently replicated, and by his own data, not stable across time (failure rates nearly doubled between the bullish 1990s and the more volatile 2000s).
f658f990dc86.sw: Tafuta "kiwango cha mafanikio" cha mtindo wowote wa chati na utapata namba kama "70% kwa head-and-shoulders" au "88% kwa double bottom." Hizi zinarudi kwa wingi mkubwa kwenye chanzo kimoja: Thomas Bulkowski, mwekezaji binafsi aliyechapisha takwimu zake mwenyewe za majaribio ya nyuma katika vitabu na kwenye tovuti binafsi — hazikukaguliwa na wenzake, hazikurudiwa kwa kujitegemea, na kwa mujibu wa data yake mwenyewe, si thabiti kwa muda (viwango vya kushindwa vilikaribia kuongezeka mara mbili kati ya miaka ya 1990 ya kupanda na miaka ya 2000 yenye mtikisiko zaidi).

f6596fcc71bf.en: The process of actually exchanging shares for money after a trade is agreed. It happens a set number of business days after the trade date.
f6596fcc71bf.sw: Mchakato wa kubadilishana hisa kwa pesa hasa baada ya biashara kukubaliwa. Hutokea idadi iliyowekwa ya siku za kazi baada ya tarehe ya biashara.

f671700f4d1e.en: A company earns 1.00 a share and pays a dividend of 1.30. What does this tell you?
f671700f4d1e.sw: Kampuni hupata 1.00 kwa hisa na hulipa gawio la 1.30. Hii hukuambia nini?

f67a45bd5ee6.en: Because currencies float — their values set by supply and demand, not fixed to gold or to each other — exchange rates are never still. They move constantly, sometimes by the minute.
f67a45bd5ee6.sw: Kwa sababu sarafu huelea — thamani zao zikiwekwa na ugavi na mahitaji, si kufungwa kwenye dhahabu au kwa kila mmoja — viwango vya ubadilishaji havitulii kamwe. Vinasogea kila wakati, wakati mwingine kwa dakika.

f6b69d157004.en: The price at which you actually open a position.
f6b69d157004.sw: Bei ambayo kwayo unafungua nafasi hasa.

f6c1c9bfcd4f.en: A paper document promising the holder can redeem it for a real asset — in this case gold — on demand. Merchant receipts like this existed in China as early as the 7th century; goldsmiths in 17th-century England ran a very similar system.
f6c1c9bfcd4f.sw: Hati ya karatasi inayoahidi kwamba mwenye nayo anaweza kuikomboa kwa mali halisi — katika kesi hii dhahabu — anapotaka. Risiti za wafanyabiashara kama hizi zilikuwepo China mapema kama karne ya 7; wahunzi wa dhahabu katika Uingereza ya karne ya 17 waliendesha mfumo unaofanana sana.

f6cf7a718b10.en: In prisoner-of-war camps during the Second World War, cigarettes functioned as real, working currency — divisible, portable, and valued by everyone (even non-smokers) because everyone knew everyone else would accept them. Prices were quoted "in cigarettes," debts were tracked in cigarettes, and the camp's money supply rose and fell with Red Cross parcel deliveries. This is a real, documented case (R.A. Radford's 1945 account of a WWII POW camp economy) — and it's the cleanest proof that money is about trust and function, not what it's made of.
f6cf7a718b10.sw: Katika kambi za wafungwa wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, sigara zilifanya kazi kama sarafu halisi inayofanya kazi — zinazoweza kugawanywa, kubebeka, na kuthaminiwa na kila mtu (hata wasiovuta) kwa sababu kila mtu alijua kwamba kila mtu mwingine angezikubali. Bei zilinukuliwa "kwa sigara," madeni yalifuatiliwa kwa sigara, na kiasi cha pesa cha kambi kilipanda na kushuka kulingana na uwasilishaji wa vifurushi vya Msalaba Mwekundu. Hii ni kesi halisi iliyorekodiwa (maelezo ya R.A. Radford ya mwaka 1945 kuhusu uchumi wa kambi ya wafungwa wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia) — na ndio uthibitisho ulio wazi zaidi kwamba pesa inahusu imani na kazi, si kile iliyotengenezwa nacho.

f6f1642fcc79.en: The possibility a decision doesn't go as intended, exposing you to loss.
f6f1642fcc79.sw: Uwezekano kwamba uamuzi hauendi kama ulivyokusudiwa, ukikuweka wazi kwa hasara.

f6f81c6b8890.en: This worked for a while — countries could hold U.S. dollars as reserves instead of physically shipping gold, making cross-border trade faster and cheaper. But a structural problem was building underneath it.
f6f81c6b8890.sw: Hii ilifanya kazi kwa muda — nchi zingeweza kushikilia dola za Marekani kama akiba badala ya kusafirisha dhahabu kimwili, na kufanya biashara ya kuvuka mipaka iwe ya haraka na ya bei nafuu zaidi. Lakini tatizo la kimuundo lilikuwa likijengeka chini yake.

f71bab11986e.en: A company using cash to buy its own shares in the market and cancel them, leaving each remaining share entitled to a larger slice of the same business.
f71bab11986e.sw: Kampuni kutumia fedha kununua hisa zake mwenyewe sokoni na kuzifuta, ikiacha kila hisa iliyobaki ikiwa na haki ya kipande kikubwa zaidi cha biashara ile ile.

f72b0938a865.en: True or False: in a short position, your stop-loss is placed below your entry price.
f72b0938a865.sw: Kweli au Uongo: katika nafasi ya short, stop-loss yako inawekwa chini ya bei yako ya kuingia.

f77dd70be86a.en: With 50:1 leverage, the required margin is 1/50 = 2% of the position size. To open a $50,000 EUR/USD position, you'd need $1,000 of your own capital as margin — the broker effectively fronts the remaining $49,000 of exposure.
f77dd70be86a.sw: Kwa leverage ya 50:1, margin inayohitajika ni 1/50 = 2% ya ukubwa wa nafasi. Kufungua nafasi ya EUR/USD ya $50,000, ungehitaji $1,000 ya mtaji wako mwenyewe kama margin — broker kwa hakika hutanguliza uwazi uliobaki wa $49,000.

f77faed1b4f2.en: The principle that a trader's or manager's most rigorously analysed ideas deserve more capital than their weaker ones, because the strongest ideas carry most of the edge.
f77faed1b4f2.sw: Kanuni kwamba mawazo ya mfanyabiashara au msimamizi yaliyochambuliwa kwa ukamilifu zaidi yanastahili mtaji zaidi kuliko yale dhaifu, kwa sababu mawazo imara zaidi hubeba faida nyingi.

f78a19f9018f.en: The most liquid pairs in the market
f78a19f9018f.sw: Jozi yenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi sokoni

f7aa9555b39d.en: Correct. Shareholders hold the residual — what is left after fixed obligations. Because those obligations do not shrink with revenue, the whole shortfall lands on the residual, so the shareholders' claim moves by much more than revenue does. This is why share prices are more volatile than the businesses underneath them.
f7aa9555b39d.sw: Sahihi. Wanahisa hushikilia mabaki — kilichobaki baada ya majukumu thabiti. Kwa sababu majukumu hayo hayapungui pamoja na mapato, upungufu wote hutua kwenye mabaki, hivyo dai la wanahisa husogea kwa zaidi mno kuliko mapato yanavyosogea. Ndiyo sababu bei za hisa zina mtikisiko zaidi kuliko biashara zilizo chini yake.

f7b8ca20a8a7.en: The series 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... where each number is the sum of the previous two. Dividing a number by its successor converges to ≈0.618 — the "golden ratio" relationship; dividing by the number two positions later gives ≈0.382, and three later ≈0.236.
f7b8ca20a8a7.sw: Mfululizo 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... ambapo kila namba ni jumla ya mbili zilizotangulia. Kugawanya namba kwa inayoifuata huungana kuelekea ≈0.618 — uhusiano wa "uwiano wa dhahabu"; kugawanya kwa namba iliyo nafasi mbili baadaye hutoa ≈0.382, na tatu baadaye ≈0.236.

f7bfdebdddbe.en: Revenue fell 10 percent. The shareholders claim fell 100 percent. That is what ranking last means.
f7bfdebdddbe.sw: Mapato yalishuka asilimia 10. Dai la wanahisa lilishuka asilimia 100. Ndivyo kuwa wa mwisho kwenye daraja kunavyomaanisha.

f7c96d70bb28.en: A stop-loss that automatically moves with the price as a trade becomes more profitable, locking in gains without requiring you to manually adjust it.
f7c96d70bb28.sw: Stop-loss inayosogea kiotomatiki pamoja na bei biashara inapopata faida zaidi, ikihifadhi faida bila kukuhitaji uirekebishe kwa mkono.

f7d0b4be96af.en: Calculating exactly how much of a currency to buy or sell in a trade, based on your account size, your risk tolerance, and your stop-loss distance.
f7d0b4be96af.sw: Kukokotoa hasa kiasi gani cha sarafu cha kununua au kuuza katika biashara, kwa msingi wa ukubwa wa akaunti yako, uvumilivu wako wa hatari, na umbali wa stop-loss yako.

f7d0d1b85997.en: The standard unit for measuring a price move in most currency pairs. For most pairs, one pip is the fourth decimal place (0.0001).
f7d0d1b85997.sw: Kipimo sanifu cha kupima msogeo wa bei katika jozi nyingi za sarafu. Kwa jozi nyingi, pip moja ni nafasi ya nne ya desimali (0.0001).

f802fb679600.en: On August 15, 1971, President Nixon announced the U.S. would suspend the dollar's convertibility into gold — "closing the gold window." What was framed as temporary turned out to be permanent. A brief patch (the Smithsonian Agreement, December 1971) failed, and by 1973 major currencies had abandoned fixed pegs entirely.
f802fb679600.sw: Tarehe 15 Agosti 1971, Rais Nixon alitangaza kwamba Marekani ingesimamisha ubadilishaji wa dola kuwa dhahabu — "kufunga dirisha la dhahabu." Kilichowasilishwa kama cha muda kiligeuka kuwa cha kudumu. Kiraka cha muda mfupi (Makubaliano ya Smithsonian, Desemba 1971) kilishindwa, na kufikia mwaka 1973 sarafu kuu zilikuwa zimeacha vifungo thabiti kabisa.

f84503889a8e.en: The reversal in AUD/JPY was brutal. Between July and October 2008 the pair fell by roughly 45%, from about 104 to below 57, reaching a low near 55 in October 2008 — nearly halving in a matter of months. The yen strengthened sharply across the board as capital fled risky assets and rushed home to safety. Traders who had earned a few percent a year in interest lost many times that in currency losses in a few weeks.
f84503889a8e.sw: Mgeuko katika AUD/JPY ulikuwa mkali. Kati ya Julai na Oktoba 2008 jozi lilishuka kwa takriban 45%, kutoka takriban 104 hadi chini ya 57, likifikia kiwango cha chini karibu na 55 mwezi Oktoba 2008 — likikaribia kupungua nusu ndani ya miezi michache. Yen iliimarika kwa kasi kote kadri mtaji ulivyokimbia mali hatarishi na kukimbilia nyumbani kwa usalama. Wafanyabiashara waliokuwa wamepata asilimia chache kwa mwaka kwa riba walipoteza mara nyingi zaidi ya hiyo kwa hasara za sarafu ndani ya wiki chache.

f88e06aafe29.en: Here is what the difference actually does. The figures below assume 10,000 invested for 30 years with an underlying return of 7% a year, and they are computed rather than estimated.
f88e06aafe29.sw: Hii hapa tofauti inafanya nini hasa. Takwimu zilizo hapa chini hudhania 10,000 zimewekezwa kwa miaka 30 kwa faida ya msingi ya 7% kwa mwaka, na zimekokotolewa badala ya kukadiriwa.

f8aaa97f9ebb.en: Being last in the queue sounds like a bad deal, and on the downside it is. The compensation sits on the other side: the residual has no ceiling. A lender who is owed 10 receives 10 whether the company earns 100 or 100,000. The shareholders receive everything above the obligations, however large that becomes.
f8aaa97f9ebb.sw: Kuwa wa mwisho kwenye foleni kunasikika kama mkataba mbaya, na upande wa chini ni hivyo. Fidia inakaa upande mwingine: mabaki hayana dari. Mkopeshaji anayedaiwa 10 hupokea 10 iwe kampuni ilipata 100 au 100,000. Wanahisa hupokea kila kitu kilicho juu ya majukumu, kikubwa kiasi chochote kile.

f8e404baebf1.en: Around any central bank meeting, hold these habits: ask not "will they hike?" but "what does the market already expect, and what would surprise it?" Watch for hawkish/dovish language in policymaker speeches between meetings — markets move on these long before any decision. When you hear "high interest rates mean a strong currency," remember the forward premium puzzle: true as an instinct, unreliable as a rule. And treat carry-trade interest income as compensation for real crash risk, not free money — size positions accordingly (Chapter 1, Lesson 5).
f8e404baebf1.sw: Kuzunguka mkutano wowote wa benki kuu, shikilia tabia hizi: uliza si "je, watapandisha?" bali "soko tayari linatarajia nini, na ni nini kingelishangaza?" Tazama lugha ya hawkish/dovish katika hotuba za watunga sera kati ya mikutano — masoko husogea kwa hizi muda mrefu kabla ya uamuzi wowote. Unaposikia "viwango vya juu vya riba vinamaanisha sarafu imara," kumbuka fumbo la malipo ya mbele: kweli kama silika, isiyotegemewa kama kanuni. Na chukulia mapato ya riba ya carry trade kama fidia kwa hatari halisi ya kuanguka, si pesa za bure — pima nafasi ipasavyo (Sura ya 1, Somo la 5).

f951fe1c2c79.sw: Bei zile zile tatu, mpangilio wa kinyume — kwa sababu mwelekeo unaoubashiri nao ni wa kinyume.

f952eb576926.en: The stated purpose was to reduce the risk that builds up while a trade is agreed but not yet completed. A shorter window means less time for either side to fail, and less exposure to price movement in between.
f952eb576926.sw: Kusudi lililotajwa lilikuwa kupunguza hatari inayojengeka wakati biashara imekubaliwa lakini bado haijakamilika. Dirisha fupi linamaanisha muda mdogo kwa upande wowote kushindwa, na uwazi mdogo kwa msogeo wa bei katikati.

f96dbb4dd373.en: In late 2021, U.S. inflation ran notably higher than Eurozone inflation. The textbook expectation was a weaker dollar. Instead, the dollar traded near a 16-month high against the euro — fears of renewed European COVID lockdowns outweighed the inflation differential. The relationship wasn't wrong; it was overridden.
f96dbb4dd373.sw: Mwishoni mwa mwaka 2021, mfumuko wa bei wa Marekani ulikuwa juu zaidi kwa kiasi kikubwa kuliko wa Eneo la Euro. Matarajio ya kitabu yalikuwa dola dhaifu. Badala yake, dola ilifanyiwa biashara karibu na kiwango cha juu zaidi cha miezi 16 dhidi ya euro — hofu ya kufungwa upya kwa Ulaya kwa sababu ya COVID zilizidi tofauti ya mfumuko wa bei. Uhusiano haukuwa batili; ulizidiwa nguvu tu.

f989aa94b432.en: Not quite. The bias comes from the arithmetic of the ratio. A falling price raises yield without any improvement in the business, and companies returning cash through buybacks are invisible to a yield screen entirely.
f989aa94b432.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Upendeleo hutoka kwa hesabu ya uwiano. Bei inayoshuka hupandisha mavuno bila uboreshaji wowote katika biashara, na kampuni zinazorudisha fedha kupitia ununuzi upya hazionekani kabisa kwa chujio la mavuno.

f9ae928b6083.en: Forex: central banks fight high inflation by raising interest rates, which tends to attract foreign capital and strengthen a currency.
f9ae928b6083.sw: Forex: benki kuu hupambana na mfumuko mkubwa wa bei kwa kupandisha viwango vya riba, jambo linaloelekea kuvutia mtaji wa kigeni na kuimarisha sarafu.

f9d73f1de13c.en: GBP/USD is trading at 1.27. Pip value = 10 pounds x 1.27 = 12.70 US dollars per pip on a standard lot. Not 10 dollars — about a quarter more.
f9d73f1de13c.sw: GBP/USD inafanyiwa biashara kwa 1.27. Thamani ya pip = pauni 10 x 1.27 = dola 12.70 za Marekani kwa kila pip kwenye lot sanifu. Si dola 10 — takriban robo moja zaidi.

fa00c8c0756f.sw: Kipimo cha umiliki katika kampuni. Kumiliki moja hukufanya kuwa mmiliki mshirika wa biashara yenyewe — si mkopeshaji kwake, wala mteja wake.

fa05affb89d8.sw: Sahihi — stop iliyoanzishwa hukuwa agizo la soko na hutimizwa kwa bei yoyote iliyopo. Tarehe 15 Januari 2015 hakukuwa na ukwasi karibu, hivyo stop zilitimizwa mamia ya pip mbali, au hazikutimizwa kabisa.

fb394cec0eb8.sw: Shughuli ambapo faida ya mshiriki mmoja ni hasara ya mwingine hasa. Hakuna kinachoundwa; chungu hugawanywa upya tu.

fbc1bf98c396.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — mkatizo unamaanisha tu kwamba bei 20 za mwisho za kufunga sasa zinawastani chini ya 50 za mwisho. Husomwa kama ya kushuka, lakini haihakikishi chochote kuhusu bei itakayofanya baadaye.

fc02159833ec.sw: Katika Somo la 1, kubadilisha dola kuwa peso kulimaanisha kufanya kazi na sarafu mbili kwa wakati mmoja. Kuna neno mahususi kwa uhusiano huo.

fc10685014c2.en: A genuinely positive-expectancy system can lose over 5, 10, even 20 trades in a row — that is normal variance, not a broken system, and it is the same fat-tailed, streaky randomness you met in Chapter 2. Just as dangerous in reverse: a losing system can win for a while by pure chance, tempting you to trust it and size up. You cannot judge a system, or yourself, on a handful of trades. This is exactly why the plan includes a review over a meaningful sample, and why your risk per trade must be small enough (Chapter 3, Lesson 1) to survive the inevitable losing streaks while the edge has time to show.
fc10685014c2.sw: Mfumo wenye matarajio chanya kweli unaweza kupoteza katika biashara 5, 10, hata 20 mfululizo — huo ni utofauti wa kawaida, si mfumo ulioharibika, na ni ubahatishaji ule ule wa mikia minene na wa mfululizo uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 2. Hatari sawa kwa kinyume: mfumo unaopoteza unaweza kushinda kwa muda kwa bahati tu, ukikushawishi uuamini na kuongeza ukubwa. Huwezi kuhukumu mfumo, wala nafsi yako, kwa biashara chache. Hii ndiyo hasa sababu mpango unajumuisha kupitia katika sampuli yenye maana, na kwa nini hatari yako kwa kila biashara lazima iwe ndogo vya kutosha (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1) kunusurika mifululizo ya hasara isiyoepukika huku faida ikiwa na muda wa kujitokeza.

fc4e3b8e0c3f.sw: Soko lisilo na mwelekeo, kichocheo, wala nguzo iliyolingana — ambapo nafasi sahihi kwa kawaida ni fedha taslimu.

fc5f971b755b.sw: Tokeo imara la kimajaribio kwamba UIP hushindwa — sarafu za viwango vya juu mara nyingi huimarika badala yake.

fc7726436736.sw: Viwango kwa 23.6/38.2/50/61.8/78.6% ya msogeo, vinavyotazamwa kama kanda za kurudi nyuma.

fc77a1532b08.sw: Dirisha huteleza bei moja ya kufunga kwa wakati, na mahali 20 inapokatiza 50 huashiria ishara — pamoja na whipsaw ya mara kwa mara iliyojengwa ndani.

fcc01cdb1391.en: This is why the arithmetic earlier is not pedantry. When the Swiss National Bank floor collapsed in 2015 (Chapter 1, Lesson 7), the traders who survived were not the ones who predicted it — they were the ones whose positions were small enough that a violent move could not end them. Correct pip value feeds correct position size, and correct position size is what keeps you at the table long enough for an edge to matter.
fcc01cdb1391.sw: Ndiyo sababu hesabu ya awali si udogo wa kupita kiasi. Sakafu ya Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilipoanguka mwaka 2015 (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7), wafanyabiashara walionusurika hawakuwa wale walioitabiri — walikuwa wale ambao nafasi zao zilikuwa ndogo vya kutosha kiasi kwamba msogeo wa nguvu haungeweza kuwamaliza. Thamani sahihi ya pip hulisha ukubwa sahihi wa nafasi, na ukubwa sahihi wa nafasi ndicho kinachokuweka mezani muda mrefu vya kutosha ili faida ihusike.

fccb59365ba1.en: Every country issues its own currency. A Canadian dollar is legal tender in Canada — but it's just a piece of paper anywhere else. Cross a border, and you need the local currency to buy anything.
fccb59365ba1.sw: Kila nchi hutoa sarafu yake yenyewe. Dola ya Kanada ni halali kisheria nchini Kanada — lakini ni kipande cha karatasi tu mahali pengine popote. Vuka mpaka, na unahitaji sarafu ya humo ili kununua chochote.

fcd35943616b.en: Effective leverage (Chapter 3, Lesson 2). The accounts that went negative were running high effective leverage, so a gap larger than their free-margin cushion blew straight through it. Low effective leverage was the difference between a scare and a ruin.
fcd35943616b.sw: Leverage halisi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2). Akaunti zilizokuwa hasi zilikuwa zikiendesha leverage halisi kubwa, hivyo kuruka kukubwa kuliko mto wao wa margin huru kulipenya moja kwa moja. Leverage halisi ndogo ndiyo ilikuwa tofauti kati ya woga na uharibifu.

fd3b0cbec57b.sw: Mitindo ya mishumaa. Hii ndiyo zana yenye undani zaidi katika seti.

fe43315eb468.en: In trading, following a pre-committed plan — entry, stop, target, and size — regardless of what you feel in the moment. It is a system for removing in-the-moment decisions, not a personality trait.
fe43315eb468.sw: Katika biashara, kufuata mpango uliojitolewa mapema — kuingia, stop, lengo, na ukubwa — bila kujali unachohisi kwa wakati huo. Ni mfumo wa kuondoa maamuzi ya papo hapo, si sifa ya tabia.

fe8e7a33b4a0.en: Real, current spread data (2026) gives a useful sense of scale. On EUR/USD — the most liquid pair in the world — the industry-average spread across retail brokers sits around 0.88 pips on a standard, commission-free account, working out to roughly $8.80 per standard lot round-trip. On "raw" or ECN-style accounts, the quoted spread often drops close to 0.0–0.2 pips, but the broker charges a separate commission (typically $3–7 per lot round-trip) instead — the total cost usually lands in a similar range either way, just structured differently.
fe8e7a33b4a0.sw: Data halisi ya sasa ya spread (2026) inatoa hisia ya manufaa ya ukubwa. Kwenye EUR/USD — jozi lenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi duniani — spread ya wastani wa sekta katika mabroker wa rejareja iko karibu pip 0.88 kwenye akaunti sanifu isiyo na kamisheni, ikitokea kuwa takriban $8.80 kwa lot sanifu ya kwenda na kurudi. Kwenye akaunti za "raw" au za mtindo wa ECN, spread inayonukuliwa mara nyingi hushuka karibu na pip 0.0–0.2, lakini broker hutoza kamisheni tofauti (kwa kawaida $3–7 kwa lot ya kwenda na kurudi) badala yake — gharama ya jumla kwa kawaida hufikia kiwango kinachofanana kwa vyovyote vile, ikiwa imepangwa tofauti tu.

ff246795b616.en: A position that profits if the price goes down. You're effectively selling now, expecting to buy back later at a lower price.
ff246795b616.sw: Nafasi inayopata faida kama bei itashuka. Kwa hakika unauza sasa, ukitarajia kununua tena baadaye kwa bei ya chini zaidi.

ff3e701a7507.en: Correct — their landmark finding was that a positive spread emerges even at zero expected profit, purely from the need to protect against adverse selection. Real-world spreads also reflect order-processing costs and inventory risk, not profit motive alone.
ff3e701a7507.sw: Sahihi — tokeo lao muhimu lilikuwa kwamba spread chanya hujitokeza hata kwa faida sifuri inayotarajiwa, kutokana tu na hitaji la kujilinda dhidi ya uteuzi mbaya. Spread za dunia halisi pia huakisi gharama za kushughulikia maagizo na hatari ya hifadhi, si lengo la faida peke yake.

ff757a6e8a0c.sw: Bei au hali ambapo nadharia inathibitishwa kuwa batili — mahali stop-loss inapostahili kuwa.

ff79b6aca814.en: The message is not "own fewer things for its own sake." It is that spreading capital evenly across strong and weak ideas alike drags your strong ideas down toward the average. Weight follows conviction — the real, six-pillar conviction of Lesson 1, not a feeling.
ff79b6aca814.sw: Ujumbe si "miliki vitu vichache kwa ajili yake yenyewe." Ni kwamba kusambaza mtaji sawasawa katika mawazo imara na dhaifu sawasawa huvuta mawazo yako imara kuelekea wastani. Uzito hufuata uhakika — uhakika halisi wa nguzo sita wa Somo la 1, si hisia.

ff98cc2242e5.en: Correct — the stop belongs at the invalidation level, where being wrong becomes a fact, not at an arbitrary distance and never absent on a "sure thing."
ff98cc2242e5.sw: Sahihi — stop inastahili kuwa kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika, pale kukosea kunapokuwa ukweli, si kwa umbali wa bahati nasibu na kamwe si kutokuwepo kwenye "jambo la uhakika."

ffcf0583bffe.en: You hold a position with a take-profit limit order at one price and a stop-loss order at another. Whichever level price reaches first executes; the other order is automatically removed. You don't have to manually cancel anything or monitor the position constantly.
ffcf0583bffe.sw: Unashikilia nafasi yenye agizo la kikomo la take-profit kwa bei moja na agizo la stop-loss kwa nyingine. Kiwango chochote ambacho bei itakifikia kwanza hutekelezwa; agizo lingine huondolewa kiotomatiki. Huhitaji kufuta chochote kwa mkono wala kufuatilia nafasi kila mara.
